article.articleHeadline: Promueven la prevención y el testeo voluntario de la hepatitis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They promote hepatitis prevention and voluntary testing.
article.articleSummary: Entre Ríos Province, Argentina—The provincial Health Ministry, via the VIH/ITS, Hepatitis Virales and Tuberculosis Coordination, will host a hepatitis prevention, counseling, and voluntary testing event on Monday, August 3, at Plaza 1° de Mayo in Paraná, from 9:00 to 12:00, commemorating World Hepatitis Day (July 28, the birth date of Baruch Blumberg, discoverer of hepatitis B virus). Coordinated by Francisco Astudilla, the initiative promotes early diagnosis and timely treatment for hepatitis B and C. Two testing approaches will be offered: a capillary finger-prick rapid test with 15-minute results to indicate exposure, and a venous blood test processed in a lab to assess vaccination status, past infection, cure, or need for treatment. Tests are voluntary, rapid, and confidential. Emphasis on ongoing prevention, safe-sex practices with condoms, early consultations, and vaccination when indicated; hepatitis C is curable, hepatitis B chronic disease has treatment.

article.articleHeadline: مختبرات "هيلمان" تطور لقاحا ضد "إيبولا" والصحة العالمية ترجح نجاحه
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Helman Laboratories have developed a vaccine against Ebola, and the World Health Organization expects it to be successful.
article.articleSummary: As of July 31, 2026, Singapore-based Helman Laboratories unveiled a candidate Ebola vaccine targeting the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists. The World Health Organization described it as the most likely to succeed in addressing an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Helman said it would accelerate development to begin human clinical trials, leveraging the rVSV platform used in Ervebo, the currently approved Ebola vaccine. A key advantage cited is that the new vaccine can be stored for months in standard refrigerators, reducing cost and easing distribution to remote areas, unlike Ervebo, which requires ultra-cold storage. The announcement centers on vaccine development progress rather than finalized efficacy data, with no current approval or licensing yet described.

article.articleHeadline: Sesau orienta população sobre Síndrome Mão-Pé-Boca
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sesau guides the public on Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease (HFMD) awareness campaign by Alagoinhas’ Sesau, Brazil, educates the public on HFMD care. HFMD is highly contagious, caused by enteroviruses (notably Coxsackieviruses), affecting mainly children under five and infants. Transmission occurs via direct contact or contaminated objects, making rapid recognition crucial to prevent daycare and school outbreaks. Incubation is 3–7 days; illness lasts 7–10 days. Common symptoms include fever, sore throat, malaise, loss of appetite, painful mouth ulcers, and small blisters or red spots on the palms and soles, possibly on buttocks, legs, or genital area. No vaccine exists; prevention relies on strict hygiene and respiratory etiquette: frequent handwashing with soap or 70% alcohol, do not share cups, utensils, pacifiers, bottles, towels, or toys; clean shared surfaces. Sick children should stay home until fever and active lesions resolve and medical clearance is obtained. Treatment is symptomatic: rest, fluids, soft foods, and prescribed analgesics.

article.articleHeadline: Virus Nipah Tailandia Qué Saber Antes De Viajar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah Virus in Thailand: What to Know Before You Travel
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus in Thailand is a travel concern but warrants prudent, not panicked, conduct. Nipah is a zoonotic virus linked to fruit bats and intermediate hosts, with rapid outbreak investigations including contact tracing and reinforced hospital measures in Asia. For travelers, the overall risk to the general population remains low unless there is direct animal exposure, consumption of contaminated foods, or exposure in healthcare settings with transmission. Early symptoms resemble other infections (fever, headache, malaise, cough, fatigue) and can progress to neurological involvement. Warning signs include persistent fever, severe headache, vomiting or dizziness, confusion, somnolence, and breathing difficulties. Practical advice emphasizes basic prevention, health monitoring during travel, and seeking medical evaluation promptly if symptoms arise; keep travel itineraries handy to aid diagnosis. The article advises vigilance without alarm and encourages informed travel decisions.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Is Now the Second-Deadliest Ever, and in Record Time
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo is the second-deadliest, with 1,521 deaths and 3,442 confirmed cases in three months. Uganda’s Bundibugyo outbreak ended after four weeks with 20 cases and 3 deaths. In DRC, more than 80% of beds in treatment centers are occupied; 797 people are hospitalized or isolated. Early surveillance missed emergence; fighting and displacement hindered tracing. More than 80% of new cases are not linked to known contacts. Each case is expected to have 40 contacts, but only 17,558 of a target 134,400 are being followed (13%). About a fifth are not being followed due to personnel shortages or insecurity; 60% of deaths occurred in the community. Trials include a therapeutics combo for over 40 patients, a 10-day antiviral for exposed people (19 enrolled, target 1,200), and an Oxford vaccine trial with 50 volunteers. CEPI funds Hilleman Labs to develop another vaccine using Merck tech.

article.articleHeadline: 游客在泰国吃生腌回国后进ICU 警惕生食风险
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tourists who ate raw pickled foods in Thailand and were admitted to the ICU after returning home — beware the risks of eating raw foods.
article.articleSummary: A Shanghai-based man contracted amoebic parasite infection after eating raw pickled seafood in Thailand during a business trip. Initial symptoms were mild gastroenteritis; upon return home, his condition rapidly deteriorated, developing extensive intestinal ulcers with recurrent massive gastrointestinal bleeding, septic shock, and a severe inflammatory response. Laboratory testing confirmed amoebiasis. Despite multiple surgeries abroad, his condition worsened, necessitating an urgent transfer to the Shanghai Public Health Clinical Center in critical condition, facing multi-organ crisis, profound anemia (hemoglobin below 6 g/dL), ongoing intra-abdominal bleeding, and large-area ulcers in both the small and large intestines, risking perforation and fatal outcomes. This case underscores travel-associated foodborne risk from raw seafood and spoiled beverages and highlights the need for early recognition and intensive care in imported infections.

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: Số ca tử vong tiếp tục tăng tại Congo và Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: The death toll continues to rise in Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in five eastern provinces of the Democratic Republic of Congo (Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo) has reached 3,442 cases and 1,521 deaths, with 615 recoveries and 797 patients in treatment or isolation as of 30 July 2026. The case fatality rate is 44.2%, and 78.3% of contacts have been monitored. The infection is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no vaccine or specific treatment exists. Ituri faces disruption as healthcare workers strike over two months’ unpaid salaries. Uganda, which this week declared the outbreak over, continues aiding Ituri with ambulances and expanded testing; on 29 July mobile laboratories were deployed to Kasenyi on Lake Albert to speed screening. WHO notes global risk remains low, but eastern DRC remains grave; over 60% of recent deaths occur outside facilities, underscoring community transmission. Africa CDC calls it the fastest-spreading outbreak in DR Congo’s history.

article.articleHeadline: Número de muertos por brote de ébola en Congo ha superado los 1.500
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of deaths from the Ebola outbreak in Congo has surpassed 1,500.
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 1,500 deaths, with 3,442 cases and 1,521 fatalities reported in the latest government update. Declared May 15, the outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there are no vaccines or approved treatments. It is the fastest-growing outbreak on record, concentrated mainly in Ituri province (about 90% of cases) with confirmed infections in five other provinces, including Kisangani. Uganda has declared itself Ebola-free after its last patient recovered in mid-June. About 63% of recent deaths occurred outside treatment centers, driven largely by unsafe handling of bodies and community resistance. Attacks on health facilities and insecurity have disrupted surveillance and response; international partners temporarily withdrew after the July 15 Nyakunde attack. The WHO says global risk remains low, but domestic risk in DRC is very high; no sustained transmission outside the region has been detected.

article.articleHeadline: 骑车撞上蝙蝠按狂犬病三级暴露处理 蝙蝠为何特殊？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cyclist collides with a bat, treated as a Category III rabies exposure. Why are bats special?
article.articleSummary: Rabies exposure after a bat collision prompts Category III management in Zhejiang Province, China. A cyclist was struck in the face by a bat; at Zhejiang Provincial People's Hospital, Dr. Yan Guangzhao notes that rabies is nearly 100% fatal once symptoms appear. Under the 2023 Rabies Exposure Prevention guidelines, direct bat contact qualifies as Class III exposure, requiring immediate wound care and administration of both rabies immunoglobulin and rabies vaccine, regardless of minor skin injuries. The article clarifies that mucous membrane exposure applies to parts of the mouth impacted by the bat; lip skin is not mucosal. Because bats carry higher viral loads, even a facial impact warrants full post-exposure prophylaxis. The need for tetanus vaccination should be assessed based on the wound. This case underscores bat-specific risk and the imperative of prompt prophylaxis after potential rabies exposure.

article.articleHeadline: 我国麻疹病例创六年新高 今年通报至少40起
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases in China reach a six-year high; at least 40 cases reported this year.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in China reach a six-year high, with at least 40 cases reported by July 18, up from 27 last year and the highest since 2020. Of the 40 cases, at least three patients had completed two doses of the MMR vaccine; the remainder were unvaccinated or with unknown vaccination status. Adults aged 25–44 account for the majority. From April 4 to July 4, 12 cases were reported: one foreign tourist and 11 local residents; nine had recently traveled abroad and are imported, while two are locally transmitted. Experts attribute the rise to a global resurgence of measles. Dr Xu Liyang of the Saw Swee Hock School of Public Health, National University of Singapore, told CNA that international increases drive importations; despite this, high vaccination coverage in Singapore keeps large, sustained domestic outbreaks unlikely.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola im Kongo eskaliert: Schon 1500 Tote | Heute.at
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo escalates: Already 1,500 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo variant Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused a dramatic outbreak: 1,521 deaths and 3,442 confirmed infections since late April, yielding a case fatality rate of 44%. Transmission sources are unclear for most new patients, and contact tracing is insufficient, hindering containment. The outbreak has spread to five provinces, including areas along the border with South Sudan; the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in mid-May. Many patients arrive at treatment centers only with advanced symptoms, and about two-thirds of deaths occur at home before specialized care. Security challenges in the east, with rebels and attacks on aid workers, worsen the response and fuel distrust of the health system. There are no targeted vaccines for the Bundibugyo variant; antivirals are under study. Experts warn it could last into 2027 and threaten other countries.

article.articleHeadline: 59 Persen Kematian DBD Terjadi pada Anak, Waspada saat Sekolah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 59 Percent of Dengue Fever Deaths Occur in Children, Be Vigilant at School.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever deaths in Indonesia are heavily concentrated in children. In 2025, 59% of dengue fatalities were in the 0–14 age group, with 41% in 5–14; adults 15–44 accounted for about 42% of cases. Dengue transmission is year-round, not seasonal, via Aedes aegypti mosquitoes active in the morning and late afternoon. Prevention centers on 3M Plus: drain and cover water containers, eliminate breeding sites, and protect against bites; schools should monitor larvae and ensure no standing water, engaging the entire community. Vaccination is advised by Indonesian bodies IDAI for children and PAPDI for adults; families should consult doctors about eligibility. Prior infection with one serotype does not prevent reinfection with others and may raise the risk of severe dengue. There is no specific cure; treatment is supportive, and warning signs such as persistent vomiting, severe abdominal pain, bleeding, or lethargy require urgent care.

article.articleHeadline: Người đàn ông nhiễm amip ăn não, suýt chết sau khi ăn hải sản theo kiểu "vạn người mê"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A man infected with a brain-eating amoeba nearly died after eating seafood in a wildly popular fashion.
article.articleSummary: A Shanghai man contracted Entamoeba histolytica after consuming large amounts of raw, spiced seafood during a trip to Thailand, triggering a life-threatening amebic infection with widespread intestinal ulcers, heavy bleeding, and septic shock. Initial emergency surgery proved insufficient; he was transferred to the Shanghai Public Health Clinical Center for specialized care. After more than a week of critical management and three weeks in intensive care, infection and hemorrhage were controlled and his condition began stabilizing under close monitoring. Laboratory confirmation linked the parasite to risky food and water exposures, underscoring that Entamoeba histolytica can cause severe disease beyond the gut and may lead to liver abscess if disseminated. The report also warns that other raw or undercooked foods and unboiled water can transmit the parasite. Five travel safety rules include cooking thoroughly, drinking bottled water, choosing reputable venues, hand hygiene, and seeking prompt medical care if symptoms arise after seafood consumption.

triage.headline_ja: 魯医健康談話｜山東省が肝炎予防対策行動計画を発表、ウイルス性肝炎の弊害排除を継続推進
triage.triage_reason: 山東省の肝炎予防・管理に関する行政計画の発表であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、シグナルとしての該当性はない。
triage.notes: 記事は山東省政府による肝炎（B型・C型等）の予防・撲滅に向けた政策計画の紹介であり、現行の感染拡大やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。ワクチン接種率やスクリーニング体制の改善など、既存の公衆衛生プログラムの進捗報告に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Philippines, US launch P42-billion five-year health partnership to fight HIV, TB
article.articleSummary: Philippines and the United States signed a five-year Health Strategic Objective Agreement committing up to P42 billion in joint funding to detect, treat, and prevent HIV and tuberculosis (TB) and bolster health security. The Philippines will co-invest over P30 billion, with the US contributing more than P11.8 billion, subject to US Congress funding, over the next five years. Signed on July 22 and announced July 31, the agreement aims to strengthen disease surveillance, detection, and outbreak response; integrate health service delivery across disease programs; and build domestic capacity to finance and manage the health sector, ultimately creating a more resilient, self-reliant system. The partnership, supported by US Ambassador Lee Lipton and during US Secretary of State Marco Rubio's Philippines visit, reinforces decades of US health assistance and global health security.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンと米国、HIV・結核対策のため5年間で420億ペソの保健パートナーシップを開始
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾患（HIV・結核）に対する二国間の資金協力・保健システム強化の発表であり、異常な公衆衛生事象や新規アウトブレイクではない。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症アウトブレイクではなく、フィリピンと米国間の保健財政協力に関する政策発表。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Death Toll Surges Beyond 1500 as Outbreak Spirals Faster Than Ever
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Bundibugyo-virus Ebola outbreak is the fastest-growing on record, with 3,442 confirmed cases and 1,521 deaths as of July 2026, up about 50% in a week. Declared May 15, the Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or specific treatments; containment relies on rapid diagnosis, isolation, contact tracing, and community cooperation. Ituri Province is the epicenter, about 90% of infections, with spread to five provinces including Kisangani. Uganda neighboring the DRC declared its outbreak over in mid-June. WHO says global risk is low, but Congo risk is very high due to ongoing transmission. About 63% of deaths occurred outside treatment centers, linked to unsafe home care and funeral practices; violence and staffing disruptions, notably Nyakunde on July 15, have hampered response. The pace surpasses the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak in speed to 1,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ死者数1500人超え—過去最速のペースで拡大する感染爆発
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を複数満たす大規模なエボラ（Bundibugyo株）アウトブレイクであり、致死率が高く承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、複数州へ拡大していることから即時のフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは隣接国として言及されているが、同国のアウトブレイクは6月中旬に終息宣言済みであり、現行の主たる発生国はDRCのみ。アンゴラは記事本文に具体的な言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: 30岁小伙路边烧烤吃出急性肝炎！重要提醒：近期感染风险上升！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 30-year-old man develops acute hepatitis after roadside barbecue! Important reminder: recent infection risk has increased!
article.articleSummary: Beijing, China reports a single acute hepatitis E infection in a man in his 30s who developed sudden abdominal distension, fatigue, and poor appetite. Laboratory tests showed alanine aminotransferase elevations over 1,000 U/L (about 25x normal) and bilirubin roughly 10x normal; anti-HEV antibodies were positive, indicating acute hepatitis E. Clinicians linked the illness to consumption of undercooked or spoiled roadside meat skewers, highlighting a foodborne transmission risk. The report notes hepatitis comprises five viruses (A–E); hepatitis A and E spread fecal-oral via contaminated water/food, while B, C, and D spread through blood, bodily fluids, or HBV coinfection. Preventive messages include fully cooking meat, avoiding unhygienic street foods, thorough hand hygiene, and proper disinfection of cutting boards and utensils. The article coincides with World Hepatitis Day, underscoring liver-health awareness.

triage.headline_ja: 30歳男性、路上焼肉を食べて急性肝炎を発症！重要な注意喚起：最近感染リスクが上昇！
triage.triage_reason: 単発の個別症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の広範な影響やアウトブレイクの兆候はなく、啓発目的の記事と判断される。
triage.notes: 個人の食中毒由来の急性E型肝炎の単発症例で、世界肝炎デーに合わせた予防啓発記事。アウトブレイクや集団感染の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Talang Kelapa Jadi Wilayah Paling Rawan, Dinkes Banyuasin Waspadai Lonjakan DBD saat Musim Kemarau
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Talang Kelapa Becomes the Most At-Risk Area, Banyuasin Health Office Warns of a Dengue Fever Surge During the Dry Season.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak warning in Banyuasin Regency, Indonesia, with Talang Kelapa district identified as the most at risk during the dry season. By July 2026, local hospitals and health centers in Banyuasin had recorded 113 dengue cases, nearly one third of the 2025 total of 338. Warmer, dry-season temperatures accelerate the Aedes aegypti mosquito life cycle, increasing populations and transmission in densely populated areas. The Health Office urges residents to routinely remove standing water around homes, improve drainage, and eliminate mosquito breeding sites. Anyone with fever or dengue-like symptoms should promptly visit a puskesmas (community health clinic) or nearest health facility for early treatment to reduce the risk of death. The warning highlights Talang Kelapa’s vulnerability and the need for environmental sanitation across Banyuasin, South Sumatra, Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: タラン・クラパが最も危険な地域に、バニュアシン保健局が乾季のデング熱急増を警戒
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア南スマトラ州バニュアシンでデング熱症例が増加傾向にあり注視が必要だが、地方レベルの季節性流行であり国際的な影響や異常性は限定的。
triage.notes: デング熱は同地域の季節性流行で、地方保健当局が予防的注意喚起を行っている段階。死亡例や重症例の具体的報告はなく、国際的拡大の兆候もない。

article.articleHeadline: Labourers, farm workers at highest risk of fatality from leptospirosis in Kerala
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis is Kerala's deadliest infectious threat, with 390 fatalities in 2025. Deaths among manual labourers accounted for 37% (47), agricultural workers 11% (14), and homemakers 10% (13). The outbreak predominantly affects adults aged 40–69, though experts believe the true toll is higher. Dr. Althaf A., director of the Kerala Centre for Disease Control, notes leptospirosis accounts for 52% of all communicable-disease deaths in the state. The case-fatality rate rose from 4.2% to 6%, while overall case volumes more than tripled from 2016–2020 to 2021–2025, with total deaths reaching 1,455 during 2021–2025 (vs 319 earlier). The illness is preventable through awareness and inexpensive medicines costing about Rs 3.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州でレプトスピラ症による死亡リスクが最も高いのは労働者・農業従事者
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州の風土病であるレプトスピラ症の死亡率・症例数増加という統計報告であり、新規の異常なアウトブレイクではないが、死亡率上昇傾向は今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はケララ州における既知の風土病レプトスピラ症の年次統計・傾向報告であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。ただし死亡率(CFR)上昇と症例数増加傾向は継続的なモニタリング対象となりうる。

article.articleHeadline: الجوع يعرقل جهود احتواء "الإيبولا" فى الكونغو |
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hunger hampers Ebola containment efforts in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with over 3,200 reported cases and an approximate case‑fatality rate of 40%. The outbreak, announced May 15 in the eastern DRC, is the fastest-spreading on record and involves hemorrhagic symptoms. Hunger and severe food insecurity are hampering containment efforts; the World Food Programme warns that delays, fear and hunger enable transmission. WFP is seeking $293.6 million over the next six months to fund emergency logistics and food assistance in Ituri and other affected areas. Providing food is highlighted as a frontline defense—keeping families at home, supporting safe isolation, bolstering community trust, and enabling health teams to operate safely and effectively. UN partners WHO and UNICEF are supporting the response amid ongoing security, access, and logistical challenges in newly affected zones.

triage.headline_ja: 飢餓がコンゴのエボラ封じ込め対策を妨げている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで3,200例超・致死率約40%と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、記録上最速の拡大速度とされ、国際支援（WFP資金要請）も必要とされているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる大規模流行で、食料不安が対応を阻害している。WFPが2億9360万ドルの資金を要請しており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC face à une multiplication des cas de choléra en plus de l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The DRC faces a surge in cholera cases in addition to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DRC faces simultaneous Ebola and a surge in cholera in 2026. Since January, cholera has reached 106,401 cases and 3,124 deaths, versus 2025’s roughly 65,000 cases and 1,880 deaths. The Ebola outbreak was declared on May 15 and continues alongside cholera. The east remains the main epicenter, with North and South Kivu housing about 52% of cases. New outbreaks are emerging in the West, in Kwango and South Ubangui, notably Zongo on the Ubangui River opposite Bangui, Central African Republic, reporting 270 suspected cases in one week. WHO alarms about river-borne spread amid population movements along regional waterways. The cholera situation is endemic in the region, underscoring the need for enhanced surveillance and outbreak response for both diseases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行に加えコレラ症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラとコレラが同時流行し、症例数・死亡者数が前年を大きく上回るとともに、河川を介した越境拡大のリスクがWHOにより警告されている。
triage.notes: 記事は中央アフリカ共和国（Bangui対岸のZongo）やベナンにも言及しているが、いずれも主題国はDRCであり対象国リストに該当しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: India sets up 887 SSH, 27 apex labs for monsoon-related disease surveillance
article.articleSummary: India's monsoon-disease surveillance expands to 887 Sentinel Surveillance Hospitals (SSHs) and 27 Apex Referral Laboratories (ARLs) for dengue, with IgM test kits supplied by NIV Pune; total malaria control relies on National Health Mission drugs and diagnostics. Five PPCL-supported diagnostic labs were strengthened with grant-in-aid. Campaigns include STOP Diarrhoea targeting under-fives with ORS and zinc; capacity building of trainers, frontline workers, and community leaders; and Integrated Vector Management (IVM) with Indoor Residual Spraying, insecticide-treated nets, larvivorous fish, bio-larvicides, and source reduction. Real-time monitoring via Integrated Health Information Portal-Vector Borne Diseases (IHIP-VBD) and NCDC Programme for Prevention and Control of Leptospirosis (PPCL) to reduce morbidity and mortality. Emphasis on outbreak prevention, rapid response, and inter-sectoral coordination (PRIs, SHGs, urban bodies). Advisories guide actions in flood-affected and high-risk areas, with readiness for diagnostic stocks and public awareness.

triage.headline_ja: インド、モンスーン関連疾患サーベイランスのため887のセンチネルサーベイランス病院と27の中核検査機関を設置
triage.triage_reason: 特定の異常な発生や症例急増を報じるものではなく、モンスーン期の恒例的なサーベイランス体制・対策強化に関する行政的な記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はインド保健当局によるデング熱・マラリア・レプトスピラ症等の通常の監視体制強化を説明するもので、具体的な発生・アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Baricuatro: Clean up, stay alert against dengue
article.articleSummary: 2026-07-31 update: Cebu Province reports 381 confirmed dengue cases and 2 deaths amid persistent rains, with hospitals on heightened alert and fast lanes for prompt treatment. Governor Pamela Baricuatro urged the public, especially parents, to clean surroundings to prevent dengue-carrying mosquitoes from breeding in clean but stagnant water, noting that even small amounts of standing water can serve as breeding grounds. Residents with dengue-like symptoms should seek prompt medical attention for evaluation. Symptoms include severe abdominal pain, vomiting, bleeding from the nose or gums, difficulty breathing, and fatigue. The message emphasizes vigilance and proactive prevention to avert severe illness and reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: バリクアトロ知事：清掃を呼びかけ、デング熱への警戒を強化
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・セブ州における季節性のデング熱流行で、毎年雨季に発生する既知の風土病。異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められず、地域公衆衛生対応の範囲内。
triage.notes: 地方自治体（州知事）による予防啓発を目的とした記事であり、既知の季節性デング熱流行の一環。死亡例（2名）はあるが規模・重症度は地域内で管理可能な水準。

article.articleHeadline: Capitol assures adequate antibiotic supply amid leptospirosis threat
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis remains a public health concern in Cebu, Philippines, with provincial hospitals reporting an adequate doxycycline stock for treatment as of July 31, 2026. Health officials warn that persistent rains raise floodwater–borne infection risk, as contaminated water may carry bacteria from rat and other animal urine. Transmission occurs through cuts, or via eyes, nose or mouth. Incubation ranges from 2 to 30 days after exposure. Symptoms include high fever, headache, muscle and back pain, red eyes, vomiting, diarrhea and abdominal pain; jaundice, breathing difficulty or reduced urination may signal severe illness. Residents are advised to avoid walking or swimming in floodwaters; if unavoidable, wear waterproof boots and gloves, cover wounds with waterproof bandages, and wash exposed skin promptly with soap and clean water. Do not self-medicate; doxycycline should be taken only under doctor’s prescription after medical consultation to prevent complications.

triage.headline_ja: 州庁、レプトスピラ症の脅威の中で抗生物質の十分な供給を保証
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・セブ島で季節性のレプトスピラ症流行リスクに関する注意喚起であり、現時点で重大な公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大の兆候はないが、雨季による感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地方自治体（州庁）が医薬品供給を確保する予防的対応であり、大規模なアウトブレイクの報告はない。毎年の雨季に伴う地域的公衆衛生課題として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠阳性率呈上升趋势，南方省份显著高于北方省份 -- 新京报
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 positivity rate on the rise, southern provinces significantly higher than northern provinces.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 remains the leading pathogen detected in sentinel hospital outpatient and emergency department influenza‑like illness samples in China during Week 30, 2026 (July 20–26), with the NB.1.8.1 lineage predominant. The national outpatient ILI positivity rate is 4.4%, higher in southern provinces (6.1%) than northern (2.8%). Among outpatient respiratory samples, the top pathogens are SARS-CoV-2 at 20.3%, influenza viruses at 14.5%, and enteroviruses at 5.9%; among hospitalized SARI patients, SARS-CoV-2 is 9.5%, influenza 6.4%, and human rhinovirus 4.3%. Regional and age differences exist, with the 15–59 age group showing the highest COVID positivity. Flu activity is low, dominated by B Victoria and A(H3N2) subtypes; positivity is higher in children aged 4 and older. No unknown pathogens detected. Since its Category B management, COVID-19 remains a cyclical, common respiratory infection; elderly and chronically ill are high‑risk; vaccination is advised.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19陽性率が上昇傾向、南部省が北部省より顕著に高い
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19・インフルエンザのサーベイランス報告であり、既知病原体による通常のモニタリングデータで、異常性や重大な公衆衛生影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 既知株（NB.1.8.1、A(H3N2)、B Victoria）による定例のサーベイランスレポートであり、未知病原体の検出なし。Category B管理下での周期的な呼吸器感染として扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: Anak-Anak Kembali ke Sekolah, Ancaman DBD Mengintai, Waspadalah!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Children Return to School, Dengue Fever Threat Looms, Stay Alert!
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's return-to-school season raises dengue fever risk for children, especially ages 0-14, who are most affected. Ministry of Health data from 2018-2025 show the 5-14 age group accounts for the highest dengue mortality proportion. In 2025, 59% of dengue fatalities occurred in children 0-14, with 41% of deaths in the 5-14 bracket. With students resuming classes, sports, and after-school activities, exposure outside the home increases, making prevention beyond household sanitation essential. Dr. Ikhsanuddin Qothi notes that dengue risk is not limited to the rainy season; the disease remains a concern in the community. The report emphasizes vigilant protection for school-age children in Jakarta and across Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: 子どもたちの登校再開、デング熱の脅威が忍び寄る、要注意！
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける季節性デング熱に関する一般的な注意喚起記事であり、異常な増加やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、保健省の既存データに基づく啓発内容にとどまる。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアで毎年流行する既知の感染症であり、本記事は学校再開に伴う一般的な注意喚起・啓発内容。新規のアウトブレイクや異常な増加を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC face à une multiplication des cas de choléra en plus de l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC faces a surge in cholera cases in addition to the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Cholera cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) surged in 2026, according to WHO updates. In 2025, the country tallied about 65,000 cholera cases and around 1,880 deaths; current year figures have already exceeded those levels within six months. The eastern provinces, notably North Kivu and South Kivu, remain the main epicenters, together accounting for about 52% of cases amid ongoing conflict and population displacement. New foci are emerging in the west, with Kwango and South Ubangi provinces reporting rising activity. The Zongo area on the Ubangi River, opposite Bangui in the Central African Republic, logged 270 suspected cholera cases in a single week. The WHO warns that riverine transmission, driven by population movements along regional waterways, could broaden the outbreak, which is already occurring alongside the Ebola epidemic in the region.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、エボラ流行に加えコレラ症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常な症例急増・河川を介した国際拡大リスク）に該当し、エボラ流行と同時進行する点も重大なため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事で言及されているCentral African Republic、Beninは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Zongoは河川を挟んでCAR側のBanguiと近接するが、行政上はDRC領内（南ウバンギ州）に位置するためDRCとして扱った。エボラ流行についても同地域で並行して発生しているとの記載があり、複合的リスクとして注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Leopard Attack in Barwani: 9-Year-Old Boy Dies 21 Days Later, Rabies Suspected
article.articleSummary: Leopard attack in Barwani district, Madhya Pradesh, on July 7 left nine-year-old Kunal dead 21 days later amid rabies suspicion. Kunal and Arun (10) were grazing goats in Moharat Mal village, Bijasan area near the MP–Maharashtra border when they inadvertently entered a leopard’s resting site. Both were rescued and treated at Civil Hospital Sendhwa and later MY Hospital Indore, and discharged on July 22. Kunal died on July 28; officials are awaiting laboratory confirmation on rabies as a contributing factor. If rabies is confirmed, the forest department will sanitise the area and proceed with leopard rescue along standard wildlife and public health protocols. The health department has not yet shared the cause of death; the next steps depend on lab results.

triage.headline_ja: バールワーニーでのヒョウ襲撃：9歳の少年、21日後に死亡、狂犬病の疑い
triage.triage_reason: ヒョウ襲撃による単発の狂犬病疑い死亡例であり、検査結果待ちの段階。人から人への感染リスクや国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 単発の野生動物襲撃による死亡例で、狂犬病は検査結果待ち。感染症としてのアウトブレイクではなく、動物咬傷後の個別症例。

article.articleHeadline: 八月份这些疾病值得关注，请注意防范！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: These diseases in August deserve attention; please take preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-31, Fuzhou faces August heat with persistent rainfall and high humidity, creating favorable conditions for mosquitoes and bacteria. Dengue fever and Chikungunya fever, transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, peak in August; imported cases from Southeast Asia and the Americas raise risk of local transmission in communities, parks, and older neighborhoods. Dengue presents with sudden high fever, severe headaches, myalgias and rashes; chikungunya with abrupt high fever and intense joint pain. Prevention: eliminate standing water, use nets and repellents, wear long sleeves, seek prompt medical care after returning from endemic areas. Respiratory infections: week 29 surveillance shows SARS-CoV-2 16.3%, influenza 12.6% among flu-like illnesses; SARS-CoV-2 5.9%, rhinovirus 5.3%, influenza 5.0% among hospitalized ARIs; overall influenza activity low, COVID rising; emphasize ventilation and vaccination. Cholera and foodborne diseases risk in coastal/riverside areas; avoid unboiled water, raw foods; ensure hygiene. Heat stroke risk with daily temps over 35°C; protect vulnerable groups; stay hydrated.

triage.headline_ja: 8月に注意すべき疾患について、予防対策を心がけましょう
triage.triage_reason: 具体的なアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、福州市における8月の季節性感染症（デング熱・チクングニア熱・呼吸器感染症等）に関する一般的な予防啓発記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な症例報告ではなく、季節・気候要因に基づく一般的な健康啓発情報。輸入例（東南アジア・米州からの渡航関連）への言及はあるが、具体的な発生状況や統計は示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo confirma 15º caso de sarampo e amplia vacinação em três cidades
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms its 15th measles case and expands vaccination in three cities.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in São Paulo state reaches 15 cases in 2026; a 1–2-year-old Guarulhos resident unvaccinated is the latest case. The state health ministry expands measles vaccination in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo during the Multivacination Campaign, starting August 3, 2026. In these three municipalities, the measles-mumps-rubella vaccine (triple viral) will be offered to people aged 6 months to 59 years regardless of vaccination status. This marks the first Guarulhos measles case since 2020. Total cases: 15 in 2026 — 12 in the city of São Paulo, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos. Campaign aims to interrupt transmission; will also provide all vaccines in the National Vaccination Calendar for children and adolescents. CVE director Tatiana Lang urged updating immunization records. Coverage: first dose 77.5%, second dose 65.5%, below 95% targets; last year 94% and 84.4%.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹15例目を確認、3都市でワクチン接種を拡大
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で麻疹の地域流行が継続しており（2026年に15例、グアルーリョスでは2020年以来の症例）、ワクチンカバー率が目標を下回る中、州政府が緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーンを開始するなど行政の対応が活発化している。
triage.notes: 麻疹・ムンプス・風疹（MMR）ワクチンの複合キャンペーンとして報告されているが、実際の感染事例は麻疹（sarampo）のみ言及されている。第1回・第2回接種率がそれぞれ77.5%・65.5%と目標の95%を下回っており、地域内での感染拡大リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: هل ما زال لغز كورونا يهدد العالم؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the coronavirus still a mystery that threatens the world?
article.articleSummary: More than six years after the Covid-19 pandemic, debate over its origin persists as Jamie Metzl, founder of One Shared World, calls for a comprehensive, independent investigation into SARS-CoV-2's origins. He argues the U.S.–China politicization distracted from answering how the pandemic began. He notes a Senate hearing yielded little progress, with Anthony Fauci asserting Fifth Amendment-like rights to avoid answering over a hundred questions, while Rand Paul floated possible legal steps. Metzl endorses a bipartisan national commission, modeled on the 9/11 Commission, to examine the origin, Chinese conduct, foreign research funding, biosafety, and public-health intelligence gaps. He also questions U.S. funding of research at the Wuhan Institute of Virology and China’s alleged withholding of data—lab records, early viral sequences, animal trade details, and lab safety information. He warns that faster biotech evolution elevates pandemic risk and that the world is ill-prepared for the next outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの謎は依然として世界を脅かしているのか？
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はCOVID-19発生から6年後の起源調査を巡る政治的議論・委員会設立提案に関する論説であり、現在進行中の感染症発生事象ではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はCOVID-19の起源調査に関する政治的・歴史的論考であり、新規の感染症発生イベントではない。米国議会公聴会や委員会設立提案についての内容で、中国・武漢は起源議論の文脈で言及されているのみで、現在の発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: MS registra 9.729 casos confirmados de chikungunya - Agência de Noticias do Governo de Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mato Grosso do Sul records 9,729 confirmed Chikungunya cases - Mato Grosso do Sul State Government News Agency
article.articleSummary: As of epidemiological week 29, 2026, Mato Grosso do Sul reports 9,729 confirmed chikungunya cases out of 12,735 probable for 2026, with 28 deaths across Dourados, Bonito, Jardim, Fátima do Sul, Douradina, Guia Lopes da Laguna, Itaporã, Ponta Porã and Nioaque; one death is under investigation. There are 114 confirmed chikungunya cases in pregnant women. For dengue, 1,828 laboratory-confirmed and 4,760 probable cases in 2026, including one death in Bonito and two under investigation. The 14-day trend shows low confirmed dengue in Santa Rita do Pardo, Nioaque, Paranhos, Sidrolândia, Itaquiraí, Três Lagoas and Chapadão do Sul. Dengue vaccination: 241,030 doses received; 223,322 administered; 201,349 to the target population. The two-dose schedule with a three-month interval targets children/adolescents 10–14 years (11 months 29 days); 6–16-year-olds account for most dengue hospitalizations. Public health guidance: seek care for symptoms and eliminate water containers to curb Aedes aegypti.

triage.headline_ja: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州、チクングニア熱確定症例9,729件を記録 - マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州政府広報局
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マットグロッソドスル州でのチクングニア熱・デング熱の流行は毎年見られる風土病的状況であり、国際的な異常性や渡航制限の兆候はないが、死亡例や妊婦感染例があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル政府（マットグロッソドスル州）の公式発表に基づく定期的な疫学週報であり、季節性のチクングニア熱・デング熱流行状況を報告している。ワクチン接種プログラムも実施中であり、国内対応能力があると見られる。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情持续失控 民主刚果已逾1500人丧生 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak continues to spiral out of control; Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 1,500 deaths - International - Real-time International
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo virus continues to escalate. As of July 21, 2026, 3,442 cases and 1,521 deaths have been reported, with the death toll up 50% in a week, signaling faster spread than prior outbreaks. The outbreak began May 15, and is described as the fastest-spreading Ebola event on record. By comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (about 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths) took ~eight months to reach 1,000 deaths. There is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo virus. Ebola virus disease is highly lethal and can be transmitted via bodily fluids, including vomit, blood, and semen.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能な状態が続く、コンゴ民主共和国で死者1500人超
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyoウイルス）による死者が急増し、史上最速の拡大ペースと報告されており、承認されたワクチン・治療法もないため公衆衛生上重大な脅威である。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC東部での流行のみが主題であり、Angolaへの拡大は言及されていないため除外した。Angolaは対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria in Myanmar dreigt zodanig te ontsporen dat er geen medicijn meer tegen opgewassen is
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria in Myanmar threatens to spiral out of control to such an extent that no medicine can cope with it.
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Myanmar's conflict-wracked Karen State is surging as war disrupts health services and drives displacement, with cross-border spillover to Bangladesh and Thailand. Field hospitals report rising cases: 298 in 2025 and 16 in the first quarter of 2026, mostly treated locally amid bombardments. Researchers from SMRU and MORU note a tripling of Plasmodium vivax and a twelvefold rise in Plasmodium falciparum between 2020–2024, signaling intensified transmission and drug resistance. The public health system has collapsed after COVID-19, the 2021 coup, and ongoing conflict, with aid programs paused or scaled back. Myanmar remains a major reservoir for resistant malaria, historically including chloroquine and artemisinin resistance that spread regionally. Abbott Bioline rapid tests have yielded false negatives, undermining detection and highlighting reliance on ACT-based therapies, which previously reduced malaria burden before the upheaval.

triage.headline_ja: ミャンマーのマラリアが制御不能な状態に陥りつつあり、もはや効く薬がない恐れ
triage.triage_reason: 紛争下で保健システムが崩壊したミャンマー・カレン州でマラリア症例と薬剤耐性（特にP. falciparum）が急増し、タイ・バングラデシュへの越境拡大が報告されているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: バングラデシュも越境拡大先として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。薬剤耐性マラリアの地域拡散リスクは歴史的にも重要な公衆衛生上の懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Death toll passes 1,500 in DR Congo Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak in the eastern region has produced over 3,400 cases and more than 1,500 deaths as of July 31, 2026. The current strain lacks an approved vaccine, intensifying the need for access to care. Response logistics are hampered by remote areas; Mission Aviation Fellowship (MAF) pilots deliver medical supplies and transport healthcare workers to isolated communities, but do not move Ebola patients. Bunia remains a focus, with Congolese staff on the ground and missionary staff operating flights from neighboring Uganda to sustain medical support while hospitals become overwhelmed. The effort underscores broader indirect impacts on non-Ebola medical treatments due to strained facilities, highlighting urgent demand for vaccines and treatment capacity in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者数が1,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による大規模な死者・症例数(3,400例超、死者1,500人超)が発生しており、ワクチン未承認・医療体制逼迫など公衆衛生上深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクがあるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部（ブニア含む）での流行に焦点。ウガンダは支援活動の拠点として言及されているのみで、ウガンダ国内での発生は明記されていないため対象国リストからも除外（ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない）。承認ワクチンがない新規株である点は要注意。

article.articleHeadline: تطوير لقاح ضد "إيبولا" والصحة العالمية ترجح نجاحه
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Development of an Ebola vaccine, and the World Health Organization expects it to be successful.
article.articleSummary: Hilleman Laboratories in Singapore are developing a candidate Ebola vaccine targeting the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which no vaccine or treatment is currently authorized. The World Health Organization regards this candidate as the most likely to succeed in addressing the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Development will be accelerated to enable human clinical trials, with the vaccine based on the rVSV platform used by Ervebo, the only licensed Ebola vaccine. Notably, the candidate can be stored for months in standard refrigerators, reducing cost and distribution challenges in remote areas compared with Ervebo, which requires ultra-cold storage. The effort focuses on a specific Ebola strain lacking approved preventive options, aiming to strengthen outbreak response in DRC as of 2026-07-31.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチンの開発、世界保健機関はその成功を有望視
triage.triage_reason: エボラ(Bundibugyo株)に対するワクチン開発の進展を報じる記事であり、DRCでの既存アウトブレイクに関する新規の症例数・死亡者数・拡大状況などの疫学情報が含まれていないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発（Hilleman Laboratories、シンガポール拠点）に関するニュースであり、DRCでのアウトブレイクの現状（症例数・拡大状況等）についての新規情報は含まれていない。ワクチン承認がない稀なBundibugyo株を対象としている点が特徴的。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia : UNICEF Donates K2 Million For Detection Of Viral Haemorrhagic Fevers
article.articleSummary: As of 31 July 2026, UNICEF donated two million Kwacha worth of infection prevention supplies and water, sanitation and hygiene equipment to Zambia to bolster detection of viral haemorrhagic fevers such as Ebola, during a Lusaka handover. The Ministry of Health’s Permanent Secretary for Technical Services, Kennedy Lishimpi, framed the gift as preparedness to prevent VHFs from crossing borders, rather than merely reacting to threats. UNICEF also plans to deliver 150 ambulance vehicles by the end of September (50 already in the country) and a consignment of 200 vaccine refrigerators, strengthening rapid response and cold-chain capacity. UNICEF Country Representative Saja Abdullah stressed preparedness to protect health workers, communities and essential services. The partnership underpins enhanced surveillance, outbreak readiness, and timely containment.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア：UNICEFがウイルス性出血熱検出のため200万クワチャを寄付
triage.triage_reason: 実際のエボラ出血熱等の発生・症例報告ではなく、UNICEFによる予防・検査体制強化のための物資寄付に関する内容であるため、シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際のアウトブレイク発生ではなく、ウイルス性出血熱（VHF）検出能力強化のための予防的支援（物資・冷蔵設備・救急車の提供）に関する内容。現時点で症例報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Penanganan TBC di Kota Malang Masih Tersisa 1.284 Kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There are still 1,284 TB cases remaining in Malang City
article.articleSummary: Malang City TB cases declined to 1,284 as of July 9, 2026, from 2,754 in 2025. The city prioritizes tuberculosis elimination through cross-sector collaboration, engaging leadership down to RT/RW levels, Puskesmas health workers, cadres, and communities. A TB Technical Facilitation event on territorial interventions (July 30, 2026) highlighted Malang’s achievements: 100% Kelurahan Siaga TB across all urban villages, TB services at 80 clinics and 28 hospitals, and ongoing monitoring. An acceleration team drives expanded screening via the e-TB platform and Mobile X-Ray in multiple kelurahan, with intensified efforts to meet Standard Service Minimums through health promotion and community empowerment. Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus praised Malang as a model, noting 100% Kelurahan Siaga TB versus 8% nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: マラン市のTB対応、残る症例数は1,284件
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病であるTBの症例数減少・対策進展を報じる内容であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは見られない。
triage.notes: 症例数は減少傾向にあり、対策の成功事例として報告されている。副保健大臣がモデル都市として称賛している内容で、危機的な公衆衛生事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 7,000 மாணவர்களுக்கு எச்ஐவி தொற்றா? - கர்நாடக எய்ட்ஸ் தடுப்பு சங்கம் விளக்கம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV infection among 7,000 students? - Karnataka AIDS Prevention Association explains.
article.articleSummary: HIV infection in Karnataka has been clarified by the Karnataka AIDS Prevention Association (KAPA). Bengaluru report notes that media claims of 7,000 college students infected are incorrect. Padma Paswanthappa, director of KAPA, states that since 2004, approximately 7,000 people aged 18–35 in Karnataka are HIV-infected. The statement indicates the figure pertains to the general population, not solely college students. There is no mention of a new outbreak or lab-confirmed cluster; the media reports were deemed inaccurate. The information highlights ongoing HIV burden in Karnataka across adults in 18–35 years, with no data provided on transmission sources or current trends. The clarification aims to dispel misinformation about student-specific infection rates in Karnataka/Bengaluru.

triage.headline_ja: 7,000人の大学生がHIV感染?―カルナタカ・エイズ予防協会が説明
triage.triage_reason: 新規アウトブレイクではなく、2004年以降の累積HIV感染者数に関する誤報を訂正する内容であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態には該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は誤報の訂正であり、実際の新規感染急増や集団感染は確認されていない。既存のHIV流行状況に関する統計的説明にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: Ancaman DBD pada Anak Indonesia Data Kematian, Dampak Ekonomi, dan Langkah Pencegahan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Threat of Dengue Fever in Indonesian Children: Mortality Data, Economic Impact, and Preventive Measures.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia faces dengue fever (DENV) as a persistent childhood threat. Data from the Ministry of Health (2018–2025) show the highest dengue mortality among ages 5–14, underscoring risks in home and school settings. In 2025, while the majority of cases occurred in adults, children bore a disproportionate death burden. Dengue is caused by four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4) transmitted by Aedes aegypti; infection with a different serotype after recovery increases the risk of severe dengue. There is no specific antiviral; care is supportive. The critical phase can follow fever resolution, with warning signs such as continuous vomiting, severe abdominal pain, bleeding, extreme lethargy, or reduced consciousness. Economic impact is substantial: total dengue cost in Indonesia nears Rp9 trillion, with an inpatient episode around Rp6 million (about 192% of 2024 provincial minimum wage). Prevention emphasizes 3M Plus and vaccination; cross-sector collaboration and Takeda’s pledge to zero dengue deaths by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの子供におけるデング熱の脅威：死亡データ、経済的影響、予防策
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はインドネシアで毎年流行している既知の風土病であり、突発的異常事象ではないが、小児死亡負担や経済的影響についての継続的懸念があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシアにおけるデング熱の長期的傾向・経済的影響・予防策に関する解説記事であり、新規アウトブレイクの発生報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Hardoi News: बढ़ने लगीं मच्छर जनित बीमारियां, रोज मिल रहे मलेरिया के मरीज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hardoi News: Mosquito-borne diseases on the rise, malaria patients being reported daily
article.articleSummary: Hardoi district is experiencing a rise in mosquito-borne diseases amid rain, intense sun, and humidity. Government and private hospitals report a surge in viral fever, with Hardoi Medical College's outpatient department (OPD) crowded; daily General Medicine OPD exceeds 450 patients, most with viral fever. About 1–2 suspected malaria cases are tested each day. Officials warn that post-rainwater stagnation and heat boost mosquito breeding, increasing risk of malaria, dengue, and chikungunya. Health department data show 184 malaria cases in the district so far this year; dengue cases and two chikungunya cases were reported in January–February. By comparison, malaria cases were 645 at the same point last year. Emphasis is on timely testing, treatment, and preventive measures to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: Hardoi News: 蚊媒介性疾患が増加、マラリア患者が毎日報告される
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の蚊媒介感染症（マラリア・デング・チクングニア）の増加が報告されているが、昨年同期より症例数は少なく、地域限定の通常の季節変動と考えられるため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州ハルドイ県における季節性の蚊媒介感染症（マラリア・デング・チクングニア）の増加。昨年同時期のマラリア症例645件に対し今年は184件と減少しており、深刻な異常事態とは言えない。保健当局は既に検査・治療体制を強化中。

article.articleHeadline: Hillmann Laboratories Advances Promising Ebola Vaccine
article.articleSummary: Ebola vaccine rVSV Bundibugyo from Hillmann Laboratories (Singapore) is being fast-tracked into human clinical trials after being recognised by the World Health Organization as the leading candidate to control Ebola spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The vaccine’s key advantage over Ervebo is thermal stability: it remains stable for months under standard refrigeration rather than requiring ultra-cold storage, reducing costs and easing distribution in remote regions lacking cold-chain infrastructure. The report provides no case counts, laboratory confirmations, infection sources, or details on imported/exported cases. Development underscores potential improvement in outbreak response efficiency in the DRC through easier storage and transport of the vaccine. Published 2026-07-31. Keywords: vaccination, outbreak, public health logistics.

triage.headline_ja: Hillmann Laboratories、有望なエボラワクチンの開発を推進
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン開発の進捗に関する報道であり、症例数や感染拡大に関する具体的情報がなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発企業の技術的進展に焦点を当てた内容で、DRCにおける実際の感染状況や症例データは含まれていない。Singaporeは企業所在地であり対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Op reis in Europa? Let ook op deze tekenziekte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Traveling in Europe? Also watch out for this tick-borne disease.
article.articleSummary: Tick-borne encephalitis (TBE) risk in the Netherlands is low but present. The tick season runs March–November, peaking June–July when temperatures exceed ~7°C. TBE virus is transmitted via tick saliva, so infection can occur almost immediately after a bite; removal reduces Lyme risk but does not fully prevent TBE. Since 2016 TBE-infected ticks have been found in the Netherlands, on Sallandse Heuvelrug and Utrechtse Heuvelrug. Prevalence is about 1 in 1,500 ticks for TBE, versus 1 in 5 for Borrelia (Lyme). Vaccination is not required for stays in the Netherlands. Travel risk is higher abroad, especially in Central, Eastern and Northern Europe: Austria, southern Germany, Switzerland, Czechia, Slovakia, Hungary, Poland, Slovenia, Croatia, the Baltic states, and parts of Scandinavia; Lithuania, Estonia, and Czechia report the highest European incidence. Outside Europe, TBE occurs in Russia and Asia (China, Mongolia, Japan, Kazakhstan, South Korea, Kyrgyzstan). Check maps via RIVM or GGD Reisvaccinaties, as risk areas expand.

triage.headline_ja: ヨーロッパ旅行中は注意！このダニ媒介性疾患にも気をつけて
triage.triage_reason: オランダにおけるダニ媒介性脳炎に関する一般的な旅行者向け注意喚起記事であり、急性のアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。対象国における具体的な発生報告も含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事は主にオランダおよび中欧・東欧諸国でのTBEリスクに関する一般的な旅行医学情報。中国・日本・モンゴル・韓国・カザフスタン・キルギスも流行地域として言及されているが、これらは一般的な地理的分布の説明であり、具体的なアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、対象国リストには該当なしと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يتفشى شرق الكونغو.. والوفيات تتجاوز 1500
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in eastern Congo, and deaths exceed 1,500.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with more than 1,500 deaths and 3,442 confirmed cases reported. Officials say the outbreak has surged about 50% in the past week. The May 15 outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV); there are no licensed vaccines or approved treatments for this strain. The apparent rise partly reflects a backlog of infections and deaths that had not yet been confirmed or recorded. The outbreak remains centered in Ituri Province, which accounts for roughly 90% of cases, but confirmed infections have appeared in five provinces, including Kisangani, one of the country’s largest cities. Health authorities urge continued surveillance, rapid isolation, and preventive measures to curb further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でエボラ出血熱が拡大、死者1500人超
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(BDBVエボラ)がコンゴ東部で急拡大し、死者1500人超・症例3442件、複数州へ拡大しており、ワクチン・治療薬未承認という重大な公衆衛生上の懸念があるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyoエボラウイルス株による流行で、大都市キサンガニにも感染が確認されており、国際的拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: 台南第5例登革熱境外移入　個案越南旅遊返國前發病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tainan's fifth imported dengue fever case; the patient developed symptoms before returning from a trip to Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Tainan City Health Bureau announced Taiwan’s fifth imported dengue fever case. The patient, a woman from Yongkang District, traveled to Vietnam from June 23 to July 29, developing fever on July 28 and returning to Taiwan on July 29. She arrived at Kaohsiung Xiaogang Airport still feverish and was admitted to Yongkang Chi Mei Hospital. Lab tests confirmed dengue by PCR, prompting the Tainan Dengue Fever Prevention Center to immediately mobilize control measures, vector elimination, and epidemiological investigation to prevent spread. National statistics show Taiwan has 108 dengue cases (as of today): 7 locally transmitted and 101 imported; Indonesia is the leading source, followed by Vietnam and the Maldives. This is the fifth imported dengue case reported in Tainan to date.

triage.headline_ja: 台南で5例目の輸入性デング熱症例、ベトナム旅行から帰国前に発症
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（対象国外）における輸入性デング熱の個別症例報告であり、通常のサーベイランス範囲内で異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Alors que l'épidémie d'Ebola s'accélère dans l'est de la RDC, le PAM avertit que l'aide alimentaire et le soutien logistique sont essentiels pour contenir la propagation de la maladie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As the Ebola outbreak accelerates in eastern DRC, the World Food Programme warns that food aid and logistical support are essential to contain the spread of the disease.
article.articleSummary: On 31 July 2026, Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo accelerates; World Food Programme (WFP) scales food aid, logistics and telecommunications across Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo and Haut-Uele as epidemic shifts to rapid spread. Ituri accounts for 90% of confirmed cases, with spread toward Kisangani in Tshopo and into Haut-Uele raising transport risks. About 10 million people in eastern DRC face crisis or emergency hunger, including 1.9 million in Ituri. WFP aid includes hot meals for patients, contacts and workers at 17 treatment centers, over 160,000 meals; dry rations for 23,000 in Nord-Sud Kivu and Ituri (14,000 in quarantine), and 36,000 others with general assistance. UNHAS has flown 495 missions, moving 3,395 aid workers and 56 tonnes of freight. The Logistics and Telecommunications Cluster coordinates last-mile delivery at Bunia and 36 zones, with six platforms alongside WHO. Three EpiShuttle isolation units are deployed in Bunia for patient evacuation.

triage.headline_ja: 東部コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ流行が加速する中、WFPは食糧援助と物流支援が感染拡大抑制に不可欠と警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC東部で急速に拡大しており、複数州にまたがる大規模な人道支援対応が行われていることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州が確定症例の90%を占め、キサンガニ(トショポ州)やオートウエレ州への拡大が懸念されている。WFP、UNHAS、WHOなど国際機関が大規模支援を展開中で、既知の疾患だが急速な地理的拡大が続いている点で継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Infeksi Nyamuk DBD Sering pada Pagi dan Sore Hari, Penularannya Sepanjang Tahun Bukan Musiman
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mosquito-borne dengue infections are common in the morning and afternoon; transmission occurs year-round, not seasonal.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever infections in Indonesia occur year-round with significant activity in the morning and afternoon, driven by Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. The article warns that dengue risk follows children as they move between home and school, so protection must extend beyond the house. Authorities emphasize year-round vigilance, not seasonality, since standing water can harbor mosquitoes at any time. Studies from Southeast Asia and Latin America suggest around 45% of household members become infected, and about 75% of dengue cases are asymptomatic. In 2018–2025, Ministry of Health data show the highest dengue mortality among ages 0–14, with 59% of deaths in 2025 in that group and 41% in ages 5–14. There is no specific antidote; early detection and timely medical care are crucial to reduce severe dengue. Schools should conduct routine vector control, larval surveillance, and implement 3M Plus measures.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Woman who returned to Taiwan from Vietnam diagnosed with dengue fever; Tainan's fifth imported case this year.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever case in Taiwan: Tainan City reports its fifth imported dengue case this year. A Taiwanese woman from Liuheli, Yongkang District, traveled to Vietnam from June 23 to July 29. She developed fever on July 28 and, after returning to Taiwan via Kaohsiung Airport on July 29, was PCR-confirmed positive for dengue fever on July 30; initial NS1 test at entry was negative. The Dengue Prevention Center immediately implemented control around her residence, including emergency spraying, removal of standing water, vector-density surveys, and health education. Nationally, Taiwan has 108 dengue cases this year, with 101 imported and 7 locally transmitted; Indonesia is the main source, followed by Vietnam and the Maldives. Officials warn the rainy season raises mosquito risk and urge travelers to Southeast Asia to use protective measures and seek care if fever, headache, myalgia, or rash occurs, informing clinicians of travel history. Surveillance shows 56,175 households inspected; 6,822 standing-water containers found (120 positive breeding sources); 31,430 health-education sessions.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tainan reports one new imported dengue fever case; woman who returned from Vietnam diagnosed.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever: Tainan City, Taiwan, reports one newly imported case on July 30, 2026. A female resident of Yongkang District’s Liuhe Li returned from Vietnam, developed fever; airport NS1 screening was negative, but she was subsequently diagnosed in hospital, marking Tainan’s fifth imported case this year. Nationwide, Taiwan has 108 dengue cases to date (as of July 31, 2026): 7 locally transmitted and 101 imported, with infections mainly from Indonesia, followed by Vietnam and the Maldives. The city responded with rapid vector-control, including fogging and environmental source reduction at residences. Dengue prevention data show vector surveillance: over 500,000 Aedes eggs collected; 1,013 Li-level areas reached intervention thresholds; 56,175 households inspected; 6,822 water containers found; 120 positive; 31,430 people educated. Authorities urge travelers to employ protective measures, seek early medical care for dengue-like symptoms, and report travel history.

article.articleHeadline: Đang có nhiều ca mắc COVID-19 trở lại? Khuyến nghị: Ngừng tiêu thụ 4 thứ này để bảo vệ phổi của bạn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is there a resurgence of COVID-19 cases? Recommendation: Stop consuming these four things to protect your lungs.
article.articleSummary: Rising respiratory symptoms and a suspected resurgence of COVID-19 are discussed alongside four foods that may quietly harm lung health. In Hanoi, 185 COVID-19 cases were recorded in the past week across 76 wards, nearly doubling the prior week, bringing year-to-date totals to 588 with no deaths reported. The Hanoi CDC notes increased hospitalizations (18 patients at the National Hospital for Tropical Diseases), mainly among the elderly or those with underlying conditions; common symptoms include fever, headache, fatigue, cough, sore throat, and diarrhea/nausea. The Ministry of Health urges precaution as summer travel and gatherings raise transmission risk. The piece cautions that even mild COVID-19 can damage lung mucosa and that recovery may be prolonged if diet worsens lung inflammation. It identifies four harmful foods, detailing the first two: excessive sugar/sweets and fried/oily foods; the article truncates before describing the remaining two. Suggests lighter proteins and water during recovery.

article.articleHeadline: ​DR Congo Ebola second-deadliest outbreak: Death toll passes 1500; why it's spreading so fast, the warning signs, and the vaccine challenge​
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed over 1,500 people and infected more than 3,400, making it the second-deadliest on record and one of the fastest-growing. In just over two months since declaration, cases have surged, with authorities warning that true counts may be higher due to under-detection in remote, conflict-hit regions. The World Health Organization states the global risk remains low, but experts emphasize the outbreak illustrates how quickly transmission can accelerate amid war, poverty, weak health systems, and public distrust in eastern Congo. The overall picture highlights the ongoing transmission and significant challenges posed by regional instability in containment efforts.

article.articleHeadline: O avanço do sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Spread of Measles.
article.articleSummary: Fifteen confirmed measles infections in São Paulo state as of 31 July 2026. First-dose coverage of the measles-containing vaccine in São Paulo is 77.5%, second-dose 65.5%, well below the 95% herd-immunity target, increasing vulnerability to imported cases. The response includes epidemiological investigation, contact tracing, active case finding, and reinforced vaccination, including a dose-zero for infants in high-risk municipalities. Brazil’s National Immunization Program (PNI) has maintained universal, free vaccination, underpinning PAHO’s 2024 recertification of elimination of endemic measles. Historical outbreaks illustrate risk: Tocantins last year faced an outbreak started by a Bolivian family in a largely unvaccinated community; the United States has over 2,200 measles cases this year, driven by immunity gaps. Vaccination remains the solution: free through the SUS, and keeping up-to-date immunization protects a shared national achievement.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health care tips: Dengue fever has heightened concerns in Khargone; a survey of 1.90 lakh homes; know when to act immediately.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever remains a concern in Khargone district, Madhya Pradesh, India, with 19 laboratory-confirmed cases in 2026 so far. A January–July survey of about 190,000 homes found dengue-carrying Aedes larvae at roughly 7,500 sites, all promptly eliminated. Around 500 suspected cases tested negative; two new dengue infections were detected in Kunda Nagar and Anand Nagar, triggering intensified vector control with larval surveys, fogging, and breeding-site destruction. Monsoon season heightens risk, and authorities urge precautions: cover water storage tanks, change cooler water regularly, wear full-sleeve clothing, use nets and repellents, and seek prompt testing for fever. A weekly 'Dry Day' aims to reduce standing water. Five-year data show dengue counts varying (2021: 320; 2022: 24; 2023: 53; 2024: 98; 2025: 96), with 19 cases confirmed in 2026 so far.

article.articleSummary: Indonesia aims to accelerate tuberculosis elimination through strong local leadership and cross-sector collaboration extending to villages and urban wards (kelurahan). On July 31, 2026, in Jakarta, Safrizal ZA, Director General of Administrative Affairs at the Ministry of Home Affairs, urged regional governments to adopt international TB-control experiences. He stressed that no country has achieved TB control by health services alone; success requires leadership, governance, innovation, adequate financing, and cross-sector collaboration. He cited his COVID-19 response experience to illustrate that with unified command, cross-sector cooperation, and active community participation, major challenges can be overcome. TB elimination is framed as a development issue, not solely a health-sector task, calling for intensified local actions down to village and kelurahan levels across Indonesia.

article.articleHeadline: 牙齿嚼不烂，胃酸消不死！旋毛虫就是这样一步步入侵人体的
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Teeth can't chew it, stomach acid can't kill it! This is how Trichinella spiralis invades the human body, step by step.
article.articleSummary: Trichinella spiralis infection (trichinellosis) is transmitted when cysts in raw or undercooked pork and other meats survive chewing and gastric acid, releasing larvae that invade skeletal muscles. In humans, adult worms mature in the small intestine within 2–3 days; females release new larvae 5–7 days after infection, which travel via blood and lymph to muscles, forming cysts that persist unless calcified. Affected regions include China’s Yunnan, Tibet, Guangxi, Sichuan, Hubei, Henan, Liaoning, Jilin and Heilongjiang, with deaths mainly in the Southwest. Clinical phases span incubation to acute disease and recovery; fever, myalgias, edema, and diarrhea are common, while severe cases can cause myocarditis or encephalitis. Diagnosis relies on muscle biopsy showing cysts; serology aids confirmation. Prevention centers on thorough cooking to at least 70°C for 10 minutes, freezing at −15°C for 20 days, avoiding cross-contamination, and consuming only inspected meats; seek medical care for post-meat fever or muscle pain.

triage.headline_ja: 歯で噛み砕けず、胃酸でも死なない！旋毛虫はこうやって人体に侵入する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は旋毛虫症（トリヒナ症）の感染機序や予防法を解説する一般的な健康教育コンテンツであり、特定の発生事例や症例数を報告するものではないため、シグナルとして扱う根拠に乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事は旋毛虫症の一般的な医学解説記事であり、雲南・チベット・広西・四川・湖北・河南・遼寧・吉林・黒竜江など複数省が挙げられているが、これは過去の症例分布に関する背景説明であり、現在進行中の特定のアウトブレイクを報じたものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Tiny RNAs Linked to COVID-19 Heart Damage
article.articleSummary: Non-coding RNAs (ncRNAs)—microRNAs, long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs), and circular RNAs (circRNAs)—are identified as central regulators of COVID-19–related heart damage, orchestrating inflammation, thrombosis, myocardial injury, and long‑term cardiovascular complications after SARS-CoV-2 infection. A Chinese team from Shandong Second Medical University, The 960th Hospital of PLA, and the State Key Laboratory of Pathogen and Biosecurity (Beijing) conducted the review. COVID-19 damages the heart directly via ACE2 in heart/vessels and indirectly through overwhelming inflammation, hypoxia, and coagulopathy. More than 20% of hospitalized patients show measurable heart injury, raising risks of myocarditis, heart failure, arrhythmias, myocardial infarction, and clots. Pre-existing hypertension, diabetes, CAD, or heart failure may heighten risk via altered ncRNA profiles. Specific ncRNAs (miR-155-5p; miR-16-5p; miR-27a-3p; MALAT1, GAS5; viral circRNAs) promote inflammation or coagulation and vascular dysfunction. Blood ncRNA measures could aid risk prediction and Long COVID monitoring; therapies targeting ncRNAs are experimental. Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine, 2026.

triage.notes: 本記事は特定の感染症発生イベントではなく、COVID-19後の心血管合併症メカニズムに関する学術研究レビュー。発生地域として中国が付与されているが、これは研究機関の所在地であり、感染症の発生地ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in Congo surpasses 1,500.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed over 1,500 people. By July 30, 2026, authorities reported more than 3,440 confirmed cases with a case fatality rate of 44.2%. The epidemic, initially centered in eastern provinces, now spans Bas-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo, with nearly 50 health zones affected after a new area in Tshopo was hit. Health authorities warn the outbreak is spreading rapidly and could overwhelm the health system. Dr. D. Joseph Kakisingi in Kinshasa called for intensified response, rapid case finding, and adherence to early isolation as symptoms appear to curb transmission. The article highlights ongoing outbreak management and the need for stronger preventive measures to halt the spread across eastern DRC.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tainan City reports one new imported dengue fever case; Huang Wei-che urges the public to take mosquito precautions when traveling abroad.
article.articleSummary: Tainan City reports one newly imported dengue case: a Taiwanese woman who traveled to Vietnam; on return she was feverish at Kaohsiung Airport. An NS1 test at entry was negative, but confirmatory PCR the next day was positive, the fifth imported dengue case in Tainan. As of July 31, Taiwan has 108 dengue cases (7 locally acquired, 101 imported), with infections mainly from Indonesia, followed by Vietnam and the Maldives. Mayor Huang Wei-che urges precautions for travel to Southeast Asia and dengue-endemic areas—wear light-colored long sleeves and use government-approved repellent; returnees with fever should seek medical care and disclose travel history. Dengue Prevention Center Director Li Cui-feng asks clinicians to apply TOCC and NS1 testing for travelers from endemic areas with fever and at least two symptoms (rash, nausea, vomiting, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia, arthralgia). Vector-control efforts include extensive mosquito surveillance and public education, encouraging Inspect-Drain-Cover-Clean after rain.

article.articleHeadline: 女子高热不退竟是"虫子"作祟 恙虫病需警惕
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman's persistent high fever turns out to be caused by 'bugs'—scrub typhus demands vigilance.
article.articleSummary: Scrub typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi infection) caused persistent high fever in a woman in Hunan Province, China, with two similar cases reported. At the Second Affiliated Hospital of Hunan University of Chinese Medicine, Ms. Wang developed repeated fever, chills, abdominal pain, fatigue, and loss of appetite, progressing to septicemia and respiratory failure. Leukopenia and thrombocytopenia were noted; routine tests found no source until metagenomic sequencing identified Orientia tsutsugamushi, enabling targeted therapy and clinical improvement. A second similar case was reported. Scrub typhus is transmitted by chigger mites; early symptoms mimic cold or flu and can lead to multi-organ involvement, including pneumonia and coagulation abnormalities, occasionally requiring ICU care. Prevention during summer outdoor activity focuses on protective clothing, insect repellents, changing clothes after outdoors, and inspecting hidden skin areas for eschars. Seek prompt care for prolonged fever after outdoor exposure.

The summary relies on the headline figure and the framing of an unprecedented outbreak in Central Africa, noting that the available content does not supply further data beyond the case count and location.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で前例のない大流行、3,500例以上
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで3,500例以上と「前例のない」規模で発生しており、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが疑われるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事は見出しの症例数のみで、死亡者数・検査確認状況・感染源・対象州・対応状況等の詳細情報が欠如しているため、続報での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ririn Ekawati Ajak Orang Tua Cegah DBD dari Rumah, Biasakan Gerakan 3M+ Sejak Dini
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ririn Ekawati Urges Parents to Prevent Dengue Fever at Home, Make the 3M+ Movement a Habit Early On
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever remains a major threat in Indonesia, with the Ministry aiming for Indonesia Zero Dengue Deaths by 2030. For ASEAN Dengue Day 2026, actress Ririn Ekawati urged parents to prevent dengue at home and adopt the 3M+ method—drain, close, reuse, and protect against mosquito bites with repellent lotion. Enesis Group via Soffell, in partnership with the Ministry of Health, DKI Jakarta Health Office, and Jakarta Education Office, led roadshows at SDN 03/05 Tanah Tinggi, SDN 20 Utan Kayu Selatan, and SDN 02 Mampang Prapatan to promote a clean-living culture. The program highlights that 5–14-year-olds account for about 41% of dengue deaths, underscoring home environments as Aedes aegypti breeding grounds when water storage and discarded containers collect water. The initiative calls for cross-sector collaboration to achieve the 2030 goal, with the National Library of Indonesia hosting the event.

triage.headline_ja: リリン・エカワティさんが親たちにデング熱の家庭内予防を呼びかけ、3M+運動の早期習慣化を推奨
triage.triage_reason: デング熱に関する啓発・予防キャンペーンの広報記事であり、新規の異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアで既知の風土病であり、本記事は予防啓発キャンペーンに関する内容。新規の異常な発生や急増を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: वेस्ट कलेक्शन ठप, बारिश में बदबू और संक्रमण का बढ़ा खतरा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Waste collection halted, foul odor during rain and increased risk of infection.
article.articleSummary: Patna, Bihar, India, is confronting a sanitation crisis as about 4,700 contract sanitation workers and drivers are on an indefinite strike for the second day, halting garbage collection across the city. Ongoing heavy rains have left uncollected waste in streets and dustbins for 48 hours, generating a foul odor and raising the risk of infectious diseases such as dengue, malaria, and diarrhea. The hardest-hit areas include Boring Road, Nehru Nagar, Anandpuri, SK Puri, Shivpuri, Rajiv Nagar, AG Colony, Patel Nagar, Shastrinagar, Rajendra Nagar, Kankarbagh, Mahendru, and Sultan Ganj. Protests at six zonal offices disrupted waste transport by e-rickshaws and large vehicles. Striking workers demand permanent status for daily wage/contract staff, equal pay for equal work, social security, health insurance, ESIC, and compensation for accidents; officials report mobilizing permanent staff, but cleanliness remains far from normal. The disruption also affects Nalanda, Muzaffarpur, and other Bihar districts.

triage.headline_ja: ゴミ収集が停止、雨天時の悪臭と感染症リスクの増大(パトナ、ビハール州)
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生報告ではなく、ストライキによるゴミ収集停止がデング熱・マラリア等のリスクを高める可能性を示唆する一般的な懸念記事であり、具体的な症例報告がない。
triage.notes: 記事はゴミ収集労働者のストライキによる衛生環境悪化とそれに伴う感染症リスクの懸念を報じたものであり、実際のデング熱・マラリア症例の発生や増加を報告するものではない。今後の症例報告に注視が必要だが、現時点では感染症イベントとしての具体的データはない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Ebola Kongo Lampaui 3.500, WHO Peringatkan Risiko Tinggi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Kongo cases exceed 3,500; WHO warns of high risk.
article.articleSummary: 3,532 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as of July 31, 2026, with 807 patients in isolation or hospital care. The outbreak has caused 1,556 deaths and 626 recoveries, yielding a case fatality rate of 44.1%. Contact tracing stands at 78.7%. The crisis prompted international concern: WHO declared the Congo and Uganda Ebola outbreaks a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, signaling very high regional risk and triggering intensified cross-border coordination and health-system strengthening at hotspot locations to curb transmission. Ongoing mitigation efforts in the DRC and neighboring regions remain critical as cases continue to rise.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が3,500人を超え、WHOが高リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率44.1%の大規模エボラ流行がPHEICと宣言されており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに無いため verified_locations から除外。PHEIC宣言済みの重大事案。
