article.articleHeadline: Deadly mosquito-borne 'breakbone' virus detected in Tampa resident
article.articleSummary: As of 31 July 2026, a Tampa Bay area resident in Hillsborough County, Florida, has dengue fever with local transmission—the first such US case this year. The patient had not traveled outside the country. Dengue is spread by Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. The CDC updated a level-1 travel alert amid rising travel-associated dengue in travelers returning from Bolivia, Cambodia, Colombia, Kenya, Malaysia, Maldives, New Caledonia, Samoa, Sri Lanka, Tonga, and Vietnam. Protect: insect repellent, long sleeves/pants, and sleeping in screened or air-conditioned rooms. High-risk groups include children under five, adults over 65, and pregnant women. Florida recorded 71 locally acquired dengue cases in 2025; California 7; Arizona 2. Since 2010, about 600 locally acquired cases in the US. No specific cure; supportive care. A three-dose vaccine for ages 9–16 reduces symptomatic infection by about 80%.

triage.headline_ja: 致死性を有する蚊媒介性『ブレイクボーン熱』ウイルス、タンパ在住者から検出
triage.triage_reason: 米国フロリダ州タンパ地域で今年初の地域内感染デング熱症例が確認され、CDCが渡航警戒レベル1を更新するなど社会・行政的関心が高く、蚊媒介感染症の継続的曝露と流行しやすさの観点からWPRO基準を満たすためPICKUPと判定。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国フロリダ州における地域内デング熱感染および渡航関連症例の増加であり、ベトナム等の対象国は渡航元として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国としては特定できないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Fastest growing Ebola outbreak on record spreads across eastern DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DRC's eastern provinces report the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record, with 3,360 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,487 deaths as of 31 July 2026. Declared 15 May, the outbreak has spread across five eastern provinces, with the Bundibugyo strain sustaining transmission at about 100–150 new infections per week in some areas. Ongoing conflict, insecurity and high population density are hindering containment, notably in Ituri where mining and crowding exacerbate spread. Public health authorities urge the public to seek medical care at the first suspicion of infection. The tally is based on laboratory-confirmed cases; the infection source is not specified in the report. Clinical trials for a Bundibugyo-targeted vaccine began in July. Uganda has dispatched health experts to border areas after declaring its own Ebola outbreak over.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ出血熱の流行、コンゴ民主共和国東部全域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が5州にまたがり急速拡大しており、症例数・死亡数ともに多く、紛争や人口密集による封じ込め困難も伴うためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは自国のエボラ流行終息後に国境地域へ専門家を派遣したとの記述のみで、ウガンダ国内での新規発生は確認されていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo confirma 15 casos de sarampo e amplia vacinação preventiva
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms 15 measles cases and expands preventive vaccination.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 July 2026, São Paulo state, Brazil, confirms 15 measles infections in 2026: 12 in the city of São Paulo, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 in Guarulhos (latest: a 1–2-year-old girl who was unvaccinated). The state previously registered 15 measles cases in 2023, including a nonvaccinated girl in Guarulhos—the first case in the city since 2020. In response, the Ministry of Health urged the municipalities of São Paulo, Guarulhos and São Bernardo do Campo to expand vaccination to individuals aged 6 months–59 years, regardless of prior vaccination status, to interrupt transmission. Measles is a highly contagious viral disease spread by the air; symptoms include high fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes, white spots in the mouth, and rash. Vaccination remains the key preventive measure.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、麻疹15例確認し予防接種拡大
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の非典型的な再興(排除国での発生)であり、政府が緊急ワクチン接種拡大を実施するなど社会・行政的関心が高いため。
triage.notes: 感染は主にサンパウロ州内の3都市（サンパウロ市、サンベルナルド・ド・カンポ、グアルーリョス）に限定されており、国際的拡大の兆候は現時点で報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: East Africa: U.S. Senators Urge Rubio to Address Impact of Ebola Outbreak on Women
article.articleSummary: U.S. Senators Jeanne Shaheen and Lisa Murkowski urged Secretary of State Marco Rubio to use congressionally appropriated funds for voluntary family planning to address the Ebola outbreak in eastern Africa, focusing on the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri and North Kivu. The outbreak has more than 2,000 confirmed cases and 796 confirmed deaths in the DRC as of this week. They call to distribute purchased family planning commodities and back UNFPA's clinics operating across 29 health zones in the DRC and Uganda, and seek a humanitarian exemption to support SRH programming. The letter warns Ebola during pregnancy yields near 100% fetal loss and severe maternal mortality from hemorrhage; conflict and displacement heighten gender-based violence and transactional sex, reducing access to care. They reference 2014-2016 West Africa experience and advocate using $608 million in international family planning funding plus $1.7 million in commodities in Geel, Belgium to prevent transmission and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 東アフリカ：米上院議員がルビオ長官にエボラ流行が女性に与える影響への対応を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州・北キブ州）で2,000例以上、死者796人に達するエボラ流行が継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: 米国上院議員2名がエボラ流行下の妊産婦・女性への影響対応のため家族計画資金の活用を要請。DRCのイトゥリ州・北キブ州が主な発生地域で、ウガンダとの国境地域の保健区域（29カ所）でも活動が行われている。米国・アンゴラ・ベルギーは資金拠出国・活動拠点として言及されているのみで、疾病発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확진자 3천500명 넘어...역대 2번째 규모
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 3,500, the second-largest on record.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 3,500 cases, the second-largest outbreak on record. As of July 29, 2026, DR Congo reports 3,532 confirmed Ebola cases, up 90 from the previous day, with 1,556 deaths (case fatality rate 44.1%). Currently, 807 people remain in isolation or hospital care, and 626 have recovered. By counts, this outbreak exceeds DR Congo’s 2018–2020 crisis (3,481 cases, 2,299 deaths) and ranks behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (more than 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths). WHO and Africa CDC warn that the transmission speed is unprecedented. The outbreak was declared in DR Congo and Uganda on May 15. In Uganda, the outbreak has been contained, with 20 cases and 2 deaths; the last patient was discharged on July 16, and the outbreak was declared over on July 28, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ確定患者3,500人超え…史上2番目の規模
triage.triage_reason: 致死率44.1%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが史上2番目の規模に達し、WHO/Africa CDCが前例のない伝播速度を警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既にアウトブレイク終息宣言済み（対象国リストに含まれないため除外）。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文で言及なく除外。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）本次伊波拉疫情 规模为历来第二大
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the second-largest on record.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths as of July 31, 2026, ranking as the second-largest on record. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, with transmission outpacing control efforts and fatalities in under three months about five times higher than in prior outbreaks. There is currently no approved vaccine or treatment for this strain. United Nations World Food Programme deputy executive director Carl Skau urged heightened global attention to the rapidly spreading situation. A June 9 Reuters report shows healthcare workers moving a child deemed not infected into an Ebola Safe Response Zone medical center, illustrating ongoing containment efforts within the DRC. The article does not note cross-border import/export cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ流行、史上2番目の規模に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率が高く、症例数・死亡者数が急増し史上2番目の規模となっており、承認されたワクチン・治療薬もないため公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyo株による流行で、致死率が高く、国連関係者も国際的な注意喚起を行っている。国境を越えた症例は記事内に言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie de Ebola fără precedent în RDC, cu peste 3.500 de cazuri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unprecedented Ebola epidemic in the DRC, with over 3,500 cases.
article.articleSummary: Unprecedented Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths across five provinces, authorities said as of late Friday. Declared on May 15, the outbreak surpassed 2,000 cases on July 15, marking the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC history. The surge is centered in Ituri province in the northeast, near borders with South Sudan and Uganda, where about 90% of cases have occurred; Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu are also affected amid territory controlled by the M23 rebel group. The Bundibugyo strain is involved, with no vaccines or approved treatments yet. A vaccine deemed most promising by the WHO is being developed by Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore). Separately, an Oxford University vaccine using the same technology as AstraZeneca’s COVID-19 vaccine has begun testing. Uganda declared its Ebola outbreak over, but risks remain per the WHO.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で前例のないエボラ出血熱の流行、感染者3,500人超
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最大規模（前例のない）のエボラ流行で、5州に拡大し3,532例・1,556人死亡、ワクチン未承認かつ紛争地域での対応困難という点で複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは流行終息を宣言済みだが対象国リスト外のため除外。南スーダン・シンガポールも対象国リスト外。DRCのイトゥリ州が感染の約90%を占め、M23反乱軍支配地域での対応が困難な状況。ワクチン・治療薬未承認の点も懸念材料。

This outbreak exceeds the prior DRC maximum (3,481 cases, 2,299 deaths in 2018–2020) and is the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (about 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths). article.articleHeadline: Segunda maior epidemia de ebola aumenta para mais de 3.500 casos e 1.556 mortes na RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second-largest Ebola epidemic rises to more than 3,500 cases and 1,556 deaths in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports the second-largest Ebola epidemic rising to 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths as of July 31, 2026. Ituri province accounts for nearly 90% of cases, according to the World Health Organization. Declared on May 15, this is the 17th Ebola outbreak and involves the Bundibugyo strain, which currently has no licensed vaccine or treatment. Across Africa over the past 50 years, Ebola outbreaks have caused more than 15,000 deaths, with the deadliest episode occurring 2018–2020 (about 2,300 deaths among roughly 3,500 cases). Laboratories are developing vaccines for Bundibugyo; the WHO notes a promising candidate from Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore), and a separate vaccine from the University of Oxford (UK) has begun human dosing. Separately, Uganda reported 20 cases and 2 deaths by July 17; the outbreak there ended July 28, with the last patient discharged July 16.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大し3,500例超・死者1,556人に、史上2番目の規模に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行が発生し、致死率が高く、承認されたワクチン・治療法が存在しない上に近隣国への波及も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例・2死亡が報告されたが、7月28日にウガンダの流行終息が宣言された。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。Bundibugyo株には承認ワクチン・治療法がなく、国際的な研究協力（シンガポール、英国）が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Philippines, US boost fight vs HIV, TB
article.articleSummary: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines and the United States signed a five-year Health Strategic Objective Agreement to intensify the fight against HIV and tuberculosis (TB). The jointly funded plan, up to ₱42 billion, aims to enhance and sustain the Philippine capacity to detect, treat, and prevent HIV and TB and to bolster global health security. The agreement marks a milestone in US-Philippine health cooperation and seeks to save lives by improving health system resilience through coordinated funding and innovative approaches to slow the spread of infectious diseases. By focusing on detection, treatment, and prevention, the initiative envisions lasting impacts on both Philippine public health and U.S.-Philippine health collaboration, with shared commitment to reducing HIV and TB burden.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンと米国、HIV・結核対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 新規の異常な感染事象ではなく、既存疾患対策の資金協定・政策的取り組みに関する記事であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 米比間の保健協力協定に関する報道であり、感染症のアウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Julien Paluku mobilise le BUREC pour renforcer la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Julien Paluku mobilizes the BUREC to strengthen the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: DRC political party Bloc Uni pour la Renaissance et l'Émergence du Congo (BUREC) mobilizes to strengthen the Ebola virus disease response in Ituri and North Kivu, tapping national MPs and a senator during parliamentary holidays to intensify community awareness campaigns. The plan emerged from a July 30, 2026 Kinshasa strategy meeting of the party’s Political Directorate, chaired by Julien Paluku Kahongya, addressing security and health in North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ituri, and organizing preparations for BUREC’s third congress. The bloc condemns the recurrent civilian massacres in Lubero, Beni, Mambasa, Irumu, Djugo, and Mahagi by armed groups, notably ADF terrorists, and denounces abuses in areas under AFC-M23/RDF control. A memorial was held for former party vice-president Cyprien Mbere Moba, with practical measures proposed to support his family.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:ジュリアン・パルクがBURECを動員しエボラ対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準上重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRCのイトゥリ・北キブ・南キブ州での対応強化が政治的にも動員されている点から、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はBURECによるエボラ対応強化のための政治的動員に関する内容であり、新規症例数や具体的な感染状況の詳細は記載されていない。武装勢力による治安悪化（ADF、AFC-M23）も対応の障壁となる可能性がある。Bluedotが付与したインドネシア（Jawa Timurなど）の地域情報は記事内容と無関係であり除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Diagnóstico molecular se torna aliado contra doenças aviárias - Agro em Campo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Molecular Diagnostics Becomes an Ally Against Avian Diseases - Agro in Field
article.articleSummary: Brazilian diagnostics firm Loccus, led by Tatiani Janegitz, highlights how molecular diagnostics, especially real-time PCR, enable early detection of infectious agents in poultry before clinical signs appear, guiding rapid responses and strengthening biosafety and sanitary programs. The ongoing threat of highly pathogenic avian influenza has underscored the value of surveillance to anticipate circulation, mutations, and dissemination routes, improving risk assessment and control decisions. This approach transforms disease management from reactive to continuous monitoring, reducing losses and supporting export markets. Beyond avian influenza, tests now aid detection of brucellosis, bovine tuberculosis, leptospirosis, mastitis, and neonatal diarrhea, aligning with international sanitary standards. The strategy emphasizes permanent surveillance in Brazilian poultry production to safeguard supply chains and animal health.

triage.headline_ja: 分子診断が鳥類疾病対策の味方に - Agro em Campo
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例を報告するものではなく、診断技術・監視体制に関する一般的な業界解説記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の発生事例ではなく、ブラジルの家禽産業における分子診断技術（PCR検査）の活用に関する一般的な解説記事。具体的な症例数・発生地・被害状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: ทำเนียบขาวทิ้งบอมบ์ แฉโควิด-19 หลุดจากแล็บอู่ฮั่น?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: White House drops a bombshell: COVID-19 leaked from the Wuhan lab?
article.articleSummary: On 31 July 2026, the White House asserted on X that COVID-19 (SARS-CoV-2) did not arise naturally but leaked from the Wuhan Institute of Virology in Wuhan, China. The administration cited lab researchers reporting COVID-like symptoms in fall 2019, months before the first officially reported cases at the Huanan Seafood Market. The White House summary argues features of the virus are not found in nature and that the outbreak likely resulted from a single spillover, with Wuhan Virology Institute safety standards described as insufficient. A map reportedly shows the institute about 12 km from the market, underscoring the lab-leak hypothesis. The release also implicates Dr. Anthony Fauci in connections to and support for coronavirus research with China, noting his Senate testimony where he invoked the Fifth Amendment, refusing questions. The stance echoes former President Donald Trump’s long-standing lab-origin claims, spotlighting a geopolitical and scientific controversy.

triage.headline_ja: ホワイトハウスが爆弾発言：新型コロナウイルスは武漢の研究所から流出したのか？
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2019年発生のCOVID-19起源に関する政治的主張・歴史的検証であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の新規事象ではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事はCOVID-19の起源（武漢研究所流出説）に関する米政権の政治的主張を扱ったものであり、現在の感染症発生・拡大を示す内容ではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak started at least in January, report shows
article.articleSummary: As of July 31, 2026, Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo began at least in January in eastern Ituri province, on the outskirts of Mongbwalu, according to a Science journal report based on interviews with 97 people. The study identified more than 500 suspected cases from mid-January to May 15, when the outbreak was announced. A transmission chain started with a 50-year-old woman identified as A who died January 25 after vomiting blood; her mother died six days later, and her husband fell ill but recovered. The outbreak is Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak and has reached 3,532 cases across the country, making it the world's second-largest on record after the 2014-16 West Africa outbreak (28,616 cases across Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone). It is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, which has no approved vaccine or treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行は少なくとも1月に始まっていたことが報告書で判明
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ流行はすでに3,532例に達し、2014-16年の西アフリカ流行に次ぐ世界第2位の規模。承認されたワクチン・治療法がない株であり、発見の遅れ（1月発生、5月発表）も確認されている。
triage.notes: リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネはBluedotの発生地域に含まれているが、記事内では2014-16年流行との規模比較のために言及されているのみで、現流行の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。既にコンゴ国内で3,532例に達した進行中の大規模流行であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Outbreak Tops 3,500 Cases
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has reached 3,532 confirmed cases across five provinces with 1,556 deaths, as of Friday, surpassing the 2018–2020 deadliest outbreak. The epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast near South Sudan and Uganda; the virus has also been detected in North Kivu and South Kivu, among others, amid areas controlled by the Rwanda-backed M23 group. Ebola spreads through contact with bodily fluids and causes haemorrhagic fever; over 50 years it has killed more than 15,000 Africans. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo. Vaccination efforts include a Singapore-based Hilleman Laboratories candidate described as most promising for the current outbreak, and Oxford University is testing a separate Bundibugyo vaccine in a clinical trial. Uganda has declared Ebola-free after last local transmission, but WHO warns the country remains at risk from cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の感染者数が3,500人を突破
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模（2018-2020年を上回る）のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中で、致死率が高く、承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、国境地帯（南スーダン・ウガンダ）への越境拡大リスクも指摘されており、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSudan、Rwanda、Uganda、Singaporeが含まれるが、記事の主題としてはDRC国内（Ituri、South Kivu等）でのアウトブレイクであり、ウガンダは既にエボラ終息宣言済み、シンガポールはワクチン開発拠点として言及されているのみのため、verified_locationsからは除外した。国境地帯の越境リスクはIHR国際拡大基準として評価に反映した。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola Outbreak Is Second-Largest on Record, Latest Data Shows
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, is the world's second-largest on record. As of 2026-07-31, 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths have been reported across Congo, less than three months after it began. The disease is the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic observed, outpacing past outbreaks; only West Africa's 2014-2016 outbreak was bigger (28,616 cases, 11,310 deaths). There is no approved vaccine or treatment. Security challenges and attacks on health facilities in eastern Congo, coupled with deep aid cuts, hamper response and stretch resources. World Health Organization and Africa CDC warn true scale may be up to four times higher than official figures. Funding needs rise to $1.4 billion to contain; the May–August plan has $213.9 million declared of $242.4 million required. U.S. travel bans limit aid workers; Samaritan's Purse scales back due to quarantine orders. Infection source not detailed in article.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、統計史上2番目の規模に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行が進行中で、死亡者数も多く、資金不足・治安悪化・渡航制限など国際的懸念が顕著なためフルRRAへ進む。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではコンゴのみが主題であり、Angolaへの言及はないため除外した。WHO/Africa CDCは実際の症例数が公表値の最大4倍に上る可能性を指摘しており、資金不足（$1.4B必要、$213.9M確保）や米国の渡航禁止措置による支援活動制限も深刻。

article.articleHeadline: La República Democrática del Congo registra más de 3.500 casos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports more than 3,500 Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: DRC reports over 3,500 Ebola cases in a few months, with 3,532 confirmed across five provinces and 1,556 deaths. Ituri, in the northeast bordering South Sudan and Uganda, accounts for about 90% of cases, per WHO. Four other provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu, have infections in areas including provincial capitals, where control is contested by the M23 rebel group backed by Rwanda. The seventeenth outbreak, declared May 15, is due to the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or treatment yet. A promising vaccine is being developed by Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore-based), and an Oxford University–developed Bundibugyo vaccine has entered human trials, with the first dose administered last week. Ebola transmits via contact with bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever. Uganda has declared the outbreak over, but WHO warns risk persists.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の症例が3,500件を超えたと報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（3,532例、1,556死亡）が複数州に拡大し、紛争地域での対応が困難でワクチン・治療法未確立であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクはブンディブギョ株によるもので、既存のワクチンや治療法が確立されていない。M23反政府勢力による支配地域での対応が困難で、国境を接するウガンダ・南スーダン・ルワンダへの波及リスクも指摘されている。ウガンダは終息を宣言したがWHOはリスク継続を警告。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola din RD Congo a devenit cea mai rapidă din istoria virusului. Aproape 1.500 de oameni au murit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in DR Congo has become the fastest in the history of the virus. Almost 1,500 people have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain is the fastest-spreading on record. Declared May 15, the outbreak has 3,360 confirmed cases and 1,487 deaths (case fatality ~45%), affecting five eastern provinces. Ituri insecurity, mining activity, and high population density drive transmission; Bunia and Rwampara report 100–150 new cases weekly. There is no standard treatment; a Bundibugyo-targeted vaccine is in clinical trials begun early July, with about 20 people enrolled by July 15, potentially four months to complete. Public health actions include over 20 treatment centers, local laboratories for rapid diagnosis, and strengthened epidemiological surveillance. Africa CDC notes late identification hampered containment and emphasizes a race against time. Cross-border collaboration with Uganda continues as Uganda concludes its own Ebola outbreak, focusing on border regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が史上最速の拡大に。約1,500人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで史上最速のペースで拡大し、死亡者数1,487人・致死率約45%と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダとの国境地域）も認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ルワンダも発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれず、記事の主題はDRCの流行状況が中心のためDRCのみ列挙。ウガンダは自国のアウトブレイク終息段階と記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Pirajá recebe mutirão contra a dengue; moradores devem retirar entulhos até hoje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pirajá hosts a dengue-control campaign; residents must remove debris by today.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases surge in Teresina, Brazil. From January to July 2026, Teresina recorded 4,481 confirmed dengue cases and one death, up from 2,947 cases and one death in the same period last year. Pirajá, a Norte zone neighborhood, was chosen to launch five dengue-control mutirões (cleanup drives) due to one of the highest Aedes aegypti infestation indices per the LIRAa survey. Residents were urged to place old furniture, broken appliances, and other water-holding waste on sidewalks by Friday, July 31, for collection during the cleanup on Saturday, August 1. The effort is led by the Municipal Health Foundation (FMS) in partnership with the SDU Norte and the Teresinense Urban Development Company (Eturb), aiming to reduce mosquito breeding in and around homes—about 80% of foci occur indoors. Additional actions will follow in other North Zone neighborhoods.

triage.headline_ja: ピラジャでデング熱対策の一斉清掃活動、住民は本日までにガレキを撤去
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・テレジーナ市における例年発生するデング熱の季節的増加と、それに対する地方自治体主導の通常の防除活動（清掃キャンペーン）に関する記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジル北東部（ピアウイ州テレジーナ）で毎年流行する風土病であり、症例数は前年比で増加しているものの死亡者数は横ばい（1名）。市当局による通常の蚊媒介対策（LIRAa調査に基づく清掃活動）の一環であり、新規性・異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情元月已引爆　期刊揭：比官方宣布早數月 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo Ebola outbreak had already erupted in January, a journal reveals: several months earlier than the official announcement - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: Science publishes a report on the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak, showing transmission began in January or earlier in the eastern region, several months before the official May 15 outbreak announcement, making it the world’s second-largest Ebola surge on record. A study interviewing 97 participants—healthcare workers, community leaders, survivors, family members, coffin makers, and cemetery workers—found more than 500 suspected cases between mid-January and mid-May before the official notice. A clear transmission chain is documented: a 50-year-old woman, referred to as A, died January 25 after vomiting blood; her mother died six days later, and her husband was infected but recovered. As of the report, Ebola cases in Congo reached 3,532, caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. The outbreak is centered in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. Keywords: outbreak, Bundibugyo, DR Congo, no approved vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、実際は1月に既に発生していた——学術誌が公式発表より数ヶ月早い感染拡大を暴露
triage.triage_reason: 既知の大規模エボラ流行（症例3,532、承認ワクチン・治療薬なし）であり、公式発表より数ヶ月早く感染が拡大していたことが判明した異常事態であるため。
triage.notes: Science誌の研究により、公式発表（5月15日）より数ヶ月前の1月から未検出の感染拡大があったことが判明。Bundibugyoウイルス株による流行で、史上2番目の規模とされる。ワクチン・治療薬が未承認であり、既に3,532症例に達している既知の大規模流行事案。

article.articleHeadline: Počtom obetí už prekonala najsmrteľnejšiu epidémiu. Ebola zabila v Kongu vyše 3500 ľudí, liečba ani vakcína neexistujú
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In terms of the death toll, it has already surpassed the deadliest epidemic. Ebola has killed over 3,500 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; there is no treatment or vaccine.
article.articleSummary: As of July 31, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths, exceeding the 2018–2020 outbreak. The surge is in eastern DRC, led by Ituri province near South Sudan and Uganda, with cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu, where rebels control large areas. It is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Authorities reported about 2,000 confirmed cases by July 15. The WHO regards vaccination as the most promising countermeasure, noting a vaccine under development by Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore); an experimental vaccine trial at Oxford University has begun, with at least one volunteer dosed. The report does not provide details on the infection source or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 死者数はすでに史上最も致死的な流行を超えた。コンゴのエボラは3,500人以上を殺し、治療法もワクチンも存在しない
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の症例数・死亡者数が過去の大規模流行を超え急増しており、承認された治療法・ワクチンが存在しないため公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ・南スーダン国境近接地域での流行拡大リスクに言及しているが、これら両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。感染源や輸出症例の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists Seek to Repurpose Existing Merck Ebola Vaccine
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-31, researchers are pursuing repurposing a Merck Ebola vaccine to protect frontline health workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo amid a fast-spreading Ebola outbreak with no approved vaccine. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) plans to move forward with this vaccination strategy as part of the public health response. The approach aims to blunt transmission among healthcare personnel who face heightened exposure risk, supplementing surveillance, infection control, and contact tracing efforts. The article notes that there is no authorized shot for this outbreak and does not provide details on trial design, implementation timelines, regulatory steps, or laboratory confirmation within the excerpt.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者ら、既存のメルク社製エボラワクチンの転用を模索
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行が発生しており、承認済みワクチンが存在しないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は承認済みワクチンがない中での既存ワクチン転用の検討段階を報じており、感染者数・致死率等の詳細は不明。続報でアウトブレイクの規模・対応状況を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: BH amplia combate à poliomielite e inicia Campanha de Multivacinação nesta segunda-feira (3) | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belo Horizonte expands its fight against polio and begins Multivaccination Campaign this Monday (3) | Rádio Itatiaia.
article.articleSummary: Belo Horizonte, Brazil, launches a dual public-health push: the National Multivaccination Campaign and a second polio booster for 4-year-old children, starting Monday, August 3, 2026, across 154 health centers and the Traveler Health Service. The updated National Vaccination Schedule adds a second polio booster at age 4, joining doses at 2, 4, and 6 months, the first booster at 15 months, and the second booster at 4 years. The city aims to bolster polio coverage, which stands at 88.7% for children under 1 year—below the 95% target—and to prevent reemergence since the virus does not currently circulate in Brazil. The Multivaccination Campaign runs through August 31, offering all vaccines in the official calendar for children and adolescents under 15; families should update vaccination records, including those who participated in prior campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: ベロオリゾンテ市、ポリオ対策を強化し月曜日（3日）から多重予防接種キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染例・アウトブレイクの報告はなく、ブラジルではポリオウイルスは流行しておらず、予防接種率向上を目的とした通常の公衆衛生キャンペーンに関する記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン接種キャンペーンの案内であり、感染症の発生・流行を報告するものではない。ポリオはブラジル国内で現在流行していないと明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mulai Agustus 2026, Tiga Puskeswan di Kota Pekanbaru Buka Layanan Vaksinasi Rabies Gratis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Starting August 2026, Three Animal Health Centers in Pekanbaru Open Free Rabies Vaccination Services
article.articleSummary: Three animal health centers in Pekanbaru will offer free rabies vaccination from August 1 to September 30, 2026, with services available only on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. The vaccination drive will be conducted at Puskeswan Tenayan (Jalan Pesantren, Pebatuan), Puskeswan Rumbai (Jalan Limbungan, Limbungan), and Puskeswan Tampan at UPT RPH Pekanbaru (Jalan Cipta Karya, Sialang Munggu). The program, announced by Zulpan Ependi, Head of Livestock and Animal Health Section of Pekanbaru’s Department of Agriculture and Fisheries, aims to protect pets and their owners and those around them. Eligible animals include dogs, cats, primates (monkeys), and civets, aged at least three months. Pet owners are advised to ensure animals are healthy and bring leashes or kennels. Vaccination is described as safe for animals.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年8月開始、プカンバル市の3か所の動物保健センターが無料狂犬病ワクチン接種サービスを開始
triage.triage_reason: 疾病発生の報告ではなく、予防的な無料狂犬病ワクチン接種プログラムの告知であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 予防接種プログラムの告知であり、狂犬病症例の発生報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Existing Merck Ebola Vaccine May Get New Role in Congo Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo authorities plan to repurpose Merck’s Ebola vaccine, Ervebo, to help protect frontline health workers amid a fast-spreading Bundibugyo virus outbreak. Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention will present evidence to the World Health Organization vaccine advisers next week to test whether Ervebo can provide at least partial protection against Bundibugyo, for which no approved shot exists. Ervebo is licensed against the Zaire strain of Ebola, not Bundibugyo. Scientists are investigating cross-protection potential as the outbreak unfolds. If results are favorable, the approach could broaden use of the existing vaccine in Congo's response while a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine is developed.

triage.headline_ja: 既存のメルク社エボラワクチンがコンゴの流行で新たな役割を担う可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ株による急速に拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行が発生しており、承認済みワクチンが存在しない異常事態であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株はザイール株用のErvebo（メルク社製）の適応外であり、Africa CDCがWHOワクチン諮問委員会に交差防御の可能性を提示予定。流行の急速な拡大が報告されており、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza segue em patamar elevado com positividade de 28,5%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza remains at an elevated level with a positivity rate of 28.5%.
article.articleSummary: Influenza remains elevated in Brazil, with a 28.5% positivity rate in Epidemiological Week 28 (July 12–18, 2026), nearly three times higher than 10.2% in the same week of 2025. The five-week moving average stays around 27%, signaling stable, ongoing high transmission rather than a decline. Brazilian pathologist Dr. Carlos Eduardo Ferreira notes the virus remains widely circulating and urges continued epidemiological monitoring and preventive measures. Vaccination and laboratory diagnosis are emphasized as essential strategies to reduce severe cases and differentiate influenza from other respiratory infections, enabling faster clinical decisions and better public health planning. Data come from Abramed’s network; compiled via METRICARE by Controllab and shared with RNDS/DATASUS for national surveillance of respiratory diseases in Brazil. The article highlights the need to protect high-risk groups during the upcoming peak period for respiratory viruses.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ陽性率28.5％と高水準が継続
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの陽性率上昇が報告されているが、通常の季節的流行の範囲内であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の懸念は現時点で不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常サーベイランス報告であり、前年同期比で陽性率が高いものの、重症度や国際的関心についての具体的情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Exclusive: State Department pressed to increase aid for women impacted by Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Several senators pressed Secretary of State Marco Rubio to unlock international family planning funds to aid women affected by the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. In a letter obtained by Semafor, Sen. Jeanne Shaheen (D-NH) and Sen. Lisa Murkowski (R-AK) urged release of $608 million in FY2026 international family planning funds and the release of $1.7 million worth of already-purchased contraceptives to avoid waste. They also called for a humanitarian exemption to resume UNFPA sexual and reproductive health programming in the affected region after the Trump administration withdrew from the agency earlier this year. The lawmakers argue that reproductive health support is integral to the Ebola response for about 642,000 women of reproductive age in the area, including 37,820 pregnant women, noting that Ebola infection during pregnancy has a near-100% fetal loss rate and high risk of maternal hemorrhage.

triage.headline_ja: 独占：国務省、エボラ出血熱流行の影響を受ける女性への支援拡大を求められる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で継続中のエボラ出血熱流行が妊産婦に深刻な影響を及ぼしており、国際的な人道支援・資金拠出の必要性が政治的にも注目されているため。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国東部のエボラ流行に関連する米国内の資金・政策論争を扱っており、米国（アラスカ・ニューハンプシャー）は議員の所属州であり発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控最新数据：新冠阳性率超过20%，呈上升趋势，此次仍属周期性波动，强度与前两年相当
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC latest data: COVID-19 positivity rate exceeds 20% and is on an upward trend; this round still shows cyclical fluctuations, with intensity comparable to the previous two years.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 (SARS-CoV-2) positivity rose to 20.3% in Week 30 of 2026 (July 20–26) in China, indicating a cyclical, mid-level transmission with intensity similar to the previous two years. Southern provinces showed higher positivity than northern areas; 15–59-year-olds had the highest rate, with elevated positivity also seen in 0–4 and 60+ groups. For 5–14-year-olds, influenza positivity dominated respiratory samples. Most infections are mild, but the elderly and those with chronic diseases remain at higher risk for severe illness, and specific antiviral therapies are effective. No variants with major public health risk were detected, and the outbreak has not disrupted healthcare services. Public guidance emphasizes masking during medical visits and in crowded or transit settings, good hand hygiene, vaccination for vulnerable groups, and maintaining ventilation.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防コントロールセンター最新データ：新型コロナ陽性率が20％を超え上昇傾向、今回も周期的変動であり、強度は過去2年と同程度
triage.triage_reason: 中国CDCは今回のCOVID-19流行を例年と同程度の周期的変動と説明しており、重大な変異株や医療逼迫も報告されていないため、シグナルとして扱う必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は中国国内の季節性COVID-19/インフルエンザの定例サーベイランス報告であり、重症例増加や新規変異株、医療逼迫の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Η δεύτερη μεγαλύτερη επιδημία αυτή του Έμπολα στο Κονγκό με 3500 κρούσματα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The second-largest Ebola outbreak in Congo, with 3,500 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached about 3,500 confirmed cases, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak ever documented, according to government data released today. The report underscores that the virus continues to transmit rapidly and outpace efforts to contain it. No death toll or laboratory confirmation details are provided in the article. The scale of transmission highlights the ongoing public health challenge posed by Ebola virus disease in the DRC and the need for sustained surveillance, case management, and control measures to curb spread among affected communities. The article focuses on the outbreak’s record magnitude and the authorities’ characterization of its persistence, without additional context on sources of infection or cross-border implications.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおける今回のエボラ流行は史上2番目の規模、症例数3500人に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで史上2番目の規模（約3500例）に達し、封じ込めが追いついていないとされることから、深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクの観点でIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 死者数や感染源、国境を越えた影響についての詳細は記事に記載がなく不明。続報でのRRA実施が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Sambut HJK Padang ke-357, Dinas Pertanian Sediakan 100 Dosis Vaksin Rabies Gratis Saat CFD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Welcoming Padang's 357th City Anniversary, the Department of Agriculture Provides 100 Free Doses of Rabies Vaccine During Car Free Day
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination campaign in Padang, Indonesia, offers 100 free doses for dogs, cats, and monkeys on Car Free Day (9 August 2026) as part of Padang City's 357th Anniversary. Organized by the Padang City Department of Agriculture, the free vaccination runs from morning until CFD ends at the front of SMP Negeri 1 Padang. Pet owners can bring animals safely and without charge; the event continues a routine HJK activity. Officials note rising reports of bites from rabies-transmitting animals in Padang, underscoring vaccination as the most effective measure to prevent rabies transmission to animals and humans. Previously, similar campaigns were held at GOR Haji Agus Salim. This event highlights public-health outreach and pet-health vaccination during a major city celebration.

triage.headline_ja: パダン市創立357周年を記念し、農業局がカーフリーデーで狂犬病ワクチン100回分を無料提供
triage.triage_reason: 定例の動物向け狂犬病ワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、公衆衛生上の異常な緊急事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病咬傷報告の増加に言及しているが、これは通常の予防啓発活動の一環であり、具体的な症例数や異常発生の記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்குவுக்கு 'எண்டு கார்டு' போடும் இந்தியா! உள்நாட்டிலேயே தயாராகும் 'டெங்கிஆல்' தடுப்பூசி..!!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India to roll out the 'Endu Card' for dengue! A domestically produced 'Dengial' vaccine..!!
article.articleSummary: India plans to roll out Endu Card for dengue alongside the domestically produced dengue vaccine DengiAll (also referred to as Dengial). In eight states, including Tamil Nadu, four dengue virus serotypes are circulating, per ICMR. ICMR, in collaboration with Panacea Biotech, is conducting Phase 3 trials to test the safety and efficacy of the first dengue vaccine fully manufactured in India, aiming to counter all four serotypes. If successful, it would bolster outbreak control and reduce disease burden. Dengue remains mosquito-borne and affects about 125 countries, presenting significant challenges to health workers; despite government measures, India still reports deaths annually. The initiative underscores domestically produced vaccines and enhanced public health measures to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱に「エンドゥカード」を導入するインド！国内製造の『デンギオール』ワクチン開発進む
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン開発・臨床試験と対策に関する通常の公衆衛生報道であり、新規または異常なアウトブレイクの兆候は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はデングワクチン開発と既存の流行状況に関する報道であり、新規アウトブレイクの発生報告ではない。毎年の流行と政府の対策強化が主題。

article.articleHeadline: 香港土瓜灣街市一魚檔驗出霍亂弧菌被勒令停業 | 社會
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vibrio cholerae detected at a fish stall in To Kwa Wan Market, Hong Kong, and ordered to cease operations | Society
article.articleSummary: Vibrio cholerae O1 detected in water from a fish tank at a stall in To Kwa Wan Market, Hong Kong. On July 30, a water sample from the stall’s tank tested positive for Vibrio cholerae O1; the stall was closed and is undergoing thorough disinfection. On July 31 morning, operations remained suspended. The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department posted a closure order, removed all live fish and seafood from the tank, and will authorize reopening only after sanitation is satisfied and evidence that the immediate public health risk is eliminated. FEHD inspectors observed cleaning; nearby stalls continued business. Vibrio cholerae cannot survive at high temperatures, and thorough cooking kills it; bacteria can adhere to shells of crabs, shrimp and other shellfish; some strains are pathogenic. Public concerns about water quality and calls for enhanced inspection.

triage.headline_ja: 香港土瓜灣街市一魚檔驗出霍亂弧菌被勒令停業
triage.triage_reason: 魚檔の水槽水からコレラ菌が検出され閉鎖措置がとられたのみで、ヒト感染例の報告はなく公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: ヒト症例の報告はなく、環境検体（魚檔の水槽水）からの検出のみ。当局は迅速に閉鎖・消毒対応済み。

article.articleHeadline: 2 Kasus Gigitan Anjing di Empat Lawang Picu Kewaspadaan, Dinas Pertanian Lakukan Vaksinasi Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two Dog Bite Cases in Empat Lawang Raise Vigilance, Department of Agriculture Conducts Rabies Vaccination
article.articleSummary: Two residents of Padang Burnai Village, Muara Pinang District, Empat Lawang Regency, were bitten by dogs on July 24 and 25, 2026, prompting the Empat Lawang Agriculture Service to deploy veterinarians to investigate and vaccinate. Dr. Rahmat Zenudin and Dr. Rini Purnamadari inspected the animals and provided rabies vaccines, part of a broader preventive campaign. Education on vaccinating pets and other potential rabies transmitters was also delivered to the community. Rabies, a deadly viral disease that can be transmitted through bites from infected animals, is the focus of the response. Vaccination is recommended not only for dogs but also for cats and macaques that could spread rabies. Residents are urged to report any animal bites or suspected rabies cases to authorities for prompt management and examination.

triage.headline_ja: エンパット・ラワンで犬咬傷事件2件発生、警戒強まる 農業局が狂犬病ワクチン接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: 地域の犬咬傷2件に対する通常の予防的獣医対応であり、異常性・重篤性・国際的拡大リスクはいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 地方の農業局による通常の狂犬病予防対応。犬咬傷2件のみで、狂犬病発症の確定例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: No Ebola case reported in country so far; screening strengthened at Points of Entry: Nadda
article.articleSummary: As of 31 July 2026, India reports no Ebola cases. Diagnostic capacity has been expanded through ICMR-NIV Pune and additional Biosafety Level-3 labs. PPE and other logistics for healthcare workers, including at Points of Entry, are ensured. Mock drills have been conducted in designated hospitals across states and UTs, with capacity-building for Airport Health Organisation officials, Bureau of Immigration, state surveillance units and isolation-hospital staff. Additional doctors and paramedical personnel have been deployed at major international airports; thermal and symptomatic screening of arriving passengers has been strengthened at airports and seaports. The 24x7 national helpline (1075) supports risk communication. The NCDC Public Health Emergency Operations Centre (PHEOC) has been activated, with regular coordination meetings to review preparedness, aiming at early detection, rapid isolation and coordinated response for any suspected Ebola infection in the country.

triage.headline_ja: 国内でエボラ症例は現時点で報告なし、入国地点での検疫を強化:ナッダ大臣
triage.triage_reason: インドではエボラ症例は報告されておらず、本記事は予防的な準備態勢の強化を報告するものであり、実際の感染症発生イベントではない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド国内でのエボラ症例なしという報告であり、実際の発生事例ではないため、対象国リストに該当する発生イベントとしては扱わない。ニパウイルスへの言及は記事サマリー内になし。

article.articleHeadline: 警惕！新冠阳性检出持续上涨，本轮感染最难受的"刀片嗓"如何处理
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be wary! COVID-19 positive detections continue to rise; how to manage the "razor-throat" that is the most uncomfortable symptom in this wave of infections.
article.articleSummary: China’s national acute respiratory infection sentinel surveillance shows COVID-19 positivity continuing to rise, now the leading respiratory pathogen ahead of influenza, with the epidemic level upgraded to moderate. Week 30 data (July 20–26) show outpatient SARS-CoV-2 positivity at 20.3%, up 4 percentage points from Week 29 and +24.5% month-on-month; hospitalized severe respiratory samples positive for COVID-19 reached 9.5%. Clinically, patients report sore throat, a sensation described as a “blade-throat,” fever, throat dryness, and persistent cough, amid co-circulation of influenza and enteroviruses. The article highlights andrographolide-containing preparations (andrographolide from Andrographis paniculata) as a symptomatic, anti-inflammatory/antiviral option for upper respiratory tract infections and sore throat, supported by in vitro studies against Omicron and included in national and municipal treatment guidelines (e.g., Tianjin, Changsha, Shaanxi). Public health measures—ventilation, masking, and prudent dosing—remain essential, with medical care advised for persistent high fever or chest tightness.

triage.headline_ja: 警戒！新型コロナ陽性率が上昇継続、今回の流行で最もつらい症状「カミソリ喉」への対処法
triage.triage_reason: 中国国内でCOVID-19陽性率が上昇し季節性の中等度流行となっているが、重症化や医療逼迫の明確な報告はなく、既存のサーベイランス・治療指針の範囲内の事象と考えられるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は中国国内の季節性呼吸器感染サーベイランスに基づく報告で、COVID-19陽性率上昇とインフルエンザ・エンテロウイルスとの共circulationを述べているが、重症例増加や死亡増加、医療体制逼迫の情報はない。省・市レベルの地名（陝西省、天津市、湖南省・長沙市）は中国国内の治療指針言及であり、いずれも中国（China）として集約。

article.articleHeadline: Journée internationale des Rangers : alerte sur les risques zoonotiques encourus par écogardes congolais - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International Rangers Day: warning about zoonotic risks faced by Congolese ecoguards - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, July 31, 2026 — On International Rangers Day, wildlife health experts warn that rangers are exposed to major zoonotic diseases during patrols, including Ebola, Marburg, Mpox, rabies, anthrax, brucellosis, and leptospirosis, plus vector-borne malaria and yellow fever. Risk rises when handling sick or dead animals, collecting samples, or operating in outbreak zones. They call for stronger biosafety measures and enhanced epidemiological surveillance to limit spillover between wildlife and people. Rangers use PPE, frequent handwashing, equipment disinfection, and safe waste disposal; they are trained to spot signs of disease in wildlife, report unusual die-offs, and avoid contact with carcasses. Vaccination, malaria prevention, and regular medical follow-up supplement protection. Advocates urge increased investment in ranger health, as ecoguards are frontline defenders of biodiversity and health surveillance in protected areas. Published July 31, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 国際レンジャーデー:コンゴ人エコガードが直面する人獣共通感染症リスクへの警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 特定の疾病発生や症例報告ではなく、国際レンジャーデーに合わせた一般的な啓発・注意喚起記事であり、実際の感染症イベントの発生を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定のアウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、国際レンジャーデーに関連した予防的・啓発的内容。具体的な症例数や発生報告がないため、実際の感染症発生国としてDRCを含めることは不適切と判断し、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Patient in Frankfurt geheilt: Uniklinik meldet Entlassung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient in Frankfurt cured: University Hospital reports discharge.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola patient infected in the Democratic Republic of Congo, later treated and discharged in Frankfurt, Germany. The patient carried the Bundibugyo variant. He arrived at Universitätsmedizin Frankfurt two weeks after exposure; treated on a specialized high-containment isolation unit. He remained stable and recovered under intensive supportive care: circulatory stabilization, fluid and electrolyte management, pain and symptom control, ongoing laboratory and vital-parameter monitoring. There is no vaccine or variant-specific therapy for Bundibugyo Ebola; treatment relies on meticulous supportive care. The infection source was a logistics worker for a humanitarian organization in DRC, highlighting exposure risk through contact with body fluids. The case emphasizes the importance of strict isolation, controlled patient transport, waste handling, PPE and interface management to prevent cross-contamination. Although Europe rarely sees Ebola, the Congo outbreak context remains hard to control, underlining reliance on non-specific supportive measures and infection-control readiness.

triage.headline_ja: フランクフルトのエボラ患者、治癒:大学病院が退院を発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国由来のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）感染者がドイツ・フランクフルトまで渡航し治療を受けたことは、国際的拡大の実例であり、DRCでの流行継続を示唆するため。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCで人道支援団体の物流従事者として曝露し、ドイツで治療・回復。ワクチンや特異的治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株であり、DRC国内の流行状況とヒト-ヒト感染リスクについて続報の確認が必要。ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Sikarutto vaikutti välittömästi vientiin - voi maksaa Suomelle kymmeniä miljoonia euroja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis had an immediate impact on exports — could cost Finland tens of millions of euros.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever detected in wild boar in eastern Finland triggers immediate export disruptions. China and Japan markets are closed to Finnish pork exports, while EU markets remain open; exports to South Korea and New Zealand may continue via regionalization agreements. Non-EU exports total about €56.7 million for pork, plus roughly €20 million from meat by-products (pig ears and trotters) not used for human consumption; South Korea and New Zealand together account for about €34 million. No infections have been found in production pigs; the issue concerns the wild boar population. Potential losses for the sector run into tens of millions of euros, with MTK demanding compensation for all ASF-related costs; costs will be assessed later. Authorities emphasize biosecurity investments to prevent spread, as with avian influenza, under the Animal Health Act which provides compensation if animals are culled.

triage.headline_ja: 豚熱（アフリカ豚熱）が輸出に即座に影響 ― フィンランドに数千万ユーロの損失の可能性
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱はフィンランドの野生イノシシで確認された事案であり、対象国（中国・日本・韓国・ニュージーランド）は輸出市場として言及されているのみで実際の発生国ではない。人への感染もなく公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 発生国はフィンランドであり対象国リストに含まれない。中国・日本・韓国・ニュージーランドは輸出停止・継続の対象市場として言及されているのみで、感染発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。動物衛生上の経済的イベントであり、ヒトの公衆衛生リスクは確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Pedro Teixeira mobiliza bairros em Dia D de Combate à Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pedro Teixeira mobilizes neighborhoods on D-Day for Dengue Control.
article.articleSummary: Dengue control mobilization took place in Pedro Teixeira on July 23, 2026, during the Day D of Dengue Combat, with neighborhood teams conducting cleanup, trash and debris removal, and residents receiving guidance to prevent Aedes aegypti breeding. The operation aimed to eliminate containers that can collect standing water and reduce mosquito habitats. Teams focused on yards, plant pots, gutters, water tanks, tires, and other potential water repositories. Municipal employees and partners joined forces with residents to extend awareness efforts throughout the Day D, reinforcing home and outdoor hygiene practices. The initiative underscores ongoing dengue prevention through removing standing water and maintaining clean properties, yards, and shared spaces to curb Aedes aegypti proliferation. The report credits the Pedro Teixeira City Hall for photos and coordination.

triage.headline_ja: ペドロ・テイシェイラ市、デング熱対策デーで地域を動員
triage.triage_reason: 通常のデング熱予防啓発活動の報道であり、症例急増や異常な流行の兆候は記載されていない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による定例的なデング熱予防清掃活動の記事であり、症例数や流行状況についての言及はない。ブラジルの一地方都市（ペドロ・テイシェイラ）の活動であり、国全体としての事象性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Malaria di Rohil Meningkat, DPRD Segera Panggil Dinas Kesehatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria cases in Rohil are rising; DPRD will immediately summon the Health Department.
article.articleSummary: Rising malaria cases in Rokan Hilir Regency, Indonesia, have prompted the DPRD Rohil’s Commission D to summon the Health Department (Dinas Kesehatan) for an in-depth review and action planning. On 31 July 2026, the commission will travel to Bagansiapiapi to meet with relevant local agencies, verify malaria data across several areas, and synchronize findings with external information to ensure an accurate picture of the outbreak. The aim is to move beyond treatment to concrete, rapid measures that protect affected residents and reduce transmission, including enhanced prevention efforts. The move follows prior reports of increased malaria cases in Rohil, signaling an urgent, cross-agency public health response.

triage.headline_ja: ロヒルでマラリア症例が増加、地方議会が保健局を招集へ
triage.triage_reason: 地域的なマラリア症例増加が報告され地元議会が対応に動いているが、規模・重症度・死亡数等の詳細情報が不足しており、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: マラリアは地方風土病として既知だが、症例増加の規模・期間・死亡者数など具体的データが記事に欠けているため詳細情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ഇന്ത്യയിൽ ഡെങ്കിയുടെ 4 വകഭേദങ്ങളും ഒരുമിച്ച് വ്യാപിക്കുന്നു, ഒരിക്കൽ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചവരിൽ ഗുരുതരമാകും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four dengue serotypes are spreading simultaneously in India, and it will be severe in those who have been previously infected.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreaks are unfolding across India, with a nationwide ICMR-supported study finding simultaneous circulation of all four dengue virus serotypes—DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3, DENV-4—in eight states and union territories. Co-circulation raises the risk of severe dengue for individuals who have prior infection, since immunity to a serotype is lifelong only for that serotype, and infection with a different serotype can worsen disease. Some parts of India exhibit hyperendemic transmission and there are reports of co-infections with multiple serotypes. The first dengue vaccine in India, Takeda’s QDENGA, has been approved by the Drugs Controller General for prevention against all four serotypes in people aged 4–60. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes (daytime bite), with a 3–14 day incubation. Initial symptoms include abrupt high fever, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia/arthralgia, and rash; warning signs include bleeding, persistent vomiting, abdominal pain, rapid breathing, shock, and altered consciousness. Prompt medical care and hydration are essential.

triage.headline_ja: インドでデング熱の4つの血清型が同時に拡大、既感染者では重症化の恐れ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はインドの風土病だが、4血清型の同時流行という異常性と重症化リスクが指摘されており、続報を注視する必要がある。ただしIHR基準の複数該当や強い社会的関心は確認できない。
triage.notes: ICMR支援による全国調査で8州・連邦直轄地において4血清型の同時流行が確認されたという内容。新規ワクチン(QDENGA)の承認情報も含む。季節性・既知の風土病であり新興感染症ではないが、重症化リスクの増大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: SP inicia campanha de multivacinação na 2ª; estado tem 15 casos de sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SP launches multivaccination campaign on Monday; state has 15 measles cases.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state launches a multivaccination campaign starting August 3, 2026, to update vaccination records for children and adolescents under 15 amid 15 confirmed measles cases in 2026. The effort spans 645 municipalities, with additional targeted strategies in the capital city of São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo due to measles activity. Parents and guardians should bring the child’s vaccination booklet to vaccination posts so teams can review overdue doses and determine which vaccines are indicated by age and vaccination history. The campaign uses the National Immunization Schedule, with all vaccines available at Basic Health Units (UBS) across the state.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、月曜日に多価ワクチン接種キャンペーンを開始;州内ではしかの症例が15件
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹15例が確認され予防接種キャンペーンが実施されているが、大規模流行や重症例の報告はなく、現時点でIHR基準の複数該当は見られない。
triage.notes: 麻疹15例に対して州レベルで大規模な予防接種キャンペーンが実施されており、地域内での感染拡大防止策として今後の症例数推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Indian strain of dengue-vector mosquito may develop resistance to common insecticide: Study - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Indian Aedes aegypti population in India shows early signs of developing resistance to α-cypermethrin, a common dengue-vector insecticide. A Frontiers in Tropical Diseases study using lab-bred Indian mosquitoes reports 97.91% mortality at the diagnostic dose, signaling potential resistance emergence rather than confirmed, lasting resistance. The research identifies β-esterase as the primary detoxification enzyme, with activity rising more than 21-fold after exposure and binding strongly to insecticide molecules, enabling defense against α-cypermethrin. Resistance may be reversible if the insecticide is not used, and cross-resistance to similar insecticides remains a concern. Findings are specific to the studied lab population and may differ in other populations or natural conditions. Recommendations include insecticide rotation, elimination of breeding sites, and biological control to preserve effectiveness.

triage.headline_ja: インドのデング熱媒介蚊、一般的な殺虫剤に対する耐性を発達させる可能性 - 研究
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染拡大や症例報告ではなく、実験室での殺虫剤耐性に関する基礎研究であり、公衆衛生上の即時の脅威や異常事態には該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は実験室内での殺虫剤耐性の初期兆候に関する研究報告であり、デング熱の実際の流行状況やヒト症例数の増加を報じたものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Bhandari hosts vector-borne disease awareness drive
article.articleSummary: Vector-borne disease awareness drive held in Bhandari on July 30 under NVBDCP, with the theme 'Fight the Bite, Defeat Vector Borne Diseases.' Extra Assistant Commissioner Kilangtemsu and NVBDCP officials Dr. Imnapokim and Dr. Imkongtemsu Longchar outlined transmission, symptoms, prevention, and treatment of malaria, dengue, and Japanese encephalitis, noting Bhandari's climate favors mosquito breeding and urging shared responsibility and proper use of government-supplied anti-mosquito materials. HPV vaccine benefits, including prevention of cervical cancer and protecting young girls’ health, were highlighted by Dr. Imkongtemsu Longchar. The program, chaired by Dr. Lichamo K. Tungoe, Dental Surgeon CHC Bhandari, was attended by members of the Bhandari Town Council, Lotha Hoho, GBs, church leaders, villagers and health workers, and supported by the district administration and medical department. The event took place at Bhandari Town Hall.

triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生や症例報告ではなく、蚊媒介性疾患に関する住民啓発イベントの報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は疾病発生報告ではなく、地域における予防啓発イベント（NVBDCP主催）の紹介記事である。

article.articleHeadline: State Department pressed to increase aid for women impacted by Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Senators Jeanne Shaheen (D-N.H.) and Lisa Murkowski (R-Alaska) pressed Secretary of State Marco Rubio to escalate U.S. aid for women in the Ebola outbreak sweeping eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, focusing on Ituri province. They urged unlocking $608 million in FY2026 international family planning funds and releasing $1.7 million in already purchased contraceptives, to avoid waste. They also request a humanitarian exemption to resume U.S. support for UNFPA’s sexual and reproductive health programming in the affected region, following the Trump administration’s withdrawal. The senators argue that SRH services are essential to the Ebola response for about 642,000 women of reproductive age, including roughly 37,820 pregnant women, noting Ebola infection during pregnancy carries near 100% fetal loss and high hemorrhage risk. UNFPA cites a $20.8 million funding gap, with Congo’s response lacking 91% of its requirements; Ituri maternal deaths have reportedly doubled to ~6.2 per week.

triage.headline_ja: 国務省、エボラ流行の影響を受ける女性への支援拡大を求められる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱流行に関する内容で、妊産婦死亡増加や資金不足など公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が示されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は米国上院議員による支援要請という政治的文脈だが、背景としてDRCイトゥリ州での進行中のエボラ流行（妊産婦死亡率倍増、資金不足91%）が確認されており、これを主題イベントとして評価した。米国（アラスカ、ニューハンプシャー）は議員の所属州であり発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Cần hơn 3.600 tỷ đồng để giữ mục tiêu loại trừ sốt rét vào năm 2030
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than VND 3.6 trillion needed to sustain the malaria elimination target by 2030
article.articleSummary: On 31 July 2026, Vietnam’s National Institute of Malariology, Parasitology and Entomology (NIMPE) organized a conference in Vũng Tàu ward, Ho Chi Minh City, to safeguard the malaria prevention and elimination program. To achieve full elimination by 2030, Vietnam needs about 3,658.5 billion VND (roughly 3.6 trillion) from 2026–2030, prioritizing surveillance maintenance, research and development, and preventing reintroduction in eliminated areas. By mid-2026, 26 of 34 provinces/cities had achieved malaria elimination, with cases falling 97.76% from 2014–2024 and 246 cases in 2025. However, a double risk persists: 77% of early-2026 cases were imported, mainly from Africa; drug resistance and vector changes; and shrinking international funding. Proposed measures include PCR-based detection of hidden cases, prophylaxis for high-risk groups, and sustained local leadership and digital health, alongside WHO criteria requiring 36 months with no indigenous cases and 5–10 years of preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 2030年までのマラリア排除目標維持に3.6兆ドン超が必要
triage.triage_reason: マラリア排除プログラムの予算・政策に関する報道であり、急性の公衆衛生事象や異常な流行は認められない。
triage.notes: 症例数は2014-2024年で97.76%減少しており、輸入症例（主にアフリカ由来）が77%を占めるが、国内での急激な感染拡大は報告されていない。予算確保・政策継続に関する会議報道。

article.articleHeadline: Monsoon Drives Surge in Suspected Dengue Cases Across Pune
article.articleSummary: As of 31 July 2026, Pune reports 473 suspected dengue cases from January to July 15, with the majority during the monsoon season. Dengue activity intensified since the onset of the rainy season, with 175 suspected cases in June and 125 in the first half of July, totaling nearly 300 in two periods. The health department attributes the rise to water pooling in residential premises, construction sites, discarded containers, and scrap materials, creating ideal Aedes mosquito breeding grounds. Municipal authorities have stepped up surveillance and vector-control in vulnerable areas and urge residents to eliminate standing water, cover water storage, keep coolers and flower pots clean, and report suspected breeding spots. Officials warn that transmission could rise further if preventive measures are not followed. People should seek medical attention for high fever, severe headache, body aches, or skin rashes, as early diagnosis helps prevent complications.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーンによりプネー市全域で疑いデング熱症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱増加であり、インドでは毎年見られる現象。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、症例数増加傾向は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節性のデング熱増加で、地方自治体が既に監視・媒介制御を強化中。重症度や死亡者数の情報はなし。例年通りの季節変動の可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : le PNLT alerte sur une rupture imminente des médicaments et intrants contre la tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: the PNLT warns of an imminent shortage of medicines and inputs for tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) faces an imminent shortage of tuberculosis medicines and essential laboratory inputs, according to the National TB Control Program (PNLT). A July 29, 2026 advocacy meeting gathered civil society, the Club des Amis Damien, patient groups, and parliamentarians to press for increased national health funding for TB. TB now ranks second in Africa after Nigeria; 2025 saw a drop in case notifications due to stockouts of diagnostics and drugs. For the second half of 2026, approximately 157,000 adults and 14,000 children with TB require treatment, but current stocks are insufficient, risking ~98,000 adults and 2,984 children missing medications. Global Fund support would cover only part of needs (meds: 46/106 million; labs: 14/81 million). From 2028, GF will fund 14 of 26 provinces, risking provincial stockouts and undermining universal health coverage, with warnings that interruptions could worsen transmission, fatalities, and drug resistance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：国家結核対策プログラム（PNLT）が結核治療薬・資材の差し迫った供給不足を警告
triage.triage_reason: 結核治療薬・診断資材の深刻な供給不足により約9.8万人の成人と約3千人の小児が治療中断のリスクに直面し、耐性菌出現や死亡増加が懸念される。政府・国際支援の必要性が明確であり社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 本件は急性アウトブレイクではなく、結核治療薬・診断資材の供給危機に関する報道。治療中断が続けば感染拡大・薬剤耐性化・死亡増加のリスクが高まるため、公衆衛生上の重大な波及が懸念される。ナイジェリアは罹患率比較のために言及されたのみで発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola na República Democrática do Congo se torna o de crescimento mais rápido da história da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has become the fastest-growing outbreak in the history of the disease.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), involving the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, has become the fastest-growing on record. Officially declared on May 15, the outbreak has reached 3,360 confirmed cases and 1,487 deaths across five eastern provinces. Case fatality stands at about 45%. Numbers approach the country's 2018–2020 peak of 3,470 infections. Immunization is hampered because a vaccine for this variant is still undergoing clinical trials. Coordinator Pierre Akilimali cautioned that a peak is unpredictable, noting that violence in Ituri province, active mining, and high population density hinder control. Congolese authorities say surveillance has expanded via community agents, more than 20 treatment centers have been established, and local laboratories deployed to accelerate diagnostics. Nevertheless, weekly confirmed cases remain between 100 and 150 in Bunia and Rwampara health zones.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが、同疾患史上最速の拡大ペースとなる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブジョ株）が史上最速のペースで拡大し、致死率約45%、3360例・1487人死亡に達しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にルワンダ（Kigali Province等）が含まれるが、記事本文はDRC国内（Ituri州Bunia、Rwampara保健区等）でのアウトブレイクを主題としており、ルワンダでの発生を示す記述はないため対象外とした。ワクチンが臨床試験段階であること、紛争や鉱山活動による対策の困難さも懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Η επιδημία στη ΛΔ του Κονγκό έγινε η δεύτερη μεγαλύτερη που έχει καταγραφεί παγκοσμίως
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo became the second-largest ever recorded worldwide.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, reaching 3,532 reported cases and 1,556 deaths, the second-largest outbreak ever recorded globally. Government figures indicate the DR Congo’s totals surpass the 2018–2020 outbreak (3,481 cases) with 1,556 deaths, per the Ministry of Communications. Health authorities say transmission remains rapid, hindering containment. The largest Ebola epidemic on record remains West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak, which caused 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, according to the World Health Organization. As of July 31, 2026, the article does not detail vaccination coverage, laboratory confirmation, or imported/exported cases. The developing situation underscores ongoing regional risk and the need for sustained public health response to stop transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:コンゴ民主共和国の流行が過去2番目の規模に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例数・死亡者数が過去世界2位の規模に達し、感染拡大が継続かつ制御困難な状況であり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行のみを主題としており、シエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアは過去の2014-2016年流行の比較対象として言及されているに過ぎないため、verified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: В Финляндии впервые обнаружили африканскую чуму свиней - под угрозой экспорт свинины
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African swine fever detected for the first time in Finland — pork exports at risk.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) has been detected for the first time in Finland, with the virus found in dead wild boars in Virolahti (Kymenlaakso region) in the southeast. The disease is highly fatal to pigs and poses no risk to humans; there is no vaccine or treatment. Authorities immediately imposed restrictions in Virolahti, Miehikkälä, and the southern part of Lappeenranta, including a hunting ban to prevent spread beyond the area. The Finnish Food Authority provides a list of measures. The outbreak threatens pork producers and exports: Finland exports about €74 million of pork outside the EU annually. Exports will be suspended until new terms are agreed with non-EU partners such as China. Finland produces roughly 160 million kilograms of pork each year, with around 30 million kilograms exported; demand in Asia is growing. Atria’s Markku Hirvijärvi emphasizes strict hygiene to protect Finnish farms.

triage.headline_ja: フィンランドで初めてアフリカ豚熱を検出 — 豚肉輸出に懸念
triage.triage_reason: フィンランドの野生イノシシでのASF検出であり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン等）とは無関係。ヒトへの健康影響もなく、家畜疾病としての貿易影響に限定される。
triage.notes: 中国は輸出停止先として言及されているのみで、ASF発生国はフィンランド。フィンランドは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。ヒト感染リスクなしのため公衆衛生上のシグナルとしては見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Πρώτο κρούσμα αφρικανικής πανώλης των χοίρων, πώς επηρεάζεται η παγκόσμια αγορά κρέατος
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First case of African swine fever in pigs, how the global meat market is affected
article.articleSummary: First case of African swine fever in pigs detected in Virolahti municipality in eastern Finland near the Russian border, Reuters reports. The ASF virus is harmless to humans but highly contagious and deadly to pigs. Wild boar population in Finland is estimated around 2,380 as of January 2026 (Natural Resources Institute). ASF has spread from Africa to Europe and Asia, causing pig losses, trade restrictions, and affecting global meat markets. Recent European cases include Croatia, Spain, Germany, Italy, Estonia, Hungary, and Serbia, with ongoing culling. Outbreaks in Germany, Poland, and Hungary; Spain expanded high-risk zone due to wild boar. USDA estimates global pork production to rise about 0.6% in 2026 to 120.2 million tonnes, while EU output falls 1.2% due to ASF; US, Brazil, China, and Canada could fill the gap. Finland's emergence raises concerns for further spread in Northern Europe, potentially impacting exports and pork prices.

triage.triage_reason: 対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン等）に該当する発生地域がなく、ヒトに感染しない家畜疾病（ASF）であるため、フルRRAの対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 本イベントはフィンランドにおける豚のASF初発生に関する記事で、ヒトへの健康影響はない。ブラジル・中国は代替生産国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。対象国リストに該当する発生国はないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Πρώτο κρούσμα αφρικανικής πανώλης των χοίρων στη Φινλανδία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First case of African swine fever in Finland.
article.articleSummary: First case of African swine fever (ASF) confirmed in Finland, in a wild boar in Virolahti, eastern Finland near the Russia border. Finnish Food Authority lab tests confirmed the virus. ASF does not affect humans but is highly transmissible and deadly for pigs, causing mass die-offs and triggering trade restrictions and culling. The disease has spread from Africa to Europe and Asia, with outbreaks in Croatia, Spain, Germany, Italy, Estonia, Hungary, and Serbia, among others; its appearance in Finland raises concerns about further spread in Northern Europe and potential impacts on pork exports and prices. USDA projects a marginal global rise in pork production in 2026, but EU production may decline due to ASF, with gaps filled by the United States, Brazil, China, and Canada. Authorities monitor developments and implications for the food-supply chain.

triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は人に感染しない動物疾病であり、発生国はフィンランドで対象国リストに含まれず、記事中の中国・ブラジル等は生産量に関する言及のみでASF発生国ではないため見送りとする。

article.articleHeadline: 最新情况公布！新冠阳性率超20%，以轻型感染为主_南方网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Latest update! COVID-19 positivity rate exceeds 20%, predominantly mild cases — Southern Net
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 positivity rate in China rose for the week of July 20–26, 2026, exceeding 20% for the first time and up 4 percentage points from the prior week, indicating a mid-epidemic level. Southern provinces recorded higher positivity than northern regions. Positivity was highest among ages 0–4, 15–59, and 60+, while influenza-like illness in ages 5–14 tested positive mainly for influenza virus. Hospitalized severe acute respiratory infections were driven by Mycoplasma pneumoniae and SARS-CoV-2. Influenza activity was low, with B/Victoria and A/H3N2 co-dominant. Since COVID-19 management shifted to Category B, SARS-CoV-2 now causes common recurrent respiratory infections with about 1–2 waves annually. Severity remains unchanged; most infections are mild, but elderly and those with chronic diseases remain high-risk. No concerning variants detected, and no major strain on healthcare. Guidance: wear masks in medical settings, and in crowded places or public transport, especially for the elderly and chronically ill.

triage.headline_ja: 最新情況公表！新型コロナ陽性率が20%超、軽症が中心

article.articleHeadline: 2 Warga Empat Lawang Digigit Anjing dalam Dua Hari, Dokter Hewan Turun Tangan Antisipasi Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two residents of Empat Lawang bitten by dogs in two days, veterinarian steps in to prevent rabies.
article.articleSummary: Two residents of Padang Burnai Village, Muara Pinang District, Empat Lawang Regency, South Sumatra, Indonesia, were bitten by dogs on July 24 and 25, 2026, triggering a rabies response. The Empat Lawang Agriculture Service deployed two veterinarians, Dr. Rahmat Zenudin and Dr. Rini Purnamadari, to investigate exposures, assess risk, and implement control measures. The team vaccinated at‑risk animals and conducted public education on rabies prevention. Rabies is transmitted via bites from infected animals and can be fatal if not treated promptly. Vaccination efforts cover dogs, cats, and macaques that may serve as reservoirs. Officials urged immediate reporting of animal bites or suspected rabies and emphasized routine pet vaccination as a key preventive measure to curb potential spread in the area as of July 31, 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Monsoon Health Alert: Fevers, Viral Infections and Pneumonia -- What an Expert Wants You To Know
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-31, Hyderabad's monsoon season correlates with higher infections. Mosquito-borne illnesses—dengue, chikungunya, malaria—are common; water-borne infections include typhoid and hepatitis A & E; airborne viruses such as flu and other respiratory infections rise in crowded, damp places. Pneumonia can develop from a simple viral cold, filling lung air sacs with fluid or pus, especially in the elderly, young children, and those with diabetes, asthma, COPD, or weak immunity. Red flags: fever with chills lasting more than 3 days; cough with yellow/green/rust mucus; chest pain worsened by coughing or deep breath; shortness of breath; fatigue or confusion in older adults. Prevention: drink boiled or filtered water; avoid raw street food; eliminate standing water; use mosquito repellents and nets; wash hands regularly and avoid self-medication. Seek medical care if fever persists beyond 3 days or there is breathing trouble or chest pain.

article.articleHeadline: Volta Grande orienta moradores sobre ciclo de vida do Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Volta Grande guides residents on the life cycle of Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: Volta Grande residents were guided on the life cycle of Aedes aegypti and how to eliminate potential breeding sites. The mosquito develops through four stages—egg, larva, pupa, and adult—in about seven to ten days. Eggs are laid by females on container walls just above water and can remain viable for more than a year in dry conditions, hatching when rehydrated. In the larval stage, the insect remains submerged and feeds on organic matter for about five days, followed by a two- to three-day pupal stage. After emerging as adults, they fly, reproduce, and can transmit dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The rapid cycle underscores the need to routinely remove standing water from homes, yards, and other spaces. The Volta Grande City Hall urges residents to monitor containers that may foster breeding; removing water interrupts early stages and reduces Aedes aegypti presence.

article.articleHeadline: В Московской области произошло массовое заражение скота ящуром
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mass outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease among cattle in Moscow Oblast
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease outbreak in Moscow Oblast (Podmoskovye), centered on a farm near the village of Dubna in Chekhovsky district. About 500 animals—sheep, cows, and goats—are preliminarily infected after diseased sheep were imported from Astrakhan. To curb spread and save the rest of the herd, authorities plan to slaughter nearly 500 head; farm access is blocked. The owner blames competitors and intends to quit livestock farming. The incident follows a report of a deadly strain of foot-and-mouth disease in China. Published July 31, 2026, via Mash Telegram channel; the article does not provide laboratory confirmation details or extensive information on human infection risk.}

article.articleHeadline: Campinas confirma primeiro caso de raiva em gato desde 2016 e investiga contatos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas confirms first rabies case in a cat since 2016 and investigates contacts.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil confirms the first rabies case in a cat since 2016. A young female tabby with a white belly was abandoned at Saudade Cemetery in the Swift neighborhood, found ill and died after veterinary care. Rabies suspicion prompted the Zoonoses Surveillance Unit (UVZ) to collect samples and send them to the Pasteur Institute; diagnosis was confirmed on July 29. The attending veterinarian, vaccinated against rabies, began human post-exposure prophylaxis (AARH) per protocol after being scratched. To prevent further transmission, the Department of Health Surveillance (Devisa) will conduct house-to-house visits near the cemetery on July 31 to identify exposed individuals and advise on preventive actions. Anyone with potential exposure, even without bites or scratches, should contact UVZ at (19) 2515-7044. Monitoring will also target other cats in the area. Rabies transmits via bite, scratch, or saliva contact with mucous membranes or wounds and is almost always fatal.
