article.articleHeadline: 台南增第5例境外登革熱！越南返台確診　住家周邊啟動防疫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tainan reports its fifth imported dengue fever case! Diagnosed after returning from Vietnam; preventive measures activated around the home.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s Tainan City reports its fifth imported dengue fever case for 2026. The patient traveled to Vietnam from June 23–July 29, developed fever on July 28, and upon return via Kaohsiung Airport on July 29, was PCR-confirmed positive on July 30. Authorities, with Yongkang District Office, implemented emergency measures around the patient’s residence, including insecticide spraying, vector control, removal of standing water, vector density surveys, and health education to reduce community transmission. As of July 31, 2026, Taiwan records 108 dengue cases nationwide: 7 locally transmitted, 101 imported, with Indonesia the leading source, followed by Vietnam and the Maldives. Mayor Huang Wei-che urged travelers returning from Southeast Asia with fever, headache, myalgia, or rash to seek prompt medical care within 14 days and disclose travel history. The Dengue Prevention Center emphasizes ongoing inspections, water clearance, and public education under the ‘Inspect, Drain, Clean, Scrub’ guideline.

article.articleHeadline: Bé gái 7 tuổi lây quai bị từ bố
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 7-year-old girl contracts mumps from her father
article.articleSummary: In Hanoi, Vietnam, a 7-year-old girl contracted mumps from her father, with Mumps IgM positive at Tam Anh General Hospital Hanoi. The four-member family includes grandmother, father, mother, and daughter; the father was diagnosed about 10 days earlier, with no identified source. The child presented with fever up to 39°C and bilateral parotid swelling; she had not received the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine. Mother and grandmother were asymptomatic. Mumps is an acute viral illness spread mainly via respiratory droplets and close contact, especially in shared living spaces; those without immunity are at higher risk. The child received supportive care (antipyretics, analgesics, anti-inflammatory) and rest, improved after three days, and was discharged without complications. Incubation is 12–25 days (average 16–18). Close contacts warrant about 25 days of monitoring; vaccination with MMR is advised, and infected individuals should limit contact with young children, pregnant women, and the immunocompromised, use masks, cover coughs, and maintain hygiene.

article.articleHeadline: 25 Warga OKI Terserang DBD Sepanjang Juli 2026, Dinkes Minta Warga Waspada, Gencarkan PSN & Fogging
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 25 OKI Residents Infected with Dengue Fever Throughout July 2026, Health Office Urges Residents to Be Vigilant, Intensify PSN & Fogging.
article.articleSummary: During July 2026, 25 residents in Ogan Komering Ilir (OKI) Regency, South Sumatra, Indonesia, were infected with dengue fever (DBD). The OKI Health Office reports cases across multiple puskesmas. Authorities say Aedes aegypti bites drive transmission and have initiated epidemiological investigations, mosquito nest elimination (PSN), and fogging in affected areas. The guidance emphasizes hygiene behavior (PHBS): drain bathtubs and water containers, avoid hanging clothes, and eliminate standing water to reduce larval habitats. Dengue presents with sudden high fever (up to 40°C), muscle and joint pain, and red skin rashes; children are most vulnerable. If suspected, seek prompt care at a puskesmas or health facility. For confirmed cases, authorities will deploy rapid response, including epidemiological investigation, PSN, and fogging in the locality.

triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアの風土病であり、地域レベルでの季節的な発生報告。25例という規模も小規模で、地元保健局による通常の対応（疫学調査・PSN・フォギング）で管理可能とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Tỉnh Chiang Mai ở Thái Lan ghi nhận 2 ca nhiễm HIV mỗi ngày: Thiên đường du lịch đáng lo ngại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chiang Mai Province in Thailand records two new HIV infections per day: A travel paradise that is worrisome.
article.articleSummary: Chiang Mai Province, Thailand, records about 23,900 HIV cases, with roughly 2 new infections daily (~700/year). The epidemic is expanding beyond traditional high-risk groups to the general population, including migrant workers and ethnic minorities; HIV prevalence among minority male service workers reaches 3.6%. Online dating apps correlate with risk: 61.9% of gay men know strangers and have sex with them via apps. Thailandwide, nearly half of new infections occur in ages 15–24, with 25–49 also high. Globally, UNAIDS notes 2025 had ~1.2 million new infections and ~570,000 AIDS-related deaths, with ~22% undiagnosed; lenacapavir-based PrEP remains unaffordable at over $20,000 per person annually; international HIV funding fell ~18% in 2024–2025, and about 20 million people need urgent ARV/PrEP access. HIV is spread via unprotected sex, blood contact, and mother-to-child; casual contact does not spread it. Prevention emphasized: consistent condom use, fewer partners, avoiding substances, and regular testing every 6–12 months.

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Maracaju amplia ações de proteção animal com novos investimentos para a Vigilância de Zoonoses -- AconteceuMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maracaju City Hall expands animal protection actions with new investments for Zoonoses Surveillance -- AconteceuMS
article.articleSummary: Maracaju's City Hall, via the Municipal Health Secretariat and the Zoonoses Surveillance Unit (UVZ), expands animal health and zoonosis prevention. The municipality purchased 250 antiparasitic collars and 550 microchips for dogs and cats in the castration program, funded by an earmarked amendment from councilor Gustavo Veterinário and municipal resources. From January to July 2026, 13 antiparasitic collars were distributed, 182 Leishmaniasis tests performed, 255 microchips implanted, and 41 doses of polyvalent V8 vaccine administered. Since September 2021, the Castramóvel program has castrated 5,370 animals (1,529 dogs and 3,675 cats). Legislation includes Municipal Law 2,137/2023 for visceral leishmaniasis prevention, Decree 170/2026, and Law 2,138/2023 guaranteeing free V8 vaccination. UVZ conducts rabies surveillance, vaccination, leishmaniasis monitoring, castration, microchiping, and animal control under Federal Ordinance 1,138/2014. For services, contact Rua Rui Barbosa, 281; (67) 3454-5041 or (67) 98478-0041.

article.articleHeadline: Suunnitteilla liikkumisrajoituksia - näin ministeri kommentoi sikaruttotilannetta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plans for movement restrictions — this is how the minister commented on the swine fever situation.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) has been detected in wild boars in Virolahti, eastern Finland—the country’s first case. A risk area in eastern Finland is planned with movement and hunting restrictions to prevent spread from wild boars to domestic farms. ASF is not dangerous to humans, but infection could devastate pork production, with worst-case losses running into millions and potential farm closures. Authorities say there is no immediate compensation package while the situation remains contained; if production animals are culled, the state would compensate under the animal disease framework, as with avian influenza. Exports to China and Japan have halted, impacting exporters, while EU and other markets remain open. The risk area covers about ten small pig farms and one larger farm. Hunting will be restricted more broadly; wild-boar management will use alternative methods. Source is believed to be from Russia.

article.articleHeadline: 본격 여름 휴가철...나라별 조심해야 할 감염병은?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Peak of the summer vacation season... Infectious diseases to watch out for by country?
article.articleSummary: Singapore and Taiwan are flagged for dengue fever and Zika virus infections; mosquito-borne diseases can mimic flu-like symptoms, but without timely treatment may cause organ failure or hemorrhagic complications with up to ~20% fatality risk. Protection focuses on wearing light-colored clothing and applying insect repellent every 3–4 hours. Vietnam, Thailand, and Malaysia face ongoing mosquito-borne diseases and measles outbreaks; measles is highly contagious, with fever, rash, cough, and runny nose. Travelers should be vaccinated at least two weeks before departure; if not vaccinated, monitor for symptoms after return and seek prompt medical care to prevent spread. The Philippines is a designated cholera quarantine area, so vigilance around contaminated water and seafood is advised. In the United States and parts of China, avian influenza has human infection risk zones, so avoid farm visits and animal contact. Japan and Hong Kong are not quarantine zones but require strong personal hygiene and awareness of heat-related illness during hot, humid summer.

article.articleSummary: As of July 2026, dengue fever cases in Ogan Komering Ilir (OKI) Regency, South Sumatra, reached 25 infections in a single month. The OKI Health Office reports cases across several puskesmas, prompting intensified surveillance and response. Authorities have conducted epidemiologic investigations and vector-control measures, including source reduction (PSN) and fogging in affected areas; officials stress fogging alone is not sufficient. The outbreak is transmitted by Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. Public health measures emphasize Clean and Healthy Living Behavior (PHBS): regularly drain water storage containers, cover reservoirs, keep surroundings clean, and avoid hanging clothes indoors where mosquitoes breed. Residents experiencing sudden high fever up to 40°C, muscle and joint pain, and red skin rashes should promptly visit the nearest puskesmas for evaluation and management.

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Η δεύτερη μεγαλύτερη επιδημία Έμπολα με 3.532 κρούσματα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: The second-largest Ebola epidemic with 3,532 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the second-largest ever recorded globally, with 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths reported by the DR Congo Ministry of Communications as of July 31, 2026. The ongoing epidemic continues to spread rapidly, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak that had 3,481 cases. The largest Ebola epidemic on record occurred in West Africa from 2014 to 2016, with 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, according to the World Health Organization. The article notes the figures were published via the X platform.

article.articleHeadline: Jharkhand reports 16,700+ malaria cases in 6 months: Causes, symptoms and prevention | TheHealthSite.com
article.articleSummary: Jharkhand logged 16,728 malaria cases in the first six months of 2026, with East Singhbhum 6,527 and West Singhbhum 6,172, together about three-quarters of the state's malaria burden. Dengue totaled 77 cases in June, Ranchi recording the highest at 27, signaling monsoon-season mosquito risk. Malaria is caused by Plasmodium parasites transmitted by infected female Anopheles mosquitoes; WHO cites stagnant water, heavy rainfall and poor sanitation as drivers. Symptoms typically appear 10-15 days after a bite. In response, authorities intensified surveillance, mosquito-control operations, prompt diagnosis and anti-malarial drug supplies, along with awareness campaigns and greater community involvement. The measures were discussed at a state Task Force meeting in Ranchi to strengthen prevention and control of vector-borne diseases during the monsoon.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: clôture de l'année académique dans le respect des mesures sanitaires à l'IBTP-Kisangani - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: End of the academic year in compliance with health measures at IBTP-Kisangani - ACP
article.articleSummary: During the 2025-2026 academic year's closing ceremony at the Institut du bâtiment et des travaux publics de Kisangani (IBTP-Kis) in Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola prevention measures were observed. To curb Ebola Virus Disease transmission, handwashing stations with soap were installed at the main entrance, seating was arranged to maintain physical distancing, and masks were provided to attendees. Access was restricted to invited guests, laureates, and academic, scientific, and administrative staff, with relatives of finalists seated in a separate room to avoid crowding. IBTP-Kis staff stated the ceremony was conducted in strict adherence to health protocols. No Ebola case information was reported; the measures reflect routine outbreak prevention rather than a confirmed outbreak at this event. Location: Kisangani, Democratic Republic of the Congo; Date: 31 July 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Hadir di ASEAN Dengue Day, Soffell Beri Edukasi Pencegahan DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Soffell Delivers Dengue Fever Prevention Education at ASEAN Dengue Day
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Soffell and Enesis Group, in cooperation with the Ministry of Health, DKI Jakarta Health Office, and Jakarta Education Office, launched CSR program 'ASEAN Dengue Day 2026' to promote Dengue fever (DHF) prevention in Indonesia. The campaign features a roadshow delivering interactive education on the 3M+ approach—Menguras (drain), Menutup (cover), Mendaur Ulang (recycle)—and personal protection from Aedes mosquito bites using Soffell anti-mosquito lotion, offering up to 8 hours of protection without skin drying or stickiness. Activities took place at several Jakarta elementary schools: SDN 03 & 05 Tanah Tinggi, SDN 20 Utan Kayu Selatan, and SDN 02 Mampang Prapatan. The initiative backs Indonesia Zero Dengue Death by 2030 and aims to cultivate prevention culture from an early age. Soffell, known for lotion and spray repellent, complements environmental clean-up efforts and personal protection against dengue-transmitting mosquitoes.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo — the second-largest in history — Onlíner Technologies.
article.articleSummary: Second-largest Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths, continues to outpace containment. By contrast, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone registered 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths, per the World Health Organization. In Uganda, officials recently declared the outbreak over after 42 days without a new case, aligning with two incubation periods. The Reuters report emphasizes ongoing transmission dynamics and the challenge of controlling the outbreak in the DRC.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DRC the fastest growing in the history of the virus
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) is the fastest-growing on record, with 3,360 confirmed cases across five eastern provinces and 1,487 deaths (case fatality ~45%). Declared 15 May, the outbreak is spreading rapidly, approaching the 2018–2020 toll of 3,470 infections; Ituri province, including Bunia and Rwampara health zones, bears the heaviest burden amid insecurity, mining, and high population density. Response measures include strengthened surveillance via community liaison officers, more than 20 Ebola treatment centres, and local laboratories for testing. Clinical trials for a Bundibugyo-targeted vaccine began in early July, about 20 people enrolled by 15 July, with up to four months duration. Uganda—now declared outbreak-free—has dispatched experts to assist in border regions Tchomia and Kasenyi. Case counts continue to rise in Bunia and Rwampara as authorities race to bring the outbreak under control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、史上最速の拡大ペースに
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目(深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク)に該当し、WPRO基準も全項目で該当するため、フルリスク評価に進むべき重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 感染は主にDRC東部(イトゥリ州、ブニア、ランパラ保健地区)で発生。ウガンダは流行終息宣言済みで国境地域(Tchomia, Kasenyi)への支援派遣にとどまるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。ワクチン臨床試験開始や治療センター20カ所超の設置など対応が進行中だが、致死率約45%と極めて高く、感染拡大が続いている点で重大なシグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: DRC berdepan wabak Ebola kedua terbesar dalam sejarah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC faces the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) faces the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history, driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain across eastern provinces. The DRC Ministry of Communications reported 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths as of 31 July 2026, with transmission continuing in several eastern regions. This outbreak has surpassed the country’s Ebola record set during 2018–2020. The report provides counts but does not detail laboratory confirmation methods, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. The persistent, high-magnitude outbreak underscores a severe public health crisis in the DRC, requiring sustained response efforts to curb transmission and reduce mortality in affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、史上2番目に大規模なエボラ流行に直面
triage.triage_reason: 3,532症例・1,556死亡という大規模流行で公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 致死率が約44%と非常に高く、2018-2020年の流行を上回る規模。検査確認方法や感染源の詳細は記事に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Ухудшение ситуации с безопасностью на востоке ДРК затрудняет борьбу со вспышкой Эболы -- ООН
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Worsening security in eastern DRC hampers the fight against the Ebola outbreak — UN.
article.articleSummary: Worsening security in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is hampering the Ebola outbreak response in Ituri province, according to UN OCHA. Heightened violence and attacks on civilians limit humanitarian access and raise risks for internally displaced families. Plaine-Savo, a displacement site near Jugu in the Fataki sanitary zone where Ebola has been confirmed, faces severe conditions: at least 12 displaced children were reportedly abducted on July 27, and local civil society groups report about 23 displaced persons killed in and around the camp in the first half of the year. Plaine-Savo shelters more than 76,000 displaced residents, many fleeing repeated violence. Humanitarian conditions are extremely challenging, with limited food, clean water, and basic services; overcrowding and poor living conditions increase the risk of Ebola transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部の治安悪化がエボラ流行対応を妨げている－国連
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重大な公衆衛生上の脅威に加え、治安悪化・人道アクセス制限・過密避難所という感染拡大リスク要因が重なっており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBeninのDjougou/Dongaが含まれるが、記事本文はDRC・Ituri州のエボラ流行対応に関する内容であり、Beninは主題として言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : une enquête situe le début de l'épidémie d'Ebola en janvier, bien avant l'alerte officielle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: An investigation places the start of the Ebola outbreak in January, long before the official alert.
article.articleSummary: An on‑the‑ground investigation into the Democratic Republic of Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak suggests it began in January 2026 in Mongbwalu, Ituri, well before the official alert on May 15. Researchers interviewed 97 people and analyzed medical records, WhatsApp exchanges, funeral biographies, and cemetery records, estimating more than 500 suspected cases from mid‑January to May 15. Thirteen frontline health workers died and 42 became ill before recovering. Transmission was already clustered within households; private clinics closed and a cemetery logged up to 20 burials per day. Delays were attributed to misattribution of deaths to HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, or artisanal gold mining, plus a culture of secrecy that discouraged reporting. WHO funded the study, which did not seek patient zero. Independent experts say late detection complicated response; containment in Mongbwalu might have eased overall control. Earlier genetic analyses placed origins around mid‑March; January start remains plausible but requires more viral sequences from Mongbwalu.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:調査により、エボラ流行の始まりは公式警報より大幅に早い1月と判明
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国の第17次エボラ流行に関する調査で、公式警報前に既に500例以上の疑い症例と多数の死亡が発生していたことが判明し、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と異常性が確認されたため。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の第17次エボラ流行（DRC、Ituri州Mongbwalu）に関する後方視的調査結果であり、新規発生ではないが、検知の遅れと拡大規模の深刻さから引き続き注視・フルRRAの対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Կոնգոյում Էբոլա տենդով վարակվածների թիվը գերազանցել է 3,5 հազարը
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the number of people infected with Ebola fever has exceeded 3,500.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 3,500 infections, with 3,532 confirmed cases. Among them, 807 patients are in isolation or hospitalization; 626 have recovered and 1,556 have died, yielding a case fatality rate of 44.1%. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared the Congo–Uganda Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and said the regional risk of spread is high. The situation remains ongoing, characterized by substantial mortality and continued patient isolation, though the report does not specify transmission sources or details on exported/imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ熱感染者数が3,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した進行中のエボラ流行で、致死率44.1%と深刻。IHR基準に複数該当し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれるが対象国リストに該当しないため除外。WHOはコンゴ・ウガンダ間の流行として5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू का बढ़ने लगा डंक, जुलाई में मिले 23 मरीज; पटना में आंकड़ा 67 पहुंचा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue on the rise; 23 patients detected in July; Patna tally reaches 67
article.articleSummary: Patna, Bihar: Dengue cases are rising during the monsoon. In July, 23 more patients were detected in Patna, bringing the year-to-date total to 67; one new case was reported on July 29, with three lab-confirmed cases on July 28. Health officials warn post-rain standing water creates Aedes aegypti breeding sites, sustaining transmission. Larval habitats include water collected in old rooftop tires, flower pots, coolers, drums, buckets, and other containers. Despite cooler temperatures, humidity and waterlogging may boost mosquito populations. Patna Medical College and Hospital (PMCH) officials urge prompt medical consultation for high fever, headache, pain behind the eyes, body/joint pain, weakness, nausea, or skin rashes, and advise against self-medication and to maintain fluids. Authorities call for intensified surveillance, vector-control, and clean-up campaigns to curb the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱が増加傾向、7月に23人の患者を確認；パトナの累計は67人に到達
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱増加であり、地域の通常のモンスーン時期の流行パターンの範囲内。異常性や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 毎年モンスーン期に発生するデング熱の季節的増加。地方当局が媒介蚊対策とサーベイランス強化を呼びかけているが、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内であり外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 增1宗外地傳入登革熱　病人曾到菲律賓
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One more imported dengue fever case; the patient had been to the Philippines.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 July 2026, Hong Kong reported one more imported dengue fever case, with travel to the Philippines during the incubation period, in the 24–30 July reporting week. The year-to-date dengue total is 27 cases (25 imported, 2 locally acquired). In 2023 there were 59 cases (all imported); in 2024 there were 161 cases (156 imported, 5 local). Two imported chikungunya fever cases have been recorded this year. The Centre for Health Protection notes that warm, rainy summer conditions favor Aedes mosquito breeding, and authorities remind residents to maintain environmental hygiene to reduce transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: 輸入デング熱症例がさらに1件増加、患者はフィリピン渡航歴あり
triage.triage_reason: 香港での輸入例1件の追加報告であり、例年発生している範囲内の事例で、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 香港での輸入デング熱症例報告。感染地はフィリピンであり、香港自体（対象国外）は含めない。過去数年の実績と比較して件数は特段の増加なし。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases surge beyond 3,500
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surged beyond 3,500 cases. As of 2026-07-31, the DRC reports 3,532 confirmed Ebola cases, 626 recoveries and 1,556 deaths, for a mortality rate of 44.1%. The outbreak remains ongoing, with authorities noting continued transmission and urging intensified response. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared the Ebola situation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda an emergency and a threat to other countries, and it assesses the regional risk of spread as high.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ症例が3,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHOが緊急事態・他国への脅威と宣言し、致死率44.1%と高く、症例数が3,500人超と急増しているため国際的拡大リスクも高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCの症例急増であり、Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOは5月17日にDRC・ウガンダのエボラ状況を緊急事態・他国への脅威と宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число случаев заражения лихорадкой Эбола превысило 3,5 тысячи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, the number of Ebola virus disease cases has exceeded 3,500.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 3,532 confirmed cases as of July 31, 2026. Of these, 807 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, 626 have recovered, and 1,556 have died, yielding a case fatality rate of 44.1%. The outbreak spans the DRC with cross-border implications for Uganda; on May 17, the World Health Organization declared this Congo–Uganda outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and assessed the regional risk as high. The figures reported by the DRC Ministry of Communications and Information reflect ongoing transmission within the DRC and cross-border concerns, signaling continued need for surveillance and containment to prevent further spread. No further imported or exported case data were provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の感染者数が3,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率44.1%の大規模エボラ流行がPHEICに指定され、ウガンダへの越境拡大も懸念されるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみを検証済み地域として記載。WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言済みで、既にフルRRA相当の対応が進行中と推測される。

article.articleHeadline: Forskere advarer: Det lukkede Hormuz-stræde kan føre til biologisk "superspreder-event"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Researchers warn: The closed Strait of Hormuz could lead to a biological superspreader event.
article.articleSummary: Hundreds of stranded ships in the Strait of Hormuz risk becoming hubs for microbes, algae, and invertebrates, potentially triggering a biological superspreader event as vessels resume travel. Biofouling accelerates when ships lie idle for more than 10 days, compromising hull coatings and enabling rapid colonization. Invasive species could disrupt local ecosystems by outcompeting native species and by spreading diseases not present in recipient waters. A study published July 22, led by Mario Tamburri of the University of Maryland Center for Climate Research, warns the global maritime network could disseminate these organisms if ships are not cleaned before departure. Mitigations include in-water hull cleaning prior to leaving Hormuz, per-ship risk assessments, and port monitoring in high-risk locations—especially ports with Gulf-region conditions in Greece, the Netherlands, India, and the Middle East.

triage.headline_ja: 研究者らが警告：ホルムズ海峡の封鎖が生物学的『スーパースプレッダー・イベント』を招く可能性
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、船舶の生物付着による侵略的種拡散リスクに関する仮説的な学術研究の紹介記事であり、現時点で人間の健康被害は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は船舶の生物付着(biofouling)による海洋侵略的種拡散の将来的リスクに関する研究発表であり、感染症アウトブレイクの実発生報告ではない。インドはリスク評価対象港の例として言及されているのみで、実際のイベント発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Число случаев заражения лихорадкой Эбола в Конго превысило 3500
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola fever cases in the Congo has surpassed 3,500.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 July 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 3,500 cases, with 3,532 confirmed infections. Of these, 807 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, 626 have recovered, and 1,556 have died, yielding a case fatality rate of 44.1%. The figures come from a DR Congo Ministry of Communications briefing cited by Armenpress on X. The outbreak also affects neighboring Uganda. On 17 May, the World Health Organization declared the Congo and Uganda Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, indicating a high regional risk of spread to other countries. This underscores the need for vigilant surveillance and continued public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱感染者数が3500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: PHEICに指定されたコンゴ・ウガンダのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで、致死率44.1%、3500例超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが確認されるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダも影響を受けているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOは既に本アウトブレイクをPHEICに指定済み。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-uitbraak Congo op een na grootste ooit geregistreerd
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo, the second largest ever recorded.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, with 3,552 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths. The outbreak center is Kinshasa, and transmission remains ongoing. Neighboring Uganda has 20 cases and 2 deaths, but authorities announced the country is Ebola-free this week. The 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak remains the largest, with 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Ebola is a rare, highly deadly infection caused by the ebolavirus. According to the RIVM, more than half of those infected die, and the disease typically occurs only in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、史上2番目の規模に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で3,552症例・1,556死亡という史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行が継続中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは20症例・2死亡が報告されたが、当局は今週エボラ終息を宣言したとのことで、記事の主題はコンゴでの流行継続。シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは2014-2016年の過去流行の比較対象として言及されているのみで、現行イベントの発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 19 pigs culled after ASF infects hogs in Brgy. Quiot, Cebu
article.articleSummary: ASF confirmed in nine hogs led to the humane culling and burial of 19 live pigs in Barangay Quiot, Cebu City, Philippines. Laboratory confirmation prompted immediate isolation; 19 animals were culled after nine positive samples. Containment occurred within 15 days of detection, aided by intensified surveillance, movement controls, and interagency coordination. Measures included random testing, farm biosecurity campaigns, and inter-barangay border controls to regulate live pig and pork movements. Executive Order No. 86 strengthened biosecurity; inspections at Cebu Ports 1–3 and Pasil Fish Port were intensified, with stricter documentary requirements for hog traders and transporters, including veterinary health certificates, ASF-negative results, shipping permits, and certificates of acceptance. Authorities: Cebu City DVMF; Mayor Nestor Archival; Dr. Jessica Maribojoc; collaboration with BAI-Veterinary Quarantine Service Region 7, Cebu Port Authority, Philippine Coast Guard, Cebu City Police, Market Operations Division, Central Visayas Pork Producers Cooperative. ASF does not infect humans; no vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: セブ市バランガイ・キオットでASF感染により豚19頭を殺処分
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（ASF）であり、人畜共通感染症ではないため公衆衛生への直接的影響は低く、既に封じ込め済みで管理体制も整っている。
triage.notes: ASF（アフリカ豚熱）は動物疾病でありヒトには感染しない。地域当局により迅速な封じ込め・管理が行われており、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。畜産・経済への影響として動物衛生部門でのモニタリング対象。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: 3.532 κρούσματα Έμπολα - Η δεύτερη μεγαλύτερη επιδημία του ιού στη χώρα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: 3,532 Ebola cases — the second-largest Ebola outbreak in the country.
article.articleSummary: As of July 31, 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths, according to the Ministry of Communications on X. This marks the second-largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded globally, with case counts surpassing the 2018-2020 outbreak (3,481 cases). Only the West Africa epidemic of 2014–2016 was larger, totaling 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, per the World Health Organization. The report notes the virus continues to spread rapidly, hindering containment efforts. The data underscore ongoing transmission in the DRC and are reported via government channels on social media.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラ出血熱3,532例—同国史上2番目に大きい流行
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ症例が3,532例・死者1,556人に達し、史上2番目の規模の流行と報告されており、重篤性・国際拡大リスクともに高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行のみを扱っており、シエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアは過去の2014-2016年流行との比較文脈で言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: BUNYORO REGION STILL AT RISK OF EBOLA DESPITE MOH DECLARING COUNTRY FREE - MK Newslink
article.articleSummary: Uganda declared Ebola-free on 28 July 2026, but the Bunyoro sub-region along the Uganda-DRC border remains at elevated risk due to cross-border movement from the Democratic Republic of Congo, which continues to report new Ebola cases. DRC has over 3,000 registered cases and more than 1,000 deaths, with a concentration in Kasenyi in Eastern DRC. In Uganda, 20 Ebola cases were reported from May to June 2026, with 2 deaths and 18 recoveries. Ministry of Health senior communications officer Emmanuel Ainebyoona stressed border districts ongoing vulnerability to new transmission via porous borders and urged continued vigilance and adherence to SOPs. The MoH, coordinating with UNICEF, is training border-area media practitioners to report responsibly and maintain community sensitization about Ebola signs. Hoima city hosted the briefing as part of preparedness despite the declared national Ebola-free status.

triage.headline_ja: ブニョロ地域、保健省が国内清浄化を宣言したにもかかわらずエボラのリスクが依然として存在
triage.triage_reason: DRCで3,000例超・死亡1,000人超の大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、ウガンダとの越境感染リスクが指摘されているため、IHR基準複数該当・WPRO基準複数該当のシグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はウガンダの越境リスクだが、実際の活動的な流行地はDRC（Kasenyi等）であり、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないためverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: 'Lá chắn' bảo vệ nông dân trước bệnh lao nơi xứ Lạng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Shield' protects farmers from tuberculosis in Lang Son Province.
article.articleSummary: Proactive community-based screening in Lang Son Province, Vietnam, has protected farmers from tuberculosis (TB) via local health networks. In 2025, Lang Son Lung Hospital organized TB screening in four districts (Lộc Bình, Hữu Lũng, Văn Lãng, Bình Gia), examining 8,640 people, with chest X-rays performed on all and GeneXpert testing for 1,181. Detected 64 drug-susceptible TB cases, 1 pediatric TB case, and 1 drug-resistant TB case. In the first half of 2026, 89% of target individuals were screened; bacteriologically confirmed TB accounted for 76.4%, with 46.6% admissions. Six-month treatment success for bacteriologically confirmed TB reached 91.5%. Drug-resistant TB: 233 Xpert tests, 7 treated (6 Rifampicin-resistant, 1 MDR). Strengthened local capacity via 1 diagnostic/therapy/prevention update training and 3 TB awareness trainings; free medications delivered within 3 km of home, Telehealth, and 78.89% non-cash payments reduced central referrals by 2% year over year.

triage.headline_ja: ランソン省の農民を結核から守る「盾」
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムの実施状況を報告する内容であり、異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 結核スクリーニングプログラムの実績報告記事であり、通常の公衆衛生活動の一環。新たな流行や異常事態の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : avec plus de 3.500 cas confirmés, le CDC Afrique juge l'épidémie toujours incontrôlée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: With more than 3,500 confirmed cases, Africa CDC says the outbreak remains out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 3,532 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths, with 807 patients still in isolation or hospitalised and 626 recovered. Reported May 15 by the Congolese government, the epidemic spans five eastern provinces—Ituri (epicentre), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Africa CDC Africa notes this is the fastest-growing outbreak to date and says it is not yet under control. More than 80% of new cases in Ituri are not linked to known contact lists, and over 60% of fatalities occur in communities rather than Ebola treatment centers. The director-general Jean Kaseya emphasised that control has not been achieved. Keywords: Ebola, DRC, outbreak, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ:確認症例3,500例超、アフリカCDCは依然として流行を制御できていないと判断
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC5州に拡大し3,500例超・死者1,556人と深刻で、Africa CDCも制御不能と評価しており国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 80%以上の新規症例が既知の接触者リストと関連せず、60%以上の死亡が地域社会内で発生しており、感染連鎖の追跡困難性が高い。Africa CDC事務局長も制御未達成と明言しており、国際的な支援・介入の必要性が高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Anak Balita Dominasi Kasus TBC di Kota Jogja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Under-fives Dominate TB Cases in Yogyakarta City
article.articleSummary: TB remains a priority in Yogyakarta City, Indonesia, with children under five most affected. By 23 July 2026, the City Health Office (Dinkes Kota Jogja) records 174 pediatric TB cases, about 71% of the 2025 pediatric total (246). Children account for roughly 12% of all TB cases in Kota Jogja, with under-fives most affected. Transmission sources include parents, neighbors, and even a daily vegetable vendor; most pediatric cases are identified after symptom onset when families seek care, unlike adults identified through contact tracing. TB treatment lasts at least six months and completion is near 100% in children, thanks to parental supervision. Public health measures stress PHBS, healthy housing, good ventilation, direct sunlight, and regular sunning of bedding and furniture, plus nutritious diets. As of 23 July 2026, total TB cases reported: 680; authorities also pursue expanded case finding and TB preventive therapy (TPT) for latent infection to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ジョグジャカルタ市の結核症例、5歳未満児が多数を占める
triage.triage_reason: 結核はインドネシアで既知のエンデミック疾患であり、通常の公衆衛生モニタリング報告の域を出ず、異常性や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地域の定期的な公衆衛生報告であり、既存の結核対策プログラム（TPT、症例発見拡大等）の一環として扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: Настоящата епидемия от ебола в ДР Конго е втората по мащаб в света, откакто се води статистика, сочат официални данни
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The current Ebola outbreak in DR Congo is the second largest in the world since records began, according to official data.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains the second largest on record. As of July 31, 2026, government data show 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak total of 3,481 cases. The outbreak is centered in the eastern DRC, with reporting from Bunia and other areas. The Ministry of Communications in Kinshasa highlighted that transmission continues to outpace containment efforts. Worldwide, only the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak was larger, with 28,616 infections and 11,310 deaths across Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone, according to the World Health Organization. A photo from July 3, 2026 shows medical staff at the Evangelical Medical Center in Bunia. The article relies on official data and does not detail laboratory confirmation, transmission sources, or imported/exported cases.

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы в Демократической республике Конго стала второй по числу заболевших в истории наблюдений -- Meduza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo became the second-highest in the number of cases in the history of surveillance.
article.articleSummary: As of July 31, 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) ongoing since April has reached 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths, the second-highest on record. Only the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) had more (28,616 cases, 11,310 deaths); the 2018-2020 DRC outbreak logged 3,481 cases and 2,270 deaths. The current outbreak is spreading faster; the death toll of 1,556 was reached after three months, versus ten months in 2018-2020. Containment continues to lag behind transmission. In neighboring Uganda, on July 28 authorities declared the Bundibugyo virus outbreak over after four weeks with no new cases; Uganda reported 20 cases and 3 deaths. The current outbreak’s main viral strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、観測史上2番目の規模に -- Meduza

triage.notes: 発生地域にシエラレオネ、リベリア、ウガンダ、ギニアが含まれるが、これらは過去の流行事例として言及されているのみで現行の主題ではないため除外。現行の流行はDRCのみが対象国。ウガンダのBundibugyo株流行は既に終息宣言済み。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Finland, African swine fever was detected for the first time: pork exports outside the EU are halted.
article.articleSummary: As of July 31, 2026, Finland reports its first African swine fever (ASF) detection from the remains of three dead wild boar piglets found in Virolahti. Finnish Food Authority preliminary tests indicate ASF; final confirmation is pending from the EU ASF reference laboratory in Spain, though outbreak controls are already in place. An infection zone covers Virolahti, Miehikkälä, and parts of Lappeenranta, with a hunting ban to prevent disturbance of wild boars. The development hits exports; pork exports outside the EU are halted until new terms are agreed with non-EU partners (for example China). Non-EU pork export value is about €74 million annually; Finland produces about 160 million kg of pork per year, exporting under 30 million kg. Asia markets are strict, often suspending farm pig meat sales even if ASF is detected in wild boar. The region has a dense wild boar population but relatively few pig farms.

triage.headline_ja: フィンランドで初めてアフリカ豚熱（ASF）を検出：EU域外への豚肉輸出停止
triage.triage_reason: フィンランドで初めてASFが野生イノシシから検出され、これはその国・地域にとって異常な事象であり、EU域外への豚肉輸出停止という貿易制限も生じているためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 本事象はフィンランドにおける野生イノシシのASF検出であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。記事中の中国はEU域外輸出先として言及されているのみで、発生地ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。ASFは非人獣共通感染症であり人への直接的健康リスクはないが、貿易・畜産業への影響がありバイオセキュリティ監視の観点から注視対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Covid in Cina, cosa c'è dietro la nuova ondata estiva con oltre 79 mila casi della variante Omicron NB.1.8.1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 in China: What's behind the new summer wave with over 79,000 cases of the Omicron NB.1.8.1 variant.
article.articleSummary: China reports a new summer wave of COVID-19 driven by the Omicron NB.1.8.1 variant, with more than 79,000 confirmed cases, 130 severe and 1 death. Most patients have mild symptoms, including fever and sore throat, with recovery typically within a week. NB.1.8.1 is described as having moderate transmission, with a 4.3% increase in contagion. For the first time, COVID-19 in China has surpassed influenza as the leading respiratory pathogen. The surge is attributed to hot weather driving people indoors into air-conditioned spaces, creating winter-like transmission conditions in summer. In Italy, experts warn of the ongoing hospital strain: infectious disease specialist Matteo Bassetti notes the virus is becoming a more summer-time threat, though still dangerous for the very elderly and frail. OECD data show Italy spent 8.4% of GDP on health in 2025 (down from 8.7% in 2019), below Germany/France (>10%), Spain (9%), and the UK (10%).

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: No Ebola case in India; 10,974 travellers screened since May 23, JP Nadda informs Lok Sabha
article.articleSummary: India has recorded no Ebola cases so far, with intensified surveillance following the WHO declaration of the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). From May 23 to July 28, 2026, 10,974 international travelers arriving from Ebola-affected countries—specifically the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan—were screened on arrival, guided by self-declaration forms and via the Air Suvidha 2.0 portal. The measures reflect continued cross-border vigilance to prevent importation of Ebola while monitoring remains active. No laboratory-confirmed infections have been reported in India to date. The information was presented to the Lok Sabha by Union Health Minister J. P. Nadda.

triage.triage_reason: 記事の主眼はインドにおけるスクリーニング状況（症例ゼロ）であり新規シグナルとしての価値は低いが、背景にあるDRC由来のエボラ出血熱（WHOがPHEIC宣言）は継続監視が必要な重大事案であるため。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo records world's second-largest Ebola outbreak as infections rise
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has reached 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths, according to the Congolese Ministry of Communications, making it the world's second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The figure surpasses 3,481 infections from the 2018–2020 outbreak. The World Health Organization notes the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic remains the largest, with 28,616 confirmed cases and 11,310 deaths across Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone. Ongoing challenges in DR Congo include insecurity, weakened healthcare infrastructure, and the absence of an approved vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain, which has complicated containment efforts. Kinshasa is cited as the outbreak location, with cases continuing to rise as of July 31, 2026. The article does not provide detail on laboratory confirmation, infection source, or any imported/exported cases.

article.articleHeadline: بيانات: إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية ثاني أكبر تفش على الإطلاق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Data: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the second-largest outbreak on record.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the second-largest on record, with 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths by Friday, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak (3,481 cases). The World Health Organization notes that the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak remains the largest (28,616 cases, 11,310 deaths in Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone). Officials say the true scope may be 2–4 times the official figures. Declared in mid-May, this is the seventh Ebola outbreak in the DRC, with infections likely spreading weeks earlier. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo strain (40% CFR), for which there is no licensed vaccine. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected people or animals; symptoms include fever, vomiting, and internal and external bleeding. Safe burial practices are essential; IOM warns about cross-border body transfers, and WHO notes about 4 of 5 contacts under surveillance, with the remainder untracked due to insecurity or mistrust.

article.articleHeadline: Merck-backed Ebola vaccine moves towards clinical manufacturing
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) escalates, with 3360 confirmed cases and 1487 deaths as of July 29, 2026. Hilleman Laboratories, a Merck-Wellcome JV, will manufacture clinical-trial doses of an investigational Bundibugyo vaccine using IAVI’s single-dose rVSV platform, backed by up to $8.5 million from CEPI. IAVI supplies starting material; Merck provides rVSV expertise, aiming to have tens of thousands of doses for early-phase testing by end-2026. This program seeks to accelerate clinical evaluation and manufacturing readiness amid no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo virus disease, unlike Zaire ebolavirus Ervebo. If needed, technology transfer could shift production to larger manufacturers. CEPI also backs an Oxford/Serum Institute ChAdOx1 candidate, Moderna, and Public Health Vaccines programs; WHO has published a Bundibugyo target product profile to guide development.

triage.headline_ja: Merck支援のエボラワクチン、臨床製造に向け前進
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行が3360症例・1487死亡に達しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）に複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola vaccine production gets $8.5 million boost as outbreak turns second-deadliest ever
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 3,442 confirmed cases and 1,521 deaths, making it the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak on record, with Ituri Province as the epicentre and healthcare facilities under pressure (beds more than 80% occupied). The outbreak was declared in mid-May and designated a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17; there are no approved therapeutics or vaccines specifically for Bundibugyo. WHO-led trials are evaluating two experimental therapies alongside enhanced supportive care. CEPI commits up to $8.5 million to Hilleman Laboratories to accelerate manufacturing of an rVSV-based Bundibugyo vaccine candidate for clinical trials, building on up to $30 million earlier for MSD’s Zaire ebolavirus vaccine manufacturing. If early results are favorable, technology will transfer to a large-scale producer. Uganda reports an imported case linked to the DRC and is Ebola-free after border closures; WHO launches a $518 million six-month emergency plan for DRC and Uganda.

article.articleHeadline: 食腦蟲｜男子泰國狂食生醃海鮮染「食腦蟲」腸道嚴重潰爛　反覆大出血休克險死|香港經濟日報 TOPick
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brain-eating Worm | Thai man binge-eats raw marinated seafood and contracts a 'brain-eating worm'; severe intestinal ulcers, recurrent massive bleeding and shock, nearly died | Hong Kong Economic Daily TOPick
article.articleSummary: A Shanghai resident (Xu, pseudonym) developed a severe Entamoeba histolytica infection after traveling to Thailand, linked to大量 raw marinated seafood. After returning to China, he suffered extensive intestinal ulcers, recurrent massive gastrointestinal bleeding, and septic shock, requiring multiple surgeries. He was transferred to Shanghai Public Health Clinical Center, where a personalized, multidisciplinary, intensive treatment course lasting over 30 days controlled the bleeding and severe infection, enabling recovery. Laboratory confirmation identified Entamoeba histolytica as the causative parasite; complications can include liver abscess from hematogenous spread. The case highlights amoebic dysentery risk in tropical/subtropical regions and the potential for rapid deterioration. Experts warn travelers to observe strict food and water hygiene when visiting Thailand and similar areas and to seek prompt medical care for severe abdominal symptoms.
