triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部のエボラ流行は感染者3,532人・死者1,556人に達し、史上2番目の規模と報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性の両基準に該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべきである。
triage.notes: 記事はアンゴラについて言及していないため、発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。国境を越えた拡大や渡航制限の情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai: ELISA Machine Defunct For 3 Months At Kandivali BMC Hospital Amid Monsoon Disease Surge
article.articleSummary: During Mumbai’s peak monsoon, Kandivali’s Bharat Ratna Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar (BDBA) Hospital has had an ELISA machine non-functional for at least three months, hindering confirmatory testing for dengue, leptospirosis, Hepatitis B and Hepatitis C. In the absence of ELISA, suspected dengue and leptospirosis cases are diagnosed with rapid tests, but BMC surveillance counts only ELISA or RT-PCR confirmations, so many cases are not logged as confirmed. Hospital sources say seven to eight patients recently tested positive for dengue via rapid tests; some cases have been referred to private labs for ELISA at Rs 2,500–4,000 per test. A newly donated ELISA machine, provided by Union Minister Piyush Goyal three months ago, remained non-operational but is now installed and expected to be operational by Saturday. Dr Ajay Gupta says treatment remains unchanged; officials warn that surveillance is hampered by staff shortages and technicians’ limited travel between civic hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイ：モンスーン性疾患急増の中、カンディヴリBMC病院のELISA機器が3か月間故障中
triage.triage_reason: 医療機器の故障による検査体制の問題を報じる記事であり、感染症の異常な流行や公衆衛生上の重大な影響を示すものではない。既知の季節性疾患（デング熱・レプトスピラ症）の通常の監視体制の課題に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事はムンバイの一病院における検査機器の機能不全という医療インフラの問題が主題であり、デング熱・レプトスピラ症自体の異常な流行を報じるものではない。地元自治体（BMC）内での対応課題として管理可能な事案。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatites virais evoluem em silêncio e ainda matam por falta de diagnóstico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral hepatitis progresses silently and still kills due to lack of diagnosis.
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces silent viral hepatitis B and C, often progressing for decades without symptoms until serious liver disease. From 2000–2024, 826,000 confirmed cases and 50,000 deaths were recorded. Hepatitis C accounts for 41.5% of cases but 75.3% of deaths; hepatitis B accounts for 36.6% of cases and 22% of deaths. Mortality fell 50% for hepatitis B and 60% for hepatitis C between 2014–2024 due to vaccination, testing, and treatment access. The WHO Global Hepatitis Report 2026 praises Brazil for eliminating vertical hepatitis B transmission in under-5s, with prevalence below 0.1%, toward 2030 target. Testing is free and rapid via SUS at Primary Health Units and CTA centers, under the 'Um Teste Pode Mudar Tudo' campaign in July Yellow. Adults should be tested at least once; high-risk groups include transfusions before 1993, shared needles, unprotected sex, and health workers. Early diagnosis enables cure, hepatitis C at 97% with 3–6 months of oral antivirals.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス性肝炎は静かに進行し、診断不足のため今も命を奪っている
triage.triage_reason: 長期的な公衆衛生統計・啓発キャンペーンに関する記事であり、急性の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 20年以上にわたる長期統計と啓発キャンペーンの報道であり、突発的な感染症イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya under control in Samar, Philippines: Health officials
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya cases in Samar province, Philippines, are under control as of 2026-07-31. The DOH Eastern Visayas Regional Epidemiology and Surveillance Unit reports 372 chikungunya cases, mainly from Basey and Gandara, with no new surge observed. Sporadic cases persist in various parts of the region, but the number of new infections is not considered alarming, according to Roderick Cerro, head of the EV-RESU. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes. Typical symptoms include abrupt fever and severe joint pain, often with muscle pain, headache, nausea, fatigue, and rash. Severe joint pain can last days to months or longer; serious complications are uncommon, though atypical severe cases can cause long-term symptoms or death in older adults and infants under one year. There is no specific antiviral cure; treatment is supportive.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン・サマール州でチクングニア熱は制御下に：保健当局
triage.triage_reason: 372例のチクングニア熱が報告されているが当局は「制御下」「憂慮すべきでない」と評価しており、新規急増もなく異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 地域の風土病的な流行であり、当局が制御下と明言しているためDISMISSと判定。ただし媒介蚊による散発的発生が続いているため今後の動向は要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: Campinas coloca 31 bairros sob alerta; veja quais - ACidade ON Campinas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Campinas puts 31 neighborhoods on alert; see which ones - ACidade ON Campinas.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil, announced the 31st Arboviroses Alert of 2026, designating 31 neighborhoods as high risk for dengue transmission by Aedes aegypti. The areas span six regions—East, Northwest, North, Southwest, South and Southeast—including Jardim Guanabara, Jardim Novo Maracanã, Parque Maria Helena, Jardim São José and Sousas. The alert triggers intensified vector-control actions: elimination of breeding sites, property inspections, and resident education, with outreach extending to surrounding nearby zones. From Jan 1 to July 28, 2026, Campinas reported 3,531 dengue cases. Between January and June, the city carried out 820,643 home visits and 53,382 backpack fogging operations. Health officials stress community participation, noting that about 80% of Aedes aegypti breeding sites are inside homes; residents should keep gutters clear, close water tanks, remove standing water, and allow health teams access during inspections.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：カンピーナスが31地区に警戒を発令、対象地区を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・カンピーナスにおけるデング熱の季節性流行に対する通常の行政対応（媒介蚊対策・警戒地域指定）であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年流行する風土病であり、本記事は自治体レベルの定例的な媒介対策・警戒情報。症例数は多いが重症度や死亡に関する情報はなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 'ಕಾಲೇಜು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ HIV ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಕಡ್ಡಾಯವಲ್ಲ': 7,000 ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸೋಂಕು; ವದಂತಿಗಳನ್ನು ತಳ್ಳಿಹಾಕಿದ KSAPS!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'HIV testing is not mandatory for college students': 7,000 students infected; KSAPS dispels the rumors!
article.articleSummary: HIV testing is not mandatory for college students in Karnataka, India; KSAPS rejects social-media claims and media reports claiming compulsory testing. Padma Basavantappa, programme director of the AIDS Prevention Society, released a video clarifying that HIV testing is not legally mandated and that the government promotes voluntary testing via digital platforms when needed. The organization also dismissed rumors that 7,000 students were infected. Regarding current HIV data, the Sankalak program counts 291,341 people living with HIV in Karnataka, of whom about 203,000 are under care and receiving treatment. The statement notes these figures include those who have died and those treated in the private sector, leading to an apparent data discrepancy of roughly 56,000.

triage.headline_ja: 「大学生へのHIV検査は義務ではない」：7,000人感染の噂をKSAPSが否定
triage.triage_reason: HIV検査義務化や学生7,000人感染という噂を公的機関が否定した内容であり、新規の感染急増や公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はHIV検査義務化や学生大量感染という噂を公的機関（KSAPS）が否定する内容であり、既存のHIV統計データの説明が中心。新規アウトブレイクではないため対象国リストへの計上は行わない。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC supera los 3.500 casos confirmados y alcanza los 1.556 fallecidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC surpasses 3,500 confirmed cases and reaches 1,556 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reaches 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths as of July 29, with a case fatality rate of 44.1%. The outbreak remains localized in 48 health zones across Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. Of the confirmed cases, 807 are in isolation or hospital, and 626 have recovered. Contact tracing stands at 78.7%, a key metric for interrupting transmission. Response efforts emphasize community engagement through CREC and RECO, risk communication, and traveler information at entry points, alongside ongoing detection and protection activities. Authorities highlight recovered-patient and frontline-worker testimonies to promote protective measures while preventing abuses; surveillance and control measures remain active to limit further spread in the affected provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、確認症例3,500例を超え、死者1,556人に達する
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例3,532例、死亡1,556例（致死率44.1%）に達する大規模なエボラ流行が5州48保健地区に及んでおり、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と流行の継続性が認められるためフルリスク評価に進むべきである。
triage.notes: 接触者追跡率78.7%、隔離・入院807例、回復626例と報告されており、依然として活発な流行が継続中。国際的な拡大は記事上明記されていないが、致死率の高さと規模からWHO等の継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 门急诊流感样病例中，每5人就有1个测出新冠，中国疾控称新冠还在中流行水平
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Among outpatient and emergency department influenza-like illness cases, one in five tested positive for COVID-19, and China CDC says COVID-19 remains at a moderate level of transmission.
article.articleSummary: Week 30, 2026 (Jul 20–26) nationwide data from China CDC show SARS-CoV-2 remains the top pathogen among outpatient and emergency department influenza-like illness samples, with a positivity rate of 20.3% (about one in five), up 4.0 percentage points from the prior week. In hospitalized severe acute respiratory infections, COVID-19 positivity is 9.5%, up 3.3 points. Regionally, COVID-19 leads outpatient/ED ILI samples in both southern and northern provinces; among SRIs admissions it leads in the south and ranks second in the north. COVID-19 is characterized as a moderate transmission level, with NB.1.8.1 as the dominant lineage. Higher positivity is noted in the south; the 15–59 age group is most affected. Public health measures and vaccination are advised. Antiviral demand is rising: an oral COVID-19 antiviral drug drew over 70,000 platform visits in the week, with orders up 48.2%, and production has been ramped up to full capacity (24/7, three shifts).

triage.headline_ja: 外来・救急のインフルエンザ様疾患患者の5人に1人が新型コロナ陽性、中国疾病予防管理センターは新型コロナが依然中程度の流行レベルにあると発表
triage.triage_reason: 中国CDCによる定例のサーベイランス報告であり、新型コロナは季節的な流行レベル（中程度）にとどまっている。新規性・異常性は認められず、既存の対策（抗ウイルス薬増産等）で対応可能な範囲内である。
triage.notes: 既知の病原体（COVID-19）による季節性の定例サーベイランス報告。新規変異株NB.1.8.1が優勢だが、重症度や国際的拡大への言及はなく、中国国内の医療体制内で対応されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus DBD pada Anak Masih Tinggi, Sekolah Dinilai Jadi Kunci Pencegahan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Cases Among Children Still High, Schools Seen as Key to Prevention.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever remains high among Indonesian children, with schools identified as pivotal for prevention toward the goal of Indonesia Zero Dengue Deaths by 2030. In 2025 Indonesia reported 161,752 dengue cases and 673 deaths; by mid-2026, cases reached 39,672 with 105 deaths. Although most cases occur in ages 15–44, the most fatalities are among 5–14-year-olds. The Ministry of Health stresses that dengue control requires cross-sector collaboration beyond health authorities, including local government, education, public communications, and civil society. Schools are viewed as effective venues to embed the 3M+ habit—drain standing water from containers, cover water storage, and recycle waste that can harbor mosquitoes—extending prevention from schools to homes and communities. During ASEAN Dengue Day 2026 in Jakarta, the Health Ministry, Jakarta Health and Education Offices, and Enesis Group (Soffell) conducted interactive 3M+ education at several primary schools (SDN 03 and 05 Tanah Tinggi, SDN 20 Utan Kayu Selatan, SDN 02 Mampang Prapatan) to advance the target by 2030."}{

triage.headline_ja: 子供のデング熱症例が依然として高水準、学校が予防の鍵とされる
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで毎年発生している風土病としてのデング熱に関する予防啓発の記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はASEAN Dengue Day 2026における学校での予防啓発活動を報じるもので、既知の季節性風土病に関する定例報告に近く、緊急シグナルとしての性質は乏しい。

article.articleHeadline: Gata com raiva leva Campinas a reforçar vigilância após primeiro caso desde 2016
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabid cat prompts Campinas to reinforce surveillance after first case since 2016.
article.articleSummary: Campinas reports its first rabies case since 2016, in a young brindled cat found ill at Cemitério da Saudade, Swift district. After veterinary evaluation, the zoonoses surveillance unit (UVZ) collected samples on July 21; laboratory confirmation was announced July 29. In response, health authorities launched active surveillance in nearby homes to identify people with direct contact to the cat, assess exposure, and reinforce prevention. The risk is limited to individuals with direct contact; authorities will monitor other felines in the area. Residents with any potential exposure, even without bites or scratches, should contact UVZ at (19) 2515-7044 for assessment. A veterinarian who treated the cat was scratched but is vaccinated for rabies and received medical follow-up. Rabies is a fatal Lyssavirus infection transmitted mainly through saliva, with exposure via bites, scratches, or licking; vaccination in animals and pre-exposure human vaccination improve protection.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病の猫、カンピーナスで2016年以来初の症例確認により監視強化
triage.triage_reason: 単一の猫での狂犬病確認で人への感染例はなく、限定的な曝露リスクだが、地域として2016年以来の異例事例であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 人への感染は確認されておらず、動物1例（猫）のみ。地域保健当局による積極的サーベイランスが実施されている段階。

article.articleHeadline: DRC faces the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest-growing outbreak on record, with 3,360 confirmed cases and 1,487 deaths across five eastern provinces as of July 31, 2026. Declared May 15, the outbreak has a case fatality rate of about 45%. Ituri province, including Bunia and Rwampara health zones, remains heavily affected with ongoing transmission and an estimated 100–150 new confirmed infections weekly. Conflict, insecurity, mining activity, and high population density hinder response efforts. Authorities have expanded surveillance through community liaison officers, established over 20 Ebola treatment centers, and set up local laboratories to enable testing. Health officials warn the road to containment is long and peak timing is uncertain, emphasizing the need for prompt medical care at suspicion of infection, amid community fear and disruption to daily life.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、史上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ出血熱の流行に直面
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、致死率約45%・週100-150例の新規感染という深刻な流行状況であるため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRwanda（Kigali Province含む）が含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（Ituri州、Bunia、Rwampara保健区）のみが感染拡大地域として言及されており、Rwandaでの症例発生は記述されていないため除外した。また対象国リストにRwandaは含まれていない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H9N2
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N8

article.articleHeadline: WHO WPRO Reporting 4 More H9N2 Cases on Chinese Mainland
article.articleSummary: Four new human infections with avian influenza A(H9N2) were reported by WHO WPRO for 24–30 July 2026, all in China, bringing 2026 totals to seven cases in roughly three weeks across six provinces. Exposures included direct contact with live poultry or visits to live-poultry stalls/wet markets; two adults with chronic respiratory diseases were hospitalized, while four pediatric cases were mild and not hospitalized. Since 2015, the Western Pacific Region has 177 H9N2 human infections with two deaths (both with underlying conditions); 174 cases have been reported from China, plus two in Cambodia and one in Vietnam. No sustained human-to-human transmission is evident; the risk of community spread remains low. An EFSA/ECDC chart through June 4, 2026 estimates 22 cases in 2026, on track to exceed last year’s 38. HA mutations (H191N, A198V, Q226L, Q234L) suggest mammalian adaptation, though surveillance gaps persist as WOAH does not require reporting in poultry. CDC lists G1 and Y280 lineages as having pandemic potential, with several candidate vaccines developed.

triage.headline_ja: WHO西太平洋地域事務局、中国本土で新たに4例のH9N2感染例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 中国での散発的なH9N2ヒト感染は例年通りの傾向で持続的なヒト-ヒト感染は確認されていないが、哺乳類適応を示唆する変異や監視体制の不備が指摘されており、継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: カンボジア・ベトナムは2015年以降の累積データにおける言及であり、今回報告された新規4症例はすべて中国本土での発生。Missouri/Pacific(米国)はBluedotの地域タグ付けの誤りと判断し除外。

article.articleHeadline: Monsoon Triggers Dengue Surge In Pune; 300 Suspected Cases Reported In Just 6 Weeks
article.articleSummary: 300 suspected dengue cases were reported in Pune between June and mid-July, constituting nearly two-thirds of the 473 suspected dengue cases since January 2026, per Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC). Higher concentrations are noted in Kothrud and Karvenagar. After a relatively quiet start to the year—January 25, February 23, March 26, April 41, May 58—the first six weeks of monsoon saw 175 cases in June and 125 more in the first 15 days of July. Officials attribute the spike to waterlogging and stagnant water around homes, construction sites, scrap yards, and open containers that enable Aedes mosquito breeding, the dengue vector. Public health guidance urges prompt medical attention for symptoms such as high fever, severe body ache, headache, pain behind the eyes and fatigue, with diagnostics advised. Preventing water accumulation around residences is highlighted as an effective control measure by Dr. Nina Borade, Head of PMC Health Department.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーンによりプネーでデング熱が急増、6週間で疑い例300件を報告
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン時季の季節性デング熱増加であり異常性は低いが、症例数の急増傾向が続いているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: プネー市保健当局（PMC）がモンスーン期の雨水滞留によるAedes蚊の繁殖増加を要因として指摘し、住民への注意喚起と予防措置を実施中。季節性の増加であり重症例や死亡についての言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Vypuknutí epidemie eboly v Konžské demokratické republice je nejrychleji se šířící v historii tohoto viru | 31. 7. 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest-spreading outbreak in the history of this virus | July 31, 2026
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province with Bunia and Rwampara health zones reporting rising cases. Since its official declaration on May 15, the strain has spread faster than the previous 16 outbreaks, with weekly new infections of 100–150, approaching the worst toll from 2018–2020 when 3,470 people were infected in DRC. Authorities have expanded response: more than 20 Ebola treatment centers, local testing laboratories, and community liaison officers; safe burials in Mongbwalu, Ituri. As of mid-July 2026, about 20 people have been enrolled in clinical vaccine trials targeting Bundibugyo, which may take up to four months. Uganda has sent experts to assist at border areas Tchomia and Kasenyi after declaring its own outbreak over. Officials emphasize seeking medical care at first signs to help containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、史上最速の拡大速度を記録 | 2026年7月31日
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が史上最速のペースで拡大しており、周辺国への越境リスクもあることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダは既に自国流行終息を宣言し国境地域への支援要員を派遣している状況で、越境拡大の懸念材料として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola en RDC : l'OMS mise sur un nouveau vaccin "prometteur" pour stopper le virus Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC: the WHO bets on a new 'promising' vaccine to stop the Bundibugyo virus.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused over 1,300 deaths. The WHO-designated most promising intervention is a single-dose rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine, in development by Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore) in collaboration with CEPI, with MSD providing technical guidance. The vaccine uses the recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus (rVSV) platform, the same technology as Ervebo for the Zaïre Ebola strain, leveraging a Master Virus Seed funded by CEPI. CEPI aims to fund up to $8.5 million to produce doses for early human trials, with first tests anticipated about seven to nine months after approval. Manufacturing optimization seeks improved cold-chain stability to facilitate deployment in affected areas and low- and middle-income countries. Separately, Oxford University is advancing another Bundibugyo vaccine using similar technology. Wellcome stresses that vaccination must be paired with surveillance, diagnostics, and broader outbreak response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行：WHOがブンディブギョ株を阻止するための新たな『有望な』ワクチンに期待
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1,300人以上の死者を出しているエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の流行であり、深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクのいずれも該当しIHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: シンガポールはワクチン開発企業（Hilleman Laboratories）の所在地として言及されているのみで、感染発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。死者数1,300人超という深刻な流行であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Julien Harneis: Er führt die UN-Hilfe zum Ebola-Virus an
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Julien Harneis: He heads UN aid for the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: UN Ebola response chief Julien Harneis warns that the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) outbreak, centered in Bunia, is the fastest-escalating Ebola crisis in history. Since the official start in May, 3,442 infections and 1,521 deaths have been reported, with cases doubling roughly every 20 days. Funding for the response is currently less than half of what is needed, hampering containment efforts. Harneis, a UN veteran based in Bunia with three decades of experience across Yemen, Pakistan, Nigeria, Guinea, and the DRC, advocates triad negotiations among local authorities, donor countries, and communities. Community mistrust remains a major obstacle: about 60% of deaths occur in households, indicating hesitancy to seek care at health centers and contributing to attacks on aid workers. The scale recalls West Africa’s 2014–2016 Ebola outbreak (≈29,000 infections, ≈11,000 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: ジュリアン・ハーネイス:国連のエボラ対応を率いる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（ブニア中心）で「史上最速の拡大」とされるエボラ流行が進行中で、致死率も高く資金不足により封じ込めが困難な状況であり、国際的関心・支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにあるパキスタン、イエメン、アンゴラ、ギニア、ナイジェリアはハーネイス氏の過去の勤務経験地であり、本件エボラ流行の発生国ではないため除外した。実際の発生地はDRC東部ブニアのみ。

article.articleHeadline: 56歲女高燒不退竟是「蟲子」害的　醫提醒：注意皮膚是否有小紅點
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 56-year-old woman with a fever that won’t subside turns out to be caused by a “bug”; doctors remind to check for small red spots on the skin.
article.articleSummary: Scrub typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi) caused severe infection in Hunan, China. A 56-year-old woman developed weeks of high fever, abdominal pain, septic shock and respiratory failure; initial tests failed to identify the source. Genomic sequencing confirmed scrub typhus, and she stabilized after targeted treatment. At the same hospital, two other scrub typhus patients were admitted to ICU with fever, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia and coagulopathy. The disease is transmitted by larval chigger mites that inhabit grasses, forests, farms and damp areas; a key clue is an eschar—a black crust at the bite site that can be hidden, even on the scalp. Prevention emphasizes long sleeves/pants, insect repellents, rapid bathing and body checks after outdoor activity. Patients with persistent fever, fatigue, low platelets, or unexplained black eschars should seek urgent care and inform doctors about outdoor exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 56歳女性の高熱が続いた原因は「虫」だった 医師が皮膚の小さな赤い点に注意するよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 重症例（敗血症性ショック・呼吸不全）を含むツツガムシ病の個別症例報告だが、地域的アウトブレイクや国際的拡大の兆候はなく、単一病院内での散発例にとどまる。
triage.notes: ツツガムシ病は既知の風土病でヒト-ヒト感染はしない。重症例3件が同一病院で報告されているが、地域的流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Governo de SP lança Campanha de Multivacinação e reforça proteção contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo State Government launches Multivaccination Campaign and reinforces protection against measles.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state launches a Multivaccination Campaign for children and adolescents under 15 across 645 municipalities to review vaccination cards and update overdue doses per the National Immunization Schedule, including BCG, polio, MMR, HPV, and COVID-19 vaccines. Parents/guardians should bring the child’s vaccination card to Basic Health Units, as schedules vary by city. In parallel, the cities of São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo will run reinforced measles control, offering the MMR vaccine to everyone aged 6 months to 59 years, regardless of prior vaccination history. The emergency response follows the state’s 15th measles case in 2026, recorded on July 30 in Guarulhos in a child not vaccinated. CVE emphasizes keeping vaccination records up to date to reach the 95% protection target. The government provides the 'Vacina 100 Dúvidas' platform for vaccine information.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州政府、複合予防接種キャンペーンを開始し麻疹対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹症例（2026年州内15例目）を受けた予防接種キャンペーンの広報記事であり、規模は限定的だが麻疹の高い感染力から今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は州政府による予防接種強化キャンペーンの広報が主題で、麻疹の重症例や国際的拡大の兆候は報告されていない。未接種児童を中心に感染しやすい状況があるため、続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Ухудшение ситуации с безопасностью на востоке ДРК затрудняет борьбу со вспышкой Эболы -- ООН
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deteriorating security in eastern DRC hampers the fight against the Ebola outbreak — UN
article.articleSummary: UN/OCHA reports worsening security in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is hindering the Ebola outbreak response, with the epicenter in Ituri Province. Violence near Plan-Savo camp in Djugu territory, located within the Fataki sanitary zone where Ebola cases have been confirmed, is increasing risk for displaced populations. On 27 July, at least 12 displaced children were abducted near Plan-Savo, and 23 displaced people were killed in and around the camp in the first half of 2026. Plan-Savo shelters over 76,000 displaced persons, many fleeing repeated violence. Humanitarian access remains severely constrained, with limited food, clean water, and essential services; overcrowding and poor living conditions elevate transmission risk. No infections have been recorded inside the Plan-Savo camp, but residents remain at elevated risk as the outbreak persists.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部の治安悪化がエボラ出血熱流行への対応を妨げている――国連
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重篤な疾患の流行が継続する中、治安悪化により対応が困難となっており、国際機関（UN/OCHA）が関与する重大事案としてIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 既知のエボラ流行（イトゥリ州）に関する続報で、治安悪化・避難民キャンプ内の過密状態が感染拡大リスクを高めている。国際的な人道支援ニーズが強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Número de casos de sarampo em São Paulo chega a 15
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases in São Paulo reach 15.
article.articleSummary: Measles in São Paulo state rise to 15 cases this year, with the latest involving a non-vaccinated child in Guarulhos. The State Government will launch a multivaccination campaign on August 3, 2026, to update vaccination records for children and adolescents under 15, aiming to curb transmission and prevent further outbreaks. Measles symptoms include high fever and a red rash; authorities urge guardians to seek medical care promptly to avoid complications and limit spread. The initiative seeks to reinforce immunization among youths and contain the current spread within the state. The report provides no details on laboratory confirmation or the infection source, and does not mention imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州の麻疹症例数が15人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹症例が15例と増加傾向にあり、未接種児童も含まれるためWPRO基準の一部（流行しやすさ・曝露継続）に該当するが、重症例や国際的拡大の情報がなく、州政府が独自にワクチンキャンペーンを実施予定であるため現時点ではPICKUPには至らない。
triage.notes: 症例数は15例と少なく、重症化や死亡の報告なし。州政府が8月3日から予防接種キャンペーンを実施予定であり、国内対応で管理可能とみられる。続報でクラスター拡大の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : en RDC, plus de 3 500 cas recensés en quelques mois, plus que lors de l'épidémie la plus meurtrière de l'histoire du pays
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: In the DRC, more than 3,500 cases have been recorded in a few months, more than during the deadliest outbreak in the country's history.
article.articleSummary: More than 3,500 Ebola virus disease cases have been recorded in a matter of months in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), according to data published Friday, July 31, by Congolese authorities. The figure exceeds counts from the country’s deadliest outbreak on record, which began in 2018. The report confirms an ongoing, rapidly evolving outbreak within the DRC, though it provides no deaths figure, symptom description, laboratory confirmation details, infection sources, or information on imported or exported cases in the excerpt. The July 31 data underline a substantial surge in transmission and highlight the strain on public health response within the country, reinforcing the need for continued surveillance, vaccination, and outbreak containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:コンゴ民主共和国で数ヶ月間に3,500例以上を記録、同国史上最も致死的だった流行を上回る
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の症例数が史上最悪の流行を上回る規模に達しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 死亡者数、症状詳細、感染源、輸入・輸出症例情報は記事に記載なし。続報での詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Com alta de casos, governo inclui sarampo em campanha de vacinação; veja datas e quem deve se vacinar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As cases rise, the government includes measles in a vaccination campaign; see dates and who should be vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in São Paulo state total 15 in 2026, with 12 in the capital, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 in Guarulhos. To curb transmission, the government expands a multivaccination campaign starting August 3, 2026, across 645 municipalities to update vaccination records for children and adolescents under 15. In São Paulo city, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, an extra measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination drive will be available to anyone aged 6 months to 59 years, regardless of vaccination history. For infants 6–11 months 29 days in these three cities, a “dose zero” extra shot is recommended, not substituting the routine schedule. Measles is highly contagious, airborne, with fever, cough, malaise, runny nose, conjunctivitis, and a facial-to-body rash; complications include pneumonia, otitis, encephalitis, and death. Vaccines are available at UBS health units across all 645 municipalities.

triage.headline_ja: 感染者数増加を受け、政府が麻疹をワクチン接種キャンペーンに追加―日程と対象者について
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹症例が増加し、政府が645自治体で大規模なMMRワクチン接種キャンペーンを緊急展開しており、WPRO基準の複数該当と行政の高い関心が確認できるため。
triage.notes: 症例数自体は15例と少ないが、政府が大規模ワクチンキャンペーンを緊急展開している点から公衆衛生上の懸念が高まっていると判断。死亡例や重症例の報告は現時点でなし。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas registra 1º caso de raiva em gato em 10 anos - ACidade ON Campinas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas records first rabies case in a cat in 10 years - ACidade ON Campinas
article.articleSummary: Rabies detected in a cat in Campinas, Brazil—the first feline case since 2016. A young tabby with white belly was found sick and died after being abandoned at Cemitério da Saudade in the Swift neighborhood. Suspicion arose on 21 July; samples were collected and the diagnosis was confirmed by Instituto Pasteur on 29 July. On 31 July, UVZ (Zoonoses Surveillance Unit) initiated preventive actions, including case investigation, active door-to-door search around the cemetery to identify potentially exposed people, and monitoring of other neighborhood cats. The treating veterinarian, who was scratched, had prior rabies vaccination and received human post-exposure prophylaxis. Exposed individuals should contact UVZ at (19) 2515-7044 for evaluation. Transmission is mainly through bites but can occur via scratches or saliva contact with mucous membranes; rabies is fatal. Risk is limited to direct contact with the cat.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナスで10年ぶりに猫の狂犬病症例を記録 - ACidade ON Campinas
triage.triage_reason: 10年ぶりの猫での狂犬病発生は地域的に異常だが、感染は単一動物・限定的接触者に留まり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。地域保健当局が既に対応を開始しており継続的な情報収集が妥当。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率がほぼ100%であるため個体レベルでの重症度は高いが、感染拡大は接触者の追跡調査により管理可能な範囲。地元当局（UVZ）が既に予防的対応を実施済み。

article.articleHeadline: La República Democrática del Congo registra el segundo mayor brote mundial de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo records the world's second-largest Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 3,532 Ebola cases and 1,556 deaths, making this the world’s second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. Official data from the DR Congo Ministry of Communications, cited by Reuters, show cases rising beyond the 3,481 registered during the 2018–2020 outbreak. The epidemic persists despite containment efforts in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with health workers in PPE conducting disinfection and epidemiological surveillance. Kinshasa reported the figures on 31 July. The largest Ebola outbreak remains the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, with 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. No details on transmission sources or vaccination status are provided in the article, highlighting the ongoing public health challenge in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、世界2番目の規模のエボラ流行を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで史上2番目の規模（3,532症例、1,556死亡）に拡大しており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は現行のDRCにおけるエボラ流行を主題としており、2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行（ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネ）は歴史的比較として言及されているのみのため、これらは verified_locations から除外した。致死率は約44%と高く、封じ込め対策が続いているにもかかわらず症例数が増加していることから、深刻度・拡大リスクともに高いと評価。

article.articleHeadline: கர்நாடகாவில் இளைஞர்களுக்கு அதிகரித்த HIV தொற்று! காரணம் என்ன? டாக்டர் பரூக்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising HIV infections among youths in Karnataka! What is the reason? Dr. Parook.
article.articleSummary: Rising HIV infections among youths in Karnataka are highlighted by Dr. Parook Abdulllah of Sivaganga Government Hospital. In 2023–2024, 44,500 infections rose to 66,600 in 2025–2026, with 18–35-year-olds most affected. Karnataka hosts about 260,000 people living with HIV; roughly 205,000 are on treatment, while about 54,000 remain untreated or unaware. Transmission is driven by unprotected sex and sharing needles. The article identifies factors fueling the youth surge: online dating apps and a hook-up culture; chem-sex and drug use; multiple concurrent partners; higher HIV prevalence among men; and overall lack of awareness about safe sex and sexually transmitted infections. The shift from venue-based spread (nightlife) to online hookups complicates surveillance. Preventive measures urged include compulsory sex education from adolescence, broad awareness of HIV and blood-borne diseases, harm reduction for drug use, and mass voluntary HIV testing across institutions to identify the 54,000 undiagnosed individuals.

triage.headline_ja: カルナータカ州で若者のHIV感染が増加!原因は?パルーク医師が説明
triage.triage_reason: HIVは既知の風土病であり、本記事は若年層における感染増加傾向と啓発活動に関する国内保健report。急性の感染症アウトブレイクや国際的拡大リスクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: HIVは慢性感染症であり、本記事はカルナータカ州における若年層の感染増加と行動要因（デーティングアプリ、薬物使用等）についての啓発・教育を目的とした報道。新興感染症や急性アウトブレイクのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Η επιδημία του Έμπολα είναι δεύτερη η μεγαλύτερη που έχει καταγραφεί ποτέ με 3.532 κρούσματα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: The Ebola outbreak is the second-largest ever recorded with 3,532 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the second-largest globally, with 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths reported as of 31 July 2026. Government figures released on X show the virus continuing to spread rapidly, outpacing containment efforts. Only the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak was larger, with 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, according to the World Health Organization. The report underscores the ongoing severity of Ebola in Central Africa, with no details provided here on laboratory confirmation or specific transmission sources. This comparison emphasizes the current outbreak’s scale relative to prior incidents, marking the Democratic Republic of Congo event as the world’s second-largest on record.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ:エボラ流行は史上2番目の規模、3,532症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラの大規模流行(症例数3,532、死亡1,556)が継続中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRコンゴのエボラ流行を主題としており、他国(シエラレオネ、リベリア、ギニア、アンゴラ)は2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現時点での発生地域ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تسجل ثاني أكبر تفشٍ عالمي لانتشار "الإيبولا"‏
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo records the world's second-largest Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's current Ebola outbreak is the world's second-largest on record, with 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths reported as of July 31, 2026, according to the DRC Ministry of Communications via Reuters. Case counts continue to rise despite containment efforts, and the outbreak has already surpassed the total from the 2018–2020 Ebola outbreak (3,481 cases). The largest Ebola epidemic to date remains the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, which recorded 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. The report places the DRC outbreak within a broader global context of Ebola activity, underscoring persistent transmission in Central Africa through 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、世界史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCで3,532例・死亡1,556人と大規模なエボラ流行が継続中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が高く、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行を主題としており、Liberia・Sierra Leone・Guineaは2014-2016年の過去流行との比較のために言及されているのみで現在の発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo vive surto de sarampo com 15 casos confirmados em 2016
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo experiences a measles outbreak with 15 confirmed cases in 2016.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak confirmed in the State of São Paulo, with the 15th case in 2026 and the first in Guarulhos since 2020. Distribution: 12 cases in the city of São Paulo, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 in Guarulhos. The Ministério da Saúde classifies this as an outbreak and has urged municipalities to widen measles vaccination to everyone aged 6 months to 59 years, regardless of vaccination history, to interrupt transmission and prevent reintroduction. The measure accompanies the statewide Multivaccination Campaign beginning August 3, 2026, offering the MMR vaccine and all vaccines on the National Vaccination Schedule for children and adolescents. Nationally, Brazil has 18 measles cases in 2026, with 3 records closed without ongoing transmission. The outbreak arises in a highly mobile region with substantial international travel. 2025 vaccination coverage: D1 92.9%, D2 78.3% nationwide; Guarulhos D1 91.59%, D2 83.90%; São Bernardo do Campo D1 90.84%, D2 83.62%; São Paulo D1 90.79%, D2 83.63%.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹アウトブレイク、2026年に15例確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル保健省がサンパウロ州での麻疹アウトブレイクを正式に宣言し、国際的な人流の多い地域での発生かつワクチン接種率がPHEIC対応の95%閾値を下回っており、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク）を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価に進める。
triage.notes: 保健省はアウトブレイクと分類し、生後6か月から59歳までの全住民への麻疹ワクチン接種拡大を要請。ワクチン接種率（D2:78-84%程度）は集団免疫閾値（95%）を下回っており、国際的な人の往来が多い地域であることから継続的な伝播・再導入リスクに留意が必要。重症例・死亡の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تحذر: أعداد إصابات إيبولا قد تفوق المعلن بأربع مرات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns: Ebola case numbers may be four times higher than reported.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak has reached 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths, making it the second-largest global outbreak on record. The event centers on Bundibugyo Ebola strain, with no licensed vaccine or effective treatment, complicating containment. WHO warns the true toll could be up to four times higher than reported due to weak surveillance, transport constraints, and eroding community trust, as Bunia and surrounding eastern DRC areas see ongoing transmission. Africa CDC notes fatalities in less than three months are fivefold compared with previous waves. Violence from dozens of armed groups hampers access and depletes resources. Containment requires about $1.4 billion; funding commitments for May–August total about $213.9 million of a $242.4 million need. US travel restrictions hinder aid delivery, affecting groups like Samaritan’s Purse; the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) remains the largest on record.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関(WHO)が警告：エボラ感染者数は報告数の4倍に上る可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行（3,532例、死亡1,556人）が継続し、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、渡航制限、資金不足、武装勢力による活動妨害など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 米国・シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは過去の流行（2014-2016年西アフリカ）や渡航制限の文脈で言及されているのみで、現在の流行地はDRC（Bunia含む）に限られる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in DR Congo: As the outbreak spreads, Caritas continues its response | Caritas International Belgium
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-31, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has expanded into its 17th outbreak, with 34 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu affected. Ituri remains the epicentre, with new hotspots emerging in neighboring provinces. In Bunia, new cases have been confirmed at the Kigonze displacement site, raising concerns about spread to nearby camps where thousands have fled violence; living conditions complicate isolation and hygiene. In the Butembo-Beni area, the response faces security and trust challenges: health workers have been attacked, a health centre vandalised, and confirmed patients removed from care with local community support. Caritas teams are continuing to work alongside communities to curb transmission and protect those most at risk, amid conflict, displacement, and a fragile health system.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：流行拡大の中、カリタスは対応を継続
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の第17次流行が34保健区に拡大し、避難民キャンプでの新規感染や治安上の障害が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 紛争・避難民キャンプでの感染拡大、医療従事者への襲撃など治安面のリスクも高く、国際支援の必要性が高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 cases rise in Delhi-NCR amid monsoon, seasonal transition: Doctors
article.articleSummary: Delhi-NCR reports a rise in H1N1 influenza amid the monsoon and seasonal transition. Over the past 3–4 weeks hospitals have seen more respiratory cases, with testing confirming a significant uptick in H1N1 and about 7–10 such patients daily in OPD, alongside a slight rise in COVID-19. Most H1N1 infections are mild, with fever typically subsiding in 3–5 days. Vulnerable groups—elderly, young children, and individuals with diabetes, hypertension, heart disease, COPD, or kidney disease—are at higher risk of complications and may require hospitalization. Common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, nasal discharge, headache, and muscle or joint pains, often with high-grade fever. AIIMS Delhi, Fortis Memorial (Gurugram), and Sir Ganga Ram Hospital attribute the rise to post-monsoon viral activity and seasonal temperature changes. Advice: isolate 2–3 days, wear a mask, and seek medical care promptly for high-risk patients.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising threat of malaria in East Singhbhum: Two more CRPF jawans admitted to hospital; one jawan has already died.
article.articleSummary: As of July 31, 2026, rising malaria threat in East Singhbhum district, Jamshedpur, India. Security forces and health authorities are concerned. CRPF has intensified health surveillance across all camps, including routine medical checks, enhanced mosquito-protection measures, and infection-prevention steps. Public health authorities are monitoring the situation. The episode highlights persistent malaria transmission risk in the region and the need for continued vigilance among security personnel.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases top 3,500 in DR Congo as Africa CDC warns of uncontrolled outbreak
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Ebola has 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths as of July 31, 2026. The outbreak spans five eastern provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. There are 807 patients in isolation or hospital care, with 626 recoveries. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya calls the outbreak the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever recorded and warns it remains uncontrolled. More than 80% of new Ituri cases lack identified links to known contacts, and over 60% of deaths occur in communities rather than at Ebola treatment centers. The government declared the outbreak on May 15, 2026. The figures reflect ongoing transmission across multiple provinces and highlight challenges in case investigation and containment outside treatment centers.

article.articleHeadline: Casos de HIV aumentam 20% no Brasil, enquanto caem 43% em outras partes do mundo | abc+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV cases rise by 20% in Brazil, while they fall by 43% in other parts of the world | abc+
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s HIV new infections rose 20% over 16 years, contrasting with a global ~43% decline since 2010, according to UNAIDS Global AIDS Update released at AIDS 2026 in Rio. Globally, new infections fell from about 2.1 million in 2010 to 1.2 million in 2025. In Brazil, 2024 recorded 39.2 thousand new cases, up 21.9% from 2014, with about 1.7 million people living with HIV. HIV mortality declined 20% between 2014 and 2024, reaching under 10,000 deaths in 2025. Brazil achieved elimination of vertical transmission and expanded PrEP, yet increases are concentrated among men who have sex with men, transgender people, and sex workers, driven by stigma, discrimination, late diagnosis, and unequal PrEP access. Public prevention spending rose up to 10%, but regional disparities persist, especially in the North. Across Latin America, new infections rose 25% from 2010 to 2025.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでHIV感染者数が20%増加、世界の他地域では43%減少 | abc+
triage.triage_reason: 長期的な統計トレンド（UNAIDSの年次報告）に基づく記事であり、急性の公衆衛生上の異常事態ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's Ebola reaches milestone as second largest Ebola outbreak on record
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak declared mid-May has reached 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths (case fatality rate 44.1%), making it the world’s second-largest Ebola outbreak by infections and the fastest-spreading for this strain. Five provinces are affected: Haut-Uele, Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo, with sustained transmission in Ituri. About 807 patients remain in isolation or hospital, and 626 have recovered. No vaccine or specific treatment is approved for Bundibugyo virus. Compared with West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak (28,616 cases, 11,310 deaths), the current epidemic is more contained in scale but severe in mortality relative to its size. CEPI, in partnership with Singapore-based Hilleman Laboratories, is funding up to $8.5 million to develop and manufacture an rVSV-based vaccine candidate for clinical trials, leveraging the platform used for the Zaire strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、史上2番目の規模に到達
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で3,532例・致死率44.1%という大規模かつ史上2位の流行が5州に拡大しており、ワクチン未承認かつ持続的なヒト-ヒト感染が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による流行で、Zaire株用のワクチンプラットフォームを応用した候補ワクチンの開発がCEPI主導で進行中。国際的な人的往来を通じた越境拡大リスクの明記はないが、既に史上2番目の規模であり継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DRC becomes fastest-growing on record, killing more than 1,500
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the world’s second-largest on record and the fastest-growing, with 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths reported by government data since mid-May (as of 2026-07-31). Transmission is outpacing containment, with infections doubling about every 20 days since May 15. The outbreak has spread across five provinces—Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo—and now affects nearly 50 health zones after reaching another area in Tshopo. The 2018-2020 Congo outbreak recorded 3,481 cases; only the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic was larger (28,616 cases, 11,310 deaths). There is no known vaccine for this outbreak. Health authorities call for accelerated mobilization and adaptive response strategies to cut transmission chains, noting that transmission begins in households and communities rather than treatment centers.

article.articleHeadline: Fast-growing Ebola outbreak in DRC surges to second-largest on record
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak has surged to the second-largest on record, identified mid-May, with 3,553 confirmed cases and 1,558 deaths per WHO. Most cases are in Ituri province, a mobile, resource-rich region fueling transmission, driven by the Bundibugyo strain for which vaccines and treatments are not readily available, with conflict hindering response. About two-thirds of deaths occur among people who never received facility care, amplifying community spread; each urban case is linked to ~40 contacts, so roughly 135,000 contacts would exist for 3,400 cases, yet fewer than 18,000 have been identified. Uganda reports 20 cases, one imported to France; Uganda declared Ebola-free but WHO requires 42 days of enhanced surveillance. Vaccines and treatments are in trials: a Bundibugyo-targeting vaccine developed by University of Oxford and Serum Institute, first dose given; antivirals MBP134 and remdesivir are in the PARTNERS trial with about 41 patients enrolled.

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC devient la plus importante jamais enregistrée dans le pays en nombre de cas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC has become the largest ever recorded in the country in terms of cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo becomes the largest by case count, with 3,532 confirmed cases across five provinces: Ituri (28 health zones affected), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo. There are 1,556 deaths among confirmed cases, 626 recoveries, and 807 patients in isolation or hospitalised, yielding a case fatality rate of 44.1% and a contact-follow-up rate of 78.7%. Ituri is the most affected, with South Kivu’s Miti-Murhesa health zone under residual surveillance after 63 days without new confirmed cases. The WHO notes the previous tenth Ebola outbreak (Aug 1, 2018–June 25, 2020) had 3,470 cases and 2,287 deaths; the current outbreak now exceeds that record in confirmed cases, though deaths are lower. Authorities stress risk communication and community engagement in Ituri, Tshopo, and Haut-Uélé, with entry-point controls and stigma reduction, while data may be revised after DHIS2 harmonization, including 11 North Kivu deaths.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in Congo surges to second-largest on record
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, northeast of the country, has become the second-largest on record, with 3,553 confirmed cases and 1,558 deaths since mid-May. In just over two months it surpassed the 2018 outbreak; only the 2014–16 West Africa event is larger. Driven by the Bundibugyo strain, vaccines and treatments are scarce, and ongoing conflict hampers response. About two-thirds of deaths occur among people who never sought facility care, fueling community transmission; each urban case has about 40 contacts, but tracing remains incomplete. Uganda reported 20 cases and France 1; Uganda declared Ebola-free, but 42 days of enhanced surveillance remain. Trials include a Bundibugyo-targeted vaccine and MBP134/remdesivir antivirals enrolling in the DRC.

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática do Congo registrou mais de 3.500 casos de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo recorded more than 3,500 Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: As of July 31, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reported more than 3,500 Ebola cases in just a few months, exceeding totals from the 2018–2020 outbreak. The outbreak's epicenter is Ituri Province in the northeast, near the borders with South Sudan and Uganda, which accounts for about 90% of cases per the World Health Organization. The virus is also present in four other provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu, where capitals and parts of the territory are controlled by the antigovernment M23 armed group, backed by Rwanda. The report underscores rapid spread amid regional instability and ongoing transmission, with the security situation posing obstacles to outbreak response.

article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 3,500 confirmed cases since May 15, with 1,556 deaths and 626 recoveries. article.articleHeadline: Claves del brote de ébola en RD Congo: el segundo con más casos de la historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Key facts about the Ebola outbreak in the DRC: the second-largest by cases in history
article.articleSummary: Outbreak declared May 15 in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has become the second-largest by confirmed cases, with 3,532 infections and 1,556 deaths across Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Uganda reported 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and 2 deaths, later declared Ebola-free on July 28. WHO flags high regional risk and low global risk. This outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo, with 30–50% fatality and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment yet. Diagnostic capacity has grown from 3 labs (≈30 tests/day) to 18 labs (up to 2,200/day); treatment centers from 3 CETs with ~20 beds to 37 centers with around 1,000 beds. Oxford began the first human trial of a Bundibugyo vaccine in July; IAVI, Moderna, and CEPI also pursuing candidates. Challenges include difficulty tracing transmission, community mistrust, and insecurity; attacks on health workers and safe-burial teams, including a July 1 CET burning in Bafwabango.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Butembo : deux enfants déclarés guéris quittent le CTE de Katwa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Butembo: two children declared cured leave the Katwa Ebola Treatment Center.
article.articleSummary: Two children, ages 11 months and 4 years, were declared cured of Ebola and discharged from Katwa Ebola Treatment Center in Butembo, North Kivu, on July 30. They had tested positive a week earlier and presented with fever, vomiting, and diarrhea; after initial care at local health posts, they received a week of treatment at the Katwa CTE. Families praised the care and urged others with Ebola-like symptoms to seek prompt treatment to improve survival. The discharge follows a week after four Katwa patients left the center: three were cured, and a fourth suspected case tested negative in laboratory analyses. One cured patient was a nurse who contracted Ebola while caring for an infected patient unknowingly. Butembo remains the epicenter of the 17th Ebola outbreak in North Kivu, with 220 confirmed cases in the city and 325 in the province as of July 27, totaling about 3,360 cases in two and a half months.

article.articleHeadline: Afrique | Le virus de l'Ebola rôde dans les camps surpeuplés du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa | The Ebola virus prowls in Congo's overcrowded camps.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak persists in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with camps housing over 1 million displaced people. In Kigonze camp (20,000 residents), four deaths occurred in the last 24 hours and 55 deaths since April; at Tsere camp in Rwampara near Bunia, more than 6,400 share a single water reservoir and sanitation facilities are limited. The situation hampers control measures as health facilities face strikes over unpaid wages and attacks on treatment centers, while many patients vanish in dense camp networks. The Ministry of Health reports 2,423 confirmed Ebola cases and 967 confirmed deaths; the WHO notes true numbers may be 2–4 times higher. More than 80% of new cases occur among people not on known contact lists. Corpses show Ebola symptoms (fever, headache, vomiting) but post-mortem tests are pending. Acute water shortages and lack of hygiene hinder infection control; funding for WASH has fallen sharply since 2024–2025.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ｜エボラウイルスがコンゴの過密難民キャンプを徘徊
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で確認症例2,423例、死亡967例と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、過密避難民キャンプでの衛生状況悪化によりヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRwanda（Kigali Province）が含まれるが、記事本文ではルワンダへの言及がなく主題はDRCのイツリ州であるため除外した。WASH資金減少や医療従事者のストライキが感染対策を阻害しており、外部支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis mortality spirals up in Kerala
article.articleSummary: Kerala records a leptospirosis mortality surge in July 2026 with 49 deaths (30 confirmed, 19 probable). For 2026 to date, 1,381 confirmed and 922 probable cases have been reported, totaling 115 deaths (including 52 probable). High-risk groups—manual/agricultural laborers, farmers, dairy workers, and gardeners—face frequent exposure to contaminated water or soil. Doxycycline prophylaxis is used but adherence is poor; clinicians say antibiotics mainly shorten fever duration and bacterial clearance when started early, with prophylaxis twice weekly during the southwest monsoon advised for those at high exposure. Clinical cases range from mild symptoms to fatal outcomes involving liver and renal failure, pulmonary hemorrhage, meningitis, and septic shock; 5–10% progress to severe disease. A 2025 death audit found 62% of deaths occurred among ages 40–52 with comorbidities, while younger deaths occur within 4.5–5 days. Emphasizes prevention via protective gear and clear risk communication.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州でレプトスピラ症による死亡者数が急増
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州で季節性（モンスーン期）のレプトスピラ症死亡者数増加が報告されているが、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクはなく、既知の地域流行パターンであるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症はケララ州でモンスーン期に毎年見られる地方風土病であり、環境曝露（汚染水・土壌）が主な感染経路。人畜共通感染症でヒト-ヒト感染はなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、死亡率上昇は地域保健当局にとって重要な課題であり続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉死亡突破一千五百人　成史上擴散最快疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpass 1,500, becoming the fastest-spreading outbreak in history.
article.articleSummary: As of July 30, 2026, the DRC's eastern Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has 3,442 confirmed cases and 1,521 deaths, making it the fastest-spreading on record. Among patients, 797 are in isolation or hospitalized, and 615 have recovered. The outbreak is centered in Ituri Province but has spread to five other provinces, including Kisangani. Health authorities report only about 78% of contacts are being traced, far below the 95% target to stop transmission. Many patients do not seek care; distrust of medical workers and traditional postmortem rituals enable transmission via blood and bodily fluids. Attacks on a hospital and an Ebola Treatment Center in Nyankunde on July 15 forced international teams to withdraw, disrupting contact tracing, testing, and supplies. The crisis reflects the combined threats of conflict, healthcare collapse, and community mistrust.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者数が1,500人を突破し史上最速の拡大を見せる疫病に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC東部で史上最速のペースで拡大し、死者1,500人超・複数州へ拡散、治安悪化による対応困難も重なりIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、接触者追跡率が目標未達（78%<95%）、医療施設への攻撃により国際支援チームが撤退するなど対応能力に深刻な支障が生じている。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情失控　確診破3500例超越歷史紀錄 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo spirals out of control as confirmed cases exceed 3,500, breaking historical records.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 3,532 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 1,556 deaths across five provinces, led by Ituri near the borders with South Sudan and Uganda. This is the DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus strain; no approved vaccines or treatments exist. Cases rose above 3,500 within months, with 2,000 reported by 15 July. WHO notes vaccine development: Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore) pursuing a candidate deemed 'most ideal' by WHO, and Oxford University vaccines entering clinical trials, first volunteer vaccinated last week. North Kivu and South Kivu remain contested by M23-aligned groups with Rwandan support, hampering response efforts. Uganda has reported no domestic cases this week, but WHO warns of cross-border spillover risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、感染確認3500例を超え歴史的記録を更新し制御不能に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで史上最多の症例数となり、複数州にまたがり致死率も高く、承認済みワクチン・治療法がない中で国境を越えた拡大リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダは国内症例なしと報告されているが越境リスクが指摘されているため監視継続が必要。シンガポールとスーダン等はワクチン開発拠点や地理的言及のみで、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Governo de São Paulo promove campanha de vacinação contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo State Government promotes measles vaccination campaign.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak prompts São Paulo State to expand vaccination efforts after confirming the 15th case. The state government launches a multivaccination campaign starting Monday, August 3, 2026, aimed at updating the immunization records for children and adolescents up to 15 years old, with all vaccines on the national calendar available. An extra measles-focused action will run in the capital, São Paulo, as well as in Guarulhos and São Bernardo do Campo, where the MMR (measles-mumps-rubella) vaccine will be offered to people aged 6 months to 59 years. The intensified measures follow the confirmation of two additional cases in unvaccinated children, underscoring the need to boost vaccination coverage to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州政府、麻疹予防接種キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹症例が15例確認され、未接種児童での感染拡大を受け州が予防接種キャンペーンを強化しており、WPRO基準の複数該当と社会的関心（政府対応・報道）が認められるため。
triage.notes: 麻疹はブラジルで排除認定を受けていた疾患であり、再発生は公衆衛生上注視すべき事象。未接種児童間での感染確認は流行しやすさを示唆する。重症度（入院・死亡数）については記事内に情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-epidemie in Democratische Republiek Congo is de snelst groeiende uitbraak in de geschiedenis van het virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest-growing outbreak in the history of the virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are the fastest-growing in the virus’s history, according to Carl Skau, acting head of the UN World Food Programme. As of the latest Congolese figures, 3,532 cases have been recorded with about 1,556 deaths, and the World Health Organization cites a case-fatality rate near 50%. This outbreak ranks as the second-largest Ebola outbreak ever documented globally; only the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, caused by the Zaire variant, had more cases. The current flare-up is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Summary context underscores the severity and ongoing transmission within the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the absence of widely available therapeutic options.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は、ウイルスの歴史上最も急速に拡大している流行である
triage.triage_reason: 史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行で致死率約50%、ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョ株による急拡大が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域として記載されているが、記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国のみが感染事例の主体として言及されており、アンゴラでの発生は確認できないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: อีโบลาคองโกวิกฤต ติดเชื้อทะลุ 3,500 ราย ขึ้นแท่นระบาดใหญ่เป็นอันดับ 2 ของโลก
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola crisis in Congo: cases surpass 3,500, making it the world's second-largest outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing one of its most severe Ebola outbreaks. On July 31, 2026, figures show 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths, making it the world’s second-largest Ebola outbreak after the West Africa outbreak of 2014–2016. Transmission is driven by Bundibugyo, a rare Ebola strain, with no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. WHO cautions case counts may be up to four times higher than figures due to surveillance gaps, limited transport and personnel, and community distrust. In Bunia, the virus has entered communities, with many patients seeking traditional healers, hampering containment. Ongoing insecurity in eastern DRC and aid shortfalls compound response challenges. Africa CDC says about $1.4 billion is needed to control the outbreak, far above previous estimates; only about $213.9 million of a $242.4 million target has been pledged. US travel restrictions are constraining aid access, prompting organizations like Samaritan’s Purse to scale back operations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ危機、感染者数3,500人突破し世界第2位の大流行に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行(3,532症例、1,556死亡)が発生し、ワクチン・治療法未承認、資金不足、渡航制限による支援困難など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 希少株Bundibugyoによる流行で、承認済みワクチン・治療法がない点、監視ギャップにより実際の症例数は報告の最大4倍の可能性がある点、米国の渡航制限が支援活動を制約している点が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: "新冠阳性率超20%"，最新情况公布
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 positivity rate exceeds 20%: latest update announced.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-31, China CDC released Week 30 sentinel surveillance for acute respiratory infections (July 20–26). The influenza-like illness proportion among outpatient visits was 4.4%, higher in southern provinces (6.1%) than northern ones (2.8%). In outpatient respiratory samples, SARS-CoV-2 positivity was 20.3%, influenza 14.5%, and enterovirus 5.9%; in hospitalized SARI samples, SARS-CoV-2 was 9.5%, influenza 6.4%, and human metapneumovirus 4.3%. Southern provinces include Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui, Fujian, Jiangxi, Hubei, Hunan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan, Chongqing, Sichuan, Guizhou, and Yunnan; northern provinces include Beijing, Tianjin, Hebei, Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, Liaoning, Jilin, Heilongjiang, Shandong, Henan, Tibet, Shaanxi, Gansu, Qinghai, Ningxia, Xinjiang. SARS-CoV-2 positivity remains rising, dominated by NB.1.8.1 lineage, higher in the south; influenza activity is low, mainly B/Victoria and A(H3N2). No new pathogens detected. COVID-19 is a common seasonal respiratory disease; elderly and chronically ill remain high-risk. Public guidance emphasizes masking, hygiene, vaccination, and prompt care.

triage.headline_ja: 「新型コロナ陽性率20%超」、最新状況公表
triage.triage_reason: 中国CDCによる定例のサーベイランス報告であり、新規病原体の検出はなく、季節性の呼吸器感染症動向の範囲内。国際的拡大や渡航制限等のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 定期サーベイランス報告。新型コロナ（NB.1.8.1系統）が季節性上昇傾向にあるが、新規病原体なし、既存の対策範囲内の内容。

article.articleHeadline: La epidemia de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo ya es la segunda con más casos de la historia - Diario de Santiago. Noticias de Santiago de Compostela y Galicia.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is now the second-highest in history in terms of cases.
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (epicenter Ituri) has reached 3,532 confirmed infections since it was declared on May 15, with 1,556 deaths (case fatality rate 44.1%). As of July 29, 807 patients were in isolation or hospital, and 626 recovered; contact tracing is 78.7%. Five provinces are affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment, and is the second-largest by case count in DRC history, the fastest-growing since declaration, though not at the scale of the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or animals. The outbreak spread to Uganda, which was declared Ebola-free on July 28 after 42 days without new cases; Uganda reported 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and 2 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、史上2番目に症例数が多い流行に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率44.1%、5州にまたがる大規模流行で史上2番目の症例数、ウガンダへの越境感染も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは越境症例が確認されたがすでにエボラフリー宣言済み（対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず）。DRCのイツリ、北キブ、南キブ、オートウエレ、チョポの5州が影響を受けている。
