article.articleHeadline: China reports 4 more human H9N2 avian influenza cases
article.articleSummary: Four additional human infections with avian influenza A(H9N2) were reported by China to the WHO in the Western Pacific Region for 24–30 July 2026. Cases: a 72-year-old woman from Jiangxi with onset 5 July; a 12-year-old boy from Jiangsu with onset 6 July; a 3-year-old girl from Gansu with onset 11 July; and a 58-year-old woman from Yunnan with onset 13 July. Each case is geographically distinct. One case had direct exposure to live poultry; the other three had potential exposure linked to live-poultry stalls or wet markets. Two patients with underlying chronic respiratory disease were hospitalized and later discharged; the other two had mild illness and were not hospitalized, having recovered by reporting. Since 2015, 177 Western Pacific Region H9N2 cases have been reported to WHO, including two deaths (both with underlying conditions); 174 cases from China, two from Cambodia, and one from Viet Nam.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、H9N2鳥インフルエンザのヒト感染例をさらに4件報告
triage.triage_reason: H9N2は例年散発的に報告されている既知のパターンであり、今回も軽症例が中心でヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はないが、継続的なサーベイランス対象として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 2015年以降、西太平洋地域で177例のH9N2ヒト感染が報告されており(うち174例が中国)、今回の4例は既知のパターンに合致。家禽との接触による散発例で、ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はない。カンボジア・ベトナムは累計データに含まれるが今回の新規報告ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Armenia assesses Ebola importation and spread risk as low
article.articleSummary: Armenia's National Center for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) assessed the risk of Ebola importation into and spread within Armenia as low, despite an ongoing DRC Bundibugyo virus outbreak. WHO data show 3,360 confirmed cases and 1,487 deaths in the DRC, the largest Bundibugyo outbreak yet. Uganda declared itself Ebola-free on 28 July 2026; last confirmed case was 21 June, with the patient discharged on 16 July after two negative tests. WHO rates Uganda's importation risk as high due to cross-border movement with the DRC. France reported one imported case - a physician returning from the DRC - who recovered; no secondary transmission. Germany evacuated two U.S. citizens infected in the DRC; one discharged, the other stable; no secondary cases. Armenia notes Ebola spreads only by direct contact with infected blood or bodily fluids, not air. NCDC urges vigilance, avoidance of non-essential travel to affected areas, early detection, and adherence to WHO temporary recommendations.

triage.headline_ja: アルメニア、エボラウイルスの侵入・拡大リスクを『低い』と評価
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のブンディブギョウ・エボラウイルス流行（確認症例3,360、死亡1,487）が継続しており、既にフランス・ドイツへの輸入例も発生し国際的拡大が現実化しているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はアルメニア・米国・フランス・ドイツ・ウガンダにも言及しているが、これらは輸入症例や自国リスク評価の文脈であり、対象国リストに該当する主題発生国はDRCのみ。ウガンダはエボラ収束宣言済みだが対象国リストには含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Why is it difficult to contain the growing Ebola outbreak in DRC?
article.articleSummary: 3,442 Ebola (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) cases and 1,521 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of July 28, 2026, with about 797 hospitalized or in isolation. Bunia, Ituri Province, is the epicenter; cases also detected in North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. The first death occurred April 24 in Bunia; confirmation delays and false negatives preceded formal recognition on May 15, 2026. Transmission is via contact with blood or bodily fluids, not airborne; incubation 2–21 days; contagious after symptoms. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or specific treatments. No vaccine yet; Oxford University’s ChAdOx1 BDBV is in human trials, with the first volunteer receiving the jab last week. Containment hampered by rebel insecurity, weak health facilities, poor infrastructure, distrust, unsafe burials, and delayed reporting; contact tracing at 78.3% (goal 90–95%). WHO declared PHEIC on May 17, 2026; funding includes a $518m WHO plan and $107m from CDC; Uganda reported Ebola-free status on July 28 after 20 cases (18 discharged, 2 died).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行、なぜ封じ込めが困難なのか
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる大規模流行（症例3,442・死亡1,521）が継続し、WHOがPHEICを宣言、ウガンダへの越境例も確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも感染例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン未承認・治療法未確立、接触者追跡率78.3%（目標90-95%未達）と管理面の課題が大きい。

article.articleHeadline: Claves del brote de ébola en RD Congo: el segundo con más casos de la historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Key facts about the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo: the second-largest on record.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, has reached 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths across Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo, making it the second-largest on record. Transmission is ongoing at roughly 50–100 new cases daily. Uganda reports 20 cases, including 15 imported from DRC, with two deaths; Uganda was declared Ebola-free on July 28. The outbreak is due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain with 30–50% fatality; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Diagnostic capacity increased from 3 labs (about 30 tests/day) to 18 labs (about 2,200/day); treatment centers rose from 3 with ~20 beds to 37 with close to 1,000 beds. Oxford began a first human vaccine trial in July; other candidates are led by IAVI, Moderna, CEPI. MSF/WHO warn of unprecedented spread amid conflict, distrust, and incomplete contact tracing, with a July 1 assault on Bafwabango CET in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行に関する重要事実：史上2番目の規模
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態＝史上2番目の規模、国際的拡大＝ウガンダへの越境）に加え、WPRO基準も全項目該当。社会的関心も高く、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例（20例、うち15例がDRCからの輸入例）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。3532例確定・1556死亡、致死率30-50%のBundibugyoエボラウイルス株による流行で、紛争地域での対応困難や不完全な接触者追跡が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola is putting millions of children at risk
article.articleSummary: WHO declared an Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo on 17 May. As of 21 July, 2,344 confirmed cases and 930 deaths have been reported in the DRC, with experts warning the true scale may be larger. Cross-border transmission concerns loom as neighbouring Uganda and South Sudan face risk. War Child notes 2.95 million children under 18 are at risk across 31 areas in eastern DRC. Children, though fewer in cases, face higher mortality if infected. The response emphasizes protection and mental health alongside medical care, with War Child working with governments and partners in DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan to ensure access to information about Ebola signs and symptoms, psychosocial support, and community-led prevention. School-based measures include handwashing facilities and child-friendly learning materials. The crisis compounds the DRC humanitarian emergency affecting 15 million people; Uganda 2022-2023 experiences inform efforts, including psychological first aid and education continuity.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が数百万人の子どもたちを危険にさらしている
triage.triage_reason: WHOがDRCでエボラ流行を宣言し、2,344症例・930死亡と重大な公衆衛生影響があり、ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境感染リスクも指摘されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンは越境感染リスクとして言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRC国内の人道危機（1500万人影響）と合わせ、深刻度が高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se stává stále větší hrozbou. Šíří se nejrychleji v historii
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Is Becoming an Increasingly Serious Threat. It Is Spreading Faster Than at Any Point in History.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), primarily Ituri province with Bunia and Rwampara health zones heavily affected. Since mid-May official declaration, the Bundibugyo strain is spreading at record speed; total 3,360 confirmed cases across five eastern provinces and 1,487 deaths (case fatality ~45%). Health workers face ongoing violence and insecurity. Weekly, 100–150 new confirmed cases in Bunia and Rwampara. Authorities have expanded field surveillance, built more than twenty specialized treatment centers, and established local laboratories for rapid testing. Early July saw clinical trials of a vaccine targeting Bundibugyo with around twenty patients by mid-July; trials may take months. Uganda has sent experts to assist Congo, especially in border areas Tchomia and Kasenyi to bolster security and coordination. The outbreak remains uncontrolled, with peak timing unknown.

triage.headline_ja: エボラはますます深刻な脅威になりつつある。史上最速のペースで拡大している
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率約45%のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が史上最速で拡大しており、確定症例3,360件・死亡1,487件、国境地域での治安悪化と国際的拡大リスクを伴う重大なアウトブレイクである。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ルワンダは国境地域として言及され支援を提供しているが、症例発生地としては言及されていないため対象国リストの検証対象外（DRCのみverified_locationsに含めた）。渡航・貿易制限に関する言及は記事中になし。

article.articleHeadline: Jumlah kasus Ebola di RD Kongo lampaui 3.500
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola case count in DR Congo surpasses 3,500.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 3,500 cases. As of now, 3,532 confirmed infections have been recorded, with 807 patients in isolation or hospitalized, 626 recovered, and 1,556 deaths. The case fatality rate is 44.1%, and contact tracing coverage is 78.7%. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared the DRC and Uganda Ebola outbreaks a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, citing very high risk of spread. The figures reflect ongoing transmission in the region, under continued international monitoring and response. The update was issued by the local Ministry of Communications and Media via its X platform.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数、3,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言済みのエボラ大規模流行で、致死率44.1%と極めて深刻。IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCの症例数増加であり、対象国リストにUgandaは含まれないため除外。WHOはDRCとウガンダ両方をPHEIC対象としている点は注記。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы в Конго стала второй по масштабам в истории - MigNews - Новости Израиля и Мира на русском языке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo became the second-largest in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has become the second-largest in history. Since the outbreak was declared in mid-May, 3,532 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths have been reported, for a case-fatality rate of 44.1%. Currently 807 patients are in isolation or receiving hospital care, and 626 have recovered. The epidemic spans five provinces—Upper Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Chopo—with Ituri the epicenter and main hotspot for the Bundibugyo strain. The World Health Organization notes that only West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak was larger (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone), which reached 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola at present.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、史上2番目の規模に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率44.1%の大規模エボラ流行が5州に拡大し、史上2番目の規模に達しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチンや特異的治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株による流行であり、致死率44.1%と極めて高い。史上2番目の規模との報道であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Covid in Cina, cosa sappiamo della nuova ondata estiva
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 in China: What We Know About the New Summer Wave
article.articleSummary: An anomalous summer COVID-19 wave is hitting China. In July, the Chinese CDC reported 79,000 cases, about 130 of them severe; most patients have mild symptoms. Weekly test positivity was 16.3% (July 13–19), up 4.3 points from the prior week, while influenza positivity was 12.6% (down 0.9). The predominant Omicron NB.1.8.1 variant is circulating at a 'moderate' transmission level, with no total of new infections provided. Authorities advise the elderly and people with underlying conditions to use masks in public and hospital settings, and to vaccinate vulnerable patients. The SCMP notes Covid has surpassed influenza as the main respiratory virus in recent weeks; warmer months do not preclude spread, aided by time spent in air-conditioned environments. Experts say no alarm since severe cases and deaths are not rising proportionally; immunity wanes over time, suggesting sporadic outbreaks. NB.1.8.1 remains a variant under monitoring; OMS has classified it as such since May 2025.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のCOVID-19、2026年夏の新たな流行の波について分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新型コロナの夏季流行が報告されているが、重症例・死亡の増加は認められず専門家も「警戒不要」としており、既知のNB.1.8.1変異株による季節性の波と考えられるため、当面は続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 検査陽性率が前週より上昇（16.3%）しているが、重症化率は比例して増加していない。NB.1.8.1はWHOが2025年5月から監視下変異株として分類済み。季節性の波である可能性が高く、現時点でRRAへの引き上げは不要と判断。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: India News | H1N1 Cases Rise in Delhi-NCR Amid Monsoon, Seasonal Transition: Doctors
article.articleSummary: Delhi-NCR reports a rise in H1N1 influenza cases amid the monsoon and seasonal changes, with hospitals noting roughly 7–10 H1N1 patients per day in OPD over the past 3–4 weeks; slight uptick in COVID-19 cases. Testing confirms increased H1N1 infections. Symptoms include fever, cough, cold, sore throat, nasal discharge and headache, with many experiencing high fever. Most H1N1 infections are mild, and fever typically subsides within 3–5 days. Vulnerable groups—elderly, young children, and those with diabetes, hypertension, heart disease, COPD or CKD—are at higher risk of complications; some patients require hospitalization. Advice: isolate at home for 2–3 days, wear a face mask, and contact a doctor if symptoms worsen or treatment is needed. Institutions cited: Fortis Memorial Research Institute, Gurugram; AIIMS Delhi; Sir Ganga Ram Hospital. Date: 31 July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: インド:デリー・NCRでモンスーンと季節の変わり目にH1N1感染が増加、医師が指摘
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の例年的な増加であり、重症度は概ね軽度だが、脆弱層への影響や医療機関の負荷を継続観察する必要がある。
triage.notes: 季節性のH1N1増加で多くは軽症、既存医療体制内で対応可能とみられる。継続的な症例動向の監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola no Congo é segundo maior já registrado, segundo dados recentes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo is the second-largest on record, according to recent data.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo reaches 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths, the second-largest on record. The eastern Congo outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. In under three months, deaths are already five times higher at this stage than in previous outbreaks, according to Africa CDC. Only West Africa's 2014-2016 epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) was larger, with 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths. Health teams face insecurity and attacks on facilities across eastern Congo, as dozens of armed groups operate and international aid has been cut. Caritas emergencies head Angele Gapio says awareness campaigns are failing and frontline workers are exhausted and traumatized.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、最新データによると史上2番目の規模に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部で史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行が発生し、稀少なブンディブギョ株（承認済みワクチン・治療法なし）により致死率が過去の流行より著しく高く、治安悪化や国際支援削減も重なり深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威となっている。
triage.notes: 西アフリカ（ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネ）2014-2016年流行は過去の比較対象として言及されているのみで、現在の発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Arboviroses : premiers cas autochtones identifiés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arboviruses: first autochthonous cases identified.
article.articleSummary: Arboviruses: France's Santé publique France reports minor autochthonous dengue, chikungunya, and West Nile virus infections from May 1 to July 26, 2026, with substantial imported cases across 13 regions. By July 27, 2026, two autochthonous dengue cases were identified in Tarn and Hérault (Occitanie), and one autochthonous chikungunya case in Tarn—the first chikungunya circulation detected in metropolitan France in 2026. Two autochthonous West Nile virus infections were confirmed in Pyrénées-Orientales (Occitanie) and Bouches-du-Rhône (PACA). Imported totals: 87 chikungunya, 261 dengue, 9 Zika. Import sources: chikungunya from Mauritius, French Guiana, Mayotte; dengue from Martinique, Togo, French Polynesia; Zika from Indonesia, Cameroon, Congo. Imported cases span 13 regions, including Île-de-France, Occitanie, Nouvelle-Aquitaine, and PACA.

triage.headline_ja: アルボウイルス感染症：フランス本土で初の自然感染症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 本事案はフランス本土における自然感染症例（デング熱・チクングニア熱・西ナイル熱）の発生に関するもので、対象国リストに該当する国（インドネシア・コンゴ民主共和国等）は輸入症例の由来地として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため対象外。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はフランス本土における自然感染（autochthonous）症例の発生であり、対象国（インドネシア、コンゴ民主共和国、カメルーン、トーゴ、モーリシャス等）は輸入症例の感染由来地として記載されているに過ぎず、実際の発生国はフランスのみ。フランスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空とする。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : plus de 600 personnes guéries (Rapport)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: More than 600 people have recovered (Report)
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo spans five provinces and 48 health zones. In Ituri, health zones include Aru, Angumu, Bambu, Bunia, Damas, Drodro, Gety, Kilo, Komanda, Lita, Logo, Mambasa, Mangala, Mongbwalu, Nizi, Nyankunde, Rimba, Rwampara, Tchomia, Kambala, Nia-Nia, Fataki, Mandima, Lolwa, Boga, Ariwara, Mahagi and Adja. In North Kivu: Beni, Butembo, Goma, Kalunguta, Katwa, Kyondo, Oicha, Masereka, Vuhovi, Mabalako, Musienene. Sud-Kivu has Miti-Murhesa as the sole affected zone. Haut-Uele zones: Boma Mangbetu, Isiro, Pawa, Rungu, Wamba. Tshopo zones: Lubunga, Makiso-Kisangani, Mangobo. Cumulative confirmed cases: 3,532; 807 in isolation or hospitalized; 626 recovered; 1,556 deaths (case fatality 44.1%); contact follow-up 78.7%. Entry/control points double as risk-communication hubs; travelers screened and urged to follow prevention, especially in highly mobile areas. Frontline teams, community relays, and care facilities are highlighted, with a recovered soldier in Beni used to bolster trust and reduce stigma.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国：600人以上が回復（報告）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で5州48保健地域にまたがるエボラ大規模流行が継続中で、確定症例3,532例・死亡1,556例（致死率44.1%）と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 致死率44.1%、接触者追跡率78.7%と不完全であり、国境近接地域（Ituri等）を含む複数州にまたがる継続流行のため国際拡大リスクに注意が必要。国際支援の有無については記事に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola no Congo já é o 2º maior da história
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is already the second-largest in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 3,532 confirmed infections and 1,556 deaths as of July 31, 2026, making it the second-largest by confirmed cases. Declared May 15, the current surge surpasses the 2018–2020 outbreak (3,481/2,299) but is far from West Africa’s 2014–2016 crisis (~28,000/11,000). Case fatality is 44.1%. About 807 patients are hospitalized or in isolation, and 626 have recovered; contact tracing covers 78.7% of monitored cases. Five provinces report cases: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. The Bundibugyo strain is involved; WHO notes no approved vaccine or specific treatment for this variant. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or animals. Uganda reports 20 cases (15 imported, 2 deaths); Uganda ended its outbreak on July 28 after 42 days without new cases. WHO assesses regional risk as high in Sub-Saharan Africa, low globally.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、史上2番目の規模に
triage.triage_reason: 確定感染者3,532人、死亡1,556人、致死率44.1%と極めて深刻で、史上2番目の規模の流行であり複数州・国境を越えた拡大（ウガンダ)も確認されているためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし国際的拡大の証拠として本文には言及。承認されたワクチン・特異的治療法がないBundibugyo株であり、WHOはサブサハラアフリカ地域リスクを高、世界リスクを低と評価している。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Khống chế dịch bệnh trên đàn vật nuôi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Controlling disease outbreaks among livestock.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 July 2026, Tuy Quang Province, Vietnam, is contending with H5N1 avian influenza outbreaks in poultry and African swine fever (ASF). H5N1 outbreaks have struck poultry in Viet Lam, Dong Tam, and Tan Quang, with 1,060 birds dead or culled (weight >1,400 kg). Tan Quang declared an outbreak on 22 July. Authorities maintain checkpoints, sanitation, and vaccination; 12,700 doses of avian influenza vaccine have been administered, with a plan to reach over 80% coverage for ring vaccination around affected areas; 482 L disinfectant and 8,290 kg lime used in decontamination; 2,000 kg lime powder and 50 L disinfectant procured for Viet Lam. A violation in Viet Lam led to seizure of 25 poultry and 300 eggs. ASF outbreaks from 21–23 July affected seven communes, triggering culling of 57 pigs from 11 households (>2.2 t). 523 L disinfectant and 4,593 kg lime used; tighter controls on transport and slaughter.

triage.headline_ja: 家畜における疫病の抑制について
triage.triage_reason: 家禽のH5N1及び豚のASFはいずれも動物感染に限定され、人への感染は報告されておらず、当局による防疫措置（ワクチン接種、消毒、移動制限）が既に奏功しているため、フルリスク評価の必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 人への感染事例の報告なし。動物（家禽・豚）に限定された地域的な家畜疫病であり、当局による防疫対応が既に進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 3 532 cas confirmés et 1 556 décès au 29 juillet, les humanitaires reviennent progressivement à Nyankunde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths as of July 29; aid workers are gradually returning to Nyankunde.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: as of July 29, the 17th outbreak has 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths across Haut-Uélé, Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu and Tshopo, with 626 recoveries and 807 in isolation or hospitalized. Provisional case fatality 44.1%; contact tracing 78.7%; the outbreak remains confined to 48 of 140 health zones. Two days earlier, report 074 recorded 3,360 cases and 1,487 deaths, with 86 daily confirmations and no new health zones affected. Nyankunde health zone in Ituri reports 114 confirmed cases and 31 deaths as of July 27; humanitarian teams are gradually returning after the July 15 killing of a local leader. In Bunia, a youth communicators training on risk-communication completed. No licensed vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo lineage; Ervebo does not cover Bundibugyo. A Phase 1 trial of the ChAdOx1 BDBV candidate vaccine began July 24; Uganda declared its own outbreak ended the same day.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱：7月29日時点で確定症例3,532例、死亡1,556例、援助関係者はニャンクンデに徐々に復帰
triage.triage_reason: 致死率44.1%、3,500例超の確定症例という大規模かつ深刻なエボラ流行が継続しており、有効なワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyo系統である点、及びウガンダでも関連流行が確認されていた点からIHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価に進むべきである。
triage.notes: ウガンダは同日に自国の流行終息を宣言したが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Bundibugyo系統に対する承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点は特筆すべきリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak tops 3,500 cases
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak has 3,532 confirmed cases across five provinces, with 1,556 deaths as of July 31, 2026. The center of the outbreak is northeastern Ituri province near South Sudan and Uganda; four other provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu where areas are controlled by the Rwanda-backed M23 armed group, have reported cases. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids and causes haemorrhagic fever. The Bundibugyo strain involved has no approved vaccine or treatment. The World Health Organization notes the most promising vaccine for this outbreak is being developed by Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore-based). Separately, Oxford University is testing a different Bundibugyo vaccine in a clinical trial, with the first dose given last week. Uganda declared Ebola-free this week after the last local transmission case, but remains at risk of cross-border spread from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、症例数3,500件を突破
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラアウトブレイクが5州に拡大し、致死率約44%（1,556人死亡/3,532症例）、承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在せず、紛争地域での対応困難や国境を越えた拡散リスクもあることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSouth Sudan, Rwanda, Uganda, Singaporeが含まれるが、いずれも対象国リストに該当しないため除外。Ugandaは今週エボラ終息宣言も国境を越えたリスクが残るとの記述あり。ワクチン開発はSingapore（Hilleman Labs）とOxford大学が関与しているが発生地ではないため対象外。

article.articleHeadline: La República Democrática del Congo registra más de 3,500 casos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports more than 3,500 Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak reaches 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths across five provinces as of Friday, exceeding totals from the 2018–2020 epidemic. Ituri, in the northeast along the border with South Sudan and Uganda, accounts for about 90% of cases, according to the World Health Organization. The virus is also present in four other provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu, whose provincial capitals and parts of the territory are controlled by the M23 antigovernment armed group backed by Rwanda. The seventeenth Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is currently no vaccine or treatment. Promising vaccine efforts: Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore-based) developing one; the University of Oxford also advancing a Bundibugyo vaccine, with a first dose given to a volunteer in the UK last week. Uganda has declared the outbreak over, but the WHO warns risk persists.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱症例が3,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は3,532症例・1,556死亡に達し2018-2020年流行を上回る規模で、ワクチン・治療法が存在しない変異株であり、紛争地域での対応困難も重なるため深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威と判断される。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSouth Kivu, Ituri, Sudan, Rwanda, Uganda, Singapore, UKが含まれるが、記事の主題はDRC国内での流行拡大であり、他国は近隣国境地域や治療薬開発拠点としての言及に留まるため対象国リストにおいてはDRCのみを確定。ウガンダは流行終息を宣言済みだがWHOはリスク継続を警告。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠冲上热搜？上海疾控详解大热天病毒活跃原因
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 Tops Hot Searches? Shanghai CDC Explains Why Viruses Are Active in Hot Weather
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Shanghai shows mild, small fluctuations in activity during July 2026, according to Shanghai CDC. No new variant emerged; circulating strain remains Omicron NB.1.8.1, with long-term stable transmission and no increased virulence. Local infections cause mild symptoms—sore throat, dry cough, low fever, fatigue—with no reported severe or critical cases. Most healthy individuals recover at home in 3–5 days; older adults, pregnant women, and those with chronic diseases should seek care if unwell. Despite higher hot-weather activity, hospital visits remain at low levels and the city’s healthcare resources are sufficient. Reasons for the minor uptick include waning population immunity, summer travel, and crowded indoor spaces with poor ventilation. Preventive measures emphasize masks in enclosed spaces (subways, buses, hospitals), regular ventilation, hand hygiene, cough etiquette, and maintaining healthy habits, rather than medication stockpiling.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナがホット検索急上昇？上海疾病予防管理センターが猛暑にウイルスが活発化する理由を解説
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株の出現なく、重症例もなく、医療資源も十分であるため、通常の季節的変動として扱われ、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は上海市当局による季節性の説明・注意喚起であり、既存のOmicron NB.1.8.1株による軽症例の小幅増加に過ぎない。SNS等での話題性はあるが公衆衛生上の脅威度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: எச்ஐவி தொற்று குறித்து வெளியான செய்தி​ தவறானவை: கர்நாடக அதிகாரி, இந்தியா செய்திகள் - தமிழ் முரசு India News in Tamil, Tamil Murasu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News about HIV infection is false: Karnataka official, India News - Tamil Murasu
article.articleSummary: False reports claimed 7,000 Karnataka college students were HIV-positive. Padma Basavanthappa, Director of the Karnataka State AIDS Prevention Society, clarified that since 2004 about 7,000 people aged 18–35 live with HIV in Karnataka, not limited to students. Data show no student-specific category; the government has ordered HIV testing in colleges and treatment camps to curb transmission. Bengaluru is cited in the report. Karnataka ranks third nationally in HIV prevalence, with approximately 260,000 people affected. The National AIDS Control Programme supports Karnataka’s position and ongoing surveillance, with interventions emphasizing testing, access to treatment, and public awareness.

triage.headline_ja: HIV感染に関する報道は誤り:カルナタカ州当局、インドニュース - Tamil Murasu
triage.triage_reason: 報道内容は誤情報の訂正であり、新規の異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はHIV感染者数に関する誤報を当局が否定した内容であり、実際の感染急増や新規アウトブレイクを報じたものではないため対象国リストへの計上は行わない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak now second largest on record, data shows
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola outbreak is now the second-largest on record, according to government data released on July 31, 2026. The communications ministry reported 3,532 cases, surpassing the 3,481 cases from the 2018–2020 outbreak, with 1,556 deaths. Only West Africa’s 2014–16 outbreak was larger, totaling 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths across Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone, per the World Health Organization. The update underscores sustained transmission and the challenge of containment. The briefing does not specify clinical symptoms, infection source, laboratory confirmation, or cross-border import/export cases. The figures emphasize the scale of the Congo outbreak relative to historic outbreaks, providing top-line counts but no additional details on the outbreak’s drivers or response actions.

article.articleHeadline: Епидемията от ебола в ДР Конго е втората по мащаб в света, откакто се води статистика
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the second-largest in the world since records began.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 July 2026, the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the second-largest globally since records began. DRC reports 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak (3,481 cases, 2,299 deaths). The West Africa 2014–2016 outbreak remains the largest, with 28,616 infections and 11,310 deaths, affecting Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Ebola causes hemorrhagic fever with high fever, bleeding, organ failure; transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids of infected people or animals. The DRC has experienced multiple outbreaks since 1976, the prior worst being 2018–2020. Challenges include difficult terrain, armed conflict, mistrust, and barriers to reaching communities. Vaccines and improved early detection have strengthened control, yet outbreaks persist in regions with limited medical care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は、統計開始以来世界で2番目の規模となっている
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行が統計開始以来世界で2番目の規模（3,532症例、1,556死亡）に達しており、深刻な公衆衛生への影響と異常性の両方に該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事は現在のDRCにおけるエボラ流行の規模と歴史的比較（2014-16年西アフリカ流行、2018-20年DRC流行）を述べているが、シエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアは過去の流行事例として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Orang Tua Wajib Waspada! Ini Gejala DBD Tak Biasa pada Anak yang Sering Dianggap Sepele
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Parents Must Be Alert! These Are Unusual Dengue Fever Symptoms in Children That Are Often Considered Trivial.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia faces dengue fever (DBD) as a year-round risk, with children most affected. Data from the Ministry of Health show that in 2025, 59% of dengue fatalities occurred in children aged 0–14. DBD is not confined to the rainy season; the risk persists year-round, especially with back-to-school season increasing exposure. Early symptoms include sudden high fever, headache, muscle and joint pains, nausea, and weakness. Parents should beware of a critical phase that can occur as fever subsides, presenting with persistent vomiting, severe abdominal pain, nosebleeds or bleeding gums, and marked lethargy or agitation, or reduced consciousness. Recovered children often experience prolonged fatigue and may not instantly return to full activity. There are four dengue serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4); infection with a new serotype can raise the risk of severe dengue. Vaccination is advised: IDAI recommends dengue vaccine for children; PAPDI for adults.

triage.headline_ja: 親は要注意!子供に見られがちな見過ごされやすいデング熱の非典型的症状

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak tops 3,500 cases, becomes 2nd-largest ever
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak has reached 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths, making it the world's second-largest on record. The epidemic is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment, and is spreading faster than containment efforts can keep up. With the outbreak now less than three months old, the Africa CDC notes it has claimed far more lives than previous epidemics at the same stage, second only to 2014-16 West Africa (28,616 cases, 11,310 deaths). The WHO warns true case counts could be up to four times higher than official numbers. Insecurity and attacks on health facilities in eastern Congo, coupled with aid shortfalls, hamper response. Funding for the May–August plan remains short—$213.9M pledged of $242.4M. A U.S. travel ban has constrained aid deployment, prompting Samaritan's Purse to scale back operations; communities show transmission chains via traditional healers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、症例数3,500件を超え史上2番目の規模に

triage.notes: 米国の渡航禁止措置により援助団体（Samaritan's Purse）が活動縮小、資金不足（$213.9M/$242.4M）、治安悪化により対応が困難化。WHOは実際の症例数が公式発表の4倍に達する可能性を警告。

article.articleHeadline: Mimoso do Sul confirma morte de menina de 12 anos por febre maculosa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mimoso do Sul confirms death of a 12-year-old girl due to Rocky Mountain spotted fever.
article.articleSummary: Rocky Mountain spotted fever (RMSF) has caused the death of a 12-year-old girl in Mimoso do Sul, southern Espírito Santo, Brazil. On 27 July, the patient died after transfer from Hospital Apóstolo Pedro (Mimoso do Sul), where she first presented on 25 July with fever, severe abdominal pain and vomiting, to Hospital Infantil Francisco de Assis (Hifa) in Cachoeiro de Itapemirim. RMSF was confirmed after autopsy and laboratory tests, with leptospirosis ruled out. Health authorities activated surveillance and entomological investigations in areas identified as possible transmission sites; the star tick is noted as the main vector and may be found throughout the municipality. Authorities urge protective measures when in rivers, pastures, or forests, and prompt medical care for fever, body aches, headache, or rashes. This is the second RMSF death in Mimoso do Sul in 2026; one RMSF death had occurred earlier this year.

triage.headline_ja: ミモゾ・ド・スル、12歳少女がロッキー山紅斑熱で死亡と確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部エスピリトサント州の既知の風土病（ダニ媒介性RMSF）による死亡例で、地域内での複数症例が続いているが、国際的拡大リスクやヒト-ヒト感染の懸念はなく、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: ロッキー山紅斑熱（RMSF）はブラジル南東部で既知の風土病であり、ダニ（星型ダニ）媒介性。同一市で2026年に2例目の死亡例。国レベルの深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大リスクは低いが、地域での継続的曝露と重症例（死亡）があるため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Finland detects first African swine fever case
article.articleSummary: Preliminary tests detected African swine fever (ASF) in the remains of three wild boar piglets found in Virolahti’s Vaalimaa area near the Russian border, Finland. Samples will go to the EU reference laboratory in Spain for formal confirmation, but containment begins immediately. An infection zone covers Virolahti, Miehikkälä and the southern part of Lappeenranta, with a core three-kilometre radius where forestry work, berry/mushroom gathering, dog walking inside the core, and hunting are restricted. In the wider zone, dogs must be leashed and walked on roads. Public are urged to report dead wild boar or ill pigs. Exports could be affected; Finland exports about €74 million of pork annually outside the EU. HK Foods and Atria have paused exports to several countries (e.g., Japan, China, Singapore, Taiwan). ASF does not infect humans; no vaccine or treatment exists, and mortality can reach 100% in infected herds; the virus persists for months in carcasses and years in frozen meat. Sweden contained its outbreak within about a year; Finland will study those measures.

As of government data, 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths have been confirmed. Officials warn transmission is outpacing containment, with World Food Programme Deputy Executive Director Carl Skau calling it the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak to date. Africa CDC notes that in under three months, fatalities are five times higher than in the same period of previous outbreaks. Health workers face security challenges in eastern DRC, where dozens of armed groups operate, and funding cuts have strained resources. The WHO notes the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) as the largest on record with 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths, and says the true scale could be up to four times higher than official counts.

article.articleHeadline: Епидемията от ебола в ДР Конго е втората по големина в историята
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in DR Congo is the second largest in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the second-largest in history, with 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths recorded as of 31 July 2026. The ongoing outbreak surpasses earlier crises; by comparison, the 2018–2020 outbreak had 3,481 cases and 2,270 deaths, while the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic remained the largest (28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone). The New York Times notes faster spread in the current outbreak, with about 1,500 deaths after three months versus ten months in 2018–2020. In Uganda, the Bundibugyo virus outbreak ended on 28 July after four weeks without new cases, reporting 20 cases and 3 deaths. Transmission in DR Congo remains ahead of containment efforts at this time.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : Enfin la riposte scientifique à la variante Bundibugyo - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Finally the scientific response to the Bundibugyo variant - LePotentiel.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo variant of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri, has claimed more than 1,500 lives to date. Two parallel advances offer a new response: Ebopep, a therapeutic protocol tested by the INRB at the Rwampara Ebola Treatment Center in Ituri, and ChAdOx1 BDBV, the first Bundibugyo-specific vaccine entering Phase I trials at the University of Oxford, England, with support from CEPI and the Serum Institute of India. About 620,000 doses have already been pre-produced to accelerate deployment if results are promising. A complete management of Bundibugyo will require showing reduced mortality, demonstrated protection for exposed populations, regulatory approvals, scalable production, and rapid distribution to affected areas. The Ituri outbreak has become a global proving ground for a combined strategy: early diagnosis, targeted vaccination of contacts, and reinforced epidemiological surveillance. INRB has launched Ebopep trials at the Rwampara CTE with 42-day follow-up for high-risk contacts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ブンディブギョ変異株への科学的対応がついに始動 - LePotentiel

article.articleHeadline: 寄生虫潜伏期可达几十年！夏天爱吃生腌海鲜的要注意了
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The incubation period for parasites can last for decades! Those who enjoy raw, salted seafood in the summer should take note.
article.articleSummary: Summer consumption of raw marinated seafood poses health risks from bacteria, viruses, and parasites. Marinating fresh seafood (shrimp, crab, shellfish) in liquor, soy, garlic, and chili is common, but does not guarantee safety. Alcohol used (often 50–75% ethanol) cannot reliably kill pathogens, and norovirus and hepatitis B virus resist such concentrations. Infections can be caused by Vibrio parahaemolyticus, Vibrio vulnificus, and Salmonella, leading to diarrhea, bloating, nausea, vomiting; severe cases may cause septicemia. Parasitic infections are also a concern: liver fluke (Clonorchis sinensis) can persist 15–25 years; many infections are asymptomatic. Sea fish can harbor anisakid nematodes, with symptoms appearing within hours to a week, ranging from mild GI upset to severe abdominal pain and perforation. Thiaminase in shellfish and freshwater fish can deplete vitamin B1, causing beriberi, distinct from athlete’s foot. China CDC and the National Emergency Broadcast urge cooking seafood thoroughly and buying from regulated sources to reduce risk.

triage.headline_ja: 寄生虫の潜伏期間は数十年にも及ぶ！夏に生腌（生の塩漬け）海鮮を好んで食べる人は注意が必要

The municipality's dengue bulletins are published on the city’s website under Informativo Dengue. Community reporting of potential Aedes aegypti breeding sites can be submitted online 24/7 or in person, Monday to Friday, at the Health Ombudsman offices (Centro). The article highlights ongoing dengue surveillance but provides no details on laboratory confirmation methods, infection sources, or any imported/exported cases.

article.articleHeadline: DRC and Food Insecurity (Ebola Crisis)
article.articleSummary: As of 31 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces a second-deadliest Ebola outbreak in its eastern regions, with at least 1,500 deaths. The epidemic compounds a broader humanitarian crisis amid ethnic, political, and religious violence, including attacks by the ADF and tensions with Rwanda over the M23 insurgency. The World Food Programme reports more than 2.65 million people in 48 Ebola-affected health zones are acutely food insecure (IPC Phase 3+), including over 628,000 in IPC Phase 4 emergency; nearly 10 million in eastern DRC face crisis or emergency hunger, with Ituri province home to about 1.9 million in distress. Beyond Ebola, outbreaks of cholera, malaria, measles, Mpox, and tuberculosis strain fragile health services. About 80% of recent Ebola infections have unknown transmission chains, hindering containment. Without stronger regional cooperation and humanitarian funding, millions remain at risk.

article.articleHeadline: Tahun Ajaran Baru Dimulai Orang Tua Perlu Waspadai Risiko DBD pada Anak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The New School Year Begins: Parents Should Be Wary of the Risk of Dengue Fever in Children
article.articleSummary: DBD risk in Indonesia rises with the new school year, especially for children in Jakarta. Ministry of Health data (2018-2025) show ages 5-14 account for the highest dengue mortality; in 2025, 59% of deaths were in 0-14-year-olds, with 41% in 5-14. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti, active in morning and afternoon, with four serotypes (DENV-1–DENV-4). Many infections are asymptomatic; studies estimate about 45% of household members of dengue patients become infected, and most infections go undetected. Schools thus demand strong prevention: eliminate standing water, regularly monitor larvae, and apply 3M Plus (drain/close water sources, dispose of water-holding items, and protect against bites). Vaccination is part of prevention per IDAI for children and PAPDI for adults; consult a doctor to determine eligibility. Warning signs of severe dengue include persistent vomiting, severe abdominal pain, bleeding, lethargy; seek care promptly.

article.articleHeadline: जमशेदपुर में मलेरिया का कहर: 2 और CRPF जवान अस्पताल में भर्ती, जिले में मिले 58 नए मरीज - jamshedpur malaria outbreak 2 crpf jawans infected and 58 new cases
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria outbreak in Jamshedpur: two more CRPF jawans admitted to hospital, 58 new cases detected in the district.
article.articleSummary: Malaria outbreak persists in East Singhbhum district, including Jamshedpur, India. On Thursday, 58 new malaria cases were confirmed across the district after 6,781 people were tested (6,436 rapid diagnostic tests and 345 blood slides). Plasmodium falciparum accounted for 43 cases (cerebral malaria), Plasmodium vivax for 13, and 2 were mixed infections. Potka reported the highest burden with 22 cases; Patamda 9; Ghatshila and Musabani 7 each; Dumaria 6; Sadar Hospital 5; Dhalbhhumgarh and Jugsalai 1 each. No new cases were detected in Baharagora, Chakulia, Urban Mango, or Urban Birsa Nagar. Two more CRPF jawans were admitted to MGM Hospital in Jamshedpur—one with malaria confirmation, another with high fever; a previous case had died. The CRPF intensified health checks, vector control, and monitoring in camps. Civil Surgeon urges fever patients to seek immediate testing, use mosquito nets, eliminate stagnant water, and complete antimalarial treatment; surveillance and screening are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: ジャムシェドプルでマラリア猛威:CRPF隊員2名が新たに入院、地区で58人の新規感染確認
triage.triage_reason: インド東シンブーム県における季節性マラリアの局地的アウトブレイクで、死亡例が1件報告されているが国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、風土病の管理範囲内と考えられるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: マラリアはインドの風土病であり、東シンブーム県（ジャムシェドプル含む）での季節性アウトブレイク。CRPF治安部隊駐屯地でも感染確認され、1名死亡との既往報告あり。地元当局によるベクター対策・監視は継続中で、外部支援の必要性は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-uitbraak in Congo is op één na grootste ooit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo is the second largest ever.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo is the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak on record, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa crisis. As of last Friday, the Congolese Ministry of Communications reported 3,552 confirmed infections and 1,556 deaths. In neighboring Uganda, 20 infections and 2 deaths were recorded, but authorities say the virus has been eradicated there. By comparison, West Africa’s earlier outbreak involved 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths, primarily in Sierra Leone, Liberia and Guinea. Ebola is a rare but deadly disease caused by the Ebola virus, with a case-fatality rate reported at more than 50%. The data cited include RIVM figures on lethality. The report underscores the ongoing severity of Ebola in Africa and contrasts Congo’s outbreak with the larger West Africa crisis.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、史上2番目の規模に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴで3,552人感染・1,556人死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が発生しており、致死率も高く公衆衛生上深刻な影響がある。国際的拡大の可能性もありIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの感染例も報告されているが、当局により終息宣言済み。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは過去（2014-2016年）の西アフリカ危機との比較対象であり、現行の発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC flags constraints on DR Congo's Ebola response as Uganda shows progress
article.articleSummary: DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, has 3,442 confirmed cases and 1,521 deaths (case fatality rate >44%), with 48 health zones across five provinces, making it the fastest-growing outbreak and second-largest by total cases. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya warned of mounting constraints hampering the response, including limited contact tracing, rising community transmission and deaths, insufficient bed capacity, funding shortages, insecurity, unsafe burials, and infections among health workers. Progress includes 19 laboratories active (up from 2) and daily testing capacity over 3,000. Bundibugyo-strain therapeutics trials have been launched. Uganda has contained the outbreak and was declared over, credited to leadership and health workers. Africa CDC urged continued vigilance and lifting U.S. entry restrictions on Uganda. Other high-risk countries: South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Zambia, Central African Republic, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, Republic of the Congo, Burundi, Somalia. Visit to Bunia Aug. 2 with the WHO DG.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応における制約を指摘、ウガンダは進展を示す
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死率44%超・3,442症例のエボラ大規模流行が継続中で、地域拡大リスクと国際支援の必要性が高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCのエボラ流行とその対応状況。ウガンダは同流行の一部として終息が宣言されたが対象国リストに含まれない。ザンビア等は高リスク国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生は確認されていないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: flambée sans précédent en RDC avec plus de 3.500 cas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Unprecedented outbreak in the DRC with more than 3,500 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 July 2026, Ebola has been confirmed in 3,532 cases across five eastern provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 1,556 deaths. Authorities describe the outbreak as unprecedented for the country, surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic that killed about 2,300 people among roughly 3,500 cases. Ebola spreads by contact with bodily fluids and presents as a hemorrhagic fever. The surge unfolds in eastern DRC, a region long plagued by conflict for more than 30 years, complicating response efforts. The figures reflect official counts from Congolese authorities, underscoring the multi-provincial spread and the ongoing public health challenge in the country.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で前例のない大流行、症例数3,500例超
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC東部の5州にまたがり3,532例・1,556人の死者を記録し、過去最大規模かつ「前例のない」流行と当局が表明しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 致死率は約44%（1,556/3,532）と高く、紛争地域での対応困難も指摘されている。2018-2020年の流行を上回る規模であり、国際的な支援・監視が急務と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Have 7,000 Karnataka students tested positive for HIV? Here's the truth
article.articleSummary: False claim that 7,000 college students in Karnataka tested HIV positive; KSAPS says data misinterpretation and no compulsory testing in colleges. The government has directed government-aided and private colleges to organize Integrated Health Camps for HIV testing, screening, and counselling, but testing remains voluntary under the HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017. Project Director Padma Basavanthappa notes data are not categorized by occupation and there are no statistics showing 7,000 student infections; actual college-going cases are one or two. About 39,000 people aged 18-35 have tested HIV-positive cumulatively since 2004. Karnataka has the third-highest HIV caseload in India per NACO, with around 2.6 lakh infected and about 54,000 undiagnosed. HIV is sexually transmitted, with WHO citing about 44.2 million deaths; the article underscores misinformation and ongoing public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: カルナータカ州の学生7,000人がHIV陽性?その真相
triage.triage_reason: 記事は誤情報の訂正が主旨であり、実際の学生感染者数は1〜2人程度で、公衆衛生上の異常事態や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はSNS等で広まった誤情報（7,000人のHIV陽性学生）を当局が否定する内容。既存のHIV流行状況（カルナータカ州の累積感染者数等）についての通常の公衆衛生報道であり、新規の異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Plus de 1.500 morts en quelques mois : l'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC dépasse tous les records historiques
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,500 deaths in just a few months: the Ebola outbreak in the DRC breaks all historical records.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reaches historic levels, with 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths in eastern provinces by July 31, 2026. Across Africa, Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in 50 years; the DRC’s worst outbreak (2018–2020) caused about 2,300 deaths among 3,500 cases. This is the 17th DRC outbreak, driven by the Bundibugyo variant, with no vaccine or treatment currently. Ituri Province in the northeast, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, accounts for about 90% of cases, with transmission also in North Kivu and South Kivu, where much of the territory is controlled by M23 rebels. The epidemic began May 15 and surpassed 2,000 cases on July 15, likely lasting months. Vaccines are in development: Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore) and an Oxford University candidate using the AstraZeneca platform, a volunteer dosed last week. Uganda reports end of its outbreak, but WHO warns risk remains.

triage.headline_ja: 数ヶ月で1,500人以上死亡：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が歴史的記録を更新
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（3,532症例、1,556死亡）が発生し、ワクチン・治療法が未確立、M23反乱軍支配地域での対応困難という管理不能要因が重なり、国際的拡大リスクも高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 南スーダン・ウガンダとの国境地帯（イツリ州）で発生、M23反乱軍支配地域での対応困難。ウガンダは流行終息を報告したがWHOはリスク継続を警告。ワクチン開発中（Hilleman Laboratories/Oxford大学）だが未承認。ウガンダ・スーダン・シンガポールは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola supera mil 500 muertes en Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola surpasses 1,500 deaths in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of July 31, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 1,500 deaths, with 3,442 confirmed cases and 1,521 fatalities. The outbreak, declared on May 15, is associated with Bundibugyo virus, for which there are no vaccines or approved treatments. The majority of cases are in Ituri province, with additional infections detected in five other provinces. Authorities report transmissions remain active and note a 50% increase in deaths compared with the prior week, attributed in part to pending case registrations. Contributing factors include challenges in contact tracing, armed-group violence, misinformation, and distrust toward health workers. The article highlights the strain on medical teams and ongoing containment challenges in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱、死者1500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）によりDRCで1,500人超の死者・3,442例の確定患者が発生、複数州へ拡大し伝播が継続しているため、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高いと判断される。
triage.notes: ワクチン・承認された治療法が存在しないブンディブギョウイルスによる流行で、武装勢力による活動妨害・誤情報・医療従事者への不信も拡大要因として報告されている。既存のRRA継続中である可能性が高く、続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: In Congo l'epidemia di ebola si diffonde anche nei campi profughi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the Ebola outbreak is spreading even in refugee camps.
article.articleSummary: Refugee camp Kigonze in Ituri province shelters 20,000 people in 0.2 km2. In just over two months since the first Ebola cases, deaths exceed 1,500 among about 3,500 infections, making it the second-worst outbreak after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (about 11,000 deaths). The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there are no licensed vaccines or approved treatments yet, with trials underway. Containment relies on rapid identification, isolation, and care, but MSF warns responses chase the outbreak as resources focus on larger clusters, hindering early action in new zones. Sanitation is dire: Tsere camp shares a water tank for 6,400 people; some areas get as little as 2.5 L per day and 580 latrines are missing. In Kigonze, 55 deaths occurred from April to June, with at least four linked to Ebola. DR Congo hosts 5 million displaced people, including 1.3 million in Ituri, complicating surveillance amid other humanitarian needs.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラの流行が難民キャンプにも拡大している
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）が難民キャンプで拡大しており、死者1,500人超と2014-16年西アフリカ流行に次ぐ規模。国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域として付与されているが、記事本文では言及がなくコンゴ（特にイトゥリ州）に主題が限定されているため除外した。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、劣悪な衛生環境、大規模避難民（500万人）による監視困難など、複数の深刻な懸念要因あり。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática do Congo registrou mais de 3.500 casos de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo registered more than 3,500 Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports over 3,500 Ebola cases in a few months, surpassing counts from the 2018–2020 outbreak. Ituri province, on the northeast border with South Sudan and Uganda, is the epicenter and accounts for about 90% of confirmed infections; North Kivu and South Kivu are also affected along with four other provinces where M23 rebels control parts of territory. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever; the disease has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa in the last 50 years. As of 31 July 2026, 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths have been confirmed in five provinces. The 17th outbreak, declared on May 15, is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. Vaccines are being developed by Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore) and Oxford University (UK); Uganda declared its outbreak over, though risk remains per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の感染者数が3,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に加えWPRO基準も全て該当する大規模エボラ流行であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 2018-2020年の流行を上回る規模で、ワクチン・治療法未確立のBundibugyoバリアントによる流行。M23反政府勢力支配地域を含む複数州に拡大しており、対応の困難さが懸念される。ウガンダは終息宣言済みだがWHOはリスク継続を指摘。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ébola na RDC já é o segundo maior da história
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is already the second largest in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared May 15, 2026, has reached 3,553 confirmed cases and 1,558 deaths, making it the second-largest in the country’s history. In 40 days the first 1,000 cases were recorded, six times faster than the 2018-2020 outbreak. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment, complicating response amid ongoing East Congo conflict and reliance on traditional healers. The current outbreak surpasses the 2018-2020 total (3,470 cases) and trails only the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic (28,600). Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths. A French doctor who returned from DRC tested positive in France, the first such case outside Africa; European risk is described as very low. Five provinces are affected—Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo—posing logistical and security challenges; a joint plan with international partners is underway with no interim targets yet set.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、史上2番目の規模に
triage.triage_reason: 史上2番目の規模かつ最速の拡大速度を示すエボラ流行で、ウガンダおよびフランスへの国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準双方で複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダおよびフランスへの越境・輸入例が報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダ・フランスが含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株であり、東コンゴ紛争下での対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola. Mais de 3.500 casos registados em poucos meses na RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola. More than 3,500 cases recorded in just a few months in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: More than 3,532 Ebola cases have been confirmed in five provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo by 2026-07-31, including 1,556 deaths, according to Congolese authorities. The 17th outbreak, centered in Ituri in the northeast near the borders with South Sudan and Uganda, accounts for about 90% of cases; the virus is also present in four other provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu, with large areas controlled by the anti-government Movement 23 March (M23) rebel group backed by Rwanda. The Bundibugyo variant drives the outbreak, for which there is currently no vaccine or treatment. A vaccine deemed most promising by WHO is to be developed by Hilleman Laboratories; Oxford University has begun testing another Bundibugyo-targeting vaccine using the same platform as AstraZeneca’s COVID-19 vaccine, with the first dose administered last week. The outbreak’s true size remains hard to gauge and may last months.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:コンゴ民主共和国でここ数ヶ月で3,500人以上の症例が記録される
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死率の高いエボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)が3,500例超・死者1,556人に達し、ワクチンや治療法が確立されておらず、紛争地域での対応困難や国際的拡大リスクも懸念されるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: M23反政府勢力による支配地域での対応困難、ワクチン未承認、周辺国（南スーダン、ウガンダ、ルワンダ）との国境地域での発生により越境拡大リスクが高い。ブンディブギョ株には現時点でワクチン・治療法が存在しない点が特に懸念される。
