article.articleHeadline: Four More Human H9N2 Avian Influenza Cases Between 24 to 30th July 2026 in China Worries Global Health Officials
article.articleSummary: Four more human infections with avian influenza A(H9N2) were reported in China for 24–30 July 2026, bringing the total to seven in a short period. New patients: 72-year-old woman, Jiangxi (onset 5 July); 12-year-old boy, Jiangsu (6 July); 3-year-old girl, Gansu (11 July); 58-year-old woman, Yunnan (13 July). Exposure included direct contact with live poultry for one patient; the others visited live poultry stalls or wet markets. Two patients with chronic respiratory disease required hospitalization; the others had mild illness and recovered. Earlier June cases: a 4-year-old boy, Guangxi (26 June); a 4-year-old boy, Jiangsu (22 June); and a 44-year-old man, Guangdong (26 June), all with live-poultry exposure; two children mild, adult in ICU. In the Western Pacific since 2015, 177 lab-confirmed H9N2 infections (China 174; Cambodia 2; Vietnam 1) with two deaths in patients with underlying conditions. The report calls for intensified surveillance, expanded sequencing, and wet-market monitoring due to ongoing poultry transmission and the potential for more transmissible strains.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年7月24日から30日の間に中国でヒトH9N2型鳥インフルエンザ感染がさらに4例確認され、世界の保健当局に懸念
triage.triage_reason: 短期間に中国でヒトH9N2感染が7例確認され、慢性疾患患者の入院例もあることから、WPRO基準（重症度・曝露継続）に該当し、報道の見出しに国際的な懸念表現があるため社会的関心も認められる。
triage.notes: H9N2は中国で家禽由来の散発的ヒト感染が継続的に報告されている疾患であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の明確な証拠はない。カンボジア・ベトナムの症例数は2015年以降の累計統計であり、本記事の主題（中国での直近クラスター）とは異なるため verified_locations には含めない。米国（ミズーリ州等）は発生地域リストに含まれるが記事内容と無関係と判断し除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Now Second Largest in History: Contact Tracing Gap Fuels Crisis
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) drives the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak, now the second-largest on record. As of Friday morning, the DRC Ministry of Communications reports 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths; WHO tallies 3,553 cases and 1,558 deaths. By July 29, 3,442 confirmed cases and 1,521 deaths, with 797 hospitalized or in isolation across five provinces. Ituri Province accounts for about 90% of cases (≈2,988 cases, 1,238 deaths across 28 of 36 health zones); transmission has reached North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo (46 health zones across five provinces). Over 100 healthcare workers infected. No approved vaccine or monoclonal therapy exists for BDBV; Ervebo is not cross-protective. Containment relies on contact tracing, yet coverage is 78.3%—below the 90–95% threshold. The outbreak began May 15, 2026; Bundibugyo was identified in Uganda (2007) and in DRC (Isiro, 2012). CFR among confirmed cases ~39–44%; true toll may be higher due to unrecorded community deaths. A diagnostic blind spot linked to Cephei complicates surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ、史上2番目の規模に:接触者追跡の不備が危機を助長
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目の規模のエボラ(BDBV)アウトブレイクが発生し、死者数1,500人超、致死率約40%、5州にまたがる拡大とワクチン未承認という重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは過去のBDBV発生歴の言及のみで、現在の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。接触者追跡率78.3%は目標(90-95%)未達であり、封じ込めの遅れが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: flambée sans précédent en RDC avec plus de 3.500 cas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: unprecedented outbreak in the DRC with more than 3,500 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), the 17th DRC Ebola outbreak, driven by the Bundibugyo variant with no vaccine or treatment yet. As of July 31, 2026, authorities report 3,532 confirmed cases across five eastern provinces and 1,556 deaths. Ituri province in the North-East, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, accounts for about 90% of cases; Nord- and South-Kivu also report cases amid territorial control by the M23 rebel group. Transmission is via contact with body fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever. The outbreak surpasses the 2018–2020 crisis (roughly 3,500 cases and ~2,300 deaths) and could last months. Vaccines under development include a Oxford University candidate (same tech as AstraZeneca) now in early trials, and a WHO-supported vaccine by Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore). Uganda reports end of its outbreak, but WHO notes ongoing risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で前例のない大流行、3,500例以上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大リスク）に加え、WPRO基準も全て該当。過去最大規模のエボラ流行でワクチン・治療法未確立、紛争地域での対応困難という点からフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダやスーダン、シンガポールも発生地域に含まれるが、記事の主題はDRCでの流行拡大であり、ウガンダは終息済み、スーダン・シンガポールは対象国リスト外またはワクチン開発拠点としての言及のみ。M23反乱軍による領域支配が対応を困難にしている点も重要な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Tubarão intensifica combate ao mosquito da dengue nos bairros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tubarão intensifies the fight against the dengue-carrying mosquito in the neighborhoods.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-31, Tubarão intensified dengue-control efforts against Aedes aegypti, the dengue vector, by reinforcing visits, inspections, and the application of insecticides in areas with the highest concentration of breeding sites. Health teams expanded prevention and monitoring activities to reduce the risk of mosquito proliferation and to protect residents from dengue transmission. The measures emphasize vector control, surveillance, and community protection, reflecting a proactive public health response to curb dengue in the city by interrupting breeding habitats in high-risk neighborhoods. These actions reflect ongoing preventive work to mitigate dengue risk in Tubarão through targeted vector-control operations. Local teams coordinate with residents to identify hotspots and ensure safe insecticide use.

triage.headline_ja: トゥバランが地域でのデング熱媒介蚊対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の日常的な予防・防除活動に関する記事であり、異常な流行や重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州トゥバラン市における日常的な蚊媒介対策活動を報じるもので、症例数や重症度、異常な発生状況についての言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta de sarampo: até imunizados devem se vacinar, diz governo de SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Alert: Even Those Who Are Immunized Must Get Vaccinated, Says the São Paulo State Government.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak prompts expanded vaccination in São Paulo state, Brazil. As of July 30, 2026, the Center for Epidemiological Surveillance (CVE) confirmed the state's 15th measles case in 2026. Mobilization begins August 3, 2026, in São Paulo city (capital), Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, offering the MMR (measles, mumps, rubella) vaccine to everyone aged 6 months to 59 years, including those already immunized. For children 6 to 11 months 29 days, the dose is considered 'dose zero' and does not replace the standard doses at 12 and 15 months. First-dose and second-dose coverage this year are 77.5% and 65.5%, respectively, short of the Ministry of Health’s 95% targets. The campaign aims to rapidly boost protection and reduce transmission by updating immunization records amid current measles activity.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹アラート：接種済みの人もワクチン接種が必要、サンパウロ州政府が発表
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹症例が15例確認され拡大予防接種が実施されているが、大規模な集団発生や重症例の報告はなく、ワクチンカバー率の低さが懸念材料である。
triage.notes: 麻疹ワクチン接種率が目標の95%を下回っており(1回目77.5%、2回目65.5%)、感染拡大のリスクがある。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため記録。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes: Anak Usia Sekolah Sumbang 41 Persen Kematian Akibat DBD, Pencegahan Harus Dimulai dari Rumah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health: School-age children account for 41 percent of deaths due to dengue fever; prevention must begin at home.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (DBD) in Jakarta, Indonesia, shows school-age children (5–14 years) account for 41% of dengue deaths, underscoring home as the first line of defense against Aedes aegypti. Ministry of Health data highlight risks from stagnant water in bathtubs, open water containers, and discarded items that collect rainwater as major mosquito breeding sites at home. Dr. Agus Handito of the Directorate of Communicable Diseases advocates a collaborative, evidence-based approach to reduce dengue mortality, targeting Indonesia Zero Dengue Deaths by 2030. Public figure Ririn Ekawati promotes 3M+ behaviors at home—weekly water container draining, tightly closing storage vessels, and reusing scrap items that can hold rainwater—plus mosquito repellent lotion. Enesis Group supports public engagement to normalize 3M+ beyond slogans, stressing the family’s crucial role in modeling preventive habits at home, schools, and in the community.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省:学齢期の子どもがデング熱による死亡の41%を占める、予防は家庭から始めるべき
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はインドネシアで流行性(エンデミック)の疾患であり、本記事は保健省による通常の予防啓発キャンペーンであって、異常な発生や国際的拡大等のシグナルは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はジャカルタにおけるデング熱の家庭内予防啓発キャンペーン(3M+運動)に関する内容であり、特定のアウトブレイクや急激な症例増加を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah patient's condition improves, shifted to ward
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus patient: 43-year-old man from Feroke, Kochi (Kerala). Condition improved; shifted to a ward from ICU on Friday after stabilization. Conscious and eating normally. Admitted to Kozhikode Govt Medical College Hospital on June 11 following acute encephalitis and severe respiratory distress, with exposure suspected from cleaning a bat-infested warehouse. Received experimental monoclonal antibody therapy plus supportive care. After two consecutive negative Nipah tests, he was moved from the isolation unit to a transit ICU on July 7. Health officials traced 77 contacts, with dozens closely monitored (family and healthcare workers); all contacts tested negative. The report details the treatment course and successful de-escalation of care amid ongoing Nipah vigilance in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルス感染患者の容態改善、病棟へ移動
triage.triage_reason: インドケララ州で発生した単発のニパウイルス感染例の続報。患者は回復し接触者77人全員が陰性で、現時点で地域拡大の兆候はないが、ニパウイルスは高致死率かつパンデミック potential を持つ病原体であり継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: ケララ州は過去にも複数回ニパウイルスのアウトブレイクを経験しており、地域として『異常』とは言えない。今回の症例は単発でコウモリ生息倉庫の清掃作業中の曝露が疑われ、接触者77人は全員陰性、ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はなし。患者は回復傾向にあり現時点でリスクは限定的だが、ニパウイルスの高致死率という特性上、続報の監視は継続すべき。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola epidemic becomes world's second largest outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has infected 3,532 people and killed 1,556 across five eastern provinces (Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo) as of 31 July 2026. It is the world's second largest Ebola outbreak on record, surpassing the 2018-2020 outbreak (~3,470 cases) and behind only the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic (28,616 cases, 11,310 deaths). The case fatality rate is 44.1% (1,556 deaths among 3,532 confirmed cases); 807 patients remain in isolation or hospital, and 626 have recovered. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. Ongoing security challenges in eastern DRC—attacks on health facilities and aid cuts—hamper response amid distrust and transmission from reliance on traditional healers. The WHO cautions the true scale could be up to four times higher; Africa CDC says containment may require about $1.4 billion.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、世界第2位の規模の流行に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率44.1%の大規模エボラ流行が5州に拡大し、承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、治安悪化により対応が困難であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による流行で承認されたワクチン・治療薬がなく、WHOは実際の規模が報告の4倍に上る可能性を指摘。Africa CDCは封じ込めに約14億ドルが必要と試算。治安悪化と伝統的治療者への依存が対応を阻害している。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta de sarampo: até imunizados devem se vacinar, diz governo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles alert: even those immunized should get vaccinated, government says.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo State government expands measles revaccination to all residents 6 months–59 years, starting August 3, 2026, with a new strategy amid the current measles epidemiological scenario. The Center for Epidemiological Surveillance (CVE) confirmed the state’s 15th measles case in 2026 on July 30. In the capital São Paulo, plus Guarulhos and São Bernardo do Campo, the measles–mumps–rubella (triple viral) vaccine will be offered to everyone 6 months–59 years, including those already immunized. For children 6 months to 11 months 29 days, this dose is considered a “dose zero” and does not replace the scheduled doses at 12 and 15 months. The campaign aims to bolster immunity across age groups to curb transmission.”} }{

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹警報：ワクチン接種済みの人も再接種を、と政府が発表
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹症例が2026年に15例確認され、政府が広範なワクチン再接種キャンペーンを開始したが、重症例や死亡、国際的拡大の情報はなく、現時点では局地的な公衆衛生対応にとどまる。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹の重症度や死亡例に関する情報を含んでおらず、感染拡大の規模も限定的（州内15例）。政府によるワクチン接種強化キャンペーンが実施されているため、今後の症例数推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية تمثّل ثاني أكبر تفشّ للوباء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo constitute the second-largest Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 July 2026, Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo constitute the world’s second-largest outbreak, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Confirmed cases reach 3,532 with 1,556 deaths and 626 recoveries; 807 patients remain in isolation or care. The case fatality rate is 44.1%, and contact tracing stands at 78.7%. The outbreak spans five eastern provinces—Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, O-Wil, and Tshopo—restricted to 48 health zones. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo. Health workers face insecurity and attacks on facilities amid funding shortfalls; the World Food Programme has warned of mounting resource needs. The WHO reports the current outbreak is among the most severe, with calls for about $1.4 billion. A WHO-supported mobile lab at the Uganda–DRC border (Kasindi) now delivers results in ~1 hour, addressing prior delays from Bunia. West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak remains the largest on record.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染は世界で2番目に大きい流行を構成
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例3,532件・死亡1,556件、致死率44.1%の大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、ワクチン・治療法が未承認でWHOが14億ドル規模の支援を要請している深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・アンゴラは国境付近の検査体制整備（モバイル検査室）や地理的近接性の文脈で言及されているのみで、実際の流行発生地ではないため除外した。Bundibugyoエボラウイルス種による流行で、世界史上2番目の規模とされる重大イベント。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les professionnels du sexe de Kisangani réclament une sensibilisation renforcée - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Kisangani sex workers call for intensified awareness campaigns.
article.articleSummary: As of July 31, 2026, sex workers in Kisangani, in Tshopo Province in northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, are calling for intensified Ebola prevention awareness. Marie Lengasa, a sex worker, reports lack of information on Ebola risks and urges campaigns in venues they frequent—hotels, bars—and the provision of handwashing stations, infrared thermometers (thermoflashes), and disinfectants. While PNMLS and other health officials sometimes address sexually transmitted infections, Ebola prevention is not sufficiently integrated into outreach to sex workers, heightening their risk due to information gaps. Authorities are urged to strengthen Ebola communication campaigns targeting all populations, especially sex workers, to improve knowledge of preventive measures and support the Ebola response in Tshopo Province.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：キサンガニの性労働者たちが啓発活動の強化を求める
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国チョポ州で進行中のエボラ対応に関連し、性労働者への情報不足がリスクを高めているとの報告。エボラは重篤な疾患で国際的拡大リスクもあり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は新規症例報告ではなく、性労働者への啓発不足に関する訴えだが、チョポ州で既にエボラ対応が進行中であることを示唆しており、既存のアウトブレイクとの関連性を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: छत्तीसगढ़ में मलेरिया से मौतों पर राज्य सरकार को नोटिस भेजा मानवाधिकार आयोग ने -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human Rights Commission sends notice to the state government over malaria-related deaths in Chhattisgarh.
article.articleSummary: Malaria deaths in Kanker district, Chhattisgarh, have reached five within 13 days, according to media reports cited by India’s National Human Rights Commission (NHRC), which on July 31, 2026, took suo motu cognizance and issued a notice to the state government seeking a detailed report within two weeks. The reports also mention an 11-year-old child who died on July 28; an initial malaria test by a private lab was negative, but the child deteriorated and, after transfer to Albelapara hospital, a blood test confirmed malaria too late for survival. If the facts are accurate, NHRC said this would constitute a serious human rights violation. Following the incident, the state health department launched door-to-door malaria screening and community awareness campaigns in the affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティースガル州のマラリア関連死をめぐり、人権委員会が州政府に通知
triage.triage_reason: 地域限定的なマラリア流行だが、複数の死亡例と国家人権委員会の介入により社会的・政治的関心が高く、WPRO基準（重症度・継続的曝露）にも該当するためフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: マラリアはインドの流行地域で地方の医療対応（戸別検診・啓発活動）が既に開始されており、国際的拡大の兆候はない。ただし国家人権委員会の関与により国内の政治的関心が高い点を考慮しPICKUPと判断。

locations.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

article.articleHeadline: CDC Refreshes Its Chikungunya and Dengue Travel Notices, and the Dengue Country List Has Changed
article.articleSummary: CDC updated its Dengue travel notice dated 2026-07-30, listing dengue risk year-round and destination list: Colombia, Samoa, Vietnam, New Caledonia, Maldives, Bolivia, Tonga, Cambodia, Kenya, Malaysia, and Sri Lanka. The January list included Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Colombia, Cook Islands, Cuba, Mali, Mauritania, Nicaragua, Samoa, Sudan, and Vietnam; only Colombia, Samoa, and Vietnam remain (Cuba removed). A Level 2 chikungunya notice covers northwest Costa Rica (Guanacaste) due to an ongoing outbreak, signaling enhanced precautions. Both are Aedes-borne and begin with fever; chikungunya often causes severe joint pain, while dengue can worsen after fever breaks with abdominal pain, bleeding gums or nose, and fatigue. No Level-4 or Level-3 destinations exist. Vaccines are limited: Ixchiq license suspended (2025); Vimkunya licensed for 12+, but no widely recommended dengue vaccine. Pregnant travelers, older adults, and those with comorbidities face higher risk. Emphasize bite avoidance. Check CDC destination page before departure.

triage.headline_ja: CDC、チクングニア熱とデング熱の渡航情報を更新、デング熱対象国リストに変更
triage.triage_reason: CDCによる渡航情報の定例更新であり、ベトナムなど対象国は継続的なデング熱リスク国として掲載されているのみで、新たな異常な流行や重症化の情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事はCDCの渡航情報定例更新に関するもので、ベトナムは1月・7月双方のデング熱リスク国リストに継続掲載されているが、具体的な流行拡大や症例急増の情報はない。コスタリカのチクングニア熱アウトブレイクは対象国リストに含まれないため評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Exames confirmam morte de menina de 12 anos por febre maculosa em Mimoso do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tests confirm the death of a 12-year-old girl due to Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever in Mimoso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever (RMSF) caused the death of 12-year-old Ana Julia da Silva Ramos in Mimoso do Sul. Diagnosis was confirmed by the Death Verification Service (SVO) after tests detected Rickettsia rickettsii. Health Surveillance of Mimoso do Sul has been tracking the case since July 27 and will launch epidemiological and entomological investigations in areas identified as possible transmission sites, with ongoing monitoring for additional suspected cases. The star tick, the primary vector, can be found throughout the municipality. Authorities advise avoiding rivers, pastures, and woods when possible, and to use protective measures in vegetation, around animals, or where tick contact is likely. Symptoms include fever, body aches, headache, and skin rashes. Anyone with these signs after exposure should seek immediate healthcare and report possible tick contact, as early diagnosis and treatment improves recovery chances.

triage.headline_ja: 検査により、ミモーゾ・ド・スル市で12歳少女がロッキー山紅斑熱で死亡したことが確認
triage.triage_reason: 単一の死亡例であり、ブラジルの既知の風土病（ダニ媒介性）であるが、当局が疫学・昆虫学調査を開始しており追加症例の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ロッキー山紅斑熱（RMSF）はブラジルの一部地域で毎年発生する既知の風土病であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はしない。地元保健当局が調査を開始しているため、追加症例の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Китай изгражда национална мрежа за наблюдение на над 15 респираторни патогена до 2030 г. -- Novinata.bg
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China is building a national surveillance network for more than 15 respiratory pathogens by 2030.
article.articleSummary: China aims to establish by 2030 a national surveillance network for more than 15 respiratory pathogens as part of a major public health strengthening strategy and preparedness for future epidemics. The plan expands immunization programs for key risk groups, including children and the elderly, enhances infectious disease surveillance, and implements a modern early-warning system to speed detection of emerging health threats. It prioritizes expanded monitoring of respiratory infections to track spread and enable rapid responses, and increases attention to vector-borne diseases such as dengue and malaria with expanded mosquito and other vector surveillance and control measures. The strategy also funds development of national and regional public health centers and scales up pilot programs to improve coordination between hospitals and preventive agencies. Overall goal: bolster resilience and rapid response capacity for future outbreaks in China.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、2030年までに15種類以上の呼吸器病原体を対象とした国家サーベイランス網を構築
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、中国政府の将来的な公衆衛生体制強化計画に関する政策発表であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な感染症の発生事例ではなく、中国の公衆衛生政策・将来計画に関する内容であるため、実際の疾病発生国としては特定されない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolaausbruch in DR Kongo: Der Markt regelt die Epidemie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo: The market regulates the epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the fastest-spreading on record, with 3,442 confirmed infections and 1,521 deaths as of Thursday. More than 1,000 new infections occurred in the past week; 40 days to surpass 1,000 cases, versus 235 days in 2018. The Bundibugyo virus drives the outbreak, for which there are no vaccines or treatments. Ongoing conflict in eastern provinces hampers response; insecure roads and distrust keep communities from receiving care. A large proportion of transmissions remain unlinked: WHO says about 80% of new infections have no known link to previous cases, possibly doubling to quadrupling the true toll. Hunger worsens transmission: WFP says 2.65 million people in the 48 health zones suffer acute food insecurity; 628,000 in emergency conditions. The agency needs $293.6 million for six months. Aid cuts, salary arrears, and fees impede care; some facilities avoid reporting suspected cases to avoid losses, Reuters reports.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク：市場が流行を規定する
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速のペースで拡大するエボラ流行で感染者3,442人、死者1,521人に達し、ワクチン・治療薬もなく紛争地域での対応困難という深刻な公衆衛生上の危機であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株によるアウトブレイクで、史上最速の感染拡大。ワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、紛争・食料不安・医療現場の報告忌避などが複合的にリスクを高めている。WHO・WFPが国際支援の必要性を明示。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : face à une épidémie qui progresse, le PAM alerte sur le risque d'une crise incontrôlable sans un renforcement urgent de l'aide alimentaire et logistique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: As the epidemic progresses, the WFP warns of the risk of an out-of-control crisis without urgent strengthening of food and logistical aid.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) accelerates as World Food Programme warns that without urgent strengthening of food and logistical support the epidemic could spin out of control. The outbreak now affects 48 health zones in five provinces—Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele—with Ituri accounting for about 90% of confirmed cases; cases in Kisangani and Haut-Uele raise fears of transmission along travel routes. The humanitarian context is dire: nearly 10 million people in the east face a food crisis, including 1.9 million in Ituri in IPC Phase 3 or worse. Across zones, 2.65 million live in IPC Phase 3+ and more than 628,000 in Phase 4. WFP has delivered 160,000 hot meals to patients and contacts in 17 centers, plus dry rations for 23,000 in Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu and Ituri. Urgent scale-up of food, logistics, telecommunications, and air transport is needed to support health response and protect communities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大、WFPが食糧・物流支援の緊急強化なしでは制御不能な危機に陥るリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC5州48保健地区に拡大し、渡航ルート沿いの伝播懸念や人道危機の深刻化が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 48保健地区、5州（Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele）に拡大しており、Ituriが症例の約90%を占める。KisanganiやHaut-Ueleへの拡大は交通路沿いの伝播リスクを示唆。食糧危機（IPC Phase 3以上2.65百万人）が対応をさらに困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Folha da Região: Araçatuba reforça vacinação após caso de sarampo em SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Folha da Região: Araçatuba reinforces vaccination after a measles case in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases continue to rise in São Paulo State, Brazil, with 15 confirmed cases in 2026 as of July 31. A new case is a 1–2-year-old girl from Guarulhos who had not been vaccinated. São Paulo city accounts for 12 cases, São Bernardo do Campo two cases, and Guarulhos one case. Araçatuba’s Municipal Health Secretariat reinforced vaccination efforts, noting the city has had no measles cases since 2020, but vaccination coverage remains below the Ministry of Health’s recommended level, heightening the risk of viral reintroduction. The Centro de Vigilância Epidemiológica (CVE) issued a health-education alert urging services to intensify surveillance and preventive actions. The report underscores ongoing transmission risk due to immunization gaps across the state.

triage.headline_ja: フォーリャ・ダ・レジオン：サンパウロ州での麻疹症例発生を受けアラサトゥーバがワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹症例が継続的に発生（15例）しているが、重篤例や国際的拡大の情報はなく、ワクチンカバー率低下による地域内伝播リスクの観点から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ブラジル・サンパウロ州内での麻疹症例増加とワクチン接種率低下が主題。地方自治体による予防的対応が中心で、国際的な懸念や渡航制限には至っていない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak becomes world's second-largest ever
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) has reached 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths across five provinces, making it the world’s second-largest Ebola outbreak and the fastest-spreading so far. The epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, near South Sudan and Uganda, with spread to four other provinces including North Kivu and South Kivu, where areas are controlled by the Rwanda-backed M23 rebel group amid eastern instability. Confirmed infections rose from about 2,000 on July 15 to over 3,500 within weeks, with mortality unusually high—five times more deaths in the first three months than in prior outbreaks. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo, though experimental vaccines are in development: a candidate from Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore) and an Oxford University Bundibugyo vaccine are in trials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、史上2番目の規模に拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での大規模エボラ流行（史上2番目の規模、致死率異常に高い）であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 感染はイトゥリ州を震源に北キブ・南キブ州など5州に拡大。南キブ・北キブはM23反政府勢力の実効支配地域であり治安不安が対応を困難にしている。承認済みワクチン・治療薬はなく、複数の実験的ワクチンが治験段階。南スーダン・ウガンダ・ルワンダ・シンガポール・英国は対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: MS confirma primeira morte por dengue em 2026, vítima era moradora de Bonito
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Ministry confirms first dengue death in 2026, the victim was a resident of Bonito.
article.articleSummary: Mato Grosso do Sul confirmed the first dengue death of 2026, a Bonito resident, per the SES Epidemiological Bulletin released on July 30, 2026. The bulletin also notes two additional dengue deaths under investigation and highlights a persistent arbovirus alert as the state reports 9,729 laboratory-confirmed chikungunya cases this year (12,735 probable) and 28 chikungunya deaths across Bonito, Douradina, Dourados, Fátima do Sul, Guia Lopes da Laguna, Itaporã, Jardim, Nioaque, and Ponta Porã (one under investigation). In the past 14 days, dengue incidence was low in Santa Rita do Pardo, Nioaque, Paranhos, Sidrolândia, Itaquiraí, Três Lagoas and Chapadão do Sul. There are 114 chikungunya-confirmed pregnancies. Dengue vaccine: 241,030 doses received; 223,322 administered, with 201,349 to the target group. The two-dose schedule is three months apart, for ages 10–14. Guidance urges care for symptoms, avoid self-medication, and remove standing water to curb Aedes aegypti.

triage.headline_ja: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州、2026年最初のデング熱による死亡を確認（被害者はボニート在住）
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱はブラジルで季節性・地方流行性の感染症であり、今回の報告は定例の疫学速報の範囲内であるため、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、死亡例や高い感染者数から継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 州保健局（SES）の定例疫学速報に基づく報告で、デング熱・チクングニア熱は同地域で毎年発生する媒介蚊感染症。ワクチン接種プログラムなど地域での対応体制が既に存在し、外部支援の必要性は低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : la synergie des acteurs, une réponse essentielle face à l'épidémie d'Ebola (incident manager de la riposte) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: the synergy of stakeholders, an essential response to the Ebola outbreak (incident manager of the response) - ACP
article.articleSummary: On July 31, 2026, in Bunia, Ituri province, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola virus disease response, led by new incident manager Dr. Steve Ahuka, prioritized strengthened synergy among all actors to accelerate interruption of the transmission chain. Weekly coordination meetings bring together operational teams, technical and financial partners, and authorities to review the evolving epidemiological situation, activities, challenges, and priority actions. Ahuka emphasized that outbreak management requires daily innovation and true unity of action, as no single actor can manage the outbreak alone. The coordination framework provides the government with essential information to guide strategic decisions, bolster field interventions, and contain the outbreak in Ituri. Keywords: Ebola, Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, outbreak response, coordination, incident management.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ:関係者の連携がエボラ流行への対応に不可欠(対応インシデントマネージャー) - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱流行に関する公式対応記事であり、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・国際拡大リスク）に複数該当するためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行の新規発生ではなく既存アウトブレイクへの対応体制強化に関するもの。具体的な症例数・死亡者数の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : la société civile " Forces vives " prône l'intensification de la sensibilisation contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: civil society "Forces vives" calls for intensified Ebola awareness campaigns - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompts civil society Forces vives to call for intensified awareness campaigns. On July 31, 2026, Franck Linato, provincial first vice-president, urged residents to strengthen hygiene and consistently apply barrier measures to curb transmission. He stressed that while Ebola is present, basic cleanliness should be a daily habit, and that preventive measures should not be viewed as harming the population. The appeal asks communities to avoid handshakes, not touch a suspected corpse or its belongings, and to ensure proper food coverage. The report notes the outbreak exists but provides no laboratory-confirmed case or death totals. The emphasis remains on prevention and behavioral change during this period.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:市民社会団体「フォース・ヴィヴ」がエボラ対策の啓発活動強化を訴える - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR通報対象疾患であり、コンゴ民主共和国チョポ州キサンガニでの発生継続が示唆されているため、確定症例数が不明でもフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事は確定症例数・死亡者数を示していないが、エボラという疾患特性上、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに高リスクと判断。続報でラボ確認症例や死亡数の情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Haut-Uele : un appui matériel de l'OIM attendu à Isiro pour la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uele: IOM's material support expected in Isiro for the outbreak response - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Haut-Uele, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with Isiro as the focal point of response. The International Organization for Migration is set to supply material for the border hygiene program to strengthen the outbreak response at Isiro's entry points. Since the Ebola declaration in Haut-Uele (and adjacent Tshopo Province), surveillance and prevention efforts continue, with the program collaborating with provincial authorities, communities, and partners to cut transmission chains. Equipment is en route and will equip border control points. The border hygiene team is deploying to checkpoints, entry/exit points, and other hotspots in Isiro. They work in close collaboration with security services — including DGM, ANR, PNC, and the air force at Matari airport — to support the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: オー・ウエレ州でのエボラ出血熱：対応強化のためIOMの物資支援がイシロに到着予定 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国オー・ウエレ州でエボラ出血熱の発生が継続中であり、IHR基準に複数該当（重篤な疾患、国際的懸念、国境対策実施）するためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にパキスタン（Sindh州、Matiari等）が含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRCのオー・ウエレ州及びツショピ州でのエボラ対応のみを扱っており、パキスタンは主題に含まれないため除外した。エボラはIHR Annex2で常時通知対象疾患であり、国境衛生プログラムの実施は国際的拡大防止措置として重要視される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mongbwalu : la baisse des cas ravive l'espoir d'un recul de l'épidémie (Parlement des jeunes) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mongbwalu: the decline in cases rekindles hope that the epidemic is retreating (Youth Parliament) - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 31 July 2026, Ebola virus disease cases are declining in Mongbwalu, the outbreak’s epicenter in Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The downward trend is affirmed by the hospital’s medical director and attributed to rising community awareness and joint outreach by local authorities, religious leaders, and neighborhood chiefs. However, deaths persist in communities due to delays in seeking care, with patients kept at home before presenting to health facilities. Gloire Abasi, president of Ituri’s Youth Parliament, urges intensified youth involvement to relay prevention messages, avoid hostility toward medical teams, and encourage rapid referral of suspected cases to care centers. He remains hopeful that the trend will lead to a future without new cases, while prevention measures must not be relaxed.

triage.headline_ja: モングワルのエボラ:症例の減少が流行後退への希望を再燃させる(青年議会) - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は既知のIHR通報対象疾患であり、コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で継続中のアウトブレイクのため、症例減少傾向でも継続監視としてフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 症例数は減少傾向にあるが、医療施設への受診遅延による死亡が継続しており、エボラという疾患特性上、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: 寄生虫潜伏期可达几十年！夏天爱吃生腌海鲜的要注意了
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The incubation period for parasites can last for decades! Those who love raw-marinated seafood in the summer should take note.
article.articleSummary: Raw-marinated seafood remains popular this summer but carries significant health risks. Pathogens including bacteria (Vibrio parahaemolyticus, Vibrio vulnificus) and viruses (norovirus, hepatitis B virus) can survive marination or refrigeration, since alcohol concentrations commonly used (50–75%) may not inactivate all pathogens. Parasitic infections can incubate for decades: liver fluke infections may persist 15–25 years and be asymptomatic. In seawater fish such as pomfret, cod, squid, beltfish, and yellow croaker, anisakid parasites (Anisakis spp.) can trigger symptoms within hours to about a week, ranging from mild GI upset to severe abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, ulcers, or perforation. Thiaminase in shellfish and freshwater fish can deplete vitamin B1, causing beri-beri with neurological and cardiovascular symptoms. To reduce risk, purchase from reputable sources and ensure seafood is thoroughly cooked. As of July 31, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 寄生虫の潜伏期は数十年にも及ぶ可能性!夏に生腌海鮮を好んで食べる人は注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや症例報告ではなく、生腌海鮮の一般的な健康リスクに関する啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の発生事例や症例クラスターの報告ではなく、食品安全に関する一般的な注意喚起記事であるため、地域特定のイベントとしての意味を持たない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak tops 3 500 cases
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has reached 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths across five eastern provinces, surpassing the country’s deadliest outbreak (2018–2020). The center of transmission is Ituri province, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, with detections in North Kivu and South Kivu amid ongoing conflict that hampers surveillance. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids and causes haemorrhagic fever; there is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo. Vaccination efforts are underway: Singapore-based Hilleman Laboratories is developing a vaccine, and Oxford University is testing another in a clinical trial. By mid-July, around 2,000 cases had been confirmed. Cross-border risk prompts neighbouring states to stay vigilant; Uganda has declared Ebola-free but remains at risk, while WHO warns of continued spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、症例数3,500件を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模（3,532症例、1,556死亡）のエボラ出血熱流行が発生し、ワクチン・治療法未承認かつ紛争地域での対応困難、国境を越えた拡大リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による第17次流行で、既知の対策（承認済みワクチン等）が効かない点、紛争による監視体制の脆弱性、国境地帯（南スーダン・ウガンダ）への波及リスクが懸念材料。ウガンダは既にエボラフリーを宣言しているがリスクは継続と記載されているため、確定症例国としてはDRCのみをverified_locationsとした。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola em curso no Congo já é o que cresce mais rápido na história
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is already the fastest-growing in history.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak, now the fastest-growing on record, reports 3,360 confirmed cases and 1,487 deaths as of July 31, 2026, with a 45% case fatality. The Bundibugyo variant has spread across five eastern provinces, with Bunia and Rwampara health zones reporting 100–150 new infections weekly. Officials warn the trajectory may exceed the 2018–2020 outbreak, which infected 3,470 people. Ongoing challenges include insecurity from armed conflict, mining activity, and high population density, complicating control and delaying peak. Public health response includes strengthened surveillance with community agents, more than 20 treatment centers, locally installed testing laboratories, and clinical trials for a Bundibugyo-targeted vaccine. Cross-border collaboration with Uganda, deploying specialists to Tchomia and Kasenyi, aims to reinforce border regions. Communities express fear; authorities urge anyone with infection signs to seek care promptly to accelerate response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで進行中のエボラ流行、史上最速の拡大ペースに
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行が史上最速の拡大ペースで、致死率45%、国境を越えた拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境対応）も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部5州における流行拡大を主題としており、ウガンダ・ルワンダは越境対応の文脈で言及されているのみで対象国リストに含まれないため除外。致死率45%、週100-150人の新規感染など重症度・拡大リスクが高く、2018-2020年流行を超える可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Azzaman daily newspaperجريدة الزمان - عربية يومية دولية مستقلة | Azzaman International daily newspaperابتكار لقاح ناجح ضد إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Invention of a Successful Vaccine Against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, has caused about 1,500 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with no vaccines or therapies available for this lineage. Several groups are racing to develop a vaccine against this rare strain to curb its spread. World Health Organization experts say a single-dose vaccine based on the rVSV platform is the most likely to succeed, as it uses the same platform as Ervebo, the only Ebola vaccine with regulatory approval. Hilleman Laboratories, headquartered in Singapore, announced it will accelerate the development of an rVSV-based Bundibugyo vaccine in preparation for human clinical trials. The effort aims to address the ongoing outbreak by enabling rapid immunization and containment in affected areas of the DRC, leveraging the established rVSV approach for potential deployment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに対する有効なワクチンの開発
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)による約1500人の死者が報告されており、ワクチン・治療法が存在しない稀少株であることから公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態と判断される。
triage.notes: Singapore拠点のHilleman Laboratoriesはワクチン開発企業として言及されているのみで、発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。DRCにおけるエボラ・ブンディブギョ株の流行状況（症例数、地理的拡大、WHO対応状況等）についてフルリスク評価での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch in DR Kongo begann bereits im Jänner
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo began as early as January.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo began in January or earlier, near Mongbwalu in Ituri province. A Science-published study identified more than 500 suspected cases from mid-January through May 15, when the outbreak was officially declared. Transmission is traced to a 50-year-old woman who died on January 25, initiating the transmission chain. Researchers interviewed clinicians, survivors, and funeral workers, and analyzed photographs and notes. The outbreak has become the second-largest on record, with 3,532 reported cases in the DRC, surpassed only by the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. The causative pathogen is the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus, for which there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は1月にはすでに始まっていた
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は史上2番目の規模（3,532例）に達しており、承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく公衆衛生上深刻な影響がある。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRCのイトゥリ州（Mongbwalu周辺）での流行のみを扱っており、Angolaへの拡大は言及されていないため除外した。Science誌の研究により流行開始が1月に遡ることが判明し、史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行であることが強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: 'All Hands on Deck': UN Urges Expanded Response as DRC Ebola Outbreak Spreads at Record Pace | Common Dreams
article.articleSummary: DRC's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, centered in Ituri Province, has surpassed 3,400 infections and 1,556 deaths since May, a 44% fatality rate, making it the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic on record. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no approved vaccine or treatment. In the last 24 hours, 50 deaths were reported, with cases doubling roughly every 20 days. UN officials urge a massive expansion of humanitarian response—supplies, PPE, staff, and logistics—with communities at the center. About 10 million people face acute food insecurity in eastern DRC, 3 million in IPC-designated emergency. More than 60% of recent deaths occurred in communities outside treatment centers, increasing transmission risk through unsafe caregiving and burial practices. Health workers have faced attacks by armed groups. Uganda reports the Bundibugyo outbreak there ended after 20 infections and 3 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 「総力を挙げて」―UNがDRCのエボラ流行拡大に対応拡大を要請、記録的なペースで感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるブンディブギョ株エボラが記録的な速度で拡大し、致死率44%、ワクチン・治療法未承認という深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダでのアウトブレイクは終息済みと記載されているため対象国リストには含まれるが、記事の主眼はDRCの継続的な流行拡大にある。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde reforça os cuidados para evitar a proliferação do mosquito da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health reinforces precautions to prevent the spread of the dengue mosquito.
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases rise in Lucas do Rio Verde, Brazil, with confirmed cases increasing from 153 to 173 and suspected cases from 3 to 149 in the last 30 days. Aedes aegypti, which also transmits Zika and Chikungunya, remains active during the dry season as water accumulates in drains, potted plants and other containers. The mosquito’s life cycle from egg to adult takes seven to ten days. Health Surveillance urges ongoing environmental control and resident vigilance to eliminate water-holding items. A key measure is 300 ovitrampas installed citywide; the latest count found mosquito eggs in 62% of the traps. Each ovitrampa is a small container with brewer’s yeast attractant, deployed at homes and collected after five days, enabling incidence assessment and targeted actions. Residents can report breeding sites via Vigilância em Saúde (65) 3548-2508, Ouvidoria 0800 646 4004, Ouvidoria da Saúde (65) 3549-7128, or the city chatbot (65) 3549-8300.

triage.headline_ja: 健康局、デング熱媒介蚊の増殖防止対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで恒常的に発生しているデング熱の季節的な症例増加であり、地域保健当局による通常の予防対策の呼びかけに留まる。異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年流行する風土病であり、本記事は自治体レベルの蚊媒介対策強化に関する定例的な内容。重症例や死亡についての言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en RD Congo: la segunda epidemia más grave de la historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: the second most serious epidemic in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo (Ituri initially, bordering Uganda and South Sudan) reached 3,532 confirmed infections and 1,556 deaths in about two and a half months, making it the second-largest and fastest-spreading outbreak on record in the country. The strain is Bundibugyo, with a 30-50% fatality range; currently no vaccine or specific treatment. The case fatality rate on the ground is 44.1%. 807 patients are under isolation or hospital care; contact tracing is 78.7% effective; 626 recoveries. The outbreak spread to five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Uganda reported 20 cases and 2 deaths but was declared Ebola-free after 42 days without new cases. WHO classifies regional risk as high in Sub-Saharan Africa and low internationally; transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：史上2番目に深刻な流行
triage.triage_reason: DRCで3,532例・1,556死亡と大規模な流行が5州に拡大し、致死率44.1%と高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ウガンダは20症例・2死亡後42日間新規なしでエボラ終息宣言済みのため、対象国リストにも含まれずverified_locationsから除外。WHOは国際的リスクを低いと評価しているが、感染規模・致死率の高さからPICKUPと判断。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo tem o segundo maior surto de Ebola na história
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo has the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history.
article.articleSummary: As of July 31, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths, making it the second-largest in history. The eastern DRC outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. In under three months since onset, fatalities have risen fivefold compared with previous surges in the same period, per the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention. Only the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) had more cases (about 28,616) and deaths (11,310). Frontline health teams face armed-group violence, attacks on facilities, scarce resources, and reduced international aid. The WHO warns the true scale could be up to four times higher than official counts, while communities increasingly seek traditional healers, sustaining transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目規模のエボラ流行（3,532症例、1,556死亡）、承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、武装勢力による医療活動妨害と国際支援の縮小により対応が困難化しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 見出し・サマリーで言及されているリベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の過去の流行との比較対象であり、現在の発生国ではないため除外。WHOは実際の症例数が公式発表の最大4倍に上る可能性を指摘しており、状況把握が困難な点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: SP: alta de casos de sarampo aumenta preocupação dos serviços de saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SP: Rise in Measles Cases Raises Concerns Among Health Services.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases rise in São Paulo state, Brazil, with 15 confirmed infections this year. In response, health authorities urge catch-up vaccination and a booster for previously vaccinated children. Metropolitan-area cities São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo are under heightened surveillance as the Ministry of Health extends immunization to people aged 6–59 years during a multivaccination campaign running August 3 to September 1. The campaign covers all 645 municipalities, with vaccines including the MMR (measles, mumps, rubella) and updates to other routine vaccines (BCG, hepatitis B, pentavalent, polio, rotavirus, pneumococcal, meningococcal, influenza, COVID-19, yellow fever, varicella, DTP, hepatitis A, HPV). Preliminary 2026 data show MMR first-dose coverage at 77.5% and second-dose at 65.5%, below the 95% target. In 2025, national D1/D2 coverage were 92.9% and 78.3%, with Guarulhos 91.59/83.90; São Bernardo do Campo 90.84/83.62; São Paulo 90.79/83.63.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州：麻疹症例の増加が保健サービスの懸念を高める
triage.triage_reason: 症例数（15件）は限定的で国際的拡大の証拠はないが、ワクチン接種率が目標を下回っており流行の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 対象国リストにBrazilが含まれているため検証地域として記載。ワクチン接種率の低さ（MMR1回目77.5%、2回目65.5%）が今後の流行拡大リスクを示唆しており、続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Segunda maior epidemia de ebola aumenta para mais de 3.500 casos e 1.556 mortes na RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second-largest Ebola outbreak rises to more than 3,500 cases and 1,556 deaths in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola cases rise to 3,532 with 1,556 deaths as of 31 July 2026, centered in Ituri (nearly 90% of infections). Declared on 15 May, this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, which currently has no licensed vaccine or treatment. The 2018–2020 outbreak remains the deadliest on record (over 2,300 deaths from ~3,500 cases). Vaccines under development include a candidate from Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore) deemed promising by the WHO, and an Oxford University vaccine entering early dosing. In Uganda, the outbreak ended on 28 July 2026 after 20 cases and 2 deaths reported through 17 July; the last case occurred 21 June, with the final patient discharged on 16 July.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大、症例数3,500人超・死者1,556人に(コンゴ史上2番目の規模)
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク(致死率約44%、3,500例超)が継続中で、ワクチン・治療薬未承認かつヒト-ヒト感染のリスクが高く、国際的関心・支援の必要性も高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は2026年7月28日に終息宣言済み(対象国リストに非該当)。シンガポールはワクチン開発拠点として言及されているのみで、発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: SP registra 15º caso de sarampo e recomenda vacina até para quem já foi imunizado em 3 cidades
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records the 15th measles case and recommends vaccination even for those who have already been immunized in three cities.
article.articleSummary: Measles in São Paulo state reaches 15 confirmed cases in 2026, including a 1-year-old girl from Guarulhos—the first there since 2020—plus 12 in São Paulo city and two in São Bernardo do Campo. The child had no vaccination history. Health authorities urge vaccination for everyone aged 6 months to 59 years in Guarulhos, São Bernardo do Campo, and São Paulo, regardless of prior immunization. A statewide Multivacination Campaign to update vaccination records for children and adolescents under 15 begins August 3. On July 28, the Ministry of Health expanded the measles vaccine recommendation to these cities after transmission linked to importation of the virus; infection source remains unknown. The vaccine is free via SUS and part of the National Vaccination Schedule (D1 and D2). During circulation, dose zero is advised for 6–11 months. In 2026, Brazil distributed over 7.2 million doses of the triple viral vaccine, with about 2.9 million administered.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹15例目を記録、3都市で既接種者にもワクチン接種を推奨
triage.triage_reason: 輸入株によるヒト-ヒト感染が疑われ、複数都市での症例確認と大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーンが開始されており、公衆衛生上の関心が高い。
triage.notes: 感染源不明の輸入株による伝播が3都市（サンパウロ市、グアルーリョス、サンベルナルド・ド・カンポ）で確認され、保健省が6か月〜59歳の全住民にワクチン接種を推奨。全国規模のワクチン更新キャンペーンも8月3日開始予定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, il focolaio che corre più veloce della risposta: perché il secondo focolaio più grande al mondo sta inquietando il pianeta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the outbreak outpacing the response: why the world's second-largest outbreak is unsettling the planet.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, is the second-largest on record, with 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths (case fatality 44.1%). The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain currently has no approved vaccines or therapies; control relies on rapid diagnosis, isolation, intensive care, contact tracing, and infection prevention. The epicenter remains Ituri, but cases have reached North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Diagnostic capacity expanded from ~30 tests per day to over 2,000 with ten decentralized laboratories, though tracing thousands of contacts over 21 days in a highly mobile, border-crossing region remains challenging. By mid-July, 119 health workers were infected and 36 died. The crisis also affects families and food security: ~2.95 million children in risk areas and over 130 orphans in Ituri. Trials in Bunia of MBP134 and remdesivir are underway; WHO has added a Bundibugyo-specific rapid test to emergency use. Not airborne; regional risk remains high.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、対応を上回るスピードで拡大する感染爆発：世界第2位の規模の流行が世界を不安にさせる理由
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部イトゥリ州で発生したエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）は史上2番目の規模（確認症例3,532例、死亡1,556例、致死率44.1%）で、複数州へ拡大し医療従事者にも多数の感染・死亡が出ており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域はイトゥリを中心にノースキブ、サウスキブ、ハウトウエレ、チョポ州へ拡大しているが、いずれもDRC国内のため verified_locations はDRCのみとした。承認されたワクチン・治療薬がない株であり、致死率が高く、越境移動の多い地域での接触者追跡が困難な点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-uitbraak in Congo groeit uit tot op één na grootste ooit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo grows to the second largest on record.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing an Ebola outbreak that ranks as the second-largest ever recorded globally. Since mid-May, 3,532 infections and 1,556 confirmed deaths (case fatality rate 44.1%) have been reported; 626 people have recovered and 807 remain in isolation. The outbreak spans five provinces—Tshopo, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Ituri—with Ituri the epicenter as the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant gains ground. There are no approved treatments or vaccines for Bundibugyo virus. CEPI, in collaboration with Hilleman Laboratories in Singapore, is accelerating development of a candidate vaccine using the recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus (rVSV) platform, previously used against Zaire (Zaïre) variant. CEPI has committed up to $8.5 million (roughly €7.4 million) to fund clinical materials production and vaccine development. Only the 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola outbreak has been larger.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、史上2番目の規模に拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目に大規模なエボラ流行が発生しており、致死率44.1%、複数州に拡大、承認済み治療薬・ワクチンが存在しないため国際的関心・支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス変異株による流行で、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない。CEPIがrVSVプラットフォームを用いたワクチン開発を加速中。シンガポール(Hilleman Laboratories)は開発協力拠点であり発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases surge in Cebu
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases surge in Cebu as of Jan 1–Jul 18: Cebu City reports 1,228 dengue cases and 10 deaths, CFR 0.81%. The rise prompts intensified monitoring by Cebu City and Cebu Provincial health offices during the rainy season. The figure is a 12.35% increase from 1,093 cases in the same period in 2025. Dengue fatalities rose from 3 to 10 year-to-date. Patients span ages 2 months to 96 years, with a median of 12. In children 1–10 years old, 498 cases (40.55%) were recorded. Males account for 661 cases (53.83%). Data derive from the Cebu City Epidemiology Surveillance and Statistics Unit (CESSU) of the City Health Department. The report highlights ongoing dengue activity in Cebu City during the current surveillance period.

triage.headline_ja: セブ島でデング熱の症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は毎年季節的に流行する既知の風土病であり、症例数増加と死亡者数上昇が見られるが、フィリピン国内の地域的流行の範囲内であり国際的拡大の懸念は現時点で低い。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 死亡者数が前年同期比で増加（3→10人）しており、CFR0.81%は許容範囲内だが小児患者の割合が高い点は注視が必要。現地保健当局による監視強化が既に行われている。
