article.articleHeadline: Επιδημία Έμπολα στο Κονγκό και ο κίνδυνος διασποράς
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in Congo and the risk of spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 3,532 confirmed cases and more than 1,500 deaths, the second-largest global outbreak after the West Africa crisis of 2014–2016. The epicenter is Ituri province near the borders with South Sudan and Uganda, with spread to four additional provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu, where armed groups such as M23 hinder access for health teams. Case detection, contact tracing, and patient isolation are likely undercounted in conflict zones, fueling rapid transmission. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or therapy; vaccines exist for other Ebola strains, and experimental vaccines are in early clinical trials in Singapore and Oxford. The crisis strains health systems and economies, disrupts supply chains, and poses cross-border risks; Greece stresses preparedness and regional surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ流行とその拡大リスク
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で3,500例超・死亡1,500人超と過去2番目に大きいエボラ流行が継続し、ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株が原因で、紛争地帯での対応困難と国境地域への拡大リスクがあるため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 南スーダン・ウガンダとの国境地帯への波及リスクが指摘されているが、これら自体は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。イギリス・シンガポールは実験的ワクチンの臨床試験地であり発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Contaminated water remains a challenge in Haryana villages - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: As of 1 August 2026, Haryana faces widespread drinking-water contamination. About 1,698 of roughly 19,000 samples tested in 2026-27 were contaminated, with total coliform detected in 855 villages. Chemical contaminants include total hardness (87 samples), total dissolved solids (78), fluoride (58), sulfate (26), chloride (23), total alkalinity (11), turbidity (4), iron (3) and nitrate (2). In Kaithal’s Sajuma village, several residents developed hepatitis-A and typhoid, with a suspected death of a minor girl; Faridabad and Kaithal have seen related incidents, and Chanot village in Hisar protested the Bhakra water supply’s quality. Groundwater, often used when canal water is insufficient, shows excessive fluoride. Protests link Bhakra water diversions to Yamuna command areas with tail-end shortages in Adampur block, Hisar. Sirsa district recorded 295 bacteriological failures (183 in Sirsa town). PHED states clean potable water has been restored in Kaithal, with the contaminated tubewell source closed.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州の村落で汚染水問題が依然として課題 - The Tribune
triage.triage_reason: WPRO基準（重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、住民の抗議活動など社会的関心も高いため、フルRRAでの評価が望ましい。
triage.notes: ハリヤナ州（サジュマ村、ファリダバード、カイタル、ヒサール等）における汚染水供給によるA型肝炎・腸チフスの発生。未成年女児の死亡疑い1例。PHEDが対応し一部地域では清浄な水の供給を回復済みだが、地域全体で継続的な水質問題（大腸菌群、フッ化物等）が指摘されている。国際的拡大の懸念は低く、地域的な公衆衛生インフラ問題として続報を注視すべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: Zahl der Ebola-Fälle in der Demokratischen Republik Kongo steigt auf mehr als 3500
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Number of Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to more than 3,500.
article.articleSummary: Laboratory-confirmed Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo since mid-May has reached 3,532 infections and 1,556 deaths, according to figures published on 31 July 2026. The number of confirmed cases rose from 3,075 at the end of the previous week. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC and affects five provinces in the war-torn eastern region. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola virus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Ebola is transmitted by direct contact with the bodily fluids of infected persons and can cause severe hemorrhagic fever. Over the past 50 years, Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa. The ongoing escalation surpasses the 2018-2020 outbreak, which had about 3,500 infections and nearly 2,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱感染者数が3,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株による大規模エボラ流行で、感染者3,532人・死者1,556人、紛争地域5州に拡大しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 第17回目のDRCエボラ流行で、2018-2020年の大規模流行（約3,500人感染、約2,300人死亡）を上回る規模。ワクチン・特効薬がないブンディブギョ株が原因で、紛争地域での対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola au Congo devient la deuxième plus importante jamais enregistrée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo becomes the second largest on record.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is now the world’s second-largest on record. Since mid-May, 3,532 infections identified across five provinces, with Ituri the main hotspot, followed by Tshopo, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu and Haut-Uele. Case fatality rate is 44.1%, with 1,556 confirmed deaths, 626 recoveries, and 807 patients still in medical isolation. There are no licensed treatments or vaccines for the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, which continues to spread. CEPI has pledged up to $8.5 million to accelerate development of an experimental vaccine, in collaboration with Hilleman Laboratories in Singapore, using the recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus (rVSV) platform proven against the Zaire variant, aiming to advance into clinical trials. This outbreak, the second-largest globally after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, underscores a severe humanitarian emergency with high mortality and limited interventions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、史上2番目の規模に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目規模のエボラ流行（3,532例、致死率44.1%）が5州に拡大、承認済み治療薬・ワクチンが存在せず、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生危機。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による流行で承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、CEPIがrVSVプラットフォームを用いた実験的ワクチン開発に資金提供。シンガポールは開発拠点であり発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Kills 1,556 in DRC as Response System Tracks Only One in Five New Cases
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), reached 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths (case fatality 44.1%) by July 31, 2026, the second-largest on record. The response is structurally unable to contain transmission: about 80% of new cases arise from unknown transmission chains, and follow-up on known contacts is 78.3%—far below the WHO target of 90–95%. Four in five new cases come from outside identified contact lists. No approved vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo; Ervebo offers insufficient cross-protection, so care remains supportive. The outbreak is the fastest-spreading Ebola event yet; the first 1,000 cases appeared in 40 days, and 856 new infections occurred in the week of July 18–25, with pace surpassing 2018–2020 DRC but still smaller than 2014–2016 West Africa. Mercy Corps reports outreach difficulties in Bunia amid staffing shortages.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱により1,556人死亡、対応システムは新規症例の5分の1しか追跡できず
triage.triage_reason: 致死率44.1%・史上最速の感染拡大を示すエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで、接触者追跡が崩壊しており国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRC国内（Bunia含む）のみに言及しており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、接触者の80%が未知の感染経路から発生しているため制御困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo se convierte en el segundo más mortífero de la historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo Becomes the Second Deadliest in History.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, reaches 3,442 confirmed cases and 1,521 deaths in under three months since May, making it the second deadliest and fastest-spreading outbreak. Health systems in eastern DRC are strained, with 80% of hospital capacity used, and more than 60% of fatalities have occurred in communities without access to medical facilities. Displacement from armed conflict hinders surveillance, with over 80% of new epicenter infections not linked to known contacts and only about 13% of exposed individuals being tracked. Uganda ended its alert after a smaller outbreak with 20 cases and 3 deaths. With no licensed vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo, emergency trials are underway: over 40 hospitalized patients in therapeutic combinations, a ten-day antiviral post-exposure prophylaxis, Oxford vaccine candidate in human testing, and CEPI funding for a second dose by Hilleman Laboratories to accelerate delivery.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が史上2番目の致死的流行に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（3,442症例、1,521死亡）で、医療体制逼迫・感染追跡困難・ワクチン未承認等、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダは小規模流行（20症例、3死亡）でアラート解除済みのため、主題であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。ウガンダは対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: MS confirma 9,7 mil casos de chikungunya e 28 mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health confirms 9,700 chikungunya cases and 28 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of week 29 (through July 30, 2026), Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reports 9,729 chikungunya cases and 28 deaths, with 12,735 probable chikungunya cases and one death under investigation. Confirmed chikungunya fatalities occurred in Bonito, Douradina, Dourados, Fátima do Sul, Guia Lopes da Laguna, Itaporã, Jardim, Nioaque and Ponta Porã; 114 pregnant women have chikungunya diagnosed this year. Dengue totals show 4,760 probable cases and 1,828 laboratory-confirmed, with one death (Bonito resident) and two additional deaths under investigation. In the last 14 days, Santa Rita do Pardo, Nioaque, Paranhos, Sidrolândia, Itaquiraí, Três Lagoas and Chapadão do Sul report low dengue incidence. Vaccination: 241,030 dengue doses received, 223,322 administered; 201,349 doses to the target group (10–14 years), two-dose schedule with a three-month interval. Public health guidance urges medical consultation for symptoms and elimination of standing water to reduce Aedes aegypti transmission.

triage.headline_ja: マットグロッソ・ド・スル州、チクングニア熱9,729例・28人死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱・デング熱ともにブラジルでは季節性・地域流行的に発生しており、症例数・死亡数は多いが「異常」とは言えず、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも示されていないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地方保健当局による定例の週次サーベイランス報告であり、ワクチン接種プログラムも既に実施中。地域流行の範囲内と考えられるため、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo em São Paulo: alta de casos acende alerta para vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles in São Paulo: Rise in Cases Raises Vaccination Alert
article.articleSummary: 15 confirmed measles cases in 2026 have triggered a state-wide vaccination push in São Paulo, Brazil. Authorities are expanding immunization to people aged 6–59 years and launching a multivaccination drive from August 3 to September 1 across all 645 municipalities, with particular focus on São Paulo city, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo due to high density and mobility. Vaccination coverage for the measles-containing vaccine remains below targets—77.5% first dose and 65.5% second dose—far from the 95% goal set by the Ministry of Health and WHO to ensure herd immunity and prevent re-emergence. The campaign centers on updating the vaccination record with the MMR (measles, mumps, rubella) vaccine, while also providing vaccines such as BCG, hepatitis B, polio, influenza, and COVID-19. The effort aims to curb transmission and avert outbreaks of a disease once considered eradicated.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロの麻疹：症例増加でワクチン接種への警戒強まる
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の再興という異常事象であり、ワクチン接種率が目標を下回っているため感染拡大の可能性がある。州政府が大規模な予防接種キャンペーンを実施しており、社会的・行政的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 症例数15件と限定的だが、ワクチン接種率が77.5%（1回目）・65.5%（2回目）とWHO目標の95%を大きく下回っており、再興リスクが高いとして州全域で大規模接種キャンペーンが開始されている。重症例・死亡についての記載はなし。

article.articleHeadline: मलेरिया का कहर: कोटा क्षेत्र में 10 दिनों में मिले 25 मरीज, 356 ग्रामीणों की जांच में 3 नए संक्रमित, स्वास्थ्य विभाग की टीम सक्रिय
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria Havoc: 25 Patients Detected in Kota Region in 10 Days; 3 New Infections Found in 356 Villagers Tested; Health Department Team Active.
article.articleSummary: Malaria in the Kota region: 25 cases detected over 10 days, with 3 new infections among 356 villagers tested at screening camps in Chhatouna, Shivtarai, Orapani, and Kenda villages. Of the new cases, two were admitted to Ganiyari Primary Health Center and one to SIMS Hospital; blood samples were collected from other feverish villagers. Seventy-two villages in the Kota area are already declared malaria-prone, and monsoon-season transmission risk is high. Past gaps in DDT spraying and mosquito-net distribution are cited as contributing factors. Health authorities are intensifying field visits and directing frontline teams to curb transmission, with ongoing screening and laboratory confirmation to monitor the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア猛威：コタ地域で10日間に25人の患者、356人の村民検査で3人の新規感染確認、保健当局チームが対応活動
triage.triage_reason: 地域的なマラリア流行で既知の流行地域における季節性の増加であり、IHR基準の該当は明確ではないが、感染継続リスクや対策不足の指摘があり経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: コタ地域は既にマラリア流行地域として認識されており、季節性（モンスーン期）の感染拡大。DDT散布・蚊帳配布の不足が指摘されているが、重症度や死亡についての情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: 驗出霍亂弧菌存水缸 圍封土瓜灣街市魚檔
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vibrio cholerae found in a water storage tank; To Kwa Wan Wet Market fish stall cordoned off.
article.articleSummary: Vibrio cholerae detected in a water tank at To Kwa Wan Wet Market fish stall 'Lianhe Fresh Fish' in Hong Kong; the stall has been sealed and a closure order issued by the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department, with operations suspended until sanitation improves. Laboratory confirmation came from the water sample. Infectious disease specialist Dr. Zeng Qiyin says V. cholerae is commonly associated with shellfish and can spread during transport via cross-contamination with other seafood, and may pose a person-to-person transmission risk if hand hygiene is poor. Authorities urge separating shellfish from other seafood and reinforcing hand hygiene at the stall. The report highlights cross-origin spread risk via transport or wholesalers, underscoring the need for vigilant hygiene across seafood supply chains.

triage.headline_ja: 水槽からコレラ菌検出、土瓜湾ウェットマーケットの魚屋を封鎖
triage.triage_reason: ヒト感染例は報告されておらず、水槽の環境検査でコレラ菌が検出され当該店舗が封鎖された事案。ただし食品供給チェーンでの交差汚染リスクが指摘されており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事案はヒト感染症例ではなく、魚介類卸売市場の水槽から環境サンプルとしてコレラ菌が検出されたもの。香港食物環境衛生署により当該店舗は封鎖済み。専門家は交差汚染や人-人感染の可能性を指摘しているが、現時点で確定患者の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: تطوير لقاح ضد سلالة "إيبولا".. و"الصحة العالمية" ترجّح نجاحه
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Development of a vaccine against the Ebola strain, and WHO predicts its success.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola vaccine candidate developed by Helman Laboratories in Singapore; WHO deems it the most likely to succeed against the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. The candidate uses the rVSV platform (like Ervebo) and reportedly can be stored in regular refrigerators for months, offering cheaper, broader distribution to remote areas. As of Friday, the DRC Ministry of Communications on X reported 3,532 Ebola cases and 1,556 deaths, making this the second-largest outbreak on record, surpassing the 2018–2020 total of 3,481 cases. The World Health Organization notes that the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak remains the largest, with 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. No licensed vaccine or treatment exists for this Bundibugyo strain yet, but trials are planned to accelerate clinical testing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ株に対するワクチン開発、WHOはその成功を有望視
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行が史上2番目の規模(3,532症例、1,556死亡)に達しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が確認されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで進行中のブンディブギョ株エボラ流行に対するワクチン開発が主題。シエラレオネ、リベリア、ギニアは2014-2016年の過去の流行の比較対象として言及されているのみで現在の発生国ではないため除外。シンガポールはワクチン開発企業の所在地であり発生国ではないため除外。アンゴラも対象国リストに含まれず、記事内での現行流行との関連も不明のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Após casos de sarampo, Ministério da Saúde recomenda vacina extra em três cidades de SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After measles cases, the Ministry of Health recommends an extra vaccine in three cities in the state of São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination campaign launched Aug 3–Sept 1 in the state of São Paulo (cities: São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo), Brazil, expanding coverage for people 6 months to 59 years. A new dose of the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine will be offered regardless of vaccination history through the SUS, alongside routine vaccines; dose zero is recommended for children 6–11 months to boost protection. Twenty-five? No, 17 measles cases identified this year, with 14 still under monitoring: 1 in Guarulhos, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 11 in São Paulo; 3 cases closed with no transmission risk. Investigations and containment measures are ongoing. Transmission is linked to importation in a highly mobile region with substantial international travel. Measles is highly contagious; symptoms include red rash and fever >38.5°C, plus cough, conjuntivitis, or malaise, prompting medical consultation.”}{

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹症例発生後、保健省がサンパウロ州の3都市で追加ワクチン接種を推奨
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で輸入例に関連した麻疹の集団発生（17例）が確認され、国際的な人の往来が活発な地域であることから国際拡大リスクが認められ、IHR基準に2項目該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 症例は輸入例に関連し、サンパウロ州内（サンパウロ市、グアルーリョス、サンベルナルド・ド・カンポ）で確認。保健省はワクチンキャンペーンで対応中であり、現時点で国外への支援要請は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: 3.532 κρούσματα Έμπολα - Η δεύτερη μεγαλύτερη επιδημία του ιού που έχει καταγραφεί ποτέ στη χώρα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: 3,532 Ebola cases - The second largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded in the country.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the second-largest ever recorded globally, government data published today show, as the virus continues to spread rapidly and outpace containment efforts. The DRC has logged 3,532 cases to date, surpassing the 3,481 cases recorded during the 2018-2020 outbreak. Deaths total 1,556, according to the Ministry of Communications on X. Only the West Africa outbreak of 2014-2016 was larger, with 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone, per the World Health Organization. The report does not detail symptoms or transmission specifics. This marks ongoing transmission as authorities assess response strategies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラ3,532症例 - 同国史上2番目に大規模な流行
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去2番目の規模のエボラ流行が進行中で、感染拡大が封じ込めを上回っており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にシエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアが含まれるが、これらは2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現在の流行地はDRCのみ。対象国リストにこれら4カ国は含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Toxina produzida por bactéria pode revolucionar combate a infecções, aponta estudo da USP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Toxin Produced by Bacteria Could Revolutionize the Fight Against Infections, According to a Study by the University of São Paulo
article.articleSummary: RhsF, a toxin produced by Chromobacterium violaceum, found in tropical regions and capable of causing severe infections in humans, could revolutionize antimicrobial therapy. The protein acts as a bacterial weapon during competition, delivered into rival cells via Type VI Secretion System, reducing or eliminating competitors. In the absence of RhsF, Chromobacterium violaceum shows reduced ability to suppress competitors. The toxin modifies RNA in target bacteria, an underexplored mechanism that may reveal new therapeutic targets against resistant infections. While promising, the work remains early-stage, with researchers pursuing the exact RNA substrates and how modifications lead to growth arrest or death. They identified the protective protein and determined the structure of the toxin-protective-protein complex, a key step for biotech applications. The study from USP Ribeirão Preto (FMRP), Brazil, published in Journal of Biological Chemistry, highlights microbial strategies for future medicine.

triage.headline_ja: 細菌が生成する毒素が感染症対策を革新する可能性、USPの研究が示す
triage.triage_reason: これは特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、細菌毒素の基礎研究に関する学術記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事象は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はChromobacterium violaceumの毒素RhsFに関する基礎研究の紹介であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや症例報告ではない。疾患名『Unknown Illness』はBluedotの誤分類と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's Ebola Outbreak Is World's Second-Largest Ever, Officials Call For Global Attention
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo reached 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths as of 2026-07-31. Officials say the fast-spreading crisis has become the world's second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, with a rapid surge in less than three months. The surge highlights the severity of the ongoing emergency and intensifies calls for greater international attention and support to containment efforts across the country. The report emphasizes nationwide impact, with cases and deaths tracked across the Democratic Republic of Congo. Details on specific regions, variants, or laboratory confirmation are not provided in the article. The authorities urge global action to mobilize resources, vaccines, and personnel to curb transmission and reduce mortality in this major public health crisis.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、史上2番目の規模に―当局が国際的な注目を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで史上2番目の規模（3,532症例、1,556死亡）に急拡大しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 致死率は約44%と高く、感染拡大速度も速いため、フルリスク評価による詳細な地域・変異株情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확진자 3천500명 넘어...역대 2번째 규모 - 미주 한국일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 3,500 — the second-largest on record.
article.articleSummary: As of July 29, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports Ebola Virus Disease with 3,532 confirmed cases, up 90 from the prior day, and 1,556 deaths (case fatality 44.1%). There are 807 patients in isolation or hospital and 626 recoveries. This outbreak surpasses the DR Congo’s 2018–2020 outbreak (3,481 cases, 2,299 deaths) to become the second-largest on record; only the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (over 28,000 cases and more than 11,000 deaths) was larger. The World Health Organization and Africa CDC warn that transmission is accelerating at an unprecedented pace. The outbreak was declared on May 15 in both the DR Congo and Uganda. In Uganda, there have been 20 cases and 2 deaths; the last confirmed case discharged on the 16th, and the Ugandan outbreak was declared over on the 28th.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ確定患者数が3,500人を超え、過去2番目の規模に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例が3,500人超・致死率44.1%と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、史上2番目の規模で感染拡大が加速中とWHO・Africa CDCが警告しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの流行は既に終息宣言済み（20例、2死亡）。アンゴラは記事本文で言及なく、発生地域データに含まれるが記事の主題ではないため除外。対象国リストにウガンダ・アンゴラは含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Surto na República Democrática do Congo: surto de Ebola se torna o segundo maior da história global e preocupa autoridades de saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola outbreak becomes the second-largest in world history and raises concerns among health authorities.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of Congo is facing an Ebola outbreak that is now the second-largest on record. As of July 31, 2026, 3,532 confirmed cases have been reported across five provinces, with 1,556 deaths. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which no widely available vaccine or treatment exists; a promising candidate vaccine from Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore) is highlighted by WHO. The epicenter is Ituri Province, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu, where armed groups such as M23 control large areas and hinder access to vulnerable populations. Cases have surged from about 2,000 to over 3,500 in weeks, underscoring urgent containment challenges amid ongoing conflict. The situation is described as highly concerning by international agencies and the scientific community due to the rapid transmission and high fatality rate in the initial months.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国での流行：エボラ出血熱の流行が世界史上2番目の規模となり、保健当局に懸念
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目規模のエボラ流行が進行中で、致死率が高く、武装勢力による対応阻害や国際的拡大リスクもあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: シンガポールはワクチン開発企業（Hilleman Laboratories）の所在地として言及されているのみで、感染発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: SP: alta de casos de sarampo aumenta preocupação dos serviços de saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SP: Rise in measles cases raises concerns among health services
article.articleSummary: Measles cases rise in São Paulo state, with 15 confirmed this year, prompting a reinforced vaccination push. In the metropolitan area, São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo have launched a multivaccination drive from August 3 to September 1, aiming to vaccinate those not immunized and provide a booster for children already vaccinated. The campaign centers on the MMR vaccine (measles, mumps, rubella) and allows updates to other routine vaccines. Preliminary 2026 coverage in the state shows 77.5% for the first MMR dose and 65.5% for the second, both below the 95% targets set by health authorities and WHO. For 2025, Guarulhos reported 91.59% D1 / 83.90% D2, São Bernardo do Campo 90.84% / 83.62%, and São Paulo city 90.79% / 83.63%. Tatiana Lang, state health secretary, emphasizes updating vaccination records to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: SP州:麻疹症例の増加で保健サービスの懸念高まる
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹症例が増加し、ワクチン接種率が世界保健機関目標(95%)を下回っており、行政が緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施するなど関係当局の関心が高まっているため。
triage.notes: 確認症例数は15件と少なく重症例・死亡の報告はないが、MMRワクチン接種率が目標を下回っており、地域保健当局が大規模な予防接種キャンペーンを実施している点から要注視。

article.articleHeadline: നാല് വകഭേദങ്ങളുടെ വ്യാപനമെന്ന് ഐ.സി.എം.ആർ, ഡെങ്കി ഉഗ്രരൂപിയാകും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ICMR says four variants are spreading; dengue will take a severe form.
article.articleSummary: As of July 2026, India faces four dengue virus serotypes (DEN-1 to DEN-4) spreading, with ICMR warning the disease could become life-threatening. Infection with one serotype may confer long-lasting immunity only to that serotype, while others may evade protection. Simultaneous circulation of all four serotypes raises the possibility of reinfection. Expanded viral mapping is under way to identify which serotype is dominant in different regions. All four serotypes have been detected in eight states and two union territories, but details are not disclosed. This comes as the country progresses its first dengue vaccination program. The Takeda-developed vaccine, referred to as Qudeng, may see delays, with public availability expected in the first half of 2027. Vaccine specifics: for ages 4–60, protects against all four serotypes, priced 3,000–6,000 INR per dose, with two doses at a three-month interval.

triage.headline_ja: ICMRは4つの変異株が拡大していると発表、デング熱は重症化する可能性
triage.triage_reason: ICMRが4種のデング血清型の同時流行と重症化リスクを警告しているが、具体的な症例数や死亡者数などの実態データが示されておらず、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ICMRによる4血清型同時流行の警告と、Takeda社開発のデングワクチン(Qudeng)の2027年上半期導入予定について言及。具体的な症例数・死亡者数のデータは記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Campo Grande confirma 12° caso de raiva em morcegos em 2026 e reforça orientações à população
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campo Grande confirms the 12th case of rabies in bats in 2026 and reiterates guidance to the public.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Campo Grande, Brazil: The Centro de Controle de Zoonoses (CCZ) confirms the 12th bat rabies case in 2026, with the infected animal found in the Pioneiros neighborhood, bringing the year's total positive bats to 12. Since January, CCZ teams have collected 772 bats in the capital. Although most bats tested are not infected, authorities maintain an ongoing alert and urge the public to avoid contact with bats, live or dead. If a bat is found on the ground, flying during the day, or hanging low, isolate it, secure people and pets, and call CCZ for collection and analysis. Dogs and cats should be up to date on rabies vaccination. A separate report from Paraíso das Águas describes a woman bitten twice by a vampire bat while sleeping; she received rabies prophylaxis and is doing well. Rabies is nearly 100% fatal after symptom onset but preventable with timely treatment.

triage.headline_ja: カンポグランデ、2026年に蝙蝠の狂犬病感染12例目を確認し、住民への注意喚起を強化
triage.triage_reason: コウモリの狂犬病は当該地域で継続的に監視されている既知の風土病で、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。人への感染例は予防的処置により対応済みで深刻な影響もない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体（CCZ）による通常のサーベイランス活動報告であり、地方レベルの公衆衛生対応として管理されている。人への咬傷例も予防処置済みで経過良好。

article.articleHeadline: Jogador de vôlei morre por dengue hemorrágica após disputar Jogos Regionais em Penápolis - Fernandópolis/SP - Jornal CidadãoNET
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Volleyball player dies of dengue hemorrhagic fever after competing in Regional Games in Penápolis – Fernandópolis, SP – Jornal CidadãoNET.
article.articleSummary: Dengue hemorrhagic fever killed 18-year-old volleyball player Fábio Ryan de Sena Pinto after competing at the Regional Games in Penápolis, São Paulo. Pinto, from Manaus, Amazonas, residing in Nova Esperança, Paraná, represented Pereira Barreto during the event. He arrived in Penápolis on July 18, played one match, and began showing symptoms the next day. He was treated at a local UPA and released, but his condition worsened and he was hospitalized again—first in Penápolis, then at Santa Casa, before transfer to Pereira Barreto and later to the Hospital Estadual de Mirandópolis. He remained hospitalized for eight days and died on July 30. The death certificate cited cerebral hemorrhage, cerebral edema, and brain herniation as complications of dengue hemorrhagic fever, a severe form of the disease. His family is seeking to transport the body to Manaus for burial.

triage.headline_ja: バレーボール選手、ペナポリスでの地域大会出場後にデング出血熱で死亡 ― フェルナンドポリス/SP、Jornal CidadãoNET
triage.triage_reason: デング出血熱による単一の死亡例であり、ブラジルでは同疾患は流行性があるため異常性は低いが、重症化・死亡例である点から経過観察が妥当。集団発生や社会的関心の高まりを示す情報は確認できない。
triage.notes: 本記事は個別死亡症例の報道であり、集団発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報は含まれていない。デングはブラジルで季節性・流行性疾患であるため、単独症例としての重症度（死亡）のみが確認される。続報でクラスター発生の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Jovem jogador de vôlei de 18 anos morre por complicações da dengue hemorrágica em Mirandópolis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 18-year-old volleyball player dies from complications of dengue hemorrhagic fever in Mirandópolis.
article.articleSummary: Dengue hemorrhagic fever fatalities: An 18-year-old Brazilian volleyball player, Fábio Ryan de Sena Pinto from Manaus, Amazonas, died in Mirandópolis, São Paulo, after eight days in hospital due to severe dengue complications including bleeding and brain swelling. He had joined an independent team based in Nova Esperança, Paraná for the Regional Games in Penápolis when symptoms began shortly after arrival. He sought care at Penápolis Emergency Care Unit twice and was released both times; his condition worsened, leading to admission at Santa Casa, then transfer to Pereira Barreto, and ultimately urgent transfer to the ICU in Mirandópolis. After his death, Pereira Barreto officials and the Paraná Volleyball Federation arranged the body’s transport to Amazonas. As of reporting, authorities had not confirmed inclusion of the death in regional dengue surveillance totals.

triage.headline_ja: 18歳のバレーボール選手、ミランドーポリスでデング出血熱の合併症により死亡
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルはデング熱流行国であり、本記事は個別の死亡例の報道にとどまり、集団発生や異常な増加を示すデータは含まれていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は個別患者（18歳男性）の死亡例に関する地域報道であり、デング出血熱のサーベイランス集計への反映は当局未確認と記載されている。二度の救急外来受診後に症状が悪化した経緯があり、医療対応の適切性が地域的関心事となる可能性はあるが、公衆衛生上の国際的シグナルとは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Menina de 12 anos morre por febre maculosa em Mimoso do Sul - Folha Vitória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 12-year-old girl dies of Rocky Mountain spotted fever in Mimoso do Sul - Folha Vitória
article.articleSummary: Rocky Mountain spotted fever (Rickettsia rickettsii) caused the death of a 12-year-old girl in Mimoso do Sul, southern Espírito Santo, Brazil. Diagnostic confirmation was provided by the Serviço de Verificação de Óbito (SVO). The death occurred on 27 July 2026 and prompted epidemiological and entomological investigations in areas identified as possible transmission sites, with ongoing surveillance for additional suspected cases. The star tick (carrapato-estrela) is reported as the main vector and is present throughout the municipality, leading health authorities to advise the public to avoid areas with rivers, pastures, and forests when possible and to follow protective measures recommended by health officials.

triage.headline_ja: ミモゾ・ド・スル(ブラジル)で12歳少女がロッキー山紅斑熱で死亡
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの一地域で発生した既知の風土病（マダニ媒介性リケッチア症）による単発の死亡例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクはなく、地域の保健当局が既に対応している。
triage.notes: ロッキー山紅斑熱（紫斑熱群リケッチア症）はブラジルで既知の風土病であり、マダニ（carrapato-estrela）媒介性でヒト-ヒト感染はしない。単一の死亡例であり、現時点で追加症例の報告や国際的な懸念は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo registra más de 3.500 casos de ébola en un nuevo pico epidémico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo records more than 3,500 Ebola cases in a new epidemic peak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths across five provinces, surpassing the total from the 2018–2020 epidemic. Declared May 15, the outbreak is centered in Ituri Province in the northeast near South Sudan and Uganda, accounting for about 90% of confirmed cases. The virus has spread to Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu amid ongoing conflict that hinders response, with M23-controlled areas complicating logistics. The Bundibugyo variant of Ebola (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing severe hemorrhagic fever. The region notes over 15,000 African deaths from Ebola in 50 years. International efforts include Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore) developing a vaccine candidate deemed promising by the WHO, and Oxford University beginning early-phase trials, with the first dose administered last week. Cross-border risk persists; Uganda recently ended its outbreak, but reintroduction remains a concern.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ、エボラ出血熱が3,500例を超え新たな流行ピークに達す
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴで2018-2020年流行を上回る3,532症例・1,556死亡を記録し、紛争地域での対応困難とヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクが認められるためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境リスクが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。シンガポールはワクチン開発拠点であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 🎙️" L'épidémie d'Ebola progresse plus rapidement que notre réponse "
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 🎙️"The Ebola outbreak is progressing faster than our response."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is advancing at an alarming pace: in two and a half months, more than 3,200 people infected, over 1,400 dead and about 580 recovered, with cases doubling roughly every twenty days. UN Ebola Response Coordinator Julien Harneis warns the outbreak is progressing faster than the response, widening the gap between needs and efforts. An audio excerpt describes a response driven by a remarkable mobilization of Congolese authorities, United Nations agencies, humanitarian organizations, health workers, volunteers, and local communities. But he cautions that this engagement is no longer enough to contain a ruthless virus that continues to gain ground, and he appeals for a surge of international solidarity. Remarks were collected by Priscilla Lecomte of OCHA for ONUInfo.

triage.headline_ja: 🎙️「エボラ出血熱の流行は我々の対応より速く進行している」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が急拡大しており（感染者3200人超、死者1400人超、20日毎に倍増）、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスク、国際支援の必要性が明確であるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 国連(OCHA/ONUInfo)によるエボラ対応責任者の警告報道。感染拡大速度が対応能力を上回っているとの指摘があり、致死率も高い（約44%）。国際社会への支援要請が明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: 'Fastest growing' outbreak in virus' history claims 1,500 lives in a few months
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, with no vaccine available, has caused what health officials call the fastest-growing outbreak in the virus’s history in the Democratic Republic of Congo. By 31 July 2026, the country reports more than 1,500 deaths and 3,360 confirmed cases across five eastern provinces, with Ituri province hardest hit due to intense transmission. The outbreak began on 15 May; the 45% case-fatality rate highlights its severity. Two-thirds of deaths occur among people who never sought care in a health facility, enabling transmission through handling of infected bodies. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the response is outpaced. Vaccine trials for the Bundibugyo strain began in July but could take up to four months to yield results; currently, no vaccine exists to curb the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが数ヶ月で1,500人の命を奪う
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でワクチン未対応のブンディブギョ株エボラが急拡大し、致死率45%・死者1,500人超という重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が対応の遅れに警鐘を鳴らしており、ワクチン未承認で死亡者の多くが医療施設未受診という状況から、感染拡大リスクと管理困難性が高い。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Deaths top 1500, More than 600 recoveries in DRC
article.articleSummary: As of 31 July 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) spans five provinces and 48 health zones. Ituri includes Bunia and zones such as Aru, Angumu, Damas; North Kivu includes Beni and Goma; South Kivu’s sole affected zone is Miti-Murhesa; Haut-Uélé includes Isiro and Boma Mangbetu; and Tshopo includes Lubunga and Mangobo. Cumulative confirmed cases: 3,532; hospitalized or in isolation: 807; recovered: 626; cumulative deaths: 1,556; case fatality rate: 44.1%; contact tracing rate: 78.7%. Declared May 15; linked to Bundibugyo virus with no approved vaccines or treatments. This is the world’s second largest outbreak on record and, within three months, has killed about five times more people than previous outbreaks at a comparable stage. Factors hampering response include delays in tracing, access barriers, mistrust and violence. Uganda declared Ebola-free after last patient discharge in mid-June.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:死者数1500人超、DRCで600人以上が回復
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、致死率44.1%と高く、5州48保健ゾーンに拡大、世界第2位規模の流行であるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダはエボラ終息宣言済みのため対象国リストに含まれないが該当しない（そもそも対象国リスト外）。コスタリカの地名が発生地域に含まれるが記事主題とは無関係のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Lucas do Rio Verde reforça combate à dengue após aumento no número de casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lucas do Rio Verde strengthens the fight against dengue after an increase in cases.
article.articleSummary: Lucas do Rio Verde's Health Department reports dengue confirmed cases rose from 153 to 173 in the past 30 days, with suspected cases increasing from 3 to 149. Despite a dry period, standing water in drains, plant pots and other sites sustains Aedes aegypti, which transmits dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The mosquito's development from egg to adult takes 7–10 days. To monitor and direct control, 300 ovitrampas have been placed across the municipality, with eggs found in 62% of traps in the latest count. An ovitrampa is a small container with brewer's yeast attractant, installed at homes and collected after five days to count eggs and guide interventions. Authorities urge residents to eliminate water-holding containers and report situations that facilitate Aedes proliferation.

triage.headline_ja: ルーカス・ド・ヒオ・ヴェルデ市、症例増加を受けデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の地域的な症例増加であり、通常の季節的流行対応の範囲内。国際的拡大や重篤性の高まりを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルでの通常のデング熱対策強化に関する記事であり、症例数も局所的。継続的なモニター対象ではあるがフルRRAは不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Niterói é referência no uso do método Wolbachia contra a dengue | Niterói | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Niterói is a reference in the use of the Wolbachia method to combat dengue | Niterói | O Dia
article.articleSummary: Wolbachia-based dengue control in Niterói, Brazil, highlighted at the 78th SBPC meeting. Initiated in 2015 in the Jurujuba neighborhood, the program achieved 100% city coverage by 2023 and is now deployed in 16 Brazilian cities, protecting about 5 million people. Internationally, the technology is used in 15 countries, benefiting more than 16 million people. Wolbachia bacteria, absent in Aedes aegypti, reduces transmission of dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and yellow fever and is self-sustaining as infected females pass it to offspring. In Niterói, 92% community approval supported releases, with studies showing an 89% decline in dengue cases after full-city coverage. The effort exemplifies translating research into a public-health tool and is expanding within Brazil’s national arbovirus prevention and control strategies, driven by science, monitoring, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: ニテロイ、デング熱対策としてのウォルバキア法の活用における参考事例に
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱制御の成功事例（ウォルバキア法）を紹介する内容であり、新規の感染拡大や公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症の発生報告ではなく、既存の予防的公衆衛生プログラム（ウォルバキア法）の成果を報告する内容。

article.articleHeadline: Covid, la nuova ondata in Cina non è un caso isolato: ecco tutti i focolai che si sono susseguiti dopo la pandemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19, the new wave in China is not an isolated case: here are all the outbreaks that followed the pandemic.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 remains circulating in China, with a new wave attributed to the Omicron NB.1.8.1 subvariant. Chinese CDC reports over 79,000 cases during the latest rise, though authorities deem the situation manageable. The surge follows a regular pattern since 2023, with peaks every six to nine months as immunity wanes and new subvariants spread. The episode echoes the spring 2023 XBB-driven post-pandemic wave, which injected cases but left severe disease contained thanks to vaccines and prior infections. From late 2023 to early 2024, China faced an epidemic of atypical pneumonia in children caused by Mycoplasma pneumoniae, linked to reduced exposure during lockdown and a so-called immune debt. Experts note that SARS-CoV-2 continues to evolve and that population-level immunity mitigates severe outcomes, so hospitalizations and ICU demand have not mirrored 2020. The virus is now considered endemic, fluctuating with cycles of activity linked to travel and indoor transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コロナ、中国での新たな流行の波は孤立した事例ではない：パンデミック後に続いた全ての流行を振り返る
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節的な波であり、当局が管理可能と評価し、免疫獲得やワクチンにより重症化も抑制されている定例的な流行パターンであるため、シグナルとしての新規性・緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は過去のパンデミック後の複数の流行（2023年XBB波、マイコプラズマ肺炎流行、今回のNB.1.8.1波）を振り返る総括的な内容であり、新規の緊急事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Study suggests Congo's Ebola outbreak began months before detection
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo began in January or earlier in Mongbwalu, Ituri province, long before official detection. A Science journal report based on interviews traced a transmission chain starting with a 50-year-old woman who died Jan 25 after vomiting blood; her mother died six days later, and her husband was ill but recovered. By the time Kinshasa identified Ebola, a large epidemic was underway. As of 2026-07-31, the outbreak has surpassed 3,530 cases and 1,556 deaths since its mid-May declaration, exceeding the ~3,470 cases of the 2018–2020 outbreak. Researchers identified over 500 suspected cases from mid-Jan to May 15. The Bundibugyo virus strain underpins the outbreak, with Ituri as the epicenter, and spread to Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. No vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo to date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、検知の数か月前から始まっていたことが研究で示唆
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が3,530症例・1,556死亡に達し2018-2020流行を上回る規模となっており、複数州へ拡大、有効なワクチン・治療法もないため公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 既に大規模流行が進行中でありRRAへの即時展開が必要。ワクチン・治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株である点も重症化・拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnam: Dengue cases rise in Ho Chi Minh City
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, reached 995 for the week ending July 27 (week 30), up 20% from the four-week average, according to the Ho Chi Minh City Center for Disease Control (HCDC). Cumulative 2026 dengue cases through week 30 total 23,481. Dengue, caused by a virus spread via Aedes mosquitoes, typically incubates up to 14 days and usually lasts less than a week. Common symptoms include fever, headache, nausea, vomiting, rash, muscle and joint pain, and minor bleeding. Dengue can progress to severe dengue, a medical emergency requiring hospitalization, with potential hemorrhage, shock, organ failure, and death. The report indicates ongoing dengue activity in Ho Chi Minh City and highlights the need for vector control and clinical vigilance during the season. A death toll is not provided in the briefing.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム:ホーチミン市でデング熱症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市で季節性のデング熱症例増加が報告されているが、例年の流行パターンの範囲内とみられ、死亡数や重症例の詳細も不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱は蚊媒介性感染症としてベトナムで毎年季節性に発生しており、週995件・累計23,481件という数字自体は多いが、平年比20%増という程度で異常事態とまでは言えない。死亡数の報告がなく重症度評価は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde visita 236 imóveis após primeiro caso de raiva em gato em Campinas desde 2016
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department visits 236 properties after first rabies case in a cat in Campinas since 2016.
article.articleSummary: Campinas reports its first cat rabies case since 2016. On 31 July 2026, the Zoonoses Surveillance Unit (UVZ) and Regional South Health Surveillance visited 236 properties around Cemitério da Saudade after rabies was confirmed by Instituto Pasteur. The infected cat, found at the cemetery, was rescued and died. Rabies transmits via bites, scratches, or saliva contact with mucous membranes or wounds. Efforts to identify human contacts have not located anyone; teams will return Saturday to previously empty locations. A veterinary clinic employee who treated the cat was scratched but, being rabies-vaccinated, received human rabies post-exposure prophylaxis. Anyone suspecting exposure should contact UVZ at (19) 2515-7044 for assessment. Prevention emphasized: vaccinate animals annually, keep pets indoors, avoid handling unknown street animals, do not touch injured animals (call Samu Animal at 156), and avoid contact with bats. Leaflets were distributed; UVZ maintains ongoing notification of suspected rabies cases with veterinary clinics.

triage.headline_ja: カンピナスで2016年以来初の猫の狂犬病症例確認後、保健局が236軒の家屋を訪問
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地域における猫の狂犬病単発事例であり、人への感染は確認されず、暴露者にはワクチン接種歴があり適切にPEPが実施され地域保健当局により管理されている。
triage.notes: 動物由来の単発症例で、地域保健当局が迅速に対応・管理しており、ヒト感染や地域拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : flambée sans précédent en RDC avec plus de 3.500 cas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Unprecedented outbreak in the DRC with more than 3,500 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the DRC reaches 3,532 confirmed cases in five provinces over two and a half months, with 1,556 deaths, authorities say. This 17th DRC outbreak, declared May 15, is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. It is centered in Ituri province near Uganda and South Sudan borders, where about 90% of cases have occurred; transmission also reported in North Kivu and South Kivu, where armed groups like ADF and M23 control parts of territory. Transmission often occurs during funerary rites; health workers face distrust and fragile health infrastructure amid ongoing conflict. Uganda reports end of its Ebola outbreak, but risk persists per WHO. Vaccines: a WHO-promoted candidate to be developed by Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore) and an Oxford University Bundibugyo vaccine in early human trials using the same platform as the AstraZeneca COVID vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:コンゴ民主共和国で前例のない大流行、感染者3,500人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行(3,532症例、死亡1,556人)が発生し、ワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株が原因。武装勢力による治安悪化で対応が困難であり、国際的拡大・支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは自国のエボラ流行終息を報告済み。ワクチン開発（シンガポール・オックスフォード大学）は治療研究の文脈であり、発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。COVID-19が疾患名に含まれるが記事本文はエボラに関する内容のみ。

article.articleHeadline: 南市第5例境外移入 台南女越南返國確診登革熱
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tainan's fifth imported case: Dengue fever diagnosed in a woman who returned from Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: On 30 July 2026, Tainan City diagnosed its fifth imported dengue fever case this year: a female resident of Yongkang District who had returned from Vietnam. She traveled 23 June–29 July and developed fever on 28 July; diagnosis was confirmed on 30 July. In response, the Dengue Prevention and Control Center, along with health authorities and the district office, conducted emergency spraying, elimination of breeding sites, mosquito density surveillance, and health education around her residence to prevent spread. Taiwan’s Centers for Disease Control reported by 31 July a total of 108 dengue cases for the year, comprising 7 local and 101 imported cases, with Indonesia as the main source, followed by Vietnam and the Maldives. Authorities advise travelers to wear light-colored long-sleeved clothing and apply government-approved anti-mosquito repellents in endemic areas to reduce infection risk.

triage.headline_ja: 南市第5例境外移入 台南女越南返國確診登革熱
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における輸入デング熱の単発症例であり、通常の検疫対応がなされている。異常性・重症性・国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: デング熱の発生国は台湾であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれないため verified_locations は空。感染源地としてベトナム・インドネシア・モルディブが言及されているが、これらは輸入元であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Lolwa : le manque de logistique paralyse la riposte contre l'épidémie - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Lolwa: Lack of logistics paralyzes the outbreak response - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of July 31, 2026, Ebola in Lolwa health zone, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is severely hampered by logistics gaps. Medical chief Dr. Patrick Mbarikane says only one motorcycle is operational for the entire Lolwa area, limiting mobility for surveillance, infection prevention and control, risk communication and community engagement, and dignified and safe burials. Since the outbreak began, eight confirmed Ebola cases have been recorded with three deaths; two patients have recovered and returned to their communities (one in Lolwa, one in Pekele). Of ten health areas in the zone, three are affected, with Pekele and Lolwa hosting active transmission foci; Lolwa houses the main reference hospital. Poor telecommunications coverage in seven health areas impedes real-time data transmission, and there is a risk of stockouts of essential PCI and EDS supplies. Authorities are calling for rapid logistical reinforcement to bolster the response.

triage.headline_ja: ロルワでのエボラ出血熱：物流不足が流行対応を麻痺させている - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例と死亡が発生しており、対応体制の物流不足による深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念とヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR2005における重大な公衆衛生上の緊急事態評価対象疾患であり、物流不足による対応の遅延がさらなる感染拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تعلن تفشيًا لفيروس إيبولا في عدة مقاطعات شرق البلاد - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo declares an Ebola outbreak in several eastern provinces.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa reports, as of 31 July 2026, that the Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing an Ebola outbreak affecting several eastern provinces, with more than 3,500 cases recorded in the past two months, exceeding totals seen during 2018-2020. Health authorities describe ongoing transmission in a region long plagued by conflict for over 30 years. Ebola virus disease is transmitted by contact with infected body fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever; over the past five decades, the disease has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa. The briefing highlights a steep, continuing outbreak in conflict-affected eastern DRC, underscoring the public health challenge in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、東部の複数州でエボラ出血熱の流行を宣言
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部で過去2018-2020年の流行を上回る3500例超のエボラ症例が報告されており、紛争地域での継続的な人-人感染が示唆されるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 3500例超という規模は過去のエボラ流行を大きく上回り、紛争地域での対応困難さが懸念される。続報でWHOのリスク評価・国際対応状況を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Tracking the Ebola outbreak in the Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 31 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo virus, has expanded by thousands of cases over the past week and is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in the DRC to date. More than 1,500 deaths have been recorded since the outbreak was declared on 15 April. The rapid case growth signals mounting transmission and a substantial ongoing public health challenge for the region. The report centers on updates from Catch Me Up and highlights the current situation without detailing laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. The segment invites viewers to watch Catch Me Up Live on Scripps News, with discussion times and viewer participation information included.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行を追跡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最速の拡大を見せるエボラ流行であり、死者1,500人超と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: バンディブギョウイルスによる流行で、DRC史上最速の拡大とされる。国際的拡大や渡航制限の有無については記事内で言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: У Фінляндії вперше виявили вірус АЧС, під загрозою - експорт свинини
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Finland, the African swine fever virus has been detected for the first time, threatening pork exports.
article.articleSummary: Finland confirmed its first African swine fever virus (ASFV) detections near the Russia border in South Karelia. The virus was found on July 24 and 27 in three wild boars: a dead infected piglet in one location and two boars skeletonized in another. A restricted zone now surrounds the affected area, including several farms raising domestic pigs; one farm houses about 3,000 pigs, with others smaller. Veterinarians will inspect all holdings in coming days. Finland has about one million domestic pigs and roughly 3,000 wild boars, concentrated in the southeast and south near the border. The ASF outbreak threatens pork production and exports, which total about EUR 74 million outside the EU annually; exports may be halted until new terms are agreed with non-EU partners, including China. Annual pork production is about 160 million kg, with around 30 million kg exported, and Asia demand rising.

triage.headline_ja: フィンランドで初のアフリカ豚熱ウイルス検出、豚肉輸出に脅威
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は野生イノシシ・家畜豚に限定された動物疾病でヒトへの健康影響はなく、発生国（フィンランド）は対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: 中国は輸出先として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため対象外。フィンランド・ロシアは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak in Congo Becomes Second-Deadliest on Record
article.articleSummary: As of late July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, driven by the Bundibugyo strain with no approved vaccines or treatments, has surpassed 3,500 confirmed cases and 1,550 deaths (case fatality about 44%) within under three months of declaration. The epicenter is Ituri province, which accounts for about 90% of cases, with detections in five provinces including Kisangani. Transmission is outpacing response efforts. Contact tracing covers roughly 78% of known contacts, well below the 90–95% target. Insecurity, community mistrust, artisanal mining-related movement, and shortages of health workers and supplies compound control challenges. A significant share of deaths occur in communities rather than treatment centers, complicating safe burial practices. Uganda reported imported cases but has declared itself free after discharge; no new cases have been reported there. WHO warns official numbers may understate the true scale. Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak; sustained funding, access, and community trust are critical.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、史上2番目に死者数が多い流行に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目(深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大)に該当し、致死率約44%・3500例超という重大なエボラ流行であるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダは輸入症例のみで、既にfree宣言されているため対象国リストにも含まれず除外。コンゴの第17次エボラ流行であり、資金・アクセス・地域社会の信頼確保が課題とされる。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Πάνω από 3.500 κρούσματα, η χειρότερη επιδημία στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 3,500 cases, the worst outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo faces the largest Ebola outbreak in its history, with more than 3,500 confirmed cases within months. Since the outbreak was declared on 15 May, laboratory-confirmed cases total 3,532, with 1,556 deaths, according to Kinshasa authorities. The epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, accounting for about 90% of cases, with spread to four other provinces including North Kivu and South Kivu under M23 control. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids; funerals are a common setting for spread, and the Bundibugyo strain currently has no vaccine or treatment. Ongoing armed conflict and weak state presence hinder response. Recently, over 30 civilians died in Ituri in attacks by ADF, an ISIS-linked group. Vaccine developments: a World Health Organization–promoted vaccine will be developed by Hilleman Laboratories; an Oxford/AstraZeneca–based vaccine is also being trialed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：3,500人以上の症例、コンゴ史上最悪の流行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行かつ武力紛争下で対応が困難なため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約44%（1,556/3,532）と非常に高く、Bundibugyo株にはワクチン・治療法が未確立。ITuri州が中心だがNorth Kivu・South Kivuを含む5州に拡大、武装勢力（M23、ADF）の活動により対応が著しく困難な状況。国際機関（WHO、Hilleman Laboratories、Oxford/AstraZeneca）によるワクチン開発支援が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 3 605 cas confirmés et 1 587 décès au 30 juillet, une 49e zone de santé touchée à Kisangani
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths as of July 30, the 49th health zone affected in Kisangani.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo: as of July 30, 2026, 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths across five provinces (Haut-Uele, Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, and Tshopo); 651 recoveries and 748 patients in isolation or hospital. Provisional case fatality rate 44.0%; contact tracing 75.3% (operational threshold 95%). Health zones affected reach 49 of 140; Kisangani’s Kabondo urban health zone is newly listed with Lubunga, Makiso-Kisangani, and Mangobo. Tshopo has four zones affected; Wanie-Rukula flagged but not yet in official totals. No province-level breakdown provided. Daily changes: +73 cases, +31 deaths; recoveries +25; active isolations down to 748. No vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola; Ervebo covers Zaïre strain. A Phase 1 trial of ChAdOx1 BDBV started July 24. Field advances include Andisa in Ituri reopening to response teams, and Bas-Uele deployment to Vianda, Poko, Ganga to bolster surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：7月30日時点で確定症例3,605件、死亡1,587人、キサンガニで49番目の保健区域が影響
triage.triage_reason: 致死率44%、49保健区域に拡大、接触者追跡率が運用閾値を下回るなど、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な状況が継続しており、国際的拡大リスクも認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株にはワクチン・承認治療法がなく、ChAdOx1 BDBVの第1相治験が7月24日開始。接触者追跡率75.3%は運用閾値95%を下回り、感染制御に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo é contagioso? Saiba quem corre mais risco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is measles contagious? Find out who is at greater risk.
article.articleSummary: Measles remains highly contagious. In São Paulo, Brazil, a 1-year-old unvaccinated child in Guarulhos is the 15th measles case of 2026, signaling ongoing transmission. In the United States, measles activity in 2025–2026 exceeds totals from 2000–2024, indicating renewed spread as vaccination coverage fluctuates. The virus is airborne and can linger in an environment for up to two hours after the infected person leaves. Transmission can occur from about six days before rash onset to four days after. Early symptoms resemble other respiratory infections: high fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes, malaise; Koplik spots may appear inside the mouth. There is no antiviral cure; care is supportive. Vaccination with the measles-containing vaccine (MMR) is essential. Brazil’s schedule includes two doses for 12 months–29 years; a dose zero may be given during outbreaks. Maintaining high vaccination coverage is key to preventing further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹は感染力が強い？リスクが高いのは誰か
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で麻疹の散発例（2026年15例目）が報告されているが、重症例や死亡の報告はなく、教育的内容が中心のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹の基礎知識・予防啓発が主目的で、ブラジルの症例数（15例）は小規模。米国の麻疹流行拡大にも言及があるが対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 'Promising' ebola vaccine in the works
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has caused nearly 1,500 deaths; there are no vaccines or treatments for this strain. Several vaccine efforts are in play to curb the escalating outbreak; the World Health Organization regards a single-dose rVSV-based vaccine as the most promising candidate. Singapore-based Hilleman Laboratories said it would advance the rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine to human trials. A local organisation announced it will develop an Ebola vaccine described as the 'most promising' for this strain. Ebola is a viral haemorrhagic fever spread by close contact and infected bodily fluids. Ongoing outbreak remains a public health concern in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of 1 August 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 有望なエボラワクチンが開発中
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクで約1500人が死亡しており、有効なワクチン・治療法が存在しない深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため。
triage.notes: シンガポールは発生地域ではなく、ワクチン開発企業（Hilleman Laboratories）の所在地であるため verified_locations から除外した。ブンディブギョ株には現在有効なワクチンや治療法がなく、死者数が約1500人に達している点で極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠检测阳性率超20% 南方省份高于北方
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 test positivity rate exceeds 20%; southern provinces higher than northern.
article.articleSummary: China’s CDC weekly sentinel surveillance of acute respiratory infections (Week 30, 2026) shows COVID-19 test positivity rising above 20% for July 20–26, 2026. Influenza-like illness (ILI) accounts for 4.4% of ED/outpatient visits, higher in the south (6.1%) than the north (2.8%). In ILI respiratory samples, SARS-CoV-2 positivity is 20.3%, influenza 14.5%, and enteroviruses 5.9%. Among hospitalized SARI patients, positivity is 9.5% for SARS-CoV-2, 6.4% for influenza, and 4.3% for enteroviruses. All detected pathogens are known; no unknown pathogens or new emergence. The dominant SARS-CoV-2 lineage remains NB.1.8.1, with higher positivity in southern provinces and the 15–59-year-old group. Influenza activity is at a low level, mainly B(Victoria) and A(H3N2). Rhinovirus and enterovirus positivity rates are falling, especially among ≤14-year-olds; human metapneumovirus and parainfluenza viruses also decline, mainly affecting 0–4-year-olds. Other monitored respiratory pathogens remain at low levels.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナ検査陽性率が20%を超える 南部の省は北部より高い
triage.triage_reason: 中国CDCの定期呼吸器サーベイランス報告で、COVID-19陽性率が上昇しているが検出病原体は全て既知であり新規性はない。重症度データが不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 定期的な急性呼吸器感染症サーベイランス報告であり、既知の病原体（SARS-CoV-2 NB.1.8.1株、季節性インフルエンザ、エンテロウイルス等）の動向を示すもの。新規病原体の出現や重症化の急増を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Augmentation du nombre d'infections au VIH au Canada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in the number of HIV infections in Canada.
article.articleSummary: Canada recorded about 2,517 new HIV infections in 2024, up 22.8% from 2022, with British Columbia reporting 166 cases in 2024, up 24.8% from 2022. Canada remains the only G7 country with rising HIV diagnoses in recent years. Dr. Sean Yaphé of Montreal’s Centre de santé sexuelle l’Actuel links the uptick to a regional pattern in Manitoba, Alberta and Saskatchewan, notably among cisgender heterosexual women, Indigenous peoples, and people who inject drugs. Prevention campaigns have largely targeted LGBTQ+ communities, leaving other groups underserved and with low PrEP prescribing. Michael Kwag of the Centre for Community Research notes that men who have sex with men remain overrepresented (42% of new infections) though they constitute about 5% of the population. Barriers extend to Indigenous, African, Black and Caribbean communities, drug users, newcomers and refugees; funding for community HIV work has stagnated for two decades. Vancouver’s Darren Ho warns the epidemic is not over; Kwag and Yaphé attended the International AIDS Conference in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: カナダにおけるHIV感染者数の増加
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はカナダにおけるHIV感染者数の慢性的な増加傾向を報じたものであり、対象国（ブラジル等）は国際会議の開催地として言及されているのみで、感染症の発生地域ではない。対象国に関連する公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はカナダ国内のHIV統計であり、ブラジル（リオデジャネイロ）は国際エイズ会議の開催地として言及されているのみで、対象国における感染症発生ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak 2026: DR Congo's Ebola Crisis Now Ranks as Second Worst in History
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo variant Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) persists as the second-worst Ebola crisis in history, with no approved vaccine or treatment available. The outbreak location is predominantly eastern DRC, where dozens of armed groups operate and attacks on medical facilities disrupt response efforts. Health workers face a dangerous security environment, hindering surveillance, containment, and care delivery. Deep cuts to foreign aid funding have reduced available resources at a critical moment, exacerbating strain on response teams. The combination of a rare Ebola strain and ongoing conflict creates difficult containment conditions, delaying outbreak management and heightening transmission risk, while communities endure continued fear and disruption as authorities continue to respond in a war zone.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行2026年：DRコンゴのエボラ危機、史上2番目に深刻な流行に
triage.triage_reason: 承認されたワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株エボラが史上2番目の深刻度に達しており、紛争地域での対応困難により国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 承認ワクチン・治療法がないこと、武装勢力による医療施設攻撃、資金不足による対応能力低下が重なり、封じ込めが著しく困難な状況。史上2番目の規模との記述から重症度・規模ともに高いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Τα κρούσματα ξεπέρασαν τα 3.500 στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Cases surpassed 3,500 in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Over 3,532 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 1,556 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo within about two and a half months, amid the 17th outbreak in the country. The epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, adjoining South Sudan and Uganda, where roughly 90% of cases have occurred. Transmission is mainly via contact with bodily fluids and funeral practices; healthcare workers face elevated risk. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or cure today. The outbreak was declared on May 15. The epidemic has spilled into four other provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu, whose capitals are controlled by M23 rebels. Violence in Ituri from the ADF has killed many civilians (over 30). Uganda has announced the end of its outbreak, but WHO cautions ongoing risk. A vaccine candidate from Hilleman Laboratories is in development; Oxford University’s vaccine, using similar tech to AstraZeneca, has begun in volunteers.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴでの症例が3,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行が3,500例・1,556死亡（致死率約44%）に達し、複数州へ拡大、ワクチン未承認の状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンは発生地域として記載されているが、記事の主題はDRC国内のエボラ流行であり、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダは既に流行終息を宣言済み。武装勢力（M23、ADF）の活動により対応が一層困難な地域であることに留意。

article.articleHeadline: Ταχύτατη η εξάπλωση του Εμπολα - Πάνω από 3.500 κρούσματα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapid spread of Ebola — over 3,500 cases.
article.articleSummary: By August 1, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is battling an explosive Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) in its northeast Ituri province, with 3,532 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths reported over roughly two and a half months since the outbreak was declared on May 15. Ituri accounts for about 90% of cases, while four other provinces, including North Kivu and South Kivu, have reported transmissions; Ugandan authorities had earlier declared an end to their Ebola outbreak, though risk remains per the WHO. The epidemic is characterized by transmission during funerals and through contact with bodily fluids, in a context of fragile state authority and ongoing armed conflict, including attacks by the ADF in Ituri, killing many civilians. The strain, Bundibugyo, currently lacks a licensed vaccine or treatment. Vaccines under development include a candidate from Hilleman Laboratories and another Oxford/AstraZeneca-based vaccine; early volunteers have started dosing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ急速拡大 ― 症例数3,500人超
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北東部で確認症例3,532例・死亡1,556例に達する爆発的なエボラ流行が進行中で、ワクチン未承認の株かつ紛争地域での対応困難という重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは以前流行終息を宣言済みだが対象国リストに含まれず、WHOはリスク残存を指摘。ブンディブギョ株にはライセンス済みワクチン・治療法が存在せず、Hilleman LaboratoriesおよびOxford/AstraZeneca由来の候補ワクチンの治験が開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: Second-Largest Ebola Outbreak Hits Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo is battling the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, driven by the rare Bundibugyo variant with no approved vaccines or treatments. As of July 31, 2026, the DR Congo public health ministry reports 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths, making it the second-largest outbreak after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone). Bundibugyo has a 30–50% fatality rate; fruit bats are suspected reservoirs, with human transmission via contact with infected blood, secretions, or other bodily fluids. Security challenges and reduced foreign aid in eastern DR Congo hinder containment, with access and contact tracing severely limited. WHO estimates true infections may be up to four times higher than reported. In neighboring Uganda, 20 infections and 2 deaths were reported earlier, and the outbreak was declared Ebola-free on July 28.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目に大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に加え、WPRO基準も全項目該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける現在進行中のBundibugyo型エボラ流行が主題。ウガンダは過去の関連流行（既にエボラフリー宣言済み）、ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年流行との比較対象であり、いずれも現在の主発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 변종 에볼라 역대 두 번째 규모로 확산...3개월 만에 사망자 1556명
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola variant in the Democratic Republic of the Congo spreads on the second-largest scale in history... 1,556 deaths in three months.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached the second-largest outbreak on record, driven by the Bundibugyo variant. By late July, 3,532 confirmed cases and 1,556 deaths have been reported, ranking behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) with 28,616 cases and 11,310 deaths. The Bundibugyo variant is rare, with a 30–50% fatality rate, and there are no approved vaccines or treatments. Transmission occurs via contact with blood, secretions, and other bodily fluids; fruit bats are suspected reservoirs. In eastern DRC, armed groups and conflict hinder access, vaccine/therapy deployment, and contact tracing, straining health workers. WHO has cautioned that the true scale may be up to four times higher than official counts due to security and reporting gaps. In nearby Uganda, a separate outbreak was declared Ebola-free after 20 infections and 2 deaths, with no onward transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の変異エボラ、史上2番目の規模で拡大…3か月で死者1,556人
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が史上2番目の規模で拡大し、致死率30-50%、武力紛争によりアクセス・対応が困難で、WHOは実際の規模が公式報告の最大4倍の可能性を指摘しており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にシエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニア・ウガンダも含まれるが、これらは過去の流行(2014-2016西アフリカ)や既に終息した別のウガンダ流行の言及であり、現在進行中の主題はDRCのみ。ウガンダの流行は既にエボラフリー宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: 中国第三批埃博拉抗疫医疗专家组赴刚果（金）
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The third batch of China's Ebola outbreak medical expert team heads for the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa)
article.articleSummary: On August 1, 2026, the third batch of China’s Ebola outbreak medical expert team departed Beijing for the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) to support Ebola outbreak containment. Building on the prior two batches, the team includes specialists from the National Health Commission, General Administration of Customs, Zhejiang University School of Medicine's First Affiliated Hospital, and the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention, with expertise in epidemiology, health quarantine, clinical treatment, and pathogen laboratory testing. They will conduct on-the-ground technical assistance, share prevention and control practices, and refine Ebola response procedures to strengthen local autonomous capacities. The group will work with Congo’s health authorities, medical teams, and international organizations to deepen joint prevention and sustain aid effectiveness.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、エボラ出血熱対策のため第3陣の医療専門家チームをコンゴ民主共和国（キンシャサ）へ派遣
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続しており、中国が既に3回目となる医療支援チームを派遣するなど国際的な関与と支援が続いている状況であり、IHR基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事は中国からの医療支援チーム派遣（第3陣）についての報道であり、エボラ出血熱の発生国はコンゴ民主共和国（キンシャサ）。中国は支援国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。既に複数回の派遣が行われていることから、アウトブレイクが継続的かつ深刻な状況にあることが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Julho Amarelo reforça alerta para prevenção e diagnóstico precoce das hepatites virais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: July Yellow Reinforces the Alert for Prevention and Early Diagnosis of Viral Hepatitis.
article.articleSummary: July is Brazil's viral hepatitis awareness month, highlighting prevention and early diagnosis. Hepatitis B and C are the most concerning due to risk of chronic infection and progression to cirrhosis and liver cancer. Experts warn many people live with the diseases silently; symptoms, when they appear, include fatigue, nausea, loss of appetite, abdominal pain, jaundice, dark urine, and pale stools, but many cases remain asymptomatic, especially B and C. Prevention varies: Hepatitis A relies on hygiene and safe water/food; Hepatitis B prevention includes vaccination, safe sex, and not sharing sharp instruments; Hepatitis C prevention centers on avoiding contact with contaminated blood and ensuring sterilized materials, as there is no vaccine. The Hep B vaccine is freely available in SUS; typically three doses. Diagnosis is via blood tests, with rapid tests in health units; treatment is free through SUS, with highly effective cures for Hep C and controllable Hep B.

triage.headline_ja: ジュライ・イエロー、ウイルス性肝炎の予防と早期診断を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: これはブラジルの啓発月間キャンペーンに関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定の感染急増や異常事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は疾病流行の報告ではなく、ブラジル保健省の啓発キャンペーン（Julho Amarelo）に関する一般情報記事。

article.articleHeadline: 珠海部署蚊媒传染病防控工作 附市民日常防护指南
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zhuhai Deploys Mosquito-Borne Infectious Disease Prevention and Control Measures, with Daily Protective Guidelines for Citizens.
article.articleSummary: Zhuhai authorities unveiled strengthened prevention and control for Aedes-borne diseases, focusing on chikungunya fever and dengue fever, amid hot, rainy weather and heavy travel. At a July 31 municipal meeting chaired by Wu Zetong, officials urged strict implementation of the '1113' emergency-disposal protocol to rapidly detect cases, escalate responses, and cut transmission chains. The plan targets source reduction at hotspots—agricultural markets, tourist areas, construction sites, old communities, inner waterways, and vacant lots—alongside enhanced vector surveillance, sentinel medical monitoring, and coordinated actions with Hengqin and Macau. Public health education, adequate supplies, and streamlined, flattened emergency command were emphasized. Daily protective guidance for residents includes: remove standing water (weekly for water plants; wash containers), ensure ventilation and dryness, install and seal screens and nets, use approved anti-mosquito products, and observe safety when spraying indoors. Outdoors, wear light clothing and apply repellents.

triage.headline_ja: 珠海市が蚊媒介感染症の予防対策を展開、市民向け日常防護ガイドラインを発表
triage.triage_reason: 珠海市によるデング熱・チクングニア熱の季節的予防対策発表であり、具体的な症例急増や異常事態を示すデータはないが、蚊媒介感染症の流行しやすさから継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な症例数や流行拡大を報告するものではなく、珠海市・香港マカオ地域における予防的な行政対応の発表である。実際の感染状況を示す続報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 9 pigs in Cebu City test positive for ASF
article.articleSummary: ASF detected in Cebu City, Philippines, with nine pigs in Barangay Quiot testing positive after three of 22 died, leaving 19 tested; nine were positive. All 19 pigs were culled with the raiser’s permission, as officials aim to contain local transmission. Dr. Jessica Maribujoc, head of DVMF, said contamination is local and that the raiser is the barangay’s only hog producer, located far from the general population in a mountainous area near the barangay border. Biosecurity measures urged include cleaning and weekly disinfection of trucks and pigpens, keeping feeds away, separating other animals, washing hands, bathing and changing clothes on arriving home, footwear outside the pen, and limiting visitors and gadgets near pigs. Officials also encouraged pig registration and insurance to enable government assistance if illness occurs.

triage.headline_ja: セブ市の豚9頭がASF(アフリカ豚熱)陽性
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（アフリカ豚熱）であり人への健康影響はなく、局所的な発生で当局が防疫措置を実施済みのためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 動物のみの感染症であり人獣共通感染症ではないため、公衆衛生上の脅威は限定的。地方当局により迅速に殺処分・防疫対応済み。

article.articleHeadline: 广州一月子会所婴儿感染后续：防控解除日期延至8月4日
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Follow-up on infant infections at a Guangzhou postpartum confinement center: date for lifting prevention and control measures extended to August 4.
article.articleSummary: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) infections have been detected among several infants at Hui Ci Hu Ai Maternity Center Luxe Yuexiu Branch in Guangzhou’s Yuexiu District. Initial mild symptoms (cough, runny nose) progressed in some cases, with affected babies receiving medical care after leaving the facility. Public health authorities conducted supervision, improving ventilation and disinfection, and the center paused admitting new infants during the revision period. On July 30, the center forecast lifting prevention measures after eight days with no new cases, but on July 31 authorities extended the tentative lifting date to August 4. Access now requires appointment only; entrants undergo temperature checks, wear masks, and must not touch infants, with visits limited to up to three people and conducted via window. The event coincides with the August 1 implementation of GB/T 33855-2026, the national standard for maternal-infant health service institutions, expanding regulatory scope and mandating comprehensive infection-control records and staffing practices.

triage.headline_ja: 広州のある産後ケアセンターでの乳児感染続報：防疫措置解除日を8月4日に延期
triage.triage_reason: 特定の産後ケア施設内でのRSV感染事例であり、当局が既に管理措置を実施しているが、対策解除が延期されており今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: RSVは乳幼児によく見られる感染症であり、単一施設内での限定的な集団感染事例。当局が既に対応措置（換気改善、消毒、新規入所停止、面会制限等）を講じており、国際的な拡大リスクは低いと考えられる。ただし対策解除の延期（8月4日まで）が続いており、施設内での感染継続の可能性があるため経過観察が望ましい。
